`Godot-MCP.Tests/ResPathNormalizerTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The res:// path normalizer (<see cref="ResPathNormalizer"/>) RQL's editor source reuses (files, resources, scenes).
    /// Pure string logic, so it runs in the plain xUnit host with no Godot binary.
    /// </summary>
    public class ResPathNormalizerTests
    {
        // ---- ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir ------------------------------------------------------

        [Theory]
        // Empty/null/'res://' all map to the project root.
        [InlineData(null, "res://")]
        [InlineData("", "res://")]
        [InlineData("res://", "res://")]
        // A directory path gets a trailing slash.
        [InlineData("res://materials", "res://materials/")]
        [InlineData("res://materials/", "res://materials/")]
        // Nested.
        [InlineData("res://a/b/c", "res://a/b/c/")]
        // Whitespace trimmed.
        [InlineData("  res://materials  ", "res://materials/")]
        public void NormalizeDir_Normalizes(string? raw, string expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir(raw));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NormalizeDir_Rejects_NonResPath()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir("/abs/path"));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir("user://x"));
        }

        // ---- ResPathNormalizer.IsResPath / RequireResFilePath ------------------------------------

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("res://x.tres", true)]
        [InlineData("res://", true)]
        [InlineData("user://x", false)]
        [InlineData("/abs", false)]
        [InlineData("", false)]
        [InlineData(null, false)]
        public void IsResPath_Detects(string? path, bool expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, ResPathNormalizer.IsResPath(path));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RequireResFilePath_AcceptsResFile_TrimsWhitespace()
        {
            Assert.Equal("res://materials/wood.tres",
                ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath("  res://materials/wood.tres  ", "p"));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RequireResFilePath_Rejects_NonResAndDirectory()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath("/abs/x.tres", "p"));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath("res://materials/", "p"));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(null, "p"));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RequireResFilePath_BareScheme_RejectsWithRootSpecificMessage()
        {
            // 'res://' passes IsResPath (it IS a res:// path) but names the project root, not a file. The
            // message must say so accurately rather than the misleading "not a directory".
            var ex = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath("res://", "p"));
            Assert.Contains("project root", ex.Message);
            Assert.DoesNotContain("not a directory", ex.Message);
        }

        // ---- ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath -------------------------------------------------------

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("res://levels/a.tscn", true)]
        [InlineData("res://levels/a.SCN", true)]
        [InlineData("res://levels/a.tres", false)]
        [InlineData("res://levels/a.tscn.bak", false)]
        [InlineData(null, false)]
        public void IsScenePath_MatchesSceneExtensions(string? path, bool expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(path));
        }

        // ---- ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir (mkdir-parents derivation) ------------------------------

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("res://scenes/level.tscn", "res://scenes/")]
        [InlineData("res://a/b/c.tres", "res://a/b/")]
        [InlineData("res://thing.tres", "res://")] // file directly under the project root
        [InlineData("  res://scenes/level.tscn  ", "res://scenes/")] // trims
        public void ParentDir_DerivesParentDirectory(string filePath, string expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(filePath));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ParentDir_Rejects_NonResAndDirectory()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir("/abs/level.tscn"));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir("res://scenes/")); // a dir, not a file
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(null));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RequireResFilePath_Rejects_ParentTraversalSegment()
        {
            // A '..' segment would let res://a/../a/b.tres and res://a/b.tres compare unequal while denoting
            // the same file — reject it so the src==dst path-equality guards hold.
            var ex = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(
                () => ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath("res://a/../a/b.tres", "p"));
            Assert.Contains("..", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NormalizeDir_Rejects_ParentTraversalSegment()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir("res://a/../b"));
        }

        // ---- protected files, moves, dependencies (DeleteResource / MoveResource) -----------------------

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("res://project.godot", true)]
        [InlineData("res://Project.Godot", true)]
        [InlineData("res://.godot/imported/x.ctex", true)]
        [InlineData("res://addons/godot_mcp/plugin.cfg", true)]
        [InlineData("res://ADDONS/Godot_Mcp/x.cs", true)]
        [InlineData("res://./project.godot", true)]
        [InlineData("res://addons//godot_mcp/x.cs", true)]
        [InlineData("res://addons/other/plugin.cfg", false)]
        [InlineData("res://materials/project.godot", false)]
        [InlineData("res://scenes/level.tscn", false)]
        public void ProtectedFileProblem(string path, bool isProtected)
            => Assert.Equal(isProtected, ResPathNormalizer.ProtectedFileProblem(path) != null);

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("res://a/mat.tres", "res://b/mat2.tres", false)]
        [InlineData("res://a/mat.tres", "res://a/mat.TRES", false)]
        [InlineData("res://a/mat.tres", "res://a/mat.res", true)]
        [InlineData("res://a/img.png", "res://a/img.jpg", true)]
        [InlineData("res://a/noext", "res://a/noext2", false)]
        public void MoveProblem_FlagsAnExtensionChange(string src, string dst, bool problem)
            => Assert.Equal(problem, ResPathNormalizer.MoveProblem(src, dst) != null);

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("res://a/bin.res", "res://a/BIN.res", true)]
        [InlineData("res://a/bin.res", "res://a/bin.res", false)]
        [InlineData("res://a/bin.res", "res://a/bin2.res", false)]
        public void IsCaseOnlyRename(string src, string dst, bool expected)
            => Assert.Equal(expected, ResPathNormalizer.IsCaseOnlyRename(src, dst));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("uid://bb35l34tvp488::::res://exp/sub.tscn", "res://exp/sub.tscn", null, true)]
        [InlineData("uid://bb35l34tvp488::PackedScene::res://exp/moved.tscn", "res://exp/sub.tscn", "uid://bb35l34tvp488", true)]
        [InlineData("res://exp/sub.tscn::PackedScene", "res://exp/sub.tscn", null, true)]
        [InlineData("res://exp/sub.tscn", "res://exp/sub.tscn", null, true)]
        [InlineData("uid://other::::res://exp/sub2.tscn", "res://exp/sub.tscn", "uid://bb35l34tvp488", false)]
        [InlineData("res://exp/sub.tscn.bak", "res://exp/sub.tscn", null, false)]
        [InlineData("uid://x::::res://Exp/Sub.tscn", "res://exp/sub.tscn", null, true)] // Windows / macOS: the same file
        public void DependencyNames_MatchesPathOrUid(string entry, string path, string? uid, bool expected)
            => Assert.Equal(expected, ResPathNormalizer.DependencyNames(entry, path, uid));
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/ResourceConverterTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Text.Json;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reflection;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model;
using Godot;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Coverage for <see cref="Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter"/>. These exercise only the pure-managed
    /// surface — type matching (by inheritance distance over <see cref="Type"/> tokens) and deserialization
    /// of the <see cref="ResourceRef"/> shape. Constructing a native Godot <c>Resource</c>/<c>Mesh</c> would
    /// fault the test host (P/Invoke with no Godot runtime), so the live <c>ResourceLoader.Load</c> path and
    /// the serialize-from-live-resource path are verified by the headless Godot smoke (test.md Suite 3), not
    /// here. <c>typeof(BoxMesh)</c> etc. are safe — a Type token triggers no native call.
    ///
    /// <para>
    /// Serial (issue #195): these facts mutate the process-wide
    /// <see cref="Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter{T}.ResourceResolver"/>, so they must not run in
    /// xUnit's parallel pool alongside another class that snapshots the same static. Enforced by
    /// <see cref="TestIsolationGuardTests"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    [Collection(GodotConverterRegistrationTests.CollectionName)]
    public class ResourceConverterTests
    {
        static Reflector NewReflector() => GodotReflectorFactory.CreateDefaultReflector();

        // The converter's SerializationPriority scores by inheritance distance from Godot.Resource, so it must
        // produce a positive score for the exact Resource type AND every Resource-derived type. A non-Resource
        // type must score 0 (cannot handle).
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(Resource))]
        [InlineData(typeof(Mesh))]
        [InlineData(typeof(BoxMesh))]
        [InlineData(typeof(Material))]
        [InlineData(typeof(Texture2D))]
        [InlineData(typeof(PackedScene))]
        public void Converter_Matches_ResourceAndDerivedTypes(System.Type type)
        {
            var converter = new Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter();
            Assert.True(converter.SerializationPriority(type) > 0,
                $"Expected the Resource converter to match '{type.Name}'.");
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(Vector3))]
        [InlineData(typeof(Color))]
        [InlineData(typeof(string))]
        [InlineData(typeof(int))]
        public void Converter_DoesNotMatch_NonResourceTypes(System.Type type)
        {
            var converter = new Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter();
            Assert.Equal(0, converter.SerializationPriority(type));
        }

        // The exact Resource type must outscore a derived type, so a more-specific converter (if ever added)
        // can win by exact match while this one still covers the whole subtree.
        [Fact]
        public void Converter_ExactResource_OutscoresDerived()
        {
            var converter = new Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter();
            Assert.True(converter.SerializationPriority(typeof(Resource)) >
                        converter.SerializationPriority(typeof(BoxMesh)));
        }

        // The registered reflector must actually pick THIS converter for a Resource-derived type — proving the
        // registration in GodotReflectorFactory routes Mesh/BoxMesh through the reference converter instead of
        // the generic instantiate-and-populate fallback that fails with "Instance creation failed".
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(Resource))]
        [InlineData(typeof(BoxMesh))]
        [InlineData(typeof(Material))]
        public void Reflector_SelectsResourceConverter_ForResourceTypes(System.Type type)
        {
            var reflector = NewReflector();
            var converter = reflector.Converters.GetConverter(type);
            Assert.IsType<Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter>(converter);
        }

        // A null/absent value clears the property (assign null) without throwing.
        [Fact]
        public void Deserialize_NullValue_ReturnsNull()
        {
            var reflector = NewReflector();
            var data = new SerializedMember { typeName = typeof(BoxMesh).GetTypeId() };
            var result = reflector.Deserialize(data, fallbackType: typeof(BoxMesh));
            Assert.Null(result);
        }

        // An empty ref ({} with neither resourcePath nor instanceId) also clears the property.
        [Fact]
        public void Deserialize_EmptyRef_ReturnsNull()
        {
            var reflector = NewReflector();
            var emptyRefJson = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new ResourceRef());
            var data = SerializedMember.FromJson(typeof(BoxMesh), emptyRefJson);
            var result = reflector.Deserialize(data, fallbackType: typeof(BoxMesh));
            Assert.Null(result);
        }

        // With NO resolver installed (the plain unit-test host), a non-empty ref does not throw — it degrades
        // to null. The live resolution is wired only under #if TOOLS and verified by the Suite-3 smoke.
        [Fact]
        public void Deserialize_NonEmptyRef_NoResolver_ReturnsNullWithoutThrowing()
        {
            // Ensure no resolver leaks in from another test.
            Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter.ResourceResolver = null;

            var reflector = NewReflector();
            var refJson = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new ResourceRef("res://box_mesh.tres"));
            var data = SerializedMember.FromJson(typeof(BoxMesh), refJson);

            var logs = new Logs();
            var result = reflector.Deserialize(data, fallbackType: typeof(BoxMesh), logs: logs);
            Assert.Null(result);
        }

        // With a resolver installed, a non-empty ref is handed to it and its result is returned. We stand in a
        // plain object for the "live resource" and pass typeof(object) as the target type so the converter's
        // assignability guard (targetType.IsInstanceOfType(resolved)) passes — this exercises the resolver
        // wiring end-to-end with NO native Godot type. The static delegate is shared across the converter's
        // closed generic types, so setting it on the base entry reaches the instance under test.
        [Fact]
        public void Deserialize_NonEmptyRef_WithResolver_ReturnsResolved()
        {
            ResourceRef? seenRef = null;
            var standIn = new object();
            Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter.ResourceResolver = (ResourceRef r, out object? res, out string? err) =>
            {
                seenRef = r;
                res = standIn;
                err = null;
                return true;
            };
            try
            {
                var converter = new Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter();
                var reflector = NewReflector();
                var refJson = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new ResourceRef("res://wood.tres"));
                var data = SerializedMember.FromJson(typeof(object), refJson);

                // typeof(object) as the target makes the assignability guard accept the plain stand-in.
                var result = converter.Deserialize(reflector, data, fallbackType: typeof(object));

                Assert.Same(standIn, result);
                Assert.NotNull(seenRef);
                Assert.Equal("res://wood.tres", seenRef!.ResourcePath);
            }
            finally
            {
                Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter.ResourceResolver = null;
            }
        }

        // ToResourceRef on a null resource yields an empty (invalid) ref — the pure-managed slice of the
        // serialize side (the live-resource branch needs a native Resource → Suite 3).
        [Fact]
        public void ToResourceRef_Null_YieldsEmptyRef()
        {
            var resourceRef = Godot_Resource_ReflectionConverter<Resource>.ToResourceRef(null);
            Assert.False(resourceRef.IsValid());
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlBulkCreateOptionsTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>A stand-in for the editor source: records what each bulk-create call received.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlFakeEditor
    {
        public readonly List<(string type, NodeOptions? options)> Created = new List<(string, NodeOptions?)>();

        [RqlCallable("test creation method")]
        public string CreateNode(string className, NodeOptions? options = null)
        {
            Created.Add((className, options));
            return className + Created.Count;
        }

        public string? ValidateCreateNode(string className, NodeOptions? options) =>
            options?.Name == "Reject" ? "a rejected name" : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The options object of <c>editor.CreateNode(class, {…})</c> / <c>editor.InstantiateScene(path, {…})</c> as RQL hands it over
    /// once per stream item (the node creation itself is native and verified by the live smoke): name, parent and Godot
    /// properties split, values kept as written, item metas evaluated per call, and the batch rule against duplicate names.
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlBulkCreateOptionsTests
    {
        private readonly RqlFakeEditor _editor = new RqlFakeEditor();

        private QueryResult Mutate(string q, bool dryRun = false)
        {
            var engine = new RqlEngine();
            engine.Mutations.Enabled = true;
            engine.AddSource("editor", () => _editor);
            engine.AddAdapter(new Godot_NodeOptions_Adapter());
            return engine.Execute(q, null, new QueryOptions { AllowMutation = true, DryRun = dryRun });
        }

        private static string Text(QueryResult r) => AgentFormat.Render(r, OutputFormat.Table);

        [Fact]
        public void ARangeCallsOncePerItemWithThatItemsOptions()
        {
            var r = Mutate("range(0, 3) | call editor.CreateNode(\"MeshInstance3D\", {name: \"Cube\" + $, parent: \"Props\", position: [$ * 2, 0, 0], Visible: false})");
            Assert.True(r.Ok, Text(r));
            Assert.Equal(3, r.Rows!.Count);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "Cube0", "Cube1", "Cube2" }, _editor.Created.Select(c => c.options!.Name));
            var last = _editor.Created[2].options!;
            Assert.Equal("Props", last.Parent);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "position", "Visible" }, last.Properties.Select(p => p.Key));
            Assert.Equal(new object?[] { 4.0, 0.0, 0.0 }, ((IEnumerable<object?>)last.Properties[0].Value!).ToArray());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AListLiteralStreamsItsEntries()
        {
            var r = Mutate("[[\"CoinA\", 1], [\"CoinB\", 2]] | call editor.CreateNode(\"Node3D\", {name: $[0]})");
            Assert.True(r.Ok, Text(r));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "CoinA", "CoinB" }, _editor.Created.Select(c => c.options!.Name));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void OptionsAreOptional()
        {
            Assert.True(Mutate("range(0, 2) | call editor.CreateNode(\"Node3D\")").Ok);
            Assert.All(_editor.Created, c => Assert.Null(c.options));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("range(0, 2) | call editor.CreateNode(\"Node3D\", \"Cube\")", "object literal")]
        [InlineData("range(0, 2) | call editor.CreateNode(\"Node3D\", {name: 5})", "'name' must be a string")]
        public void ABadOptionsValueFailsBeforeTheFirstCall(string query, string expected)
        {
            var r = Mutate(query);
            Assert.False(r.Ok);
            Assert.Contains(expected, Text(r));
            Assert.Empty(_editor.Created);
        }

        // The host's check runs for every item before the first call: item 2 failing leaves items 0 and 1 uncreated.
        [Fact]
        public void ARejectedItemStopsTheCallBeforeAnyNodeIsMade()
        {
            var r = Mutate("range(0, 3) | call editor.CreateNode(\"Node3D\", {name: ($ == 2 ? \"Reject\" : \"N\" + $)})");
            Assert.False(r.Ok);
            Assert.Contains("a rejected name", Text(r));
            Assert.Empty(_editor.Created);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ADryRunCreatesNothing()
        {
            var r = Mutate("range(0, 5) | call editor.CreateNode(\"Node3D\", {name: \"N\" + $})", dryRun: true);
            Assert.True(r.Ok, Text(r));
            Assert.Equal(5, r.Rows!.Count);
            Assert.Empty(_editor.Created);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DuplicateNamesUnderOneParentAreFound()
        {
            var root = new object();
            var props = new object();
            Assert.Null(NodeOptions.DuplicateName(new[] { (root, (string?)"A"), (root, "B"), (props, "A"), (root, null), (root, null) }));
            Assert.Equal("B", NodeOptions.DuplicateName(new[] { (root, (string?)"A"), (props, "B"), (props, "B") }));
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlCallableTextTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>The text form of a Callable ("target::method", CallableText).</summary>
    public class RqlCallableTextTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Player::_on_hit", "Player", "_on_hit")]
        [InlineData(" Level/Player :: hide ", "Level/Player", "hide")]
        [InlineData(".::queue_free", ".", "queue_free")]
        [InlineData("res://ui/menu.tres::Script_x1::_ready", "res://ui/menu.tres::Script_x1", "_ready")]
        [InlineData("Node3D#123456::show", "Node3D#123456", "show")]
        public void TargetAndMethodSplitAtTheLastSeparator(string text, string target, string method)
        {
            Assert.True(CallableText.TryParse(text, out var t, out var m, out var reason), reason);
            Assert.Equal(target, t);
            Assert.Equal(method, m);
            Assert.Equal(target + "::" + method, CallableText.Format(t, m));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Player")]
        [InlineData("::hide")]
        [InlineData("Player::")]
        [InlineData("Player::not a method")]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData(null)]
        public void OtherTextIsRejectedWithTheForm(string? text)
        {
            Assert.False(CallableText.TryParse(text, out _, out _, out var reason));
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(reason));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ReferencesAreClassAndInstanceId()
        {
            var m = CallableText.Reference.Match("StaticBody3D#1598684208646");
            Assert.True(m.Success);
            Assert.Equal("StaticBody3D", m.Groups["type"].Value);
            Assert.Equal("1598684208646", m.Groups["id"].Value);
            Assert.False(CallableText.Reference.IsMatch("Level/Player"));
            Assert.False(CallableText.Reference.IsMatch("res://a.tres"));
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlEditorHistoryAndGameLogTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The pure parts of what wave-3 agent runs found missing: <c>editor | call Undo() / Redo()</c> (the report and the action
    /// names), the <c>gameLog</c> source (Godot's game log text as entries) and the radians warning of a degree-sized Rotation.
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlEditorHistoryAndGameLogTests
    {
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- undo / redo

        [Fact]
        public void ActionNameIsTheQueryOnOneLine()
        {
            Assert.Equal("RQL: nodes | where name == \"A\" | set Visible = false",
                HistoryStepText.ActionName("nodes |\n  where name == \"A\"\r\n| set   Visible = false"));
            Assert.Equal("RQL mutation", HistoryStepText.ActionName("   "));
            Assert.Equal("RQL mutation", HistoryStepText.ActionName(null));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LongQueriesAreCut()
        {
            var name = HistoryStepText.ActionName(new string('x', 500), max: 20);
            Assert.Equal("RQL: " + new string('x', 19) + "…", name);
        }

        private static List<HistoryState> States(params (ulong v, string a)[] s) => s.Select(x => new HistoryState(x.v, x.a)).ToList();

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- files: deps / usedBy

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("uid://b1x::Texture2D::res://art/a.png", "uid://b1x", "res://art/a.png")]
        [InlineData("uid://b1x::::res://art/a.png", "uid://b1x", "res://art/a.png")]
        [InlineData("res://scenes/house.tscn", null, "res://scenes/house.tscn")]
        [InlineData("res://scenes/house.tscn::PackedScene", null, "res://scenes/house.tscn")]
        [InlineData("uid://b1x::Texture2D::", "uid://b1x", null)]
        [InlineData("", null, null)]
        [InlineData(null, null, null)]
        public void DependencyEntriesGiveTheirUidAndPath(string? entry, string? uid, string? path) =>
            Assert.Equal((uid, path), com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools.ResPathNormalizer.DependencyParts(entry));

        [Fact]
        public void PendingUndoListsTheCurrentActionFirst()
        {
            var names = new[] { "a", "b", "c", "d" };
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "c", "b", "a" }, HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: true, current: 2, count: 4, i => names[i]).ToArray());
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "d (global)" }, HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: false, current: 2, count: 4, i => names[i], " (global)").ToArray());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PendingIsEmptyAtTheEndsAndCapped()
        {
            Assert.Empty(HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: true, current: -1, count: 3, i => "x"));
            Assert.Empty(HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: false, current: 2, count: 3, i => "x"));
            Assert.Equal(HistoryStepText.MaxListed, HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: true, current: 99, count: 100, i => "x" + i).Count());
            Assert.Equal("x99", HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: true, current: 99, count: 100, i => "x" + i).First());
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "(unnamed action)" }, HistoryStepText.Pending(undo: false, current: -1, count: 1, i => "").ToArray());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UndoNamesTheActionTheMovedHistoryHadBefore()
        {
            var before = States((4, "Global thing"), (10, "RQL: rename"));
            var after = States((4, "Global thing"), (9, "RQL: add crates"));
            Assert.Equal("undone: RQL: rename", HistoryStepText.Describe(undo: true, before, after));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RedoNamesTheActionTheMovedHistoryHasAfter()
        {
            var before = States((3, "older"), (9, "RQL: add crates"));
            var after = States((4, "Project setting"), (9, "RQL: add crates"));
            Assert.Equal("redone: Project setting", HistoryStepText.Describe(undo: false, before, after));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(true, "nothing to undo")]
        [InlineData(false, "nothing to redo")]
        public void NothingMovedIsAnError(bool undo, string message)
        {
            var same = States((1, "a"), (2, "b"));
            var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => HistoryStepText.Describe(undo, same, same));
            Assert.StartsWith(message, ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AnUnnamedActionStillReports() =>
            Assert.Equal("undone: (unnamed action)", HistoryStepText.Describe(true, States((2, "")), States((1, ""))));

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- game log

        // What Godot 4.5's file logger wrote for a game run from the editor (wave-3 run: a push_error and an out-of-range index).
        private const string Log =
            "Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.mono.official.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org\n" +
            "Vulkan 1.4.351 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090\n" +
            "\n" +
            "W3 game ready\n" +
            "ERROR: W3 boom at 1s\n" +
            "   at: push_error (core/variant/variant_utility.cpp:1024)\n" +
            "   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):\n" +
            "       [0] _process (res://w3/game.gd:10)\n" +
            "SCRIPT ERROR: Invalid access of index '3' on a base object of type: 'Array'.\n" +
            "   at: _process (res://w3/game.gd:12)\n" +
            "WARNING: low fps\n" +
            "     at: something (x.cpp:1)\n" +
            "door open = true\n";

        [Fact]
        public void ParsesPrintsErrorsAndWarningsWithTheirLocations()
        {
            var e = GameLogText.Parse(Log);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "Log", "Error", "Error", "Warning", "Log" }, e.Select(x => x.LogType));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }, e.Select(x => x.Sequence));
            Assert.Equal("W3 game ready", e[0].Message);
            Assert.Equal("W3 boom at 1s", e[1].Message);
            Assert.Equal("at: push_error (core/variant/variant_utility.cpp:1024)\nGDScript backtrace (most recent call first):\n[0] _process (res://w3/game.gd:10)",
                e[1].StackTrace);
            Assert.Equal("Invalid access of index '3' on a base object of type: 'Array'.", e[2].Message);
            Assert.Equal("at: _process (res://w3/game.gd:12)", e[2].StackTrace);
            Assert.Equal("low fps", e[3].Message);
            Assert.Equal("door open = true", e[4].Message);
            Assert.Equal("", e[4].StackTrace);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandlesCrLfAndNoBannerAndEmpty()
        {
            var e = GameLogText.Parse("hello\r\nUSER ERROR: bad\r\n   at: f (res://a.gd:1)\r\n");
            Assert.Equal(2, e.Count);
            Assert.Equal("hello", e[0].Message);
            Assert.Equal(("Error", "bad", "at: f (res://a.gd:1)"), (e[1].LogType, e[1].Message, e[1].StackTrace));
            Assert.Empty(GameLogText.Parse(""));
            Assert.Empty(GameLogText.Parse(null));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ABannerWithoutRendererLineKeepsTheEntries()
        {
            // A headless game: the version line, then its prints at once (no renderer line, no blank line).
            var e = GameLogText.Parse("Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.mono.official - https://godotengine.org\nfirst print\nERROR: x\n");
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "first print", "x" }, e.Select(x => x.Message));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SplitMutationPartsAreRecognized()
        {
            Assert.True(HistoryStepText.IsPart("undone: RQL: q" + HistoryStepText.ScenePart));
            Assert.True(HistoryStepText.IsPart("redone: RQL: q" + HistoryStepText.GlobalPart));
            Assert.False(HistoryStepText.IsPart("undone: RQL: q"));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IndentedPrintsStayPrints()
        {
            // Only an error / warning collects indented lines; a print may itself start with spaces.
            var e = GameLogText.Parse("a\n   indented print\n");
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "a", "   indented print" }, e.Select(x => x.Message));
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- radians

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Rotation")]
        [InlineData("rotation")]
        [InlineData("Rotation.X")]
        [InlineData("GlobalRotation")]
        public void RadiansMembers(string member) => Assert.True(RotationUnits.IsRadiansMember(member));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("RotationDegrees")]
        [InlineData("RotationDegrees.Y")]
        [InlineData("props[\"rotation\"]")]
        [InlineData("Position")]
        public void OtherMembers(string member) => Assert.False(RotationUnits.IsRadiansMember(member));

        [Fact]
        public void DegreeSizedAnglesWarnWithTheDegreeMember()
        {
            // The wave-3 agent's sun: set Rotation = "(-45, 35, 0)".
            var w = RotationUnits.Warning("Rotation", new double[] { -45, 35, 0 });
            Assert.NotNull(w);
            Assert.Contains("Rotation is in radians", w);
            Assert.Contains("set RotationDegrees = (-45, 35, 0)", w);
            Assert.Contains("(-2578.31, 2005.35, 0)°", w);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void OneAngleAndLowerCaseMembers()
        {
            var w = RotationUnits.Warning("rotation.y", new double[] { 90 });
            Assert.Contains("set RotationDegrees.y = 90", w);
            Assert.Contains("5156.62°", w);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(3.14159, 0, 0)]
        [InlineData(-6.28, 1.5, 0)]
        [InlineData(0, 0, 0)]
        public void RadianSizedAnglesDoNotWarn(double x, double y, double z) =>
            Assert.Null(RotationUnits.Warning("Rotation", new[] { x, y, z }));

        [Fact]
        public void DegreeMembersNeverWarn() => Assert.Null(RotationUnits.Warning("RotationDegrees", new double[] { 90, 0, 0 }));
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlEnumNamesTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Generic;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// <see cref="GodotEnumNames"/>: an enum-hinted int property (grow_horizontal) or a class-enum method argument
    /// (Control.LayoutPreset) takes the name an agent writes — the inspector's, the C++ / C# constant, or a short form.
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlEnumNamesTests
    {
        // grow_horizontal's real hint labels; its setter's enum constants (Control.GrowDirection) differ from them.
        private static readonly List<(string, long)> Grow = GodotEnumNames.ParseHint("Left,Right,Both");

        private static readonly List<(string, long)> GrowConstants = new List<(string, long)>
        {
            ("Left", 0), ("Right", 1), ("Both", 2), ("GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN", 0), ("GROW_DIRECTION_END", 1), ("GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH", 2),
        };

        private static readonly List<(string, long)> Preset = new List<(string, long)>
        {
            ("PRESET_TOP_LEFT", 0), ("PRESET_TOP_RIGHT", 1), ("PRESET_CENTER_LEFT", 4), ("PRESET_CENTER", 8),
            ("PRESET_LEFT_WIDE", 9), ("PRESET_FULL_RECT", 15),
        };

        [Fact]
        public void ParsesImplicitAndExplicitValues()
        {
            Assert.Equal(new List<(string, long)> { ("Left", 0), ("Right", 1), ("Both", 2) }, Grow);
            Assert.Equal(new List<(string, long)> { ("Off", 0), ("On", 5), ("Auto", 6), ("Max", 10) }, GodotEnumNames.ParseHint("Off,On:5,Auto, Max:10"));
            Assert.Empty(GodotEnumNames.ParseHint(""));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Both", 2)]
        [InlineData("both", 2)]
        [InlineData("RIGHT", 1)]
        [InlineData("GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH", 2)] // ends with the label's word
        public void MatchesHintNames(string text, long expected)
        {
            Assert.True(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(Grow, text, out var value));
            Assert.Equal(expected, value);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN", 0)]
        [InlineData("GrowDirectionEnd", 1)]
        [InlineData("Begin", 0)]
        [InlineData("Left", 0)]
        public void MatchesSetterConstantsBesideTheLabels(string text, long expected)
        {
            Assert.True(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(GrowConstants, text, out var value));
            Assert.Equal(expected, value);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN")] // the labels alone do not know the constant (Godot 4.3 has no setter lookup)
        [InlineData("h")]
        [InlineData("Rend")]
        [InlineData("oth")]
        public void SuffixesMatchWholeWordsOnly(string text) => Assert.False(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(Grow, text, out _));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("PRESET_FULL_RECT", 15)]
        [InlineData("PresetFullRect", 15)]
        [InlineData("FullRect", 15)]
        [InlineData("full_rect", 15)]
        [InlineData("Center", 8)]
        [InlineData("LeftWide", 9)]
        public void MatchesClassConstants(string text, long expected)
        {
            Assert.True(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(Preset, text, out var value));
            Assert.Equal(expected, value);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Sideways")]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData("__")]
        [InlineData("Left")] // ends PRESET_TOP_LEFT and PRESET_CENTER_LEFT: ambiguous, refused rather than guessed
        public void RefusesUnknownOrAmbiguous(string text)
        {
            var options = text == "Left" ? Preset : Grow;
            Assert.False(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(options, text, out _));
        }

        // directional_shadow_mode: inspector labels with a note, and its setter's constants (DirectionalLight3D.ShadowMode).
        private static readonly List<(string, long)> ShadowMode = new List<(string, long)>
        {
            ("Orthogonal (Fast)", 0), ("PSSM 2 Splits (Average)", 1), ("PSSM 4 Splits (Quality)", 2),
            ("SHADOW_ORTHOGONAL", 0), ("SHADOW_PARALLEL_2_SPLITS", 1), ("SHADOW_PARALLEL_4_SPLITS", 2),
        };

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("PSSM 4 Splits", 2)] // the label without its note (was refused: wave-3 agent run)
        [InlineData("pssm 2 splits", 1)]
        [InlineData("Orthogonal", 0)]
        [InlineData("Parallel4Splits", 2)] // the C# enum name: digits are a word of their own (was refused)
        [InlineData("Parallel2Splits", 1)]
        [InlineData("SHADOW_PARALLEL_4_SPLITS", 2)]
        [InlineData("PSSM 4 Splits (Quality)", 2)]
        public void MatchesLabelsWithoutTheirNoteAndCSharpNamesWithDigits(string text, long expected)
        {
            Assert.True(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(ShadowMode, text, out var value));
            Assert.Equal(expected, value);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("4 Splits")] // [4, splits] ends SHADOW_PARALLEL_4_SPLITS only
        public void DigitWordsStillMatchWholeWords(string text)
        {
            Assert.True(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(ShadowMode, text, out var value));
            Assert.Equal(2, value);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Splits")] // ends PSSM 2, PSSM 4 and both constants: ambiguous
        [InlineData("Parallel")]
        public void AmbiguousDigitlessWordsAreRefused(string text) => Assert.False(GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(ShadowMode, text, out _));

        [Fact]
        public void DescribesTheOptions() =>
            Assert.Equal("one of: Left, Right, Both (or its number)", GodotEnumNames.Describe(Grow));
    }
}
```

```cs
/*

#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql;
using Rql;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The agent guide of the RQL tools (<see cref="RqlGuide"/>): every example parses, mutate examples end with set / call,
    /// and <c>Godot-Tests/rql-guide-examples.json</c> — the list the live CI smoke (scripts/smoke_rql.py) runs against a real
    /// editor — mirrors the guide exactly.
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlGuideTests
    {
        public static IEnumerable<object[]> QueryExamples() => RqlGuide.QueryExamples.Select(e => new object[] { e });
        public static IEnumerable<object[]> MutateExamples() => RqlGuide.MutateExamples.Select(e => new object[] { e });

        [Theory]
        [MemberData(nameof(QueryExamples))]
        public void QueryExamplesParse(string query)
        {
            Assert.True(RqlParser.TryParse(query, out var plan, out var error), $"'{query}': {error?.Message}");
            Assert.NotNull(plan);
        }

        [Theory]
        [MemberData(nameof(MutateExamples))]
        public void MutateExamplesParseAndEndWithSetOrCall(string query)
        {
            Assert.True(RqlParser.TryParse(query, out _, out var error), $"'{query}': {error?.Message}");
            var last = query.Split('|').Last().TrimStart();
            Assert.True(last.StartsWith("set ") || last.StartsWith("call "), $"'{query}' must end with a set or call stage");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ExampleListsAreNotEmptyAndHaveNoNotesLeft()
        {
            Assert.Equal(27, RqlGuide.QueryExamples.Length);
            Assert.Equal(40, RqlGuide.MutateExamples.Length);
            Assert.All(RqlGuide.MutateExamples, e => Assert.DoesNotContain("   ", e));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheGuideTeachesTheStringFunctionsGroupByKeysAndTargetScope()
        {
            foreach (var function in new[] { "replace(", "replace-regex(", "substring(", "split(", "trim(", "pad(" })
                Assert.Contains(function, RqlGuide.Language);
            Assert.Contains("group-by a, b", RqlGuide.Language);
            Assert.Contains("$index", RqlGuide.MutateStages);
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.MutateExamples, e => e.Contains("$index") && e.Contains("set "));
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.MutateExamples, e => e.Contains(".replace("));
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.QueryExamples, e => e.Contains("group-by class, "));
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.QueryExamples, e => e.Contains("items.avg("));
            Assert.Contains("a boolean condition", RqlGuide.Language);
            Assert.Contains("has(Mesh)", RqlGuide.QuerySyntaxShort);
            // The shared rules come from the runtime (conditions, list equality, receipts, call, bulk create, vectors, map entries).
            Assert.EndsWith(global::Rql.Execution.RqlLanguageGuide.Rules, RqlGuide.Language);
            Assert.Contains("Lists compare by value", RqlGuide.Language);
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.MutateExamples, e => e.StartsWith("range(0, ") && e.Contains("call editor.CreateNode("));
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.MutateExamples, e => e.StartsWith("[[") && e.Contains("call editor.InstantiateScene("));
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.MutateExamples, e => e.Contains("set Scale = Scale * 1.5"));
            Assert.Contains("one undo step", RqlGuide.MutateDescription);
            Assert.Contains("unchanged assignment(s) not listed", RqlGuide.MutateDescription);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheToolDescriptionsCarryTheGuide()
        {
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.Language, RqlGuide.QueryDescription);
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.QueryExampleText, RqlGuide.QueryDescription);
            Assert.Contains(RqlGuide.MutateExampleText, RqlGuide.MutateDescription);
            Assert.Contains("SaveScene", RqlGuide.MutateDescription);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheLiveSmokeRunsExactlyTheGuideExamples()
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(RepoRoot(), "Godot-Tests", "rql-guide-examples.json");
            Assert.True(File.Exists(path), $"{path} is missing");
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
            var query = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("query").EnumerateArray().Select(e => e.GetString()).ToArray();
            var mutate = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("mutate").EnumerateArray().Select(e => e.GetString()).ToArray();
            Assert.True(RqlGuide.QueryExamples.SequenceEqual(query!),
                "Godot-Tests/rql-guide-examples.json 'query' differs from RqlGuide.QueryExampleText; copy the examples over (same order)");
            Assert.True(RqlGuide.MutateExamples.SequenceEqual(mutate!),
                "Godot-Tests/rql-guide-examples.json 'mutate' differs from RqlGuide.MutateExampleText; copy the examples over (same order)");
        }

        private static string RepoRoot()
        {
            var dir = new DirectoryInfo(System.AppContext.BaseDirectory);
            while (dir != null && !File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "Godot-MCP.csproj"))) dir = dir.Parent;
            Assert.NotNull(dir);
            return dir!.FullName;
        }
    }
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlInputEventTextTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The text format of input events (inputActions / AddInputEvent): every kind parses, names and numbers resolve to
    /// Godot's indices, the canonical texts read back the same, and bad texts explain the format.
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlInputEventTextTests
    {
        private static InputEventSpec Parse(string text)
        {
            Assert.True(InputEventText.TryParse(text, out var spec, out var error), error);
            return spec!;
        }

        private static string Error(string? text)
        {
            Assert.False(InputEventText.TryParse(text, out var spec, out var error));
            Assert.Null(spec);
            return error!;
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Key:W", InputEventKind.Key, "W")]
        [InlineData("key: Ctrl+S ", InputEventKind.Key, "Ctrl+S")]
        [InlineData("PhysicalKey:Space", InputEventKind.PhysicalKey, "Space")]
        [InlineData("physical_key:F1", InputEventKind.PhysicalKey, "F1")]
        public void KeysKeepTheirTextForTheEngine(string text, InputEventKind kind, string keys)
        {
            var spec = Parse(text);
            Assert.Equal(kind, spec.Kind);
            Assert.Equal(keys, spec.Keys);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Mouse:Left", 1)]
        [InlineData("Mouse:right", 2)]
        [InlineData("MouseButton:WheelUp", 4)]
        [InlineData("Mouse:wheel_down", 5)]
        [InlineData("Mouse:Xbutton2", 9)]
        [InlineData("Mouse:3", 3)]
        public void MouseButtonsByNameOrNumber(string text, int button)
        {
            var spec = Parse(text);
            Assert.Equal(InputEventKind.Mouse, spec.Kind);
            Assert.Equal(button, spec.Index);
            Assert.Empty(spec.Modifiers);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void MouseModifiersAreCanonicalAndDeduplicated()
        {
            var spec = Parse("Mouse:ctrl+Shift+Control+Left");
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "Shift", "Ctrl" }, spec.Modifiers.ToArray());
            Assert.Equal("Mouse:Shift+Ctrl+Left", InputEventText.Mouse(spec.Index, spec.Modifiers));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "Alt", "Meta" }, Parse("Mouse:Cmd+Option+Right").Modifiers.ToArray());
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:A", 0)]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:start", 6)]
        [InlineData("joy_button:Right Shoulder", 10)]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:DpadDown", 12)]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:Touchpad", 20)]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:42", 42)]
        public void JoypadButtonsByNameOrNumber(string text, int button) => Assert.Equal(button, Parse(text).Index);

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:LeftX-", 0, -1)]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:LeftY+", 1, 1)]
        [InlineData("joy_axis:right_x -", 2, -1)]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:TriggerLeft", 4, 1)]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:TriggerRight+", 5, 1)]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:3-", 3, -1)]
        public void JoypadAxesWithTheirDirection(string text, int axis, int sign)
        {
            var spec = Parse(text);
            Assert.Equal(InputEventKind.JoypadMotion, spec.Kind);
            Assert.Equal(axis, spec.Index);
            Assert.Equal(sign, spec.AxisSign);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CanonicalTextsReadBackAsTheSameEvent()
        {
            foreach (var text in new[] { "Mouse:Left", "Mouse:Shift+WheelUp", "JoypadButton:A", "JoypadButton:DpadDown", "JoypadMotion:LeftX-", "JoypadMotion:TriggerRight+" })
            {
                var spec = Parse(text);
                var back = spec.Kind switch
                {
                    InputEventKind.Mouse => InputEventText.Mouse(spec.Index, spec.Modifiers),
                    InputEventKind.JoypadButton => InputEventText.JoypadButton(spec.Index),
                    _ => InputEventText.JoypadMotion(spec.Index, spec.AxisSign),
                };
                Assert.Equal(text, back);
            }
            Assert.Equal("JoypadButton:99", InputEventText.JoypadButton(99));
            Assert.Equal("Key:Ctrl+S", InputEventText.Key("Ctrl+S", physical: false));
            Assert.Equal("PhysicalKey:W", InputEventText.Key("W", physical: true));
            Assert.True(InputEventText.SameText(" key:space", "Key:Space "));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(null, "not an input event")]
        [InlineData("", "not an input event")]
        [InlineData("Space", "not an input event")]
        [InlineData("Key:", "not an input event")]
        [InlineData("Bogus:1", "unknown input event kind")]
        [InlineData("Mouse:Thumb", "unknown mouse button")]
        [InlineData("Mouse:None", "unknown mouse button")]
        [InlineData("Mouse:0", "unknown mouse button")]
        [InlineData("Mouse:Hyper+Left", "unknown modifier")]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:Z", "unknown joypad button")]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:-1", "unknown joypad button")]
        [InlineData("JoypadButton:128", "unknown joypad button")]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:Wheel+", "unknown joypad axis")]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:6+", "unknown joypad axis")]
        [InlineData("JoypadMotion:LeftX", "needs a direction")]
        public void BadTextsExplainTheFormat(string? text, string message) => Assert.Contains(message, Error(text));

        [Fact]
        public void TheHelpNamesEveryKind()
        {
            foreach (var kind in new[] { "Key:", "PhysicalKey:", "Mouse:", "JoypadButton:", "JoypadMotion:" })
                Assert.Contains(kind, InputEventText.Help);
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlLayerNamesTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings;
using Godot;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>Layer masks ⇄ layer names (LayerNames): kinds by hint, names / numbers both ways, errors, kept high bits.</summary>
    public class RqlLayerNamesTests
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<int, string> Named = new Dictionary<int, string> { [1] = "world", [2] = "enemies", [5] = "Water" };

        private static string? NameOf(int layer) => Named.TryGetValue(layer, out var n) ? n : null;

        private static LayerNames.Kind Physics3D => Kind(PropertyHint.Layers3DPhysics);

        private static LayerNames.Kind Kind(PropertyHint hint)
        {
            Assert.True(LayerNames.TryKindOf(hint, out var kind));
            return kind;
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.Layers2DRender, "2d_render", 20)]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.Layers2DPhysics, "2d_physics", 32)]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.Layers2DNavigation, "2d_navigation", 32)]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.Layers3DRender, "3d_render", 20)]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.Layers3DPhysics, "3d_physics", 32)]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.Layers3DNavigation, "3d_navigation", 32)]
        [InlineData(PropertyHint.LayersAvoidance, "avoidance", 32)]
        public void EveryLayerHintHasItsKind(PropertyHint hint, string name, int count)
        {
            var kind = Kind(hint);
            Assert.Equal(name, kind.Name);
            Assert.Equal(count, kind.Count);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void OtherHintsAreNoLayers()
        {
            Assert.False(LayerNames.TryKindOf(PropertyHint.None, out _));
            Assert.False(LayerNames.TryKindOf(PropertyHint.Flags, out _));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SettingNamesAndBitsAreOneBased()
        {
            Assert.Equal("layer_names/3d_physics/layer_2", LayerNames.SettingName("3d_physics", 2));
            Assert.Equal(1L, LayerNames.Bit(1));
            Assert.Equal(1L << 31, LayerNames.Bit(32));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void MasksReadAsNamesOrNumbers()
        {
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "world", "enemies", "3", "Water" }, LayerNames.Names(0b10111, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Empty(LayerNames.Names(0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            // Render layers stop at 20: bit 21 is not listed.
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "world" }, LayerNames.Names(1 | (1L << 20), Kind(PropertyHint.Layers3DRender), NameOf));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NamesAndNumbersWriteTheirBits()
        {
            Assert.Equal(0b10011L, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { "world", "enemies", 5.0 }, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Equal(0b100L, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { "3" }, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Equal(0b10L, LayerNames.Mask("ENEMIES", 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Equal(1L << 31, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { 32L }, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Equal(0L, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?>(), 0b111, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Equal(0L, LayerNames.Mask(null, 0b111, Physics3D, NameOf));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AnExactNameWinsOverACaseInsensitiveOneAndOverANumber()
        {
            var names = new Dictionary<int, string> { [1] = "Wall", [2] = "wall", [3] = "7" };
            string? Of(int l) => names.TryGetValue(l, out var n) ? n : null;
            Assert.Equal(0b10L, LayerNames.Mask("wall", 0, Physics3D, Of));
            Assert.Equal(0b1L, LayerNames.Mask("WALL", 0, Physics3D, Of));
            Assert.Equal(0b100L, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { "7" }, 0, Physics3D, Of));
            Assert.Equal(1L << 6, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { 7.0 }, 0, Physics3D, Of));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BitsAboveTheKindAreKept()
        {
            var render = Kind(PropertyHint.Layers3DRender);
            var high = 1L << 25;
            Assert.Equal(high | 0b1, LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { "world" }, high | 0b110, render, NameOf));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("nobody", "no 3d_physics layer named 'nobody'")]
        [InlineData("0", "numbered 1-32")]
        [InlineData("33", "numbered 1-32")]
        public void UnknownLayersAreRejectedWithTheNamedOnes(string entry, string expected)
        {
            var ex = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { entry }, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Contains(expected, ex.Message);
            if (entry == "nobody") Assert.Contains("1 world, 2 enemies, 5 Water", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void FractionsBareNumbersAndOtherValuesAreRejected()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { 1.5 }, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => LayerNames.Mask(new List<object?> { true }, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            var bare = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => LayerNames.Mask(3.0, 0, Physics3D, NameOf));
            Assert.Contains("write [3]", bare.Message);
            var none = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => LayerNames.Mask("x", 0, Physics3D, _ => null));
            Assert.Contains("no 3d_physics layer is named yet", none.Message);
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlMutationHooksTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The pure parts of the editor's mutation hooks (RqlGodot.Save.cs) over a real RqlEngine: setter undo steps are kept only
    /// when their set stage commits (RqlSetStageBuffer), and the owner whose snapshot covers a change (RqlMutationOwner).
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlMutationHooksTests
    {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------ set stage buffer

        /// <summary>A row whose setters record "undo steps" the way the Theme map / node groups setters do.</summary>
        public sealed class Row
        {
            private readonly Action<string> _record;
            private int _value;

            public Row(string name, Action<string> record) { this.name = name; _record = record; }

            public string name { get; }

            public int value
            {
                get => _value;
                set { _record($"{name}.value {_value}->{value}"); _value = value; }
            }

            // Fails at write time (after validation): the engine rolls the earlier writes of the stage back.
            public int broken
            {
                get => 0;
                set => throw new InvalidOperationException("broken setter");
            }

            [RqlCallable("records a step and returns true")]
            public bool Touch() { _record($"{name}.Touch"); return true; }

            [RqlCallable("records a step, then throws")]
            public bool Fail() { _record($"{name}.Fail"); throw new InvalidOperationException("call failed"); }
        }

        private sealed class Host
        {
            public readonly RqlSetStageBuffer Buffer = new RqlSetStageBuffer();
            public readonly List<string> Committed = new List<string>();
            public readonly List<Row> Rows;
            public readonly RqlEngine Engine = new RqlEngine();
            public int Depth;

            public Host()
            {
                Rows = new List<Row> { new Row("a", Record), new Row("b", Record) };
                Engine.Mutations.Enabled = true;
                Engine.Mutations.BeforeWrite = records => Buffer.BeforeWrite(records, Depth);
                Engine.Mutations.Committed = records => Buffer.Committed(records, Depth);
                Engine.AddSource("rows", () => Rows);
            }

            private void Record(string step) => Buffer.Record(() => Committed.Add(step));

            // What RqlGodot.Mutate does around the engine.
            public QueryResult Mutate(string query)
            {
                Depth++;
                try { return Engine.Execute(query, null, new QueryOptions { AllowMutation = true }); }
                finally
                {
                    Depth--;
                    Buffer.DiscardAbove(Depth);
                }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ACommittedSetKeepsItsSetterSteps()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var r = host.Mutate("rows | set value = 5");
            Assert.True(r.Ok, string.Join("; ", r.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.Message)));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "a.value 0->5", "b.value 0->5" }, host.Committed);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ARolledBackSetDropsItsSetterSteps()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var r = host.Mutate("rows | set value = 5, broken = 1");
            Assert.False(r.Ok);
            // The rollback restored the value through the same setter; neither the write nor its restore left a step.
            Assert.All(host.Rows, row => Assert.Equal(0, row.value));
            Assert.Empty(host.Committed);
            // The next mutation starts clean: its steps are committed.
            Assert.True(host.Mutate("rows | where name == \"a\" | set value = 2").Ok);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "a.value 0->2" }, host.Committed);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CallStepsAreKeptAlsoWhenALaterCallThrows()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            Assert.True(host.Mutate("rows | call Touch()").Ok);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "a.Touch", "b.Touch" }, host.Committed);
            host.Committed.Clear();
            // Completed calls are not rolled back, nor is a failing call's partial change: their steps stay.
            Assert.False(host.Mutate("rows | call Fail()").Ok);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "a.Fail" }, host.Committed);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ANestedSetJoinsTheEnclosingStage()
        {
            var buffer = new RqlSetStageBuffer();
            var applied = new List<string>();
            var set = new[] { SetRecord() };
            buffer.BeforeWrite(set, 1);
            buffer.Record(() => applied.Add("outer"));
            buffer.BeforeWrite(set, 2);
            buffer.Record(() => applied.Add("inner"));
            buffer.Committed(set, 2);
            buffer.DiscardAbove(1);
            Assert.Empty(applied); // the inner stage committed into the still-running outer one
            buffer.Committed(set, 1);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "outer", "inner" }, applied);

            applied.Clear();
            buffer.BeforeWrite(set, 1);
            buffer.BeforeWrite(set, 2);
            buffer.Record(() => applied.Add("inner"));
            buffer.Committed(set, 2);
            buffer.DiscardAbove(0); // the outer stage rolled back: the inner one goes with it
            buffer.Record(() => applied.Add("after"));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "after" }, applied);
        }

        // A real set record (MutationRecord has no public constructor): the first one a set hands to BeforeWrite.
        private static MutationRecord SetRecord()
        {
            MutationRecord? record = null;
            var engine = new RqlEngine();
            engine.Mutations.Enabled = true;
            engine.Mutations.BeforeWrite = records => record ??= records[0];
            engine.AddSource("rows", () => new List<Row> { new Row("x", _ => { }) });
            engine.Execute("rows | set value = 1", null, new QueryOptions { AllowMutation = true });
            return record!;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ owner selection

        private sealed class Obj
        {
            public Obj(string name, RqlOwnerKind kind, Obj? viewOf = null) { Name = name; Kind = kind; ViewOf = viewOf; }
            public string Name { get; }
            public RqlOwnerKind Kind { get; }
            public Obj? ViewOf { get; }
        }

        private static string? Owner(params Obj[] enclosing) =>
            RqlMutationOwner.Nearest<Obj>(enclosing, o =>
            {
                var obj = (Obj)o;
                return (obj.Kind == RqlOwnerKind.View ? obj.ViewOf : obj, obj.Kind);
            })?.Name;

        [Fact]
        public void APlainObjectHeldByANodeIsItsOwnOwner()
        {
            var node = new Obj("node", RqlOwnerKind.Stored);
            Assert.Equal("inner", Owner(new Obj("inner", RqlOwnerKind.Plain), node));
            Assert.Equal("inner", Owner(new Obj("inner", RqlOwnerKind.Plain), new Obj("plain C# view", RqlOwnerKind.None), node));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void APlainObjectUnderAViewBelongsToTheViewsObject()
        {
            // set data.Modulate on a TileSet tile row: TileData → RqlTile (view of its atlas source) → TileSet.
            var atlas = new Obj("atlas", RqlOwnerKind.Stored);
            Assert.Equal("atlas", Owner(new Obj("tileData", RqlOwnerKind.Plain), new Obj("tile", RqlOwnerKind.View, atlas),
                new Obj("tileSet", RqlOwnerKind.Stored)));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheNearestStoredObjectOwnsTheRest()
        {
            var resource = new Obj("material", RqlOwnerKind.Stored);
            Assert.Equal("material", Owner(new Obj("struct box", RqlOwnerKind.None), resource, new Obj("node", RqlOwnerKind.Stored)));
            Assert.Equal("settings", Owner(new Obj("action", RqlOwnerKind.View, new Obj("settings", RqlOwnerKind.Stored))));
            Assert.Equal("lonely", Owner(new Obj("lonely", RqlOwnerKind.Plain)));
            Assert.Null(Owner(new Obj("view only", RqlOwnerKind.None)));
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlNodeNameRulesTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// <see cref="NodeNameRules"/>: a rename Godot would silently change (an invalid character, a sibling's name) is refused, so
    /// the rql-mutate receipt never shows a name the node does not have.
    /// </summary>
    public class RqlNodeNameRulesTests
    {
        private static readonly System.Func<string, bool> Siblings = name => name == "Player" || name == "Enemy";

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Boss")]
        [InlineData("Узел_🎮")]
        [InlineData("with space")]
        [InlineData("player")] // names are case-sensitive in Godot
        public void ValidNamesPass(string name) => Assert.Null(NodeNameRules.Problem(name, Siblings));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData("   ")]
        [InlineData(null)]
        public void EmptyNamesFail(string? name) => Assert.Equal("a node name cannot be empty", NodeNameRules.Problem(name, Siblings));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("x.y", "'.'")]
        [InlineData("a:b", "':'")]
        [InlineData("a@b", "'@'")]
        [InlineData("a/b", "'/'")]
        [InlineData("a\"b", "'\"'")]
        [InlineData("%Unique", "'%'")]
        [InlineData("x.y:z@", "'.' ':' '@'")]
        public void InvalidCharactersFailNamingThem(string name, string named)
        {
            var problem = NodeNameRules.Problem(name, Siblings);
            Assert.NotNull(problem);
            Assert.Contains("cannot contain " + named, problem);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ASiblingsNameFails()
        {
            var problem = NodeNameRules.Problem("Enemy", Siblings);
            Assert.Equal("a sibling is already named 'Enemy' (node names are unique among siblings; to swap or renumber siblings, " +
                         "rename them to temporary names first, then to the final names in a second call)", problem);
        }
    }
}
```

`Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlShaderUniformDefaultsTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Godot;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tests
{
    /// <summary>Shader uniform defaults read from the code (ShaderUniformDefaults): literal forms, hints, comments, typing.</summary>
    public class RqlShaderUniformDefaultsTests
    {
        private const string Code =
            "shader_type spatial;\n" +
            "// uniform float commented = 9.0;\n" +
            "/* uniform float blocked = 8.0; */\n" +
            "uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 1.0);\n" +
            "uniform float speed : hint_range(0.0, 10.0, 0.1) = 2.5;\n" +
            "uniform highp int count = -3;\n" +
            "uniform uint mask = 7u;\n" +
            "uniform bool on = true;\n" +
            "uniform vec3 up = vec3(1.0);\n" +
            "uniform ivec2 cell = ivec2(2, 3);\n" +
            "uniform float half_ = .5f;\n" +
            "uniform sampler2D tex : source_color;\n" +
            "uniform float computed = 1.0 + 2.0;\n" +
            "uniform vec4 nested = vec4(vec3(1.0), 1.0);\n" +
            "uniform mat4 m;\n" +
            "uniform vec2 short_ = vec2(1.0, 2.0, 3.0);\n" +
            "void fragment() { float uniform_like = 1.0; }\n";

        [Fact]
        public void LiteralDefaultsAreRead()
        {
            var d = ShaderUniformDefaults.Parse(Code);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 1.0 }, d["tint"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 2.5 }, d["speed"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { -3.0 }, d["count"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 7.0 }, d["mask"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 1.0 }, d["on"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 }, d["up"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 2.0, 3.0 }, d["cell"]);
            Assert.Equal(new[] { 0.5 }, d["half_"]);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CommentsComputedValuesAndUninitializedUniformsHaveNoDefault()
        {
            var d = ShaderUniformDefaults.Parse(Code);
            foreach (var name in new[] { "commented", "blocked", "tex", "computed", "nested", "m", "short_", "uniform_like" })
                Assert.False(d.ContainsKey(name), name);
            Assert.Empty(ShaderUniformDefaults.Parse(null));
            Assert.Empty(ShaderUniformDefaults.Parse(""));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ValuesTakeTheUniformsType()
        {
            Assert.Equal(new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0.25f, 1f), ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Color, new[] { 1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 1.0 }));
            Assert.Equal(new Color(1f, 0f, 0f), ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Color, new[] { 1.0, 0.0, 0.0 }));
            Assert.Equal(new Vector4(1, 0.5f, 0.25f, 1), ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Vector4, new[] { 1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 1.0 }));
            Assert.Equal(2.5, ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Float, new[] { 2.5 }));
            Assert.Equal(-3L, ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Int, new[] { -3.0 }));
            Assert.Equal(true, ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Bool, new[] { 1.0 }));
            Assert.Equal(new Vector2I(2, 3), ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Vector2I, new[] { 2.0, 3.0 }));
            Assert.Equal(new Vector3(1, 1, 1), ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Vector3, new[] { 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 }));
            Assert.Null(ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Vector3, new[] { 1.0, 1.0 }));
            Assert.Null(ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Variant.Type.Projection, new[] { 1.0 }));
        }
    }
}
```
