`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Reload/GatedRunTool.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin.Common.Model;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reload
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A tool whose calls pass the <see cref="AssemblyReloadGate"/>: refused with a retryable
    /// <see cref="ResponseErrorKind.Unavailable"/> error while a reload is pending or running (HTTP 503 when the gate refused
    /// the call before it started, so the server may re-send it), counted while they run.
    /// Everything else is the wrapped tool's, so the tool list, schemas and enable states are unchanged.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GatedRunTool : IRunTool
    {
        readonly AssemblyReloadGate _gate;

        public GatedRunTool(IRunTool inner, AssemblyReloadGate gate)
        {
            Inner = inner;
            _gate = gate;
        }

        public IRunTool Inner { get; }

        /// <summary>Wrap every tool of <paramref name="tools"/> (already wrapped ones are left as they are), keeping their order.</summary>
        public static int WrapAll(IToolManager? tools, AssemblyReloadGate gate)
        {
            if (tools == null)
                return 0;
            var wrapped = 0;
            foreach (var tool in tools.GetAllTools().Where(t => t is not GatedRunTool).ToList())
            {
                // Remove then add: the tool table reuses the freed slot, so the listed order stays the same.
                if (!tools.RemoveTool(tool.Name))
                    continue;
                tools.AddTool(tool.Name, new GatedRunTool(tool, gate));
                wrapped++;
            }
            return wrapped;
        }

        public async Task<ResponseCallTool> Run(string requestId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>? namedParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (!_gate.TryEnter(out var refusal))
                return NotStarted(refusal, requestId);
            try
            {
                var result = await Inner.Run(requestId, namedParameters, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                // A body the unloading gate refused on the main thread fails the tool with the refusal wrapped in its error
                // ("Tool execution failed ... One or more errors occurred. (<refusal>)"): answer with the refusal itself.
                return result.Status == ResponseStatus.Error && _gate.Refusal is { } late && result.GetMessage()?.Contains(late) == true
                    ? Refused(late, requestId)
                    : result;
            }
            finally
            {
                _gate.Exit();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// McpPlugin's "not executed" answer (Unavailable, HTTP 503) tells the server nothing of the call ran, so it re-sends it
        /// once the editor is back. Only the gate's own refusal qualifies: the call never reached the tool.
        /// </summary>
        static ResponseCallTool NotStarted(string? refusal, string requestId)
            => ResponseCallTool.NotExecuted(refusal ?? AssemblyReloadGate.UnloadingMessage).SetRequestID(requestId);

        // A body refused on the main thread after the tool began (its off-thread part may have run): retryable, but no 503, so
        // the server reports it instead of re-sending a call that may have started.
        static ResponseCallTool Refused(string? refusal, string requestId)
            => ResponseCallTool.Error(refusal, ResponseErrorKind.Unavailable).SetRequestID(requestId);

        public bool Visible { get => Inner.Visible; set => Inner.Visible = value; }
        public string Name => Inner.Name;
        public string? Title => Inner.Title;
        public string? Description => Inner.Description;
        public string? SkillDescription => Inner.SkillDescription;
        public string? SkillBody => Inner.SkillBody;
        public JsonNode? InputSchema => Inner.InputSchema;
        public JsonNode? OutputSchema => Inner.OutputSchema;
        public McpToolType ToolType => Inner.ToolType;
        public bool? ReadOnlyHint => Inner.ReadOnlyHint;
        public bool? DestructiveHint => Inner.DestructiveHint;
        public bool? IdempotentHint => Inner.IdempotentHint;
        public bool? OpenWorldHint => Inner.OpenWorldHint;
        public int TokenCount => Inner.TokenCount;
        public int SkillMetadataTokenCount => Inner.SkillMetadataTokenCount;
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Reload/ProjectBuild.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reload
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A <c>script-build</c> in progress, kept in a file under <c>.godot/</c> because its result is usually reported by
    /// the NEXT load of this assembly (the build changes the DLL, Godot reloads it). Plain <c>key=value</c> lines, so no
    /// serializer caches this assembly's types. Pure (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class BuildRecord
    {
        public string RequestId { get; set; } = "";
        public int ProcessId { get; set; }
        public string LogPath { get; set; } = "";
        public string ProjectDir { get; set; } = "";
        /// <summary>Write time (UTC ticks) of the project DLL when the build started; 0 = there was none.</summary>
        public long DllWriteTicksAtStart { get; set; }
        public long StartedUtcTicks { get; set; }
        /// <summary>Which load of the assembly started the build (<see cref="ProjectBuildTracker"/>'s per-load id).</summary>
        public string LoadId { get; set; } = "";

        public string Serialize()
        {
            var b = new StringBuilder();
            void Line(string key, string value) => b.Append(key).Append('=').Append(value.Replace("\r", "").Replace("\n", " ")).Append('\n');
            Line(nameof(RequestId), RequestId);
            Line(nameof(ProcessId), ProcessId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            Line(nameof(LogPath), LogPath);
            Line(nameof(ProjectDir), ProjectDir);
            Line(nameof(DllWriteTicksAtStart), DllWriteTicksAtStart.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            Line(nameof(StartedUtcTicks), StartedUtcTicks.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            Line(nameof(LoadId), LoadId);
            return b.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>The record in <paramref name="text"/>, or null when it is missing or unreadable (no request id).</summary>
        public static BuildRecord? Parse(string? text)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
                return null;
            var values = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            foreach (var line in text!.Split('\n'))
                if (line.TrimEnd('\r').Split(new[] { '=' }, 2) is { Length: 2 } pair && pair[0].Length > 0)
                    values[pair[0]] = pair[1];
            string Get(string key) => values.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v : "";
            long Long(string key) => long.TryParse(Get(key), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var v) ? v : 0;
            var record = new BuildRecord
            {
                RequestId = Get(nameof(RequestId)),
                ProcessId = (int)Long(nameof(ProcessId)),
                LogPath = Get(nameof(LogPath)),
                ProjectDir = Get(nameof(ProjectDir)),
                DllWriteTicksAtStart = Long(nameof(DllWriteTicksAtStart)),
                StartedUtcTicks = Long(nameof(StartedUtcTicks)),
                LoadId = Get(nameof(LoadId)),
            };
            return record.RequestId.Length == 0 ? null : record;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The outcome of a finished <c>dotnet build</c>, read from its MSBuild file log.</summary>
    public sealed class BuildOutcome
    {
        BuildOutcome(bool succeeded, IReadOnlyList<string> warnings, IReadOnlyList<string> errors, string? tail)
        {
            Succeeded = succeeded;
            WarningList = warnings;
            Errors = errors;
            Tail = tail;
        }

        public const int MaxErrors = 20;

        /// <summary>The most warnings a result lists (the count covers all of them).</summary>
        public const int MaxWarnings = 20;

        public bool Succeeded { get; }
        public int Warnings => WarningList.Count;
        /// <summary>The distinct compiler warnings, project folder cut from their paths (an agent asked to fix warnings needs them).</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<string> WarningList { get; }
        /// <summary>The distinct compiler errors (MSBuild prints each twice), project folder cut from their paths.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<string> Errors { get; }
        /// <summary>The log's last lines when the build failed without a compiler error (an MSBuild / SDK failure).</summary>
        public string? Tail { get; }

        static readonly Regex Diagnostic = new Regex(@":\s+(error|warning)\s+[A-Z]+\d+\s*:", RegexOptions.Compiled);
        static readonly Regex ProjectSuffix = new Regex(@"\s*\[[^\[\]]+\.csproj\]$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

        /// <summary>
        /// The outcome of the build that wrote <paramref name="log"/> (MSBuild's file logger with <c>Summary</c>), or null
        /// while it has not finished writing it (no "Build succeeded." / "Build FAILED." line yet).
        /// </summary>
        public static BuildOutcome? FromLog(string? log, string projectDir = "")
        {
            var lines = (log ?? "").Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n').Select(l => l.Trim()).Where(l => l.Length > 0).ToList();
            var succeeded = lines.Contains("Build succeeded.");
            if (!succeeded && !lines.Contains("Build FAILED."))
                return null;
            var errors = Diagnostics(lines, "error", projectDir);
            var tail = !succeeded && errors.Count == 0 ? string.Join("\n", lines.Skip(Math.Max(0, lines.Count - 10))) : null;
            return new BuildOutcome(succeeded, Diagnostics(lines, "warning", projectDir), errors, tail);
        }

        /// <summary>The text an agent gets for a failed build: the errors (at most <see cref="MaxErrors"/>) or the log tail.</summary>
        public string FailureText()
        {
            if (Errors.Count == 0)
                return "C# build failed:\n" + (Tail ?? "(no output)");
            return $"C# build failed with {Count(Errors.Count, "error")} (the editor keeps the previous assembly):\n" + Listed(Errors, MaxErrors);
        }

        public string WarningsText => Count(Warnings, "warning");

        /// <summary>The warnings (at most <see cref="MaxWarnings"/>) as lines to append to a success text; empty when there are none.</summary>
        public string WarningLines => Warnings == 0 ? "" : "\nWarnings:\n" + Listed(WarningList, MaxWarnings);

        /// <summary>The text an agent gets for a successful build: the count, <paramref name="rest"/>, then the warnings.</summary>
        public string SuccessText(string rest) => $"C# build succeeded ({WarningsText}){rest}" + WarningLines;

        static string Listed(IReadOnlyList<string> items, int max)
        {
            var shown = items.Take(max).ToList();
            var more = items.Count > shown.Count ? $"\n… and {items.Count - shown.Count} more" : "";
            return string.Join("\n", shown) + more;
        }

        static string Count(int n, string word) => $"{n} {word}{(n == 1 ? "" : "s")}";

        // "C:\proj\Player.cs(3,5): error CS1002: ; expected [C:\proj\Game.csproj]" -> "Player.cs(3,5): error CS1002: ; expected".
        static List<string> Diagnostics(List<string> lines, string kind, string projectDir)
        {
            var dir = projectDir.Replace('\\', '/').TrimEnd('/');
            return lines.Where(l => Diagnostic.Match(l) is { Success: true } m && m.Groups[1].Value == kind)
                .Select(raw =>
                {
                    var line = ProjectSuffix.Replace(raw, "").Replace('\\', '/');
                    return dir.Length > 0 && line.StartsWith(dir + "/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? line.Substring(dir.Length + 1) : line;
                })
                .Distinct().ToList();
        }
    }
}
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Reload/ProjectBuildTracker.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.UI;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin.Common.Model;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reload
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs <c>script-build</c>'s <c>dotnet build</c> detached and delivers its result through the request's id
    /// (<c>NotifyToolRequestCompleted</c>), usually from the NEXT load of this assembly: a successful build changes the
    /// DLL, Godot reloads it (behind the <see cref="AssemblyReloadGate"/>) and the reloaded plugin reports.
    /// <para>
    /// Nothing of this assembly runs while the build does: no output-reading threads or exit callbacks (they would pin
    /// the assembly when Godot reloads it mid-build). The build writes an MSBuild file log, the state is a
    /// <see cref="BuildRecord"/> file under <c>.godot/godot_mcp/</c>, and <see cref="Tick"/> polls both on the main
    /// thread; a later load finds the build by its process id.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    sealed class ProjectBuildTracker
    {
        /// <summary>The tracker of the booted plugin (script-build starts builds through it); null when not booted.</summary>
        public static ProjectBuildTracker? Current { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Identifies this load of the assembly: a record written by another load means Godot reloaded it.</summary>
        static readonly string LoadId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");

        const double PollSeconds = 0.25;
        static readonly TimeSpan BuildTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
        /// <summary>How long a build whose output Godot did not reload waits (from its end) before it is reported anyway.</summary>
        static readonly TimeSpan ReloadTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
        /// <summary>A build process gone without its log summary is reported after this grace (the log is flushed last).</summary>
        static readonly TimeSpan LogGrace = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

        readonly string? _dllPath;
        BuildRecord? _record;
        /// <summary>The build process of <see cref="_record"/> once found (null: not looked up yet, or gone).</summary>
        Process? _process;
        bool _processLookedUp;
        BuildOutcome? _outcome;
        ResponseCallTool? _result;
        Task? _sending;
        DateTime? _finishedAt;
        DateTime? _goneAt;
        double _sincePoll = PollSeconds;

        public ProjectBuildTracker(string? dllPath)
        {
            _dllPath = dllPath;
            // Only Start (this load) or a load before the last reload writes a record, so the file is read once here.
            _record = BuildRecord.Parse(ReadText(RecordPath));
        }

        static string StateDir => ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://.godot/godot_mcp");
        static string RecordPath => Path.Combine(StateDir, "build.txt");

        /// <summary>Start a build for <paramref name="requestId"/> (main thread). Returns the "processing" message.</summary>
        public string Start(string requestId)
        {
            // One build at a time, and the previous one's result is handed to the server first (its request still waits for
            // it). Once that send has started, the agent may already have the result and ask again: let it.
            if (_record != null && _sending == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The previous script-build has not delivered its result yet (its build is running, or " +
                                                    "Godot is reloading the C# assembly); retry once it has.");

            var csproj = new Extensions.ConsumerProjectFile().Path
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("This project has no C# project (.csproj) to build.");
            var projectDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(csproj)!;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(StateDir);
            var log = Path.Combine(StateDir, "build.log");
            File.Delete(log);

            var start = new ProcessStartInfo("dotnet")
            {
                WorkingDirectory = projectDir,
                UseShellExecute = false,
                CreateNoWindow = true,
            };
            // The editor's Debug configuration, with no console output (it would go to the editor's stdout), a file log the
            // tracker reads (in English: its summary line is matched), and no build servers outliving the build. Godot's own
            // builds drop a Developer Command Prompt's Platform variable too: it would change the output folder.
            start.Environment["DOTNET_CLI_UI_LANGUAGE"] = "en";
            start.Environment.Remove("Platform");
            foreach (var arg in new[] { "build", csproj, "-c", "Debug", "-nologo", "-noConsoleLogger", "--disable-build-servers",
                         $"-flp:LogFile={log};Verbosity=minimal;Summary" })
                start.ArgumentList.Add(arg);
            var process = Process.Start(start) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not start dotnet (is the .NET SDK installed and on PATH?).");

            var record = new BuildRecord
            {
                RequestId = requestId,
                ProcessId = process.Id,
                LogPath = log,
                ProjectDir = projectDir,
                DllWriteTicksAtStart = ReloadGateDriver.WriteTime(_dllPath)?.Ticks ?? 0,
                StartedUtcTicks = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks,
                LoadId = LoadId,
            };
            try { File.WriteAllText(RecordPath, record.Serialize()); }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // Without its record the result could not be delivered after the reload: do not build at all.
                try { process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); } catch (Exception) { /* already gone */ }
                process.Dispose();
                throw;
            }
            ResetBuild();
            _record = record;
            _process = process;
            _processLookedUp = true;
            GodotMcpLog.Info($"[Godot-MCP] script-build: dotnet build started (pid {process.Id}).");
            return "Building the project's C# (dotnet build) in the background. When it succeeds Godot reloads the C# assembly and the " +
                   "plugin reconnects; the result (the compiler warnings, or the compiler errors) is delivered then. Tool calls made " +
                   "while the reload is pending are refused with a retryable error.";
        }

        /// <summary>Main-thread tick: settle the build once it ended and report it over a connected plugin.</summary>
        public void Tick(double delta, GodotMcpConnection? connection)
        {
            if (_record is not { } record)
                return;
            _sincePoll += delta;
            if (_sincePoll < PollSeconds)
                return;
            _sincePoll = 0;
            try
            {
                if (_sending != null)
                {
                    // Polled, not continued: no callback of this assembly runs on a thread-pool thread.
                    if (!_sending.IsCompleted)
                        return;
                    if (_sending.Status == TaskStatus.RanToCompletion)
                    {
                        GodotMcpLog.Info($"[Godot-MCP] script-build: result delivered ({_result?.Status}).");
                        Forget();
                        return;
                    }
                    _sending = null; // the send failed (connection dropped): send again once connected
                }

                try { _result ??= Evaluate(record); }
                catch (Exception ex) { _result = ResponseCallTool.Error($"Tracking the C# build failed: {ex.Message}", ResponseErrorKind.Internal); }
                if (_result == null || connection?.ConnectionStatus != ConnectionStatus.Connected || connection.Plugin?.McpManagerHub is not { } hub)
                    return;
                _sending = hub.NotifyToolRequestCompleted(new RequestToolCompletedData
                {
                    RequestId = record.RequestId,
                    Result = _result.SetRequestID(record.RequestId),
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                GodotMcpLog.Error($"[Godot-MCP] script-build: delivering the result failed: {ex.Message}");
                _sending = null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>The result of the build, or null while it (or Godot's reload of its output) is still to come.</summary>
        ResponseCallTool? Evaluate(BuildRecord record)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (_outcome == null)
            {
                // The summary is the log's last line: read it only once the build process is gone.
                if (FindProcess(record) is { HasExited: false })
                {
                    if (now - new DateTime(record.StartedUtcTicks, DateTimeKind.Utc) < BuildTimeout)
                        return null;
                    try { _process?.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); } catch (Exception) { /* already gone */ }
                    return ResponseCallTool.Error($"The C# build did not finish in {BuildTimeout.TotalMinutes:0} minutes and was stopped.", ResponseErrorKind.Timeout);
                }
                _outcome = BuildOutcome.FromLog(ReadText(record.LogPath), record.ProjectDir);
                if (_outcome == null)
                {
                    _goneAt ??= now;
                    return now - _goneAt < LogGrace
                        ? null
                        : ResponseCallTool.Error($"The C# build ended without a result; see its log: {record.LogPath}", ResponseErrorKind.Internal);
                }
            }
            var outcome = _outcome;
            if (!outcome.Succeeded)
                return ResponseCallTool.Error(outcome.FailureText(), ResponseErrorKind.BadRequest);

            var dllNow = ReloadGateDriver.WriteTime(_dllPath);
            var dllAtStart = record.DllWriteTicksAtStart > 0 ? AssemblyReloadGate.ToSeconds(new DateTime(record.DllWriteTicksAtStart, DateTimeKind.Utc)) : 0;
            if (dllNow == null || AssemblyReloadGate.ToSeconds(dllNow.Value) <= dllAtStart)
                return ResponseCallTool.Success(outcome.SuccessText("; the assembly was already up to date, so there was nothing to reload."));
            if (record.LoadId != LoadId)
                return ResponseCallTool.Success(outcome.SuccessText(" and Godot reloaded the C# assembly: new and changed C# " +
                                                                        "scripts and [GlobalClass] types are usable now."));
            _finishedAt ??= now;
            return now - _finishedAt < ReloadTimeout
                ? null
                : ResponseCallTool.Success(outcome.SuccessText(", but Godot has not reloaded the C# assembly (C# hot " +
                                                                   "reload may be off): focus the editor window or restart the editor to load it."));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The build process of <paramref name="record"/> (looked up once per load: after a reload the process id comes from
        /// the record, checked against its start time so a later process with the same id is not taken for it), or null.
        /// </summary>
        Process? FindProcess(BuildRecord record)
        {
            if (_processLookedUp)
                return _process;
            _processLookedUp = true;
            try
            {
                var process = Process.GetProcessById(record.ProcessId);
                if (Math.Abs((process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime() - new DateTime(record.StartedUtcTicks, DateTimeKind.Utc)).TotalSeconds) < 10)
                    return _process = process;
                process.Dispose();
            }
            catch (Exception) { /* exited, or not ours to inspect */ }
            return null;
        }

        /// <summary>Plugin teardown: let go of the process handle; the build itself keeps running and the next load reports it.</summary>
        public void Release()
        {
            _process?.Dispose();
            _process = null;
            _processLookedUp = false;
        }

        void ResetBuild()
        {
            Release();
            _record = null;
            _outcome = null;
            _result = null;
            _sending = null;
            _finishedAt = null;
            _goneAt = null;
        }

        void Forget()
        {
            ResetBuild();
            try { File.Delete(RecordPath); } catch (Exception) { /* a stale record is re-evaluated and reported once more at worst */ }
        }

        static string? ReadText(string path)
        {
            try
            {
                if (!File.Exists(path))
                    return null;
                // The build may still hold its log open: open it shared.
                using var stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, System.IO.FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete);
                using var reader = new StreamReader(stream);
                return reader.ReadToEnd();
            }
            catch (IOException) { return null; }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { return null; }
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Reload/ReloadGateDriver.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.MainThreadDispatch;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reload
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the <see cref="AssemblyReloadGate"/> in the editor (one per plugin boot, main thread):
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>watches the built project DLL (<c>.godot/mono/temp/bin/Debug/&lt;assembly&gt;.dll</c>, the file Godot's
    /// <c>HotReloadAssemblyWatcher</c> watches) and turns the gate pending once it is newer than the loaded one;</item>
    /// <item>while calls admitted before that are still running, pauses the watcher's 0.5 s timer so Godot reloads
    /// after they finish (bounded by <see cref="AssemblyReloadGate.MaxHoldMs"/>). A reload Godot starts some other way
    /// (editor window focus) is not deferred; <see cref="DrainForUnload"/> covers it;</item>
    /// <item>wraps the plugin's tools in <see cref="GatedRunTool"/>;</item>
    /// <item>at teardown (<see cref="DrainForUnload"/>) refuses everything, fails the queued main-thread bodies of calls
    /// in flight without running them and waits for those calls to return, so no thread is left inside this assembly
    /// and no cache is refilled after teardown clears it.</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </summary>
    sealed class ReloadGateDriver
    {
        const double PollSeconds = 0.1;

        /// <summary>The main thread waits at most this long at teardown for the calls in flight to return.</summary>
        static readonly TimeSpan DrainTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);

        const string WatcherNodeName = "HotReloadAssemblyWatcher";

        Timer? _watcherTimer;
        bool _holding;
        double _sincePoll = PollSeconds;

        ReloadGateDriver(string? dllPath)
        {
            DllPath = dllPath;
            Gate.SetBaseline(WriteTime(dllPath));
        }

        public AssemblyReloadGate Gate { get; } = new AssemblyReloadGate();

        /// <summary>The DLL Godot reloads this assembly from (null when there is none).</summary>
        public string? DllPath { get; }

        /// <summary>Main thread, at plugin boot. Also clears a refusal a previous teardown in this assembly left behind.</summary>
        public static ReloadGateDriver Install()
        {
            MainThreadDispatcher.RefusalReason = null;
            // A refused call is expected, not an error worth a backtrace each (agents retry them in bursts).
            GodotMcpLogger.IsExpectedError = AssemblyReloadGate.IsRefusal;
            var driver = new ReloadGateDriver(BuiltAssemblyPath());
            driver._watcherTimer = FindWatcherTimer();
            // A previous instance may have died holding the timer (never leave Godot's reload switched off).
            if (driver._watcherTimer != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(driver._watcherTimer))
                driver._watcherTimer.Paused = false;
            if (driver.DllPath == null)
                GodotMcpLog.Warning("[Godot-MCP] reload gate: the built project assembly was not found; C# reloads are not anticipated.");
            return driver;
        }

        /// <summary>The project assembly as Godot's editor builds it (the Debug configuration, which the helper prefers).</summary>
        static string? BuiltAssemblyPath() => Tools.ScriptExecuteSource.BuiltAssemblyPath(
            ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://.godot/mono/temp/bin"), typeof(ReloadGateDriver).Assembly.GetName().Name);

        /// <summary>The write time of <paramref name="path"/>, or null when it is missing (one file-system call: polled 10 times a second).</summary>
        internal static DateTime? WriteTime(string? path)
        {
            if (path == null)
                return null;
            try
            {
                var time = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path);
                return time.Year <= 1601 ? null : time; // a missing file reads as 1601-01-01
            }
            catch (Exception) { return null; }
        }

        static Timer? FindWatcherTimer()
        {
            try
            {
                var root = (Engine.GetMainLoop() as SceneTree)?.Root;
                var watcher = root?.FindChild(WatcherNodeName, recursive: true, owned: false);
                return watcher?.GetChildren().OfType<Timer>().FirstOrDefault();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] reload gate: Godot's {WatcherNodeName} not found ({ex.Message}); reloads are not deferred.");
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Wrap the plugin's tools in the gate (the editor's plugin configuration).</summary>
        public void Configure(IMcpPlugin plugin) => GatedRunTool.WrapAll(plugin.McpManager?.ToolManager, Gate);

        /// <summary>Main-thread tick (<c>GodotMcpPlugin._Process</c>).</summary>
        public void Tick(double delta)
        {
            _sincePoll += delta;
            if (_sincePoll < PollSeconds)
                return;
            _sincePoll = 0;
            var now = (long)Time.GetTicksMsec();
            switch (Gate.Observe(WriteTime(DllPath), now))
            {
                case AssemblyReloadGate.Observation.BecamePending:
                    GodotMcpLog.Info($"[Godot-MCP] the project's C# assembly was rebuilt; new tool calls wait for Godot's reload ({Gate.InFlight} running).");
                    break;
                case AssemblyReloadGate.Observation.PendingExpired:
                    GodotMcpLog.Warning("[Godot-MCP] the rebuilt C# assembly was not reloaded by Godot; tool calls run again on the loaded one.");
                    break;
            }
            SetHold(Gate.HoldReload(now));
        }

        void SetHold(bool hold)
        {
            if (hold == _holding)
                return;
            _holding = hold;
            try
            {
                if (_watcherTimer == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_watcherTimer))
                    return;
                _watcherTimer.Paused = hold;
                GodotMcpLog.Info(hold
                    ? $"[Godot-MCP] deferring Godot's C# reload until {Gate.InFlight} running tool call(s) finish."
                    : "[Godot-MCP] Godot's C# reload may start.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] reload gate: could not {(hold ? "defer" : "release")} Godot's reload ({ex.Message}).");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Teardown, main thread: refuse every new call. On a <paramref name="reload"/> also stop receiving calls
        /// (<paramref name="stopReceiving"/>: every call arriving now would run this assembly's code on a thread-pool thread
        /// while Godot unloads it), refuse the queued main-thread bodies (Godot has already detached the dispatcher's
        /// script, so nothing else would ever settle them) and wait, bounded, until the calls in flight have left this
        /// assembly. Their answers may no longer reach the server (it reports the call as lost with the connection); a
        /// thread left inside the assembly would fail the unload. A plain shutdown (editor closing, plugin disabled) only
        /// refuses new calls: the dispatcher's own <c>_ExitTree</c> drains the queue as before. A call whose body is running
        /// below this teardown on the main thread (Godot started the reload from inside it) cannot return before it; it is
        /// not waited for, and <see cref="AssemblyReloadGate.Drained"/> cleans up after it instead.
        /// </summary>
        public void DrainForUnload(Func<int> inFlight, bool reload, Action stopReceiving)
        {
            Gate.BeginUnload(reload ? AssemblyReloadGate.UnloadingMessage : AssemblyReloadGate.ShutdownMessage);
            SetHold(false);
            if (!reload)
                return;
            MainThreadDispatcher.RefusalReason = AssemblyReloadGate.UnloadingMessage;
            try { stopReceiving(); }
            catch (Exception ex) { GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] reload gate: stopping the connection failed ({ex.Message})."); }

            var nested = MainThreadDispatcher.IsRunningAwaitedWork ? 1 : 0;
            // McpPlugin's count also covers system tools, prompts and resources, which are not gated.
            int Running() => Math.Max(inFlight(), Gate.InFlight) - nested;
            var initial = Running();
            var clock = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var running = initial;
            while (running > 0 && clock.Elapsed < DrainTimeout)
            {
                MainThreadDispatcher.FlushQueued();
                running = Running();
                if (running > 0)
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(10);
            }
            MainThreadDispatcher.FlushQueued();
            if (nested > 0)
                GodotMcpLog.Warning("[Godot-MCP] the C# assembly started unloading inside a running tool call; Godot's first unload attempt may fail and is retried once it returns.");
            if (running > 0)
                GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] {running} tool call(s) still running after {DrainTimeout.TotalSeconds:0} s; unloading anyway.");
            else if (initial > 0)
                GodotMcpLog.Info($"[Godot-MCP] {initial} running tool call(s) drained for the unload in {clock.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms.");
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/GodotCallArguments.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The argument list of <c>CallMethod(name, [args])</c>: the RQL values as written, plus the kernel that coerced the list,
    /// so each value can then be converted like a <c>set</c> would to the type the Godot method declares for it
    /// (<c>"(0, 5)"</c> → Vector2i, <c>"res://…"</c> → the resource, an enum name → its value). Passing the raw values made
    /// Godot reject or silently zero them ("Cannot convert argument … from String to Object") while the call read as success.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ArgumentList
    {
        internal ArgumentList(IReadOnlyList<object?> values, RqlKernel kernel) { Values = values; Kernel = kernel; }
        internal IReadOnlyList<object?> Values { get; }
        internal RqlKernel Kernel { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>Takes any RQL list as an <see cref="ArgumentList"/>.</summary>
    public sealed class Godot_ArgumentList_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<ArgumentList>
    {
        public override string Description => "a list of method arguments, e.g. [\"(0, 5)\", 0, \"res://icon.svg\"]";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<ArgumentList> m) { }

        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            reason = null;
            result = null;
            if (value is string || !(value is IEnumerable items)) { reason = "expected a list of arguments, e.g. [1, \"(0, 5)\"]"; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
            result = new ArgumentList(items.Cast<object?>().ToList(), kernel);
            return AdapterOutcome.Ok;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Converting <see cref="ArgumentList"/> values to the argument types of a Godot method.</summary>
    internal static class GodotCallArguments
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The Variants to call <paramref name="method"/> of <paramref name="o"/> with, each converted to the type the method
        /// declares; throws <see cref="ArgumentException"/> naming the argument that does not convert. Vararg extras and
        /// untyped (Variant) arguments pass as given.
        /// </summary>
        public static Variant[] Convert(global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary? methodInfo, string method, ArgumentList? args, bool build = true)
        {
            var values = args?.Values ?? Array.Empty<object?>();
            var declared = methodInfo?["args"].AsGodotArray<global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>();
            var result = new Variant[values.Count];
            for (var i = 0; i < values.Count; i++)
                result[i] = !build && values[i] is ObjectValue ? default // not built while validating
                    : declared != null && i < declared.Count ? ConvertOne(values[i], declared[i], args!.Kernel, method, i)
                    : GodotVariants.ToVariant(values[i]);
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>The method list entry (name, args, default_args, flags …) of <paramref name="method"/>, or null.</summary>
        public static global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary? FindMethod(GodotObject o, string method)
        {
            foreach (var entry in o.GetMethodList())
                if (entry["name"].AsString() == method) return entry;
            return null;
        }

        private static Variant ConvertOne(object? value, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary arg, RqlKernel kernel, string method, int index)
        {
            var className = arg["class_name"].AsString();
            var label = $"{method} argument {index + 1} ({arg["name"].AsString()}: {(className.Length > 0 ? className : ((Variant.Type)arg["type"].AsInt32()).ToString())})";
            return ConvertTo(value, arg, kernel, label);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// <paramref name="value"/> converted like a <c>set</c> would to the type a Godot method argument or property list entry
        /// (<paramref name="info"/>: type, hint, hint_string, class_name) declares; throws <see cref="ArgumentException"/> starting
        /// with <paramref name="label"/> when it does not convert.
        /// </summary>
        public static Variant ConvertTo(object? value, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary info, RqlKernel kernel, string label)
        {
            var type = (Variant.Type)info["type"].AsInt32();
            var hint = (PropertyHint)info["hint"].AsInt32();
            var hintString = info["hint_string"].AsString();
            var className = info["class_name"].AsString();
            if (type == Variant.Type.Nil) return GodotVariants.ToVariant(value);
            if (type == Variant.Type.Int && value is string text && GodotEnumOptions.Of(className, hint, hintString) is { Count: > 0 } options)
                return GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(options, text, out var enumValue)
                    ? Variant.From(enumValue)
                    : throw new ArgumentException($"{label}: \"{text}\" is not {GodotEnumNames.Describe(options)}");
            var classes = ObjectClasses(className);
            var target = type == Variant.Type.Object ? ObjectType(classes) : GodotVariants.ClrType(type, hint, hintString);
            if (!kernel.TryCoerce(value, target, out var converted, out var why))
            {
                // Godot arrays / dictionaries take any list / object literal (the elements are checked by Godot).
                if (type == Variant.Type.Array || type == Variant.Type.Dictionary) return GodotVariants.ToVariant(value);
                throw new ArgumentException($"{label}: {why}");
            }
            var known = classes.Where(c => ClassDB.ClassExists(c)).ToList();
            if (converted is GodotObject go && known.Count > 0 && !known.Any(c => go.IsClass(c)))
                throw new ArgumentException($"{label}: got a {go.GetClass()}, expected {string.Join(" or ", known)}");
            return GodotVariants.ToVariant(converted);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The classes an object argument or property accepts: one ("Mesh"), or several for a property that takes more than one
        /// resource type ("BaseMaterial3D,ShaderMaterial" on material_override); none when it declares no class.
        /// </summary>
        public static string[] ObjectClasses(string className) =>
            className.Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Select(c => c.Trim()).Where(c => c.Length > 0).ToArray();

        /// <summary>The C# type a value for <paramref name="classes"/> is coerced to: the class's own, Resource for a list of resource classes.</summary>
        public static Type ObjectType(string[] classes)
        {
            if (classes.Length == 1) return GodotTypes.GodotObjectType(classes[0]);
            return classes.Length > 0 && classes.All(c => typeof(Resource).IsAssignableFrom(GodotTypes.GodotObjectType(c))) ? typeof(Resource) : typeof(GodotObject);
        }

    }

    /// <summary>The names and values of a Godot enum: a class enum, an enum hint, or an enum-hinted property.</summary>
    internal static class GodotEnumOptions
    {
        /// <summary>A class enum ("Control.LayoutPreset") or an enum hint ("Begin,End,Both"): its names and values, or null.</summary>
        public static List<(string name, long value)>? Of(string className, PropertyHint hint, string hintString)
        {
            var dot = className.LastIndexOf('.');
            if (dot > 0 && ClassDB.ClassExists(className.Substring(0, dot)))
            {
                var owner = className.Substring(0, dot);
                return ClassDB.ClassGetEnumConstants(owner, className.Substring(dot + 1))
                    .Select(c => (c, ClassDB.ClassGetIntegerConstant(owner, c))).ToList();
            }
            return hint == PropertyHint.Enum ? GodotEnumNames.ParseHint(hintString) : null;
        }

        private static bool? _hasSetterApi;

        /// <summary>
        /// The setter method of a class's property ("" when it has none), or null before Godot 4.4: ClassDB.class_get_property_setter
        /// is 4.4+ (the addon's floor is 4.3), so it is called by name when it exists (checked once per session).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? PropertySetter(string godotClass, string property)
        {
            var classDb = Engine.GetSingleton("ClassDB");
            _hasSetterApi ??= classDb != null && classDb.HasMethod("class_get_property_setter");
            return _hasSetterApi == true ? classDb!.Call("class_get_property_setter", godotClass, property).AsString() : null;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The names an enum-hinted int property takes: its hint labels ("Top,Bottom,Both") and, when its setter's argument is a
        /// class enum, that enum's constants (GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN …), which can differ from the labels.
        /// </summary>
        public static List<(string name, long value)> OfProperty(GodotObject o, string property, string hintString)
        {
            var options = GodotEnumNames.ParseHint(hintString);
            if (PropertySetter(o.GetClass(), property) is not { } setter) return options;
            var args = setter.Length > 0 ? GodotCallArguments.FindMethod(o, setter)?["args"].AsGodotArray<global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>() : null;
            if (args is { Count: > 0 } && Of(args[0]["class_name"].AsString(), PropertyHint.None, "") is { } constants) options.AddRange(constants);
            return options;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Enum values written by name where Godot stores an int: an enum-hinted property (<c>grow_horizontal</c>, hint string
    /// <c>"Begin,End,Both"</c>) or a method argument of a class enum (<c>Control.LayoutPreset</c>). Accepts the name as the
    /// inspector shows it (<c>"Both"</c>, also without a parenthesised note: <c>"PSSM 4 Splits"</c> for
    /// <c>"PSSM 4 Splits (Quality)"</c>), the C++ / C# constant (<c>"GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH"</c>, <c>"PresetFullRect"</c>,
    /// <c>"Parallel4Splits"</c>; setter constants need Godot 4.4+) or the short form (<c>"FullRect"</c>). Pure managed: no Godot types (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    internal static class GodotEnumNames
    {
        /// <summary>The options of an enum hint string: "A,B,C" (0, 1, 2) or "A:3,B,C:10" (a value continues from the last).</summary>
        public static List<(string name, long value)> ParseHint(string hintString)
        {
            var options = new List<(string, long)>();
            long next = 0;
            foreach (var part in (hintString ?? "").Split(','))
            {
                var item = part.Trim();
                if (item.Length == 0) continue;
                var colon = item.LastIndexOf(':');
                if (colon > 0 && long.TryParse(item.Substring(colon + 1), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var explicitValue))
                {
                    options.Add((item.Substring(0, colon).Trim(), explicitValue));
                    next = explicitValue + 1;
                }
                else options.Add((item, next++));
            }
            return options;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The value of the option <paramref name="text"/> names: the same name (case-insensitive), the same letters without
        /// separators, or the one option whose name the text ends with or that ends with the text ("GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH" →
        /// "Both", "FullRect" → "PRESET_FULL_RECT"). False when nothing or more than one option matches.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool TryMatch(IReadOnlyList<(string name, long value)> options, string text, out long value)
        {
            value = 0;
            var key = Normalize(text);
            if (key.Length == 0) return false;
            foreach (var (name, v) in options)
                if (string.Equals(name, text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || Normalize(name) == key) { value = v; return true; }
            // An inspector label with a note: "PSSM 4 Splits (Quality)" is also "PSSM 4 Splits".
            var labels = options.Where(o => Normalize(WithoutNote(o.name)) == key).Select(o => o.value).Distinct().ToList();
            if (labels.Count == 1) { value = labels[0]; return true; }
            // Whole words only (split at '_', spaces and camelCase): "GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH" ends with the word "both", "Rend"
            // does not end with "end".
            var words = Words(text);
            var hits = options.Where(o => Words(o.name) is { Count: > 0 } n && (EndsWith(words, n) || EndsWith(n, words)))
                              .Select(o => o.value).Distinct().ToList();
            if (hits.Count != 1) return false;
            value = hits[0];
            return true;
        }

        private static bool EndsWith(List<string> words, List<string> tail) =>
            tail.Count <= words.Count && words.Skip(words.Count - tail.Count).SequenceEqual(tail);

        // "Orthogonal (Fast)" -> "Orthogonal"; a name without a trailing note stays as it is.
        private static string WithoutNote(string name)
        {
            var open = name.LastIndexOf(" (", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            return open > 0 && name.EndsWith(")", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? name.Substring(0, open) : name;
        }

        // "PRESET_FULL_RECT" / "PresetFullRect" / "full rect" -> [preset, full, rect]; digits are a word of their own
        // ("SHADOW_PARALLEL_4_SPLITS" / "Parallel4Splits" -> [..., parallel, 4, splits]).
        private static List<string> Words(string s)
        {
            var words = new List<string>();
            var current = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            char prev = '\0';
            foreach (var c in s ?? "")
            {
                if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)) { Flush(); prev = c; continue; }
                if (current.Length > 0 && ((char.IsUpper(c) && char.IsLower(prev)) || char.IsDigit(c) != char.IsDigit(prev))) Flush();
                current.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
                prev = c;
            }
            Flush();
            return words;

            void Flush()
            {
                if (current.Length > 0) words.Add(current.ToString());
                current.Clear();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>"one of: Begin, End, Both" for an error message.</summary>
        public static string Describe(IReadOnlyList<(string name, long value)> options) =>
            "one of: " + string.Join(", ", options.Select(o => o.name)) + " (or its number)";

        private static string Normalize(string s) =>
            new string((s ?? "").Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit).Select(char.ToLowerInvariant).ToArray());
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/Godot_GodotObject_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Every Godot object: identity (<c>$ref</c> "Class#instance id"), liveness (a freed object reads as null), the Godot
    /// class (<c>class</c>, which also names GDExtension classes the C# type cannot), and <c>props</c> — every Godot
    /// property by its snake_case name, read and written through <see cref="GodotObject.Get"/> / <see cref="GodotObject.Set"/>.
    /// <c>props</c> is what reaches GDScript script variables and GDExtension properties: a CLR <c>is</c> check cannot see a
    /// GDScript class, and those properties have no C# member. Where an object is expected, a <c>res://</c> path loads the
    /// resource and a node path or name finds the node in the edited scene.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_GodotObject_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<GodotObject>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "Godot object: id, class, props[\"snake_name\"] (every Godot property, GDScript variables included), " +
            "layerNames[\"collision_mask\"] (layer properties by layer name)";

        protected override string? Id(GodotObject o) =>
            GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o) ? o.GetInstanceId().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : null;

        protected override bool? Alive(GodotObject o) => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o);

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<GodotObject> m)
        {
            m.Add<ulong>("id", o => o.GetInstanceId(), description: "Godot instance id (the number in $ref)")
             .Add<string>("class", o => o.GetClass(), description: "Godot class name, e.g. \"OmniLight3D\" (GDExtension classes too)");
            m.Untyped.AddMixedMap("props",
                o => GodotVariants.Properties((GodotObject)o).Keys,
                // An enum-hinted int (grow_horizontal: "Begin,End,Both") also takes a name: typed object, converted on write.
                (o, key) => Property((GodotObject)o, key) is { } info ? (IsEnumInt(info) ? typeof(object) : info.ClrType) : typeof(object),
                (o, key) => GodotVariants.ToClr(((GodotObject)o).Get(key)),
                (o, key, value) => Set((GodotObject)o, key, EnumValue((GodotObject)o, key, value, out _)),
                (o, key, value) => PropProblem((GodotObject)o, key, value),
                "every Godot property by its snake_case name (GDScript script variables and GDExtension properties included)",
                // Script-only properties (rotation_degrees, global_position …) are reachable by name but not listed.
                has: (o, key) => Property((GodotObject)o, key) != null);
            m.Untyped.AddMixedMap("layerNames",
                o => Settings.RqlLayers.Properties((GodotObject)o),
                (o, key) => typeof(object),
                (o, key) => Settings.RqlLayers.Read((GodotObject)o, key),
                (o, key, value) => Settings.RqlLayers.Write((GodotObject)o, key, value),
                (o, key, value) => Settings.RqlLayers.Validate((GodotObject)o, key, value),
                "layer properties (collision_layer, collision_mask, visibility_layer, layers, cull_mask, navigation_layers …) as lists of " +
                "layer names, a number for an unnamed layer: set layerNames[\"collision_mask\"] = [\"world\", 3]",
                // Every key reaches validate, which names the object's layer properties.
                has: (o, key) => true);
            m.ExplicitOnly("layerNames");
            m.Untyped.AddMethod("CallMethod",
                new[] { new CallableParameter("method", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("args", typeof(ArgumentList), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null) },
                typeof(object),
                (o, a) => CallMethod((GodotObject)o, (string)a[0]!, a[1] as ArgumentList),
                "call any Godot method (GDScript ones too) by name with a list of arguments, each converted to the type the method " +
                "declares (\"(1, 2)\" for a Vector2i, \"res://…\" for a resource, an enum by name); returns its result",
                (o, a) => RqlGodot.Rejection(() => Prepare((GodotObject)o, (string)a[0]!, a[1] as ArgumentList, build: false)));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// A new Godot object from an object literal naming its class — <c>{"$type": "BoxShape3D", Size: "(1, 2, 1)"}</c>, or
        /// <c>{class: "BoxShape3D", …}</c> (the member every Godot object reads as): an embedded sub-resource for a property
        /// (shape, mesh, material, environment …). A Godot class goes to RQL's own construction (C# members); a class Godot
        /// cannot instantiate is refused (C# would build a useless abstract Mesh); a script class (GDScript <c>class_name</c>)
        /// is built here, its other keys written as Godot properties (snake_case or the C#-style name).
        /// </summary>
        private static AdapterOutcome TryBuild(ObjectValue literal, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            result = null;
            reason = null;
            var key = literal.ContainsKey("$type") ? "$type" : literal.ContainsKey("class") ? "class" : null;
            if (key == null || !(literal[key] is string className) || className.Length == 0) return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
            if (ClassDB.ClassExists(className))
            {
                if (!ClassDB.CanInstantiate(className)) { reason = $"Godot class '{className}' cannot be instantiated (abstract); name a concrete class"; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
                // RQL builds it from "$type" with the C# type (CSGBox3D's is CsgBox3D, ORMMaterial3D's OrmMaterial3D). Rewritten in
                // place and left to RQL rather than built through the kernel here: a nested value of the same target type would
                // then skip this adapter (the kernel's re-entry guard) and lose res:// paths and nested literals.
                var clr = GodotTypes.GodotClassType(className);
                if (clr == null) { reason = $"no C# type for Godot class '{className}'"; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
                literal.Remove("class");
                literal["$type"] = clr.FullName;
                return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
            }
            if (!RqlGodot.IsGlobalScriptClass(className)) return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
            GodotObject built;
            try { built = RqlGodot.Instantiate<GodotObject>(className, typeof(Resource).IsAssignableFrom(target) ? "Resource" : "Object", "class"); }
            catch (ArgumentException e) { reason = e.Message; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
            reason = target.IsInstanceOfType(built) ? SetScriptProperties(built, className, key, literal, kernel) : $"a {className} is not a {target.Name}";
            if (reason == null) { result = built; return AdapterOutcome.Ok; }
            if (!(built is RefCounted)) built.Free(); // a failed build of a Node / Object script class is not kept
            return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
        }

        // The literal's other keys as Godot properties of a script-class object (snake_case or the C#-style name); the problem.
        private static string? SetScriptProperties(GodotObject built, string className, string classKey, ObjectValue literal, RqlKernel kernel)
        {
            var props = GodotVariants.Properties(built);
            foreach (var kv in literal)
            {
                if (kv.Key == classKey) continue;
                var name = props.ContainsKey(kv.Key) ? kv.Key : kv.Key.ToSnakeCase();
                if (!props.TryGetValue(name, out var info)) return $"{className} has no property '{kv.Key}'";
                var value = EnumValue(built, name, kv.Value, out var problem);
                if (problem != null) return $"'{kv.Key}': {problem}";
                // A Godot-object property (a texture path, a nested literal) is coerced here first: through the kernel it could
                // skip this adapter (re-entry guard of the same target type).
                object? converted = null;
                string? why = null;
                var outcome = typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(info.ClrType)
                    ? CoerceObject(value, info.ClrType, kernel, out converted, out why)
                    : AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
                if (outcome == AdapterOutcome.NotHandled && !kernel.TryCoerce(value, info.ClrType, out converted, out why)) outcome = AdapterOutcome.Failed;
                if (outcome == AdapterOutcome.Failed) return $"'{kv.Key}': {why}";
                built.Set(name, GodotVariants.ToVariant(converted));
            }
            return null;
        }

        // A listed property (stored or in the inspector), else a script-only one.
        private static GodotVariants.GodotProperty? Property(GodotObject o, string key) =>
            GodotVariants.Properties(o).TryGetValue(key, out var info) ? info : GodotVariants.ScriptOnlyProperty(o, key);

        private static bool IsEnumInt(GodotVariants.GodotProperty info) => info.Type == Variant.Type.Int && info.Hint == PropertyHint.Enum;

        private static string? PropProblem(GodotObject o, string key, object? value)
        {
            EnumValue(o, key, value, out var problem);
            return problem;
        }

        // The value property `key` is written with: an enum-hinted int's name becomes its number; other values pass as given.
        // An unknown property, or an enum name / value that is not a number, sets `problem`.
        private static object? EnumValue(GodotObject o, string key, object? value, out string? problem)
        {
            problem = null;
            if (!(Property(o, key) is { } info)) { problem = $"{o.GetClass()} has no property '{key}'"; return value; }
            if (!IsEnumInt(info)) return value;
            switch (value)
            {
                case string number when long.TryParse(number, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var parsed): return parsed;
                case string text:
                    var options = GodotEnumOptions.OfProperty(o, key, info.HintString);
                    if (GodotEnumNames.TryMatch(options, text, out var v)) return v;
                    problem = $"\"{text}\" is not {GodotEnumNames.Describe(options)}";
                    return value;
                case double d when d == Math.Floor(d) && !double.IsInfinity(d): return (long)d;
                case int or long or Enum: return Convert.ToInt64(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                default:
                    problem = $"expected a name ({GodotEnumNames.Describe(GodotEnumNames.ParseHint(info.HintString))}), got {value ?? "null"}";
                    return value;
            }
        }

        private static void Set(GodotObject o, string key, object? value)
        {
            var variant = GodotVariants.ToVariant(value);
            // A typed array property (Array[Font] …) refuses an untyped Array: fill a copy of the current, typed one
            // instead. An element of the wrong type is refused by Godot; that makes the whole write fail (rollback).
            var current = o.Get(key);
            if (current.VariantType == Variant.Type.Array && variant.VariantType == Variant.Type.Array)
            {
                var source = variant.AsGodotArray();
                var typed = current.AsGodotArray().Duplicate(false);
                typed.Clear();
                foreach (var element in source) typed.Add(element);
                if (typed.Count != source.Count)
                    throw new ArgumentException($"'{key}' is a typed array; an element does not match its element type");
                variant = typed;
            }
            o.Set(key, variant);
        }

        private static object? CallMethod(GodotObject o, string method, ArgumentList? args) =>
            GodotVariants.ToClr(o.Call(method, Prepare(o, method, args)));

        // Every check of a call and its converted arguments; the call validator runs it for every target first (dry runs too),
        // with build false: object literals are not built there (a Node built per target would never be freed).
        private static Variant[] Prepare(GodotObject o, string method, ArgumentList? args, bool build = true)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(method)) throw new ArgumentException("CallMethod needs a method name");
            if (!o.HasMethod(method)) throw new ArgumentException($"{o.GetClass()} has no method '{method}'");
            // In the editor a non-tool script runs as a placeholder: Godot answers a call to its methods with an error text
            // ("Attempt to call a method on a placeholder instance…") as if it were the result.
            if (!ClassDB.ClassHasMethod(o.GetClass(), method) && o.GetScript().As<Script>() is { } script && !script.IsTool())
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{method}' is a method of the non-tool script {script.ResourcePath}, which does not run in the editor; " +
                    "add @tool at the top of a GDScript (or [Tool] on a C# class) to call it here");
            var entry = GodotCallArguments.FindMethod(o, method);
            if (ArgumentProblem(entry, method, args?.Values.Count ?? 0) is { } problem) throw new ArgumentException(problem);
            return GodotCallArguments.Convert(entry, method, args, build);
        }

        // A wrong argument count makes Godot print an error and return null, which would read as a successful call.
        private static string? ArgumentProblem(global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary? entry, string method, int given)
        {
            if (entry == null || (entry["flags"].AsInt32() & (int)MethodFlags.Vararg) != 0) return null;
            var max = entry["args"].AsGodotArray().Count;
            var min = max - entry["default_args"].AsGodotArray().Count;
            return given >= min && given <= max ? null : $"{method} takes {(min == max ? $"{max}" : $"{min} to {max}")} argument(s), got {given}";
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Text where a Godot object is expected: a <c>res://</c> / <c>uid://</c> path loads the resource, a node path or name
        /// finds the node in the edited scene (<c>godot.find</c> rules).
        /// </summary>
        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason) =>
            CoerceObject(value, target, kernel, out result, out reason);

        private static AdapterOutcome CoerceObject(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            result = null;
            reason = null;
            if (value is ObjectValue literal) return TryBuild(literal, target, kernel, out result, out reason);
            if (!(value is string text) || text.Length == 0) return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
            var wantsResource = typeof(Resource).IsAssignableFrom(target) || target.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(Resource));
            var wantsNode = typeof(Node).IsAssignableFrom(target) || target.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(Node));
            if (wantsResource && (text.StartsWith("res://", StringComparison.Ordinal) || text.StartsWith("uid://", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            {
                if (!RqlGodot.TryLoadResource(text, out var resource, out reason)) return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
                if (!target.IsInstanceOfType(resource)) { reason = $"'{text}' is a {resource!.GetClass()}, expected {target.Name}"; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
                result = resource;
                return AdapterOutcome.Ok;
            }
            if (wantsNode)
            {
                if (!RqlGodot.TryFindNode(text, out var node, out var error)) { reason = error!.Value.message; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
                if (!target.IsInstanceOfType(node)) { reason = $"node '{text}' is a {node!.GetClass()}, expected {target.Name}"; return AdapterOutcome.Failed; }
                result = node;
                return AdapterOutcome.Ok;
            }
            return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// MeshLibrary (the item palette of a GridMap): its items by id — name, mesh, mesh transform, collision shapes,
    /// navigation mesh, preview — with CreateItem / RemoveItem (undoable, a removed item comes back with all its settings).
    /// Item settings are Godot's stored <c>item/&lt;id&gt;/…</c> properties, so editing a row is a change of the library:
    /// undoable through the property snapshot and saved with its .tres.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_MeshLibrary_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<MeshLibrary>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "MeshLibrary: items (id name mesh meshTransform shapes navigationMesh navigationMeshTransform navigationLayers preview); " +
            "calls CreateItem(name, mesh?, id?), RemoveItem(id); item rows: set name / mesh / …, call AddShape(shape, transform?), ClearShapes()";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<MeshLibrary> m)
        {
            m.Add<List<RqlMeshItem>>("items", lib => lib.GetItemList().OrderBy(id => id).Select(id => new RqlMeshItem(lib, id)).ToList(),
                description: "the items by id: id name mesh meshTransform shapes navigationMesh preview (set them on a row)", owning: true);
            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("CreateItem",
                    new[]
                    {
                        new CallableParameter("name", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("mesh", typeof(Mesh), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null),
                        new CallableParameter("id", typeof(int), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: -1),
                    },
                    typeof(RqlMeshItem), (o, a) => CreateItem((MeshLibrary)o, (string)a[0]!, a[1] as Mesh, a[2] is int id ? id : -1),
                    "add an item with a name and an optional mesh (a res:// path works) at a free id (or the id given); returns it")
                .AddMethod("RemoveItem", new[] { new CallableParameter("id", typeof(int)) }, typeof(void),
                    (o, a) => { RemoveItem((MeshLibrary)o, (int)a[0]!); return null; }, "remove the item with that id");
        }

        private static RqlMeshItem CreateItem(MeshLibrary lib, string name, Mesh? mesh, int id)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) throw new ArgumentException("an item needs a name");
            if (id < 0) id = lib.GetLastUnusedItemId();
            else if (lib.GetItemList().Contains(id)) throw new ArgumentException($"the MeshLibrary already has an item {id} ('{lib.GetItemName(id)}')");
            lib.CreateItem(id);
            lib.SetItemName(id, name);
            if (mesh != null) lib.SetItemMesh(id, mesh);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(lib,
                ur =>
                {
                    ur.AddDoMethod(lib, MeshLibrary.MethodName.CreateItem, id);
                    ur.AddDoMethod(lib, MeshLibrary.MethodName.SetItemName, id, name);
                    if (mesh != null) { ur.AddDoMethod(lib, MeshLibrary.MethodName.SetItemMesh, id, mesh); ur.AddDoReference(mesh); }
                },
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(lib, MeshLibrary.MethodName.RemoveItem, id));
            return new RqlMeshItem(lib, id);
        }

        private static void RemoveItem(MeshLibrary lib, int id)
        {
            RqlMeshItem.Require(lib, id);
            // The item's stored properties ("item/<id>/…") come back on undo.
            RqlGodot.RecordRemoval(lib, $"item/{id}/", () => lib.RemoveItem(id),
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(lib, MeshLibrary.MethodName.RemoveItem, id),
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(lib, MeshLibrary.MethodName.CreateItem, id));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>An item of a MeshLibrary; its settings are written on the row (a change of the library).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlMeshItem : Settings.IRqlViewOf
    {
        private readonly MeshLibrary _lib;

        public RqlMeshItem(MeshLibrary lib, int id) { _lib = lib; this.id = id; }

        GodotObject Settings.IRqlViewOf.Owner => _lib;

        internal static void Require(MeshLibrary lib, int id)
        {
            if (!lib.GetItemList().Contains(id))
                throw new ArgumentException($"the MeshLibrary has no item {id} (its items: {string.Join(", ", lib.GetItemList().OrderBy(i => i))})");
        }

        // Writes and calls check the item still exists (rows are listed from the library, so reads need not).
        private int Id { get { Require(_lib, id); return id; } }

        [RqlDescription("item id (what GridMap cells refer to)")]
        public int id { get; }

        [RqlDescription("item name")]
        public string name { get => _lib.GetItemName(id); set => _lib.SetItemName(Id, value ?? ""); }

        [RqlDescription("the mesh (a res:// path works), or null")]
        public Mesh? mesh { get => _lib.GetItemMesh(id); set => _lib.SetItemMesh(Id, value); }

        [RqlDescription("transform of the mesh within the cell")]
        public Transform3D meshTransform { get => _lib.GetItemMeshTransform(id); set => _lib.SetItemMeshTransform(Id, value); }

        [RqlDescription("collision shapes: index shape transform (add with call AddShape(shape, transform?), ClearShapes())")]
        public List<RqlMeshShape> shapes
        {
            get
            {
                var raw = _lib.GetItemShapes(id);
                var list = new List<RqlMeshShape>();
                for (int i = 0; i + 1 < raw.Count; i += 2)
                    list.Add(new RqlMeshShape(list.Count, raw[i].As<Shape3D>(), raw[i + 1].VariantType == Variant.Type.Transform3D ? raw[i + 1].AsTransform3D() : Transform3D.Identity));
                return list;
            }
        }

        [RqlDescription("the navigation mesh (a res:// path works), or null")]
        public NavigationMesh? navigationMesh { get => _lib.GetItemNavigationMesh(id); set => _lib.SetItemNavigationMesh(Id, value); }

        [RqlDescription("transform of the navigation mesh within the cell")]
        public Transform3D navigationMeshTransform { get => _lib.GetItemNavigationMeshTransform(id); set => _lib.SetItemNavigationMeshTransform(Id, value); }

        [RqlDescription("navigation layers bit mask of the navigation mesh (by name: the library's layerNames[\"item/<id>/navigation_layers\"])")]
        public uint navigationLayers { get => _lib.GetItemNavigationLayers(id); set => _lib.SetItemNavigationLayers(Id, value); }

        [RqlDescription("the preview icon (a res:// texture works), or null")]
        public Texture2D? preview { get => _lib.GetItemPreview(id); set => _lib.SetItemPreview(Id, value); }

        [RqlCallable("add a collision shape (a res:// path works) with an optional transform; returns the number of shapes")]
        public int AddShape(Shape3D shape, Transform3D? transform = null)
        {
            if (shape == null) throw new ArgumentException("AddShape needs a Shape3D");
            var raw = _lib.GetItemShapes(Id).Duplicate();
            raw.Add(shape);
            raw.Add(transform ?? Transform3D.Identity);
            _lib.SetItemShapes(Id, raw);
            return raw.Count / 2;
        }

        [RqlCallable("remove every collision shape of the item")]
        public void ClearShapes() => _lib.SetItemShapes(Id, new global::Godot.Collections.Array());
    }

    /// <summary>A collision shape of a MeshLibrary item.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlMeshShape
    {
        public RqlMeshShape(int index, Shape3D? shape, Transform3D transform) { this.index = index; this.shape = shape; this.transform = transform; }

        [RqlDescription("position in the item's shape list")]
        public int index { get; }

        [RqlDescription("the Shape3D")]
        public Shape3D? shape { get; }

        [RqlDescription("its transform within the cell")]
        public Transform3D transform { get; }
    }
}
#endif
```
