`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/Godot_Node_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Node: <c>name</c> (writable), <c>path</c> below the edited scene root, <c>parent</c> / <c>Owner</c> as references,
    /// <c>children</c> (internal children excluded), <c>index</c>, <c>script</c>; structural calls AddChild,
    /// InstantiateScene, Duplicate, Free, Reparent, MoveChild (undoable, see <see cref="RqlGodot"/>.Nodes); groups, signals and
    /// persistent signal connections with Connect / Disconnect / AddToGroup / RemoveFromGroup (see RqlGodot.Signals).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Node_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<Node>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "Node: name, path, class, parent, children, index, script, groups, signals, connections, incoming, overrides, props[\"…\"]; calls " +
            "AddChild(class, name), InstantiateScene(path), Duplicate(), Free(), Reparent(node), MoveChild(index), " +
            "Connect(signal, target, method), Disconnect(signal, target, method), AddToGroup(group), RemoveFromGroup(group); " +
            "a node path or name works where a node is expected";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<Node> m)
        {
            // The C# Name is a StringName; the virtual name below reads and writes it as text.
            m.Hide("Name");
            m.Add<string>("name", n => n.Name.ToString(), (n, v) => Rename(n, v),
                    validate: (n, v) => v == n.Name.ToString() ? null : RqlGodot.ForeignRenameProblem(n) ?? NodeNameRules.Problem(v, name => SiblingHas(n, name)),
                    description: "node name")
             .Add<string>("path", n => RqlGodot.PathOf(n), description: "path below the edited scene root (\".\" = the root)")
             .Add<Node?>("parent", n => n == RqlGodot.EditedRoot() ? null : n.GetParent(),
                    description: "parent node, null for the scene root (read-only: move a node with call Reparent(node))")
             .Add<List<Node>>("children", n => Children(n), description: "direct child nodes (internal children excluded)", owning: true)
             .Add<int>("childCount", n => n.GetChildCount(includeInternal: false), description: "number of child nodes")
             .Add<int>("index", n => Math.Max(0, n.GetIndex(includeInternal: false)), description: "position among its siblings (reorder with call MoveChild(i))")
             .Add<string?>("script", n => ScriptPath(n), description: "res:// path of the attached script, or null")
             .Add<List<string>>("groups", n => RqlGodot.GroupsOf(n), (n, v) => RqlGodot.SetGroups(n, v ?? new List<string>()),
                    description: "persistent groups the node is in (saved with the scene); assign a list to replace them, or call AddToGroup / RemoveFromGroup")
             .Add<List<RqlSignal>>("signals", n => RqlGodot.SignalsOf(n), description: "signals the node can emit: name args connections")
             .Add<List<RqlConnection>>("connections", n => RqlGodot.ConnectionsOf(n),
                    description: "persistent connections from its signals (saved with the scene): signal target method flags; call Disconnect() on one")
             .Add<List<RqlConnection>>("incoming", n => RqlGodot.IncomingConnectionsOf(n),
                    description: "persistent connections whose method is on this node: source signal method")
             .Add<List<RqlOverride>>("overrides", n => RqlGodot.OverridesOf(n),
                    description: "for a scene instance, how it differs from its scene file: node property value template (a Node3D " +
                                 "transform as position / rotation_degrees / scale; the root's position, its placement, is left out); revert one " +
                                 "with set props[\"<property>\"] = <template> on that node");
            m.Reference("parent", "Owner");
            m.ExplicitOnly("signals", "connections", "incoming", "overrides");
            m.Hide("Multiplayer");
            m.Display("name");

            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("AddChild", new[] { new CallableParameter("class", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("name", typeof(string), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null) },
                    typeof(Node), (o, a) => RqlGodot.AddChild((Node)o, (string)a[0]!, a[1] as string),
                    "add a new child node of a Godot class (e.g. \"Node3D\", \"Sprite2D\", a GDScript class_name) and return it",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateAddChild((Node)o, (string)a[0]!))
                .AddMethod("InstantiateScene", new[] { new CallableParameter("path", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("name", typeof(string), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null) },
                    typeof(Node), (o, a) => RqlGodot.InstantiateScene((Node)o, (string)a[0]!, a[1] as string),
                    "instance the scene at a res:// path as a new child and return it",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateInstantiateScene((Node)o, (string)a[0]!))
                .AddMethod("Duplicate", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(Node), (o, a) => RqlGodot.Duplicate((Node)o),
                    "copy this node (with its children) next to it and return the copy",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateDuplicate((Node)o))
                .AddMethod("Free", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(void), (o, a) => { RqlGodot.Remove((Node)o); return null; },
                    "remove this node from the scene (undoable, like Delete in the Scene dock)",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateRemove((Node)o))
                .AddMethod("Reparent", new[] { new CallableParameter("parent", typeof(Node)), new CallableParameter("keepGlobalTransform", typeof(bool), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: true) },
                    typeof(void), (o, a) => { RqlGodot.Reparent((Node)o, a[0] as Node, a[1] is bool keep ? keep : true); return null; },
                    "move this node under another node, keeping its global transform unless keepGlobalTransform is false",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateReparent((Node)o, a[0] as Node))
                .AddMethod("MoveChild", new[] { new CallableParameter("index", typeof(int)) },
                    typeof(int), (o, a) => RqlGodot.MoveChild((Node)o, (int)a[0]!),
                    "move this node to a position among its siblings (0 = first, -1 = last); returns the resulting index",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateMoveChild((Node)o))
                .AddMethod("Connect", new[]
                    {
                        new CallableParameter("signal", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("target", typeof(Node)), new CallableParameter("method", typeof(string)),
                        new CallableParameter("deferred", typeof(bool), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: false),
                        new CallableParameter("oneShot", typeof(bool), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: false),
                    },
                    typeof(RqlConnection),
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.Connect((Node)o, (string)a[0]!, (Node)a[1]!, (string)a[2]!, a[3] is true, a[4] is true),
                    "connect one of this node's signals to a method of a target node (persistent: saved with the scene, like the Node dock); the method must exist in the target's script",
                    (o, a) => RqlGodot.ValidateConnect((Node)o, (string)a[0]!, a[1] as Node, (string)a[2]!))
                .AddMethod("Disconnect", new[] { new CallableParameter("signal", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("target", typeof(Node)), new CallableParameter("method", typeof(string)) },
                    typeof(void), (o, a) => { RqlGodot.Disconnect((Node)o, (string)a[0]!, (Node)a[1]!, (string)a[2]!); return null; },
                    "remove a connection from one of this node's signals")
                .AddMethod("AddToGroup", new[] { new CallableParameter("group", typeof(string)) },
                    typeof(bool), (o, a) => RqlGodot.AddToGroup((Node)o, (string)a[0]!),
                    "add the node to a persistent group (saved with the scene); returns false when it already was in it")
                .AddMethod("RemoveFromGroup", new[] { new CallableParameter("group", typeof(string)) },
                    typeof(bool), (o, a) => RqlGodot.RemoveFromGroup((Node)o, (string)a[0]!),
                    "remove the node from a group; returns false when it was not in it");
        }

        private static List<Node> Children(Node n)
        {
            var count = n.GetChildCount(includeInternal: false);
            var list = new List<Node>(count);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                if (n.GetChild(i, includeInternal: false) is { } child) list.Add(child);
            return list;
        }

        // The root has no siblings in the scene (its parent is the editor's viewport).
        private static bool SiblingHas(Node n, string name) =>
            n != RqlGodot.EditedRoot() && n.GetParent()?.GetNodeOrNull(name) is { } other && other != n;

        // Validation sees the names before the set: two rows given the same new name both pass, and Godot would make the
        // second unique ("Enemy2"). Throwing rolls the whole set back.
        private static void Rename(Node n, string v)
        {
            n.Name = v;
            if (n.Name.ToString() != v)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(NodeNameRules.Taken(v));
        }

        private static string? ScriptPath(Node n)
        {
            var script = n.GetScript();
            if (script.VariantType == Variant.Type.Nil) return null;
            var path = script.As<Script>()?.ResourcePath;
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) ? null : path;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/Godot_ProjectSettings_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │

│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The ProjectSettings singleton (the <c>project</c> source): <c>settings["section/key"]</c> reads and writes any project
    /// setting typed like the Project Settings dialog does, <c>name</c> / <c>mainScene</c> for the two most used ones, and
    /// calls for the input map, autoloads and global groups. Changes are one undo action and are saved to project.godot.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_ProjectSettings_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<ProjectSettingsInstance>
    {
        /// <summary>The members and calls, shared with the <c>project</c> source description.</summary>
        public const string Summary =
            "project settings (project.godot): settings[\"section/key\"], name, mainScene; calls SetSetting, ClearSetting, " +
            "AddInputAction, RemoveInputAction, AddInputEvent, RemoveInputEvent, AddAutoload, RemoveAutoload, AddGlobalGroup, RemoveGlobalGroup";

        public override string Description => "Project settings: " + Summary;

        private const string NameSetting = "application/config/name";
        private const string MainSceneSetting = "application/run/main_scene";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<ProjectSettingsInstance> m)
        {
            m.Add<string>("name", _ => ProjectSettings.GetSetting(NameSetting).AsString(), (_, v) => RqlProject.Set(NameSetting, v),
                    validate: (_, v) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v) ? "the project name cannot be empty" : null,
                    description: "project name (application/config/name)")
             .Add<string?>("mainScene", _ => ProjectSettings.GetSetting(MainSceneSetting).AsString() is { Length: > 0 } s ? s : null,
                    (_, v) => RqlProject.Set(MainSceneSetting, v ?? ""), validate: (_, v) => ValidateScene(v),
                    description: "res:// path of the scene the game starts with (application/run/main_scene)");
            m.Untyped.AddMixedMap("settings",
                o => GodotVariants.Properties((GodotObject)o).Keys,
                (o, key) => GodotVariants.Properties((GodotObject)o).TryGetValue(key, out var info) ? info.ClrType : typeof(object),
                (o, key) => RqlProject.Get(key),
                (o, key, value) => RqlProject.Set(key, GodotVariants.ToVariant(value)),
                (o, key, value) => GodotVariants.Properties((GodotObject)o).ContainsKey(key)
                    ? null
                    : $"no project setting '{key}'; create a custom one with project | call SetSetting(\"{key}\", value)",
                "every project setting by its path (\"display/window/size/viewport_width\"), typed; list them with the settings source",
                // Every key passes to validate, which names SetSetting for a setting that does not exist yet.
                has: (o, key) => true);
            m.Display("name");

            var u = m.Untyped;
            u.AddMethod("SetSetting", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)), P("value", typeof(object)) }, typeof(object),
                (o, a) => SetSetting((string)a[0]!, a[1]),
                "create a custom setting, or set one to a value of its own type; returns the value");
            u.AddMethod("ClearSetting", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)) }, typeof(void),
                (o, a) => { ClearSetting((string)a[0]!); return null; },
                "remove a custom setting, or return a built-in one to its default");
            u.AddMethod("AddInputAction",
                new[] { P("name", typeof(string)), P("events", typeof(string[]), null), P("deadzone", typeof(double), double.NaN) },
                typeof(RqlInputAction),
                (o, a) => RqlProject.AddInputAction((string)a[0]!, a[1] as string[], a[2] is double d && !double.IsNaN(d) ? d : (double?)null),
                "add an input action with optional events (e.g. [\"Key:Space\", \"JoypadButton:A\"]) and deadzone; returns it");
            u.AddMethod("RemoveInputAction", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)) }, typeof(void),
                (o, a) => { RqlProject.RemoveInputAction((string)a[0]!); return null; }, "remove an input action");
            u.AddMethod("AddInputEvent", new[] { P("action", typeof(string)), P("event", typeof(string)) }, typeof(object),
                (o, a) => new RqlInputAction(RqlProject.RequireInputAction((string)a[0]!)).AddEvent((string)a[1]!),
                "add an input event (\"Key:W\", \"Mouse:Left\", \"JoypadButton:A\", \"JoypadMotion:LeftX-\") to an action; returns its events");
            u.AddMethod("RemoveInputEvent", new[] { P("action", typeof(string)), P("event", typeof(string)) }, typeof(object),
                (o, a) => new RqlInputAction(RqlProject.RequireInputAction((string)a[0]!)).RemoveEvent((string)a[1]!),
                "remove an input event from an action by its text; returns its events");
            u.AddMethod("AddAutoload", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)), P("path", typeof(string)), P("singleton", typeof(bool), true) },
                typeof(RqlAutoload), (o, a) => RqlProject.AddAutoload((string)a[0]!, (string)a[1]!, a[2] is bool b ? b : true),
                "add an autoload of a res:// script or scene (singleton = a global variable of that name); returns it");
            u.AddMethod("RemoveAutoload", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)) }, typeof(void),
                (o, a) => { RqlProject.RemoveAutoload((string)a[0]!); return null; }, "remove an autoload");
            u.AddMethod("AddGlobalGroup", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)), P("description", typeof(string), "") }, typeof(void),
                (o, a) => { RqlProject.AddGlobalGroup((string)a[0]!, a[1] as string); return null; },
                "add a global group (Project Settings → Global Groups)");
            u.AddMethod("RemoveGlobalGroup", new[] { P("name", typeof(string)) }, typeof(void),
                (o, a) => { RqlProject.RemoveGlobalGroup((string)a[0]!); return null; }, "remove a global group");
        }

        private static CallableParameter P(string name, Type type) => new CallableParameter(name, type);

        private static CallableParameter P(string name, Type type, object? defaultValue) =>
            new CallableParameter(name, type, hasDefault: true, defaultValue: defaultValue);

        private static string? ValidateScene(string? path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return null;
            if (!(ResPathNormalizer.IsResPath(path) && ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(path)) && !path.StartsWith("uid://", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                return $"'{path}' is not a res:// path to a scene (.tscn, .scn)";
            return ResourceLoader.Exists(path) ? null : $"no scene at '{path}'";
        }

        private static object? SetSetting(string name, object? value)
        {
            var variant = GodotVariants.ToVariant(value);
            // RQL numbers are doubles: a whole number creates an int setting (written 3, not 3.0).
            if (variant.VariantType == Variant.Type.Float && !ProjectSettings.HasSetting(name) && variant.AsDouble() % 1 == 0
                && Math.Abs(variant.AsDouble()) < 9e15)
                variant = (long)variant.AsDouble();
            if (ProjectSettings.HasSetting(name))
            {
                var current = ProjectSettings.GetSetting(name);
                if (current.VariantType != Variant.Type.Nil && variant.VariantType != current.VariantType && !Numeric(current, variant))
                    throw new ArgumentException($"'{name}' holds a {current.VariantType}, not a {variant.VariantType}: set it with " +
                                                $"project | set settings[\"{name}\"] = … (the value is converted to its type)");
                if (Numeric(current, variant))
                    variant = current.VariantType == Variant.Type.Int ? (Variant)(long)variant.AsDouble() : variant.AsDouble();
            }
            RqlProject.Set(name, variant);
            return RqlProject.Get(name);
        }

        private static bool Numeric(Variant a, Variant b) =>
            (a.VariantType is Variant.Type.Int or Variant.Type.Float) && (b.VariantType is Variant.Type.Int or Variant.Type.Float)
            && !(a.VariantType == Variant.Type.Int && b.VariantType == Variant.Type.Float && b.AsDouble() % 1 != 0);

        private static void ClearSetting(string name)
        {
            if (!ProjectSettings.HasSetting(name)) throw new ArgumentException($"no project setting '{name}'");
            // A built-in setting goes back to its default (its revert value); a custom one has none (null) and is removed.
            // PropertyCanRevert is false for a built-in already at its default, so it must not gate this: setting null
            // would erase the built-in setting.
            RqlProject.Set(name, RqlProject.Instance.PropertyGetRevert(name));
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/Godot_ShaderMaterial_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// ShaderMaterial: the shader's uniforms (<c>uniforms</c>: name, type, group, default, value, overridden) and
    /// <c>params["uniform"]</c> — every uniform of the shader (text or VisualShader alike) by name, typed by the uniform,
    /// validated against the shader's uniform list; assigning null reverts one to its default. Writes go through
    /// <see cref="ShaderMaterial.SetShaderParameter"/>, i.e. the stored <c>shader_parameter/…</c> properties, so the
    /// mutation's property snapshot makes them undoable and a material file is saved.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_ShaderMaterial_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<ShaderMaterial>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "ShaderMaterial: Shader, uniforms (name type group default value overridden), params[\"uniform\"] typed by the shader's uniforms " +
            "(null reverts one to its default); calls ClearParam(name), ClearParams()";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<ShaderMaterial> m)
        {
            m.Add<List<RqlShaderUniform>>("uniforms", mat => RqlShaderUniform.Of(mat.Shader, mat),
                description: "the shader's uniforms: name type group default value overridden");
            m.Untyped.AddMixedMap("params",
                o => ShaderUniforms.Of(((ShaderMaterial)o).Shader).Keys,
                // Nullable: assigning null reverts a uniform to its default.
                (o, key) => ShaderUniforms.Of(((ShaderMaterial)o).Shader).TryGetValue(key, out var u) ? Nullable(u.ClrType) : typeof(object),
                (o, key) => ShaderUniforms.Of(((ShaderMaterial)o).Shader).TryGetValue(key, out var u) ? u.Value((ShaderMaterial)o) : null,
                (o, key, value) => ((ShaderMaterial)o).SetShaderParameter(key, GodotVariants.ToVariant(value)),
                (o, key, value) => Validate((ShaderMaterial)o, key, value),
                "the shader's uniforms by name, typed (e.g. params[\"speed\"] = 2, params[\"tint\"] = \"#ff8800\", a texture as res://…); null reverts to the default",
                // Every key reaches validate, which names the shader's uniforms.
                has: (o, key) => true);
            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("ClearParam", new[] { new CallableParameter("name", typeof(string)) }, typeof(bool),
                    (o, a) => Clear((ShaderMaterial)o, Require((ShaderMaterial)o, (string)a[0]!)),
                    "revert one uniform to the shader's default; returns false when it already had the default")
                .AddMethod("ClearParams", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => ShaderUniforms.Of(((ShaderMaterial)o).Shader).Values.Count(u => Clear((ShaderMaterial)o, u)),
                    "revert every uniform to the shader's default; returns how many had another value");
        }

        private static Type Nullable(Type t) => t.IsValueType && System.Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(t) == null ? typeof(Nullable<>).MakeGenericType(t) : t;

        // The uniform a key names, or why there is none.
        private static ShaderUniform? Find(ShaderMaterial mat, string key, out string? reason)
        {
            reason = null;
            if (mat.Shader == null)
            {
                reason = "the material has no shader: set Shader first (e.g. set Shader = \"res://….gdshader\")";
                return null;
            }
            var uniforms = ShaderUniforms.Of(mat.Shader);
            if (uniforms.TryGetValue(key, out var uniform)) return uniform;
            reason = uniforms.Count == 0
                ? $"the shader has no uniforms (no '{key}')"
                : $"the shader has no uniform '{key}' (its uniforms: {string.Join(", ", uniforms.Keys.Take(30))})" + RqlGodot.Similar(uniforms.Keys, key);
            return null;
        }

        private static ShaderUniform Require(ShaderMaterial mat, string key) => Find(mat, key, out var reason) ?? throw new ArgumentException(reason);

        private static string? Validate(ShaderMaterial mat, string key, object? value)
        {
            if (!(Find(mat, key, out var reason) is { } uniform)) return reason;
            if (value is Resource resource && uniform.Class is { Length: > 0 } classes
                && !classes.Split(',').Any(c => ClassDB.ClassExists(c.Trim()) && (resource.GetClass() == c.Trim() || ClassDB.IsParentClass(resource.GetClass(), c.Trim()))))
                return $"uniform '{key}' takes a {classes}, not a {resource.GetClass()}";
            return null;
        }

        private static bool Clear(ShaderMaterial mat, ShaderUniform uniform)
        {
            var overridden = uniform.Overridden(mat);
            mat.SetShaderParameter(uniform.Name, default(Variant));
            return overridden;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Shader: its uniforms (name type group default), for a text shader and a VisualShader alike.</summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Shader_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<Shader>
    {
        public override string Description => "Shader: Code, uniforms (name type group default); a ShaderMaterial sets them in params[\"…\"]";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<Shader> m) =>
            m.Add<List<RqlShaderUniform>>("uniforms", s => RqlShaderUniform.Of(s, null), description: "the shader's uniforms: name type group default");
    }

    /// <summary>One uniform of a shader as <see cref="Shader.GetShaderUniformList"/> describes it, with its default.</summary>
    internal sealed class ShaderUniform
    {
        private readonly Shader _shader;
        private readonly Lazy<Dictionary<string, double[]>> _codeDefaults;
        private readonly Lazy<object?> _default;

        public ShaderUniform(Shader shader, Lazy<Dictionary<string, double[]>> codeDefaults, GodotVariants.GodotProperty info, string name, string group)
        {
            _shader = shader; _codeDefaults = codeDefaults; Info = info; Name = name; Group = group;
            _default = new Lazy<object?>(ReadDefault);
        }

        public string Name { get; }
        public GodotVariants.GodotProperty Info { get; }
        public string Group { get; }

        public Type ClrType => Info.ClrType;

        /// <summary>The resource class(es) an object uniform takes ("Texture2D"), or null.</summary>
        public string? Class => Info.Type == Variant.Type.Object && Info.Hint == PropertyHint.ResourceType && Info.HintString.Length > 0 ? Info.HintString : null;

        /// <summary>The shader's default: the rendering server's, else the literal in the code (the headless dummy renderer keeps none).</summary>
        public object? Default => _default.Value;

        private object? ReadDefault()
        {
            var value = RenderingServer.ShaderGetParameterDefault(_shader.GetRid(), Name);
            if (value.VariantType != Variant.Type.Nil) return GodotVariants.ToClr(value);
            return _codeDefaults.Value.TryGetValue(Name, out var parts) ? ShaderUniformDefaults.ToValue(Info.Type, parts) : null;
        }

        /// <summary>The value <paramref name="mat"/> uses: its own, else the default.</summary>
        public object? Value(ShaderMaterial mat)
        {
            var own = mat.GetShaderParameter(Name);
            return own.VariantType != Variant.Type.Nil ? GodotVariants.ToClr(own) : Default;
        }

        /// <summary>Whether the material holds a value of its own that differs from the default.</summary>
        public bool Overridden(ShaderMaterial mat)
        {
            var own = mat.GetShaderParameter(Name);
            if (own.VariantType == Variant.Type.Nil) return false;
            // A shader keeps float uniforms in 32 bits (the rendering server's default of 0.1 is 0.100000001…), the material
            // the double written to it: compare them at the shader's precision.
            if (own.VariantType == Variant.Type.Float && Default is double d) return (float)own.AsDouble() != (float)d;
            return !RqlGodot.Same(own, GodotVariants.ToVariant(Default));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The uniforms of a shader, by name, in declaration order (cached for the running query).</summary>
    internal static class ShaderUniforms
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, ShaderUniform> None = new Dictionary<string, ShaderUniform>();

        public static Dictionary<string, ShaderUniform> Of(Shader? shader) =>
            shader == null ? None : GodotVariants.Scoped(("uniforms", shader.GetInstanceId()), () => Read(shader));

        private static Dictionary<string, ShaderUniform> Read(Shader shader)
        {
            var uniforms = new Dictionary<string, ShaderUniform>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var codeDefaults = new Lazy<Dictionary<string, double[]>>(() => ShaderUniformDefaults.Parse(shader.Code));
            var group = "";
            foreach (var entry in shader.GetShaderUniformList(getGroups: true))
            {
                var info = entry.AsGodotDictionary();
                var name = info["name"].AsString();
                if (GodotVariants.IsHeader((PropertyUsageFlags)info["usage"].AsInt64()))
                {
                    // "group_uniforms a;" opens a group, "group_uniforms a.b;" a subgroup ("a::b"), "group_uniforms;" closes it.
                    group = name;
                    continue;
                }
                if (name.Length == 0 || uniforms.ContainsKey(name)) continue;
                var property = new GodotVariants.GodotProperty((Variant.Type)info["type"].AsInt64(), (PropertyHint)info["hint"].AsInt64(), info["hint_string"].AsString());
                uniforms[name] = new ShaderUniform(shader, codeDefaults, property, name, group);
            }
            return uniforms;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A uniform row of <c>uniforms</c> (a Shader's, or a ShaderMaterial's with its value).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlShaderUniform
    {
        private readonly ShaderMaterial? _material;
        private readonly ShaderUniform _uniform;

        private RqlShaderUniform(ShaderMaterial? material, ShaderUniform uniform) { _material = material; _uniform = uniform; }

        internal static List<RqlShaderUniform> Of(Shader? shader, ShaderMaterial? material) =>
            ShaderUniforms.Of(shader).Values.Select(u => new RqlShaderUniform(material, u)).ToList();

        [RqlDescription("uniform name (the key of a ShaderMaterial's params)")]
        public string name => _uniform.Name;

        [RqlDescription("Godot value type (\"Float\", \"Color\", \"Vector3\" …), or the resource class of a sampler (\"Texture2D\")")]
        public string type => _uniform.Class ?? _uniform.Info.Type.ToString();

        [RqlDescription("group_uniforms group it belongs to (\"\" when none)")]
        public string group => _uniform.Group;

        [RqlDescription("the shader's default value (null when the shader computes it, or for a sampler)")]
        public object? @default => _uniform.Default;

        [RqlDescription("the value the material uses: its own, else the default (null for a Shader row)")]
        public object? value => _material == null ? null : _uniform.Value(_material);

        [RqlDescription("true when the material holds a value other than the default (false for a Shader row)")]
        public bool overridden => _material != null && _uniform.Overridden(_material);
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/Godot_Theme_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Theme: its items as six maps keyed "ControlType/item" — <c>colors["Button/font_color"]</c>, <c>constants</c>,
    /// <c>fonts</c>, <c>fontSizes</c>, <c>icons</c>, <c>styleboxes</c> — read, written and cleared (assign null to an
    /// object item, or call ClearItem) with undo, plus <c>types</c> and <c>items</c> listings.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Theme_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<Theme>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "Theme: DefaultFont, DefaultFontSize, DefaultBaseScale, types, items (type kind name value), maps keyed \"ControlType/item\": " +
            "colors, constants, fonts, fontSizes, icons, styleboxes (assign null to clear a font / icon / stylebox); calls ClearItem(kind, key), " +
            "ClearType(type)";

        // Every item kind with the name ClearItem / items use (aliases: the plural and the name without '_').
        private static readonly (Theme.DataType kind, string name)[] AllKinds =
        {
            (Theme.DataType.Color, "color"), (Theme.DataType.Constant, "constant"), (Theme.DataType.Font, "font"),
            (Theme.DataType.FontSize, "font_size"), (Theme.DataType.Icon, "icon"), (Theme.DataType.Stylebox, "stylebox"),
        };

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<Theme> m)
        {
            m.Add<List<string>>("types", t => t.GetTypeList().Where(type => HasItems(t, type)).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList(),
                    description: "control types the theme has items for (\"Button\", \"Label\" …)")
             .Add<List<RqlThemeItem>>("items", t => Items(t), description: "every item: type kind name value");
            Map<Color?>(m, "colors", Theme.DataType.Color, "colors, e.g. colors[\"Button/font_color\"] = \"#ffcc00\" (null clears)");
            Map<int?>(m, "constants", Theme.DataType.Constant, "integer constants, e.g. constants[\"HBoxContainer/separation\"] = 8 (null clears)");
            Map<int?>(m, "fontSizes", Theme.DataType.FontSize, "font sizes, e.g. fontSizes[\"Label/font_size\"] = 24 (null clears)");
            Map<Font?>(m, "fonts", Theme.DataType.Font, "fonts (a res:// path works; null clears)");
            Map<Texture2D?>(m, "icons", Theme.DataType.Icon, "icons (a res:// path works; null clears)");
            Map<StyleBox?>(m, "styleboxes", Theme.DataType.Stylebox, "style boxes (a res:// path or a StyleBox resource; null clears)");
            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("ClearItem", new[] { new CallableParameter("kind", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("key", typeof(string)) }, typeof(bool),
                    (o, a) => ClearItem((Theme)o, Kind((string)a[0]!), (string)a[1]!),
                    "remove one item: kind color, constant, font, font_size, icon or stylebox, key \"ControlType/item\"; returns false when there was none")
                .AddMethod("ClearType", new[] { new CallableParameter("type", typeof(string)) }, typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => ClearType((Theme)o, (string)a[0]!), "remove every item of a control type; returns how many");
        }

        // Every "ControlType/item" key is writable (a new key adds the item); a missing item reads as null and assigning null
        // removes one. The listed keys are the existing items.
        private static void Map<T>(MemberTable<Theme> m, string name, Theme.DataType kind, string description)
        {
            m.Map<T>(name,
                t => Keys(t, kind),
                (t, key) => Split(key, out var parts) == null ? As<T>(Get(t, kind, parts.item, parts.type)) : default!,
                (t, key, value) => Set(t, kind, key, value),
                (t, key, value) => Split(key, out _),
                description,
                has: (t, key) => true);
        }

        // Variant ints read as long: the int maps convert them; a missing item reads as null.
        private static T As<T>(object? value)
        {
            if (value is T typed) return typed;
            if (value != null && typeof(T) == typeof(int?)) return (T)(object)Convert.ToInt32(value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            return default!;
        }

        // A type whose items were all cleared stays in the theme's type list; it is not shown.
        private static bool HasItems(Theme t, string type) => AllKinds.Any(k => t.GetThemeItemList(k.kind, type).Length > 0);

        private static IEnumerable<string> Keys(Theme t, Theme.DataType kind) =>
            t.GetThemeItemTypeList(kind).SelectMany(type => t.GetThemeItemList(kind, type).Select(item => $"{type}/{item}"));

        private static List<RqlThemeItem> Items(Theme t)
        {
            var list = new List<RqlThemeItem>();
            foreach (var (kind, kindName) in AllKinds)
                foreach (var type in t.GetThemeItemTypeList(kind))
                    foreach (var item in t.GetThemeItemList(kind, type))
                        list.Add(new RqlThemeItem(type, kindName, item, GodotVariants.ToClr(t.GetThemeItem(kind, item, type))));
            return list.OrderBy(i => i.type, StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(i => i.kind, StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(i => i.name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();
        }

        private static object? Get(Theme t, Theme.DataType kind, string item, string type) =>
            t.HasThemeItem(kind, item, type) ? GodotVariants.ToClr(t.GetThemeItem(kind, item, type)) : null;

        private static void Set(Theme t, Theme.DataType kind, string key, object? value)
        {
            var (type, item) = Split(key);
            var had = t.HasThemeItem(kind, item, type);
            var before = had ? t.GetThemeItem(kind, item, type) : default;
            var after = GodotVariants.ToVariant(value);
            if (after.VariantType == Variant.Type.Nil)
            {
                if (!had) return;
                t.ClearThemeItem(kind, item, type);
            }
            else t.SetThemeItem(kind, item, type, after);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t,
                ur =>
                {
                    if (after.VariantType == Variant.Type.Nil) ur.AddDoMethod(t, Theme.MethodName.ClearThemeItem, (int)kind, item, type);
                    else ur.AddDoMethod(t, Theme.MethodName.SetThemeItem, (int)kind, item, type, after);
                },
                ur =>
                {
                    if (had) ur.AddUndoMethod(t, Theme.MethodName.SetThemeItem, (int)kind, item, type, before);
                    else ur.AddUndoMethod(t, Theme.MethodName.ClearThemeItem, (int)kind, item, type);
                });
        }

        private static bool ClearItem(Theme t, Theme.DataType kind, string key)
        {
            var (type, item) = Split(key);
            if (!t.HasThemeItem(kind, item, type)) return false;
            Set(t, kind, key, null);
            return true;
        }

        private static int ClearType(Theme t, string type)
        {
            var removed = 0;
            foreach (var (kind, _) in AllKinds)
                foreach (var item in t.GetThemeItemList(kind, type))
                {
                    Set(t, kind, $"{type}/{item}", null);
                    removed++;
                }
            return removed;
        }

        private static Theme.DataType Kind(string kind)
        {
            var key = kind.Replace(" ", "").Replace("_", "").ToLowerInvariant();
            foreach (var (k, name) in AllKinds)
            {
                var plain = name.Replace("_", "");
                if (key == plain || key == plain + "s" || key == plain + "es") return k;
            }
            throw new ArgumentException($"unknown theme item kind '{kind}' (use {string.Join(", ", AllKinds.Select(k => k.name))})");
        }

        private static (string type, string item) Split(string key)
        {
            if (Split(key, out var parts) is { } error) throw new ArgumentException(error);
            return parts;
        }

        private static string? Split(string key, out (string type, string item) parts)
        {
            parts = default;
            var slash = key.IndexOf('/');
            if (slash <= 0 || slash == key.Length - 1 || key.IndexOf('/', slash + 1) >= 0)
                return $"a theme item key is \"ControlType/item\", e.g. \"Button/font_color\", not '{key}'";
            parts = (key.Substring(0, slash), key.Substring(slash + 1));
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One item of a Theme.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlThemeItem
    {
        public RqlThemeItem(string type, string kind, string name, object? value) { this.type = type; this.kind = kind; this.name = name; this.value = value; }

        [RqlDescription("control type, e.g. \"Button\"")]
        public string type { get; }

        [RqlDescription("color, constant, font, font_size, icon or stylebox")]
        public string kind { get; }

        [RqlDescription("item name, e.g. \"font_color\"")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("the value (write it through the colors / constants / fonts / fontSizes / icons / styleboxes maps)")]
        public object? value { get; }
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/Godot_TileSet_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// TileSet: its sources (atlas textures / scene collections, by source id) and its layers (physics, terrain sets and
    /// terrains, navigation, occlusion, custom data), which Godot keeps in dynamic properties; calls add sources and layers
    /// (undoable). Per-layer settings stay reachable through <c>props["physics_layer_0/collision_layer"]</c> etc.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_TileSet_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<TileSet>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "TileSet: TileShape, TileSize, sources (id kind atlas scenes texture tileCount), physicsLayers, terrainSets, customDataLayers, " +
            "navigationLayers, occlusionLayers; calls AddAtlasSource(texture, tileSize?), RemoveSource(id), AddPhysicsLayer(), " +
            "AddTerrainSet(mode?), AddTerrain(set, name, color?), AddCustomDataLayer(name, type), AddNavigationLayer(), AddOcclusionLayer()";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<TileSet> m)
        {
            m.Add<List<RqlTileSource>>("sources", t => Sources(t), description: "the sources by id: id kind atlas texture tileCount (get sources | get atlas for an atlas source's tiles and calls)", owning: true)
             .Add<int>("physicsLayers", t => t.GetPhysicsLayersCount(), description: "number of physics layers (settings: props[\"physics_layer_<i>/…\"])")
             .Add<List<RqlTerrainSet>>("terrainSets", t => Enumerable.Range(0, t.GetTerrainSetsCount()).Select(i => new RqlTerrainSet(t, i)).ToList(),
                    description: "terrain sets: index mode terrains")
             .Add<List<RqlCustomDataLayer>>("customDataLayers",
                    t => Enumerable.Range(0, t.GetCustomDataLayersCount()).Select(i => new RqlCustomDataLayer(t.GetCustomDataLayerName(i), t.GetCustomDataLayerType(i).ToString(), i)).ToList(),
                    description: "custom data layers: index name type")
             .Add<int>("navigationLayers", t => t.GetNavigationLayersCount(), description: "number of navigation layers")
             .Add<int>("occlusionLayers", t => t.GetOcclusionLayersCount(), description: "number of occlusion layers");

            var u = m.Untyped;
            u.AddMethod("AddAtlasSource",
                    new[] { new CallableParameter("texture", typeof(Texture2D)), new CallableParameter("tileSize", typeof(Vector2I), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null) },
                    typeof(int), (o, a) => AddAtlasSource((TileSet)o, (Texture2D)a[0]!, a[1] is Vector2I size ? size : (Vector2I?)null),
                    "add an atlas source for a texture (a res:// path works), its tiles sized tileSize (default: the TileSet's TileSize); returns its source id")
             .AddMethod("RemoveSource", new[] { new CallableParameter("id", typeof(int)) }, typeof(void),
                    (o, a) => { RemoveSource((TileSet)o, (int)a[0]!); return null; }, "remove the source with that id")
             .AddMethod("AddPhysicsLayer", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => AddLayer((TileSet)o, t => t.GetPhysicsLayersCount(), t => t.AddPhysicsLayer(), TileSet.MethodName.AddPhysicsLayer, TileSet.MethodName.RemovePhysicsLayer),
                    "add a physics layer; returns its index")
             .AddMethod("AddNavigationLayer", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => AddLayer((TileSet)o, t => t.GetNavigationLayersCount(), t => t.AddNavigationLayer(), TileSet.MethodName.AddNavigationLayer, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveNavigationLayer),
                    "add a navigation layer; returns its index")
             .AddMethod("AddOcclusionLayer", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => AddLayer((TileSet)o, t => t.GetOcclusionLayersCount(), t => t.AddOcclusionLayer(), TileSet.MethodName.AddOcclusionLayer, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveOcclusionLayer),
                    "add an occlusion layer; returns its index")
             .AddMethod("AddTerrainSet", new[] { new CallableParameter("mode", typeof(string), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: "MatchCornersAndSides") }, typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => AddTerrainSet((TileSet)o, (string)a[0]!),
                    "add a terrain set (mode MatchCornersAndSides, MatchCorners or MatchSides); returns its index")
             .AddMethod("AddTerrain",
                    new[] { new CallableParameter("set", typeof(int)), new CallableParameter("name", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("color", typeof(Color), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null) },
                    typeof(int), (o, a) => AddTerrain((TileSet)o, (int)a[0]!, (string)a[1]!, a[2] is Color c ? c : (Color?)null),
                    "add a terrain to a terrain set; returns its index in the set")
             .AddMethod("AddCustomDataLayer", new[] { new CallableParameter("name", typeof(string)), new CallableParameter("type", typeof(string)) }, typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => AddCustomDataLayer((TileSet)o, (string)a[0]!, (string)a[1]!),
                    "add a custom data layer of a Godot value type (\"Int\", \"Float\", \"Bool\", \"String\", \"Color\", \"Vector2\" …); returns its index");
        }

        private static List<RqlTileSource> Sources(TileSet t)
        {
            var list = new List<RqlTileSource>(t.GetSourceCount());
            for (int i = 0; i < t.GetSourceCount(); i++)
            {
                var id = t.GetSourceId(i);
                var source = t.GetSource(id);
                RqlGodot.RegisterContainer(source, t);
                list.Add(new RqlTileSource(id, source));
            }
            return list;
        }

        private static int AddAtlasSource(TileSet t, Texture2D texture, Vector2I? tileSize)
        {
            var size = tileSize ?? t.TileSize;
            if (size.X <= 0 || size.Y <= 0) throw new ArgumentException($"tileSize must be positive, got {size}");
            var source = new TileSetAtlasSource { Texture = texture, TextureRegionSize = size };
            var id = t.AddSource(source);
            RqlGodot.RegisterContainer(source, t);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t,
                ur => { ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.AddSource, source, id); ur.AddDoReference(source); },
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveSource, id));
            return id;
        }

        private static void RemoveSource(TileSet t, int id)
        {
            if (!t.HasSource(id))
                throw new ArgumentException($"the TileSet has no source {id} (its sources: {string.Join(", ", Enumerable.Range(0, t.GetSourceCount()).Select(t.GetSourceId))})");
            var source = t.GetSource(id);
            t.RemoveSource(id);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t,
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveSource, id),
                ur => { ur.AddUndoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.AddSource, source, id); ur.AddUndoReference(source); });
        }

        private static int AddLayer(TileSet t, Func<TileSet, int> count, Action<TileSet> add, StringName addMethod, StringName removeMethod)
        {
            var index = count(t);
            add(t);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t, ur => ur.AddDoMethod(t, addMethod, index), ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(t, removeMethod, index));
            return index;
        }

        /// <summary>A terrain mode as the editor names it: MatchCornersAndSides, MatchCorners, MatchSides.</summary>
        internal static string TerrainModeName(TileSet.TerrainMode mode) => "Match" + mode;

        private static int AddTerrainSet(TileSet t, string mode)
        {
            var key = mode.Replace(" ", "").Replace("_", "");
            if (key.StartsWith("match", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) key = key.Substring(5);
            if (!TryParseName<TileSet.TerrainMode>(key, out var parsed))
                throw new ArgumentException($"unknown terrain mode '{mode}' (use {string.Join(", ", Enum.GetValues(typeof(TileSet.TerrainMode)).Cast<TileSet.TerrainMode>().Select(TerrainModeName))})");
            var index = t.GetTerrainSetsCount();
            t.AddTerrainSet();
            t.SetTerrainSetMode(index, parsed);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t,
                ur => { ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.AddTerrainSet, index); ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.SetTerrainSetMode, index, (int)parsed); },
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveTerrainSet, index));
            return index;
        }

        private static int AddTerrain(TileSet t, int set, string name, Color? color)
        {
            if (set < 0 || set >= t.GetTerrainSetsCount())
                throw new ArgumentException($"the TileSet has no terrain set {set} ({t.GetTerrainSetsCount()} terrain set(s); add one with AddTerrainSet())");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) throw new ArgumentException("a terrain needs a name");
            var index = t.GetTerrainsCount(set);
            t.AddTerrain(set);
            t.SetTerrainName(set, index, name);
            if (color is { } c) t.SetTerrainColor(set, index, c);
            var finalColor = t.GetTerrainColor(set, index);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t,
                ur =>
                {
                    ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.AddTerrain, set, index);
                    ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.SetTerrainName, set, index, name);
                    ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.SetTerrainColor, set, index, finalColor);
                },
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveTerrain, set, index));
            return index;
        }

        // An enum value by its name only: Enum.TryParse also takes numbers ("3") and flag lists ("Bool,Int").
        private static bool TryParseName<T>(string text, out T value) where T : struct, Enum
        {
            value = default;
            return Enum.GetNames(typeof(T)).FirstOrDefault(n => string.Equals(n, text.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) is { } name
                   && Enum.TryParse(name, out value);
        }

        private static int AddCustomDataLayer(TileSet t, string name, string type)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) throw new ArgumentException("a custom data layer needs a name");
            if (t.GetCustomDataLayerByName(name) >= 0) throw new ArgumentException($"the TileSet already has a custom data layer '{name}'");
            if (!TryParseName<Variant.Type>(type, out var parsed) || parsed == Variant.Type.Nil || parsed == Variant.Type.Max)
                throw new ArgumentException($"unknown value type '{type}' (e.g. Int, Float, Bool, String, Color, Vector2, Vector2I, Object)");
            var index = t.GetCustomDataLayersCount();
            t.AddCustomDataLayer();
            t.SetCustomDataLayerName(index, name);
            t.SetCustomDataLayerType(index, parsed);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(t,
                ur =>
                {
                    ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.AddCustomDataLayer, index);
                    ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.SetCustomDataLayerName, index, name);
                    ur.AddDoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.SetCustomDataLayerType, index, (int)parsed);
                },
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(t, TileSet.MethodName.RemoveCustomDataLayer, index));
            return index;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A source of a TileSet with its id.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlTileSource
    {
        public RqlTileSource(int id, TileSetSource source) { this.id = id; this.source = source; }

        [RqlDescription("source id (what TileMapLayer cells refer to)")]
        public int id { get; }

        [RqlDescription("\"atlas\" (a texture cut into tiles) or \"scenes\" (a scene collection)")]
        public string kind => source is TileSetAtlasSource ? "atlas" : source is TileSetScenesCollectionSource ? "scenes" : source.GetClass();

        private TileSetSource source { get; }

        [RqlDescription("the atlas source (Texture, TextureRegionSize, tiles; calls CreateTile, RemoveTile, CreateTilesFromTexture), or null")]
        public TileSetAtlasSource? atlas => source as TileSetAtlasSource;

        [RqlDescription("the scene collection source, or null")]
        public TileSetScenesCollectionSource? scenes => source as TileSetScenesCollectionSource;

        [RqlDescription("res:// path of an atlas source's texture, or null")]
        public string? texture => source is TileSetAtlasSource atlas && atlas.Texture is { } t && t.ResourcePath.Length > 0 ? t.ResourcePath : null;

        [RqlDescription("number of tiles (atlas) or scenes (scene collection)")]
        public int tileCount => source.GetTilesCount();
    }

    /// <summary>A terrain set of a TileSet.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlTerrainSet
    {
        private readonly TileSet _tileSet;

        public RqlTerrainSet(TileSet tileSet, int index) { _tileSet = tileSet; this.index = index; }

        [RqlDescription("terrain set index")]
        public int index { get; }

        [RqlDescription("MatchCornersAndSides, MatchCorners or MatchSides")]
        public string mode => Godot_TileSet_Adapter.TerrainModeName(_tileSet.GetTerrainSetMode(index));

        [RqlDescription("terrain names, by index")]
        public List<string> terrains => Enumerable.Range(0, _tileSet.GetTerrainsCount(index)).Select(i => _tileSet.GetTerrainName(index, i)).ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>A custom data layer of a TileSet.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlCustomDataLayer
    {
        public RqlCustomDataLayer(string name, string type, int index) { this.name = name; this.type = type; this.index = index; }

        [RqlDescription("layer index")]
        public int index { get; }

        [RqlDescription("layer name (TileData.GetCustomData(name))")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("Godot value type of the layer")]
        public string type { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// An atlas source of a TileSet: its tiles by atlas coordinates; calls create and remove tiles (undoable). Tile settings
    /// (modulate, z index, terrain, custom data …) are on each tile's <c>data</c> (a TileData object, <c>props[…]</c>).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_TileSetAtlasSource_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<TileSetAtlasSource>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "TileSet atlas source: Texture, TextureRegionSize, Margins, Separation, tiles (coords size data); calls CreateTile(coords, size?), " +
            "RemoveTile(coords), CreateTilesFromTexture()";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<TileSetAtlasSource> m)
        {
            m.Add<List<RqlTile>>("tiles", a => Tiles(a), description: "tiles by atlas coordinates: coords size data (TileData, alternative 0)", owning: true)
             .Add<Vector2I>("gridSize", a => a.GetAtlasGridSize(), description: "number of tile columns and rows the texture holds");
            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("CreateTile",
                    new[] { new CallableParameter("coords", typeof(Vector2I)), new CallableParameter("size", typeof(Vector2I), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: null) },
                    typeof(RqlTile), (o, a) => CreateTile((TileSetAtlasSource)o, (Vector2I)a[0]!, a[1] is Vector2I s ? s : Vector2I.One),
                    "create a tile at atlas coordinates \"(x, y)\" spanning size cells (default (1, 1)); returns it")
                .AddMethod("RemoveTile", new[] { new CallableParameter("coords", typeof(Vector2I)) }, typeof(void),
                    (o, a) => { RemoveTile((TileSetAtlasSource)o, (Vector2I)a[0]!); return null; }, "remove the tile at atlas coordinates")
                .AddMethod("CreateTilesFromTexture", Array.Empty<CallableParameter>(), typeof(int),
                    (o, a) => CreateTilesFromTexture((TileSetAtlasSource)o),
                    "create a tile in every free grid cell of the texture that is not fully transparent (the editor's \"create tiles in non-transparent regions\"); returns how many");
        }

        private static List<RqlTile> Tiles(TileSetAtlasSource a) =>
            Enumerable.Range(0, a.GetTilesCount()).Select(i => new RqlTile(a, a.GetTileId(i))).ToList();

        private static RqlTile CreateTile(TileSetAtlasSource a, Vector2I coords, Vector2I size)
        {
            if (a.Texture == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("the atlas source has no texture; set Texture first");
            if (size.X <= 0 || size.Y <= 0) throw new ArgumentException($"size must be positive, got {size}");
            if (!a.HasRoomForTile(coords, size, 1, Vector2I.Zero, 1))
                throw new ArgumentException($"no room for a {size} tile at {coords}: outside the texture grid {a.GetAtlasGridSize()} or overlapping a tile");
            a.CreateTile(coords, size);
            RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(a,
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(a, TileSetAtlasSource.MethodName.CreateTile, coords, size),
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(a, TileSetAtlasSource.MethodName.RemoveTile, coords));
            return new RqlTile(a, coords);
        }

        private static void RemoveTile(TileSetAtlasSource a, Vector2I coords)
        {
            if (!a.HasTile(coords)) throw new ArgumentException($"no tile at {coords}");
            var size = a.GetTileSizeInAtlas(coords);
            // The tile's stored properties ("x:y/…": its alternatives and their data) come back on undo.
            RqlGodot.RecordRemoval(a, $"{coords.X}:{coords.Y}/", () => a.RemoveTile(coords),
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(a, TileSetAtlasSource.MethodName.RemoveTile, coords),
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(a, TileSetAtlasSource.MethodName.CreateTile, coords, size));
        }

        private static int CreateTilesFromTexture(TileSetAtlasSource a)
        {
            if (a.Texture == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("the atlas source has no texture; set Texture first");
            var image = a.Texture.GetImage() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the texture's image cannot be read");
            if (image.IsCompressed()) image.Decompress();
            var grid = a.GetAtlasGridSize();
            var created = new List<Vector2I>();
            for (int y = 0; y < grid.Y; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < grid.X; x++)
                {
                    var coords = new Vector2I(x, y);
                    if (a.HasTile(coords) || a.GetTileAtCoords(coords) != new Vector2I(-1, -1)) continue;
                    if (!a.HasRoomForTile(coords, Vector2I.One, 1, Vector2I.Zero, 1)) continue;
                    if (IsTransparent(image, CellRegion(a, coords))) continue;
                    a.CreateTile(coords);
                    created.Add(coords);
                }
            if (created.Count > 0)
                RqlGodot.RecordUndoFor(a,
                    ur => { foreach (var c in created) ur.AddDoMethod(a, TileSetAtlasSource.MethodName.CreateTile, c, Vector2I.One); },
                    ur => { foreach (var c in created) ur.AddUndoMethod(a, TileSetAtlasSource.MethodName.RemoveTile, c); });
            return created.Count;
        }

        // The texture region of a grid cell (GetTileTextureRegion needs an existing tile).
        private static Rect2I CellRegion(TileSetAtlasSource a, Vector2I coords)
        {
            var size = a.TextureRegionSize;
            var step = size + a.Separation;
            return new Rect2I(a.Margins + coords * step, size);
        }

        // One native call per cell (GetPixel per pixel would be one per pixel).
        private static bool IsTransparent(Image image, Rect2I region)
        {
            var clipped = region.Intersection(new Rect2I(Vector2I.Zero, image.GetSize()));
            return clipped.Area == 0 || image.GetRegion(clipped).IsInvisible();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A tile of an atlas source.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlTile : Settings.IRqlViewOf
    {
        private readonly TileSetAtlasSource _atlas;

        public RqlTile(TileSetAtlasSource atlas, Vector2I coords) { _atlas = atlas; this.coords = coords; }

        // A write to the tile's data is a change of its atlas source (undo, and the TileSet file is saved).
        GodotObject Settings.IRqlViewOf.Owner => _atlas;

        [RqlDescription("atlas coordinates of the tile")]
        public Vector2I coords { get; }

        [RqlDescription("size in atlas cells")]
        public Vector2I size => _atlas.GetTileSizeInAtlas(coords);

        [RqlDescription("number of alternative tiles (0 = the base tile only)")]
        public int alternatives => Math.Max(0, _atlas.GetAlternativeTilesCount(coords) - 1);

        [RqlDescription("the tile's settings (alternative 0): Modulate, ZIndex, Probability, TerrainSet, Terrain, props[\"custom_data_0\"] …")]
        public TileData data => _atlas.GetTileData(coords, 0);
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/NodeNameRules.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Linq;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// What a rename (<c>set name = …</c>) may assign. Godot itself would silently change a name with a character it does not
    /// allow ("a.b" → "a_b") or one a sibling already has ("N2" → "N3"), and the receipt would show a name the node does not
    /// have; the rename is refused instead, like the Scene dock refuses an invalid name. Pure (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public static class NodeNameRules
    {
        /// <summary>The characters Godot does not allow in a node name (<c>String.get_invalid_node_name_characters</c>).</summary>
        public const string InvalidCharacters = ".:@/\"%";

        /// <summary>
        /// How to give siblings names some of them hold now (the auto names of Duplicate copies, a swap): the names are checked
        /// against the siblings as they are before the set.
        /// </summary>
        public static string Taken(string name) =>
            $"a sibling is already named '{name}' (node names are unique among siblings; to swap or renumber siblings, rename them " +
            "to temporary names first, then to the final names in a second call)";

        /// <summary>Why <paramref name="name"/> cannot be a node's name (<paramref name="siblingHas"/>: a sibling has it); null when it can.</summary>
        public static string? Problem(string? name, Func<string, bool> siblingHas)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return "a node name cannot be empty";
            if (name!.IndexOfAny(InvalidCharacters.ToCharArray()) >= 0)
            {
                var bad = name.Where(c => InvalidCharacters.IndexOf(c) >= 0).Distinct().Select(c => "'" + c + "'");
                return $"a node name cannot contain {string.Join(" ", bad)} (not allowed: {string.Join(" ", InvalidCharacters.ToCharArray())})";
            }
            if (siblingHas(name))
                return Taken(name);
            return null;
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Object/ShaderUniformDefaults.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The literal default values of a shader's uniforms, read from its code (pure, unit-tested). The rendering server
    /// knows them too, but a headless editor runs the dummy renderer, which keeps none; this covers the literal forms —
    /// <c>= 2.5</c>, <c>= -3</c>, <c>= true</c>, <c>= vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0)</c>, <c>= vec4(1.0)</c> — and leaves anything
    /// computed (expressions, nested constructors, matrices, arrays) unknown.
    /// </summary>
    public static class ShaderUniformDefaults
    {
        // uniform [precision] <type> <name> [: hints] = <default>;  (hints such as hint_range(0, 1) hold no '=' or ';')
        private static readonly Regex Uniform = new Regex(
            @"\buniform\s+(?:(?:lowp|mediump|highp)\s+)?\w+\s+(?<name>\w+)\s*(?::[^=;]*)?=\s*(?<value>[^;]+);",
            RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

        private static readonly Regex Constructor = new Regex(@"^(?<type>\w+)\s*\((?<args>[^()]*)\)$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

        private static readonly Regex Comments = new Regex(@"//[^\n]*|/\*.*?\*/", RegexOptions.Singleline | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

        /// <summary>The components of every uniform default written as a literal, by uniform name (booleans as 1 / 0).</summary>
        public static Dictionary<string, double[]> Parse(string? code)
        {
            var defaults = new Dictionary<string, double[]>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code)) return defaults;
            foreach (Match m in Uniform.Matches(Comments.Replace(code, " ")))
                if (Literal(m.Groups["value"].Value.Trim()) is { } parts)
                    defaults[m.Groups["name"].Value] = parts;
            return defaults;
        }

        // A scalar literal, or a vector constructor of scalar literals (one argument fills every component).
        private static double[]? Literal(string text)
        {
            if (Scalar(text) is { } scalar) return new[] { scalar };
            var m = Constructor.Match(text);
            if (!m.Success || Width(m.Groups["type"].Value) is not { } width) return null;
            var args = m.Groups["args"].Value.Split(',');
            var parts = new double[args.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
                if (Scalar(args[i].Trim()) is { } v) parts[i] = v;
                else return null;
            if (parts.Length == 1 && width > 1)
            {
                var fill = parts[0];
                parts = new double[width];
                for (int i = 0; i < width; i++) parts[i] = fill;
            }
            return parts.Length == width ? parts : null;
        }

        private static int? Width(string type)
        {
            var t = type.TrimStart('i', 'u', 'b');
            return t switch { "vec2" => 2, "vec3" => 3, "vec4" => 4, _ => (int?)null };
        }

        private static double? Scalar(string text)
        {
            if (text == "true") return 1;
            if (text == "false") return 0;
            var t = text.TrimEnd('f', 'F', 'u', 'U');
            return t.Length > 0 && double.TryParse(t, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var v) ? v : (double?)null;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The CLR value of parsed components for a uniform of Godot type <paramref name="type"/> (what the Variant of that type
        /// would hold: double, long, bool, vectors, Color); null when they do not fit the type.
        /// </summary>
        public static object? ToValue(Variant.Type type, double[] p)
        {
            float F(int i) => (float)p[i];
            int I(int i) => (int)p[i];
            return (type, p.Length) switch
            {
                (Variant.Type.Bool, 1) => p[0] != 0,
                (Variant.Type.Int, 1) => (long)p[0],
                (Variant.Type.Float, 1) => p[0],
                (Variant.Type.Vector2, 2) => new Vector2(F(0), F(1)),
                (Variant.Type.Vector3, 3) => new Vector3(F(0), F(1), F(2)),
                (Variant.Type.Vector4, 4) => new Vector4(F(0), F(1), F(2), F(3)),
                (Variant.Type.Vector2I, 2) => new Vector2I(I(0), I(1)),
                (Variant.Type.Vector3I, 3) => new Vector3I(I(0), I(1), I(2)),
                (Variant.Type.Vector4I, 4) => new Vector4I(I(0), I(1), I(2), I(3)),
                (Variant.Type.Color, 3) => new Color(F(0), F(1), F(2)),
                (Variant.Type.Color, 4) => new Color(F(0), F(1), F(2), F(3)),
                _ => null,
            };
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Struct/GodotFloatTupleAdapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │

│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A float tuple struct (vectors, colors, transforms, rects …): its components come from <see cref="Component"/>, with -0
    /// normalised to 0 (Godot produces -0 from rotations and quaternions). RQL (0.2+) tidies the display text (6 significant
    /// digits, float noise as 0) and compares object literals by the members they name.
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class GodotFloatTupleAdapter<T> : NumericTupleAdapter<T> where T : struct
    {
        protected sealed override float Part(T value, int index) => 0f + Component(value, index);

        /// <summary>Component <paramref name="index"/> of <paramref name="value"/>.</summary>
        protected abstract float Component(T value, int index);
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Struct/GodotIntTupleAdapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A whole-number tuple struct (Vector2I/3I/4I, Rect2I). RQL's tuple adapter is single-precision: it prints 6 significant
    /// digits ("(1.23457E+06, 2)", which writes back as 1234570) and compares with a relative tolerance (100000 == 100001).
    /// Integers print and compare exactly here. An object literal keeps RQL's comparison by the members it names.
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class GodotIntTupleAdapter<T> : NumericTupleAdapter<T> where T : struct
    {
        /// <summary>Component <paramref name="index"/> of <paramref name="value"/>.</summary>
        protected abstract int Whole(T value, int index);

        protected sealed override float Part(T value, int index) => Whole(value, index);

        protected sealed override float Tolerance => 0;

        protected override JsonNode? Encode(T value, EncodeContext context)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("(");
            for (int i = 0; i < Width; i++)
            {
                if (i > 0) sb.Append(", ");
                sb.Append(Whole(value, i).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
            return JsonValue.Create(sb.Append(')').ToString());
        }

        protected override bool? Equal(T value, object? other, RqlKernel kernel)
        {
            if (other is ObjectValue) return base.Equal(value, other, kernel);
            if (!kernel.TryCoerce(other, typeof(T), out var parsed, out _) || !(parsed is T o)) return null;
            for (int i = 0; i < Width; i++)
                if (Whole(value, i) != Whole(o, i)) return false;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
    /// <summary>Color: "(r, g, b, a)" output; "(r, g, b[, a])", [r, g, b[, a]], "#RRGGBB[AA]" or {r, g, b, a} input.</summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Color_Adapter : GodotFloatTupleAdapter<Color>
    {
        public override string Description => "Color: write as \"(r, g, b, a)\" with 0..1 components, [r, g, b] or \"#RRGGBB\"";
        protected override string Expected => "(r, g, b, a), [r, g, b] or #RRGGBB";
        protected override int Width => 4;
        // Component-wise arithmetic (RQL spec §4.2): Scale * 1.5, Position + [0, 1, 0], -Velocity.
        protected override bool Arithmetic => true;
        protected override float Component(Color c, int index) => index switch { 0 => c.R, 1 => c.G, 2 => c.B, _ => c.A };
        protected override Color? Make(float[] f) =>
            f.Length == 4 ? new Color(f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3]) : f.Length == 3 ? new Color(f[0], f[1], f[2]) : (Color?)null;

        // "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" (Godot's managed HTML parser; no native call).
        protected override Color? ParseExtra(string text)
        {
            var t = text.Trim();
            return t.StartsWith("#", System.StringComparison.Ordinal) && Color.HtmlIsValid(t) ? Color.FromHtml(t) : (Color?)null;
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
    /// <summary>
    /// Projection (a 4x4 matrix, e.g. a <c>mat4</c> shader uniform): 16 numbers column by column — the x, y, z and w columns,
    /// each (x, y, z, w) — the order Godot writes <c>Projection(…)</c> in .tres files.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Projection_Adapter : GodotFloatTupleAdapter<Projection>
    {
        public override string Description => "Projection (4x4 matrix): write as 16 numbers column by column, \"(xx, xy, xz, xw, yx, …, ww)\" or a list";
        protected override string Expected => "16 numbers, column by column: (xx, xy, xz, xw, yx, yy, yz, yw, zx, zy, zz, zw, wx, wy, wz, ww)";
        protected override int Width => 16;

        protected override float Component(Projection v, int index)
        {
            var column = (index / 4) switch { 0 => v.X, 1 => v.Y, 2 => v.Z, _ => v.W };
            return (index % 4) switch { 0 => column.X, 1 => column.Y, 2 => column.Z, _ => column.W };
        }

        protected override Projection? Make(float[] f) => f.Length == 16
            ? new Projection(new Vector4(f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3]), new Vector4(f[4], f[5], f[6], f[7]),
                new Vector4(f[8], f[9], f[10], f[11]), new Vector4(f[12], f[13], f[14], f[15]))
            : (Projection?)null;
    }
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Struct/Godot_Rid_Adapter.cs`:
