```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// RID: an opaque handle of a server object (a World3D's space, a texture on the RenderingDevice …), shown as
    /// <c>"RID(1234)"</c> like Godot prints it and compared by id. Read-only: a handle only means something to the server
    /// that issued it, so no value is written as one.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Rid_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<Rid>
    {
        public override string Description => "RID: an opaque server handle, shown as \"RID(1234)\" (Id, IsValid); read-only";

        /// <summary>The text of a RID: <c>RID(id)</c>.</summary>
        public static string Text(Rid rid) => "RID(" + rid.Id.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";

        protected override JsonNode? Encode(Rid value, EncodeContext context) => JsonValue.Create(Text(value));

        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            result = null;
            reason = null;
            if (target != typeof(Rid)) return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
            if (value is Rid rid) { result = rid; return AdapterOutcome.Ok; }
            reason = "a RID is a runtime handle of a server object and cannot be written";
            return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
        }

        protected override bool? Equal(Rid value, object? other, RqlKernel kernel) => other switch
        {
            Rid o => value.Id == o.Id,
            string s => string.Equals(Text(value), s.Replace(" ", ""), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
            double d => value.Id == d,
            long l => l >= 0 && value.Id == (ulong)l,
            _ => null,
        };

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<Rid> m) => m.HideWhere(member => member.Name != "Id" && member.Name != "IsValid");
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Struct/WholeNumbers.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>The whole-number rule of the integer struct adapters (Vector2I / Vector3I / Vector4I / Rect2I).</summary>
    internal static class WholeNumbers
    {
        /// <summary>The components as ints when there are exactly <paramref name="width"/> whole numbers; null otherwise.</summary>
        public static int[]? Of(float[] parts, int width)
        {
            if (parts.Length != width) return null;
            var ints = new int[width];
            for (int k = 0; k < width; k++)
            {
                if (Math.Abs(parts[k] - Math.Round(parts[k])) > 1e-6) return null;
                ints[k] = (int)Math.Round(parts[k]);
            }
            return ints;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Tool/Godot_NodeRef_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// NodeRef tool arguments (script-attach-to-node, screenshot-camera, screenshot-isolated) in RQL terms: a node from
    /// <c>ref("Node3D#12")</c> / <c>godot.find("Name")</c>, an instance id number, or text — a path below the edited scene
    /// root (or a node name). Pure-managed for the node-free forms, so it is unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_NodeRef_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter
    {
        public Godot_NodeRef_Adapter() : base(typeof(NodeRef)) { }

        public override string? Description =>
            "a node: ref(\"Node3D#12\") from a query, godot.find(\"Name\"), an instance id, or its path below the scene root as text (\"Level/Player\")";

        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            reason = null;
            result = value switch
            {
                NodeRef existing => existing,
                global::Godot.GodotObject o when global::Godot.GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o) => new NodeRef(o.GetInstanceId()),
                string s when s.Length > 0 => new NodeRef(s),
                double d when d >= 1 && Math.Floor(d) == d => new NodeRef((ulong)d),
                long l when l >= 1 => new NodeRef((ulong)l),
                _ => null,
            };
            if (result == null && value is double bad)
            {
                reason = $"{bad.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} is not an instance id";
                return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
            }
            return result != null ? AdapterOutcome.Ok : AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Tool/ReflectorNet_SerializedMemberList_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// SerializedMemberList tool arguments (script-execute parameters) in RQL terms, as in Unity-MCP: named values
    /// <c>{count: 3, target: ref("Node3D#12")}</c>, each becoming a parameter of its value's type. The ReflectorNet form
    /// (a list of {name, typeName, value}) still works. Pure-managed except for a node value's instance id.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ReflectorNet_SerializedMemberList_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter
    {
        public ReflectorNet_SerializedMemberList_Adapter() : base(typeof(SerializedMemberList)) { }

        public override string? Description =>
            "named values {count: 3, label: \"x\", target: ref(\"Node3D#12\")}: each is passed as a parameter of the value's type (a node, string, int, float, bool)";

        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            result = null;
            reason = null;
            if (value is ObjectValue named)
            {
                var list = new SerializedMemberList();
                foreach (var kv in named)
                {
                    if (!TryMember(kv.Key, kv.Value, out var member, out reason)) return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
                    list.Add(member!);
                }
                result = list;
                return AdapterOutcome.Ok;
            }
            if (value is List<object?> items && items.All(i => i is ObjectValue o && o.ContainsKey("typeName")))
            {
                var list = new SerializedMemberList();
                foreach (var o in items.Cast<ObjectValue>())
                {
                    var member = new SerializedMember { name = o.TryGetValue("name", out var n) ? n as string : null, typeName = o["typeName"] as string ?? "" };
                    if (o.TryGetValue("value", out var v)) member.SetJsonValue(ToJson(v)?.ToJsonString());
                    list.Add(member);
                }
                result = list;
                return AdapterOutcome.Ok;
            }
            return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
        }

        private static bool TryMember(string name, object? value, out SerializedMember? member, out string? reason)
        {
            reason = null;
            // RQL numbers are doubles: a whole one is passed as an integer (one rule for the type and the JSON).
            if (value is double whole && Math.Floor(whole) == whole && Math.Abs(whole) < 9e15)
                value = (long)whole;
            var typeName = value switch
            {
                null => "System.Object",
                global::Godot.Node node => node.GetType().FullName!,
                string _ => "System.String",
                bool _ => "System.Boolean",
                long l when l >= int.MinValue && l <= int.MaxValue => "System.Int32",
                long _ => "System.Int64",
                double _ => "System.Double",
                _ => null,
            };
            member = null;
            if (typeName == null)
            {
                reason = $"parameter '{name}': {value!.GetType().Name} values are not supported (use a node reference, text, a number or a bool)";
                return false;
            }
            member = new SerializedMember { name = name, typeName = typeName };
            member.SetJsonValue(ToJson(value)?.ToJsonString());
            return true;
        }

        // JSON in the form script-execute's ReflectorNet deserialization expects; nodes as {"instanceId": N}.
        private static JsonNode? ToJson(object? v) => v switch
        {
            null => null,
            bool b => JsonValue.Create(b),
            string s => JsonValue.Create(s),
            long l => JsonValue.Create(l),
            double d when Math.Floor(d) == d && Math.Abs(d) < 9e15 => JsonValue.Create((long)d),
            double d => JsonValue.Create(d),
            global::Godot.Node node => new JsonObject { [NodeRef.NodeRefProperty.InstanceId] = node.GetInstanceId() },
            ObjectValue o => new JsonObject(o.Select(kv => new KeyValuePair<string, JsonNode?>(kv.Key, ToJson(kv.Value)))),
            List<object?> l => new JsonArray(l.Select(ToJson).ToArray()),
            _ => JsonValue.Create(Convert.ToString(v, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
        };
    }
}
#endif

```

```cs
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The text form of a Callable (pure, unit-tested): <c>"&lt;target&gt;::&lt;method&gt;"</c>, the target being a node path
    /// below the edited scene root (<c>"."</c> for the root), a <c>res://</c> path or a <c>Class#instance id</c> reference;
    /// e.g. <c>"Player::_on_hit"</c>. The method is split off at the last <c>"::"</c> (a sub-resource path holds one too).
    /// </summary>
    public static class CallableText
    {
        public const string Separator = "::";

        private static readonly Regex Identifier = new Regex(@"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

        /// <summary>A reference to any object, as RQL's <c>$ref</c> writes it: <c>Class#instance id</c>.</summary>
        public static readonly Regex Reference = new Regex(@"^(?<type>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)#(?<id>\d+)$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

        public static string Format(string target, string method) => target + Separator + method;

        /// <summary>Split <paramref name="text"/> into its target and method; false (with the reason) when it is not that form.</summary>
        public static bool TryParse(string? text, out string target, out string method, out string? reason)
        {
            target = method = "";
            reason = null;
            var t = (text ?? "").Trim();
            var cut = t.LastIndexOf(Separator, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (cut <= 0 || cut + Separator.Length >= t.Length)
            {
                reason = $"a Callable is written \"<target>::<method>\", e.g. \"Player::_on_hit\" (target: a node path, a res:// path or Class#id), not '{text}'";
                return false;
            }
            target = t.Substring(0, cut).Trim();
            method = t.Substring(cut + Separator.Length).Trim();
            if (!Identifier.IsMatch(method))
            {
                reason = $"'{method}' is not a method name";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Adapters/Value/Godot_Callable_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Callable: shown as <c>"Player::_on_hit"</c> (<see cref="CallableText"/>: the target as a node path, res:// path or
    /// <c>Class#id</c>, then the method); members <c>target</c>, <c>method</c>, <c>valid</c>. Written as that text, a
    /// <c>[target, method]</c> list, an object literal <c>{target: …, method: …}</c> or <c>godot.callable(target, method)</c>;
    /// the target must exist and have the method (script methods included). A C# lambda reads as <c>"&lt;delegate&gt;"</c>; an
    /// empty Callable (no target, or a freed one) shows its members (<c>valid</c> false).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Callable_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<Callable>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "Callable: \"<target>::<method>\" (target: node path, res:// path or Class#id), e.g. \"Player::_on_hit\"; " +
            "write that text, [target, method], {target, method} or godot.callable(target, method)";

        protected override JsonNode? Encode(Callable value, EncodeContext context) => Text(value) is { } text ? JsonValue.Create(text) : null;

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<Callable> m)
        {
            // The CLR members (Delegate, a function-pointer Trampoline) are plumbing; these three describe a Callable.
            m.HideWhere(_ => true);
            m.Add<GodotObject?>("target", c => TargetOf(c), description: "the object whose method it calls (null for a C# lambda or a freed object)")
             .Add<string>("method", MethodOf, description: "the method name")
             .Add<bool>("valid", c => c.Delegate != null || TargetOf(c) is { } t && MethodOf(c) is { Length: > 0 } method && RqlGodot.HasCallableMethod(t, method),
                 description: "true when the target exists and has the method");
        }

        protected override bool? Equal(Callable value, object? other, RqlKernel kernel) => other switch
        {
            string s => Text(value) == s.Trim(),
            Callable o => value.Delegate == null && o.Delegate == null && TargetOf(value) is { } a && TargetOf(o) is { } b
                          && a.GetInstanceId() == b.GetInstanceId() && MethodOf(value) == MethodOf(o),
            _ => null,
        };

        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            result = null;
            reason = null;
            if (target != typeof(Callable)) return AdapterOutcome.NotHandled;
            if (value is Callable c) { result = c; return AdapterOutcome.Ok; }
            object? targetValue;
            object? method;
            switch (value)
            {
                case string text:
                    if (!CallableText.TryParse(text, out var t, out var m, out reason)) return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
                    (targetValue, method) = (t, m);
                    break;
                case ObjectValue literal:
                    literal.TryGetValue("target", out targetValue);
                    literal.TryGetValue("method", out method);
                    break;
                case IList list when list.Count == 2:
                    (targetValue, method) = (list[0], list[1]);
                    break;
                default:
                    reason = "expected \"<target>::<method>\", [target, method] or {target: …, method: …}";
                    return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
            }
            if (!TryMake(targetValue, method as string, out var made, out reason)) return AdapterOutcome.Failed;
            result = made;
            return AdapterOutcome.Ok;
        }

        /// <summary><c>godot.callable(target, method)</c>: a Callable of a node (path or node), resource (res://) or <c>Class#id</c>.</summary>
        public static object? Function(object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length != 2 || !(args[1] is string method))
                return new RqlError("type-mismatch", "godot.callable(target, method) expects a target (node path, node, res:// path or Class#id) and a method name");
            return TryMake(args[0], method, out var made, out var reason) ? made : new RqlError("not-found", reason);
        }

        /// <summary>The Callable of <paramref name="method"/> on the object <paramref name="target"/> names; the reason when there is none.</summary>
        public static bool TryMake(object? target, string? method, out Callable callable, out string? reason)
        {
            callable = default;
            reason = null;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(method)) { reason = "a Callable needs a method name"; return false; }
            var o = target as GodotObject;
            if (o == null)
            {
                if (!(target is string text) || text.Length == 0) { reason = "a Callable needs a target: a node path, a node, a res:// path or Class#id"; return false; }
                if (!TryResolve(text, out var resolved, out reason)) return false;
                o = resolved;
            }
            if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o)) { reason = "the Callable's target no longer exists"; return false; }
            if (!RqlGodot.HasCallableMethod(o, method))
            {
                reason = $"{o.GetClass()} has no method '{method}'";
                return false;
            }
            callable = new Callable(o, method);
            return true;
        }

        // A target's text: Class#id (the $ref form), a res:// / uid:// resource or a node of the edited scene; non-null when true.
        private static bool TryResolve(string text, out GodotObject o, out string? reason)
        {
            reason = null;
            GodotObject? found;
            var reference = CallableText.Reference.Match(text);
            if (reference.Success)
            {
                var type = reference.Groups["type"].Value;
                found = RqlGodot.ResolveStableRef(type, reference.Groups["id"].Value) as GodotObject;
                if (found == null) reason = $"no object {text}";
                // ResolveStableRef leaves the type check to the engine; a direct call checks it here (Godot class or C# type).
                else if (!IsOfType(found, type))
                {
                    reason = $"object {reference.Groups["id"].Value} is a {found.GetClass()}, not a {type}";
                    found = null;
                }
            }
            else if (text.StartsWith("res://", StringComparison.Ordinal) || text.StartsWith("uid://", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                found = RqlGodot.TryLoadResource(text, out var resource, out reason) ? resource : null;
            else if (RqlGodot.TryFindNode(text, out var node, out var error)) found = node;
            else (found, reason) = (null, error!.Value.message);
            o = found!;
            return found != null;
        }

        private static bool IsOfType(GodotObject o, string type)
        {
            if (o.IsClass(type)) return true;
            for (var t = o.GetType(); t != null; t = t.BaseType)
                if (t.Name == type) return true;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The text of a Callable (<see cref="CallableText"/>), or null when its target is gone or it names no method (a custom
        /// Callable such as a GDScript lambda or a bound one, which C# sees as an empty Callable).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? Text(Callable c)
        {
            if (c.Delegate != null) return "<delegate>";
            return TargetOf(c) is { } target && MethodOf(c) is { Length: > 0 } method ? CallableText.Format(TargetText(target), method) : null;
        }

        private static GodotObject? TargetOf(Callable c) => c.Target is { } t && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(t) ? t : null;

        // Method is null on default(Callable), which is also what C# makes of a custom (non-managed) native Callable.
        private static string MethodOf(Callable c) => c.Delegate != null ? "" : c.Method?.ToString() ?? "";

        private static string TargetText(GodotObject target) => target switch
        {
            Node node when RqlGodot.IsInEditedScene(node) => RqlGodot.PathOf(node),
            Resource resource when RqlGodot.IsFileResource(resource) => resource.ResourcePath,
            _ => $"{RqlHostNames.GodotClassName(target.GetType()) ?? target.GetType().Name}#{target.GetInstanceId().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}",
        };
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/ConvertingList.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A read-only view of a list whose elements are read through a converter. A Godot array holds Variants, which RQL would
    /// stream as Variant structs (members VariantType and Obj only): <c>get props["items"] | where props["price"] &gt; 10</c> found
    /// nothing. Through this view the elements are the values the Variants hold (a Resource, a number, a nested array); writes
    /// through an element object (its props) work, while an index write is refused like before: it would change the shared array
    /// behind the property's setter, so no undo step and no save. Assign the whole list instead. Pure: unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ConvertingList<T> : IList, IReadOnlyList<object?>
    {
        private readonly Func<T, object?> _read;

        public ConvertingList(IList<T> inner, Func<T, object?> read)
        {
            Inner = inner;
            _read = read;
        }

        /// <summary>The list the view reads.</summary>
        public IList<T> Inner { get; }

        public object? this[int index]
        {
            get => _read(Inner[index]);
            set => throw ReadOnly();
        }

        public int Count => Inner.Count;
        public bool IsReadOnly => true;
        public bool IsFixedSize => true;
        bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;
        object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

        public bool Contains(object? value) => IndexOf(value) >= 0;

        public int IndexOf(object? value)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Inner.Count; i++)
                if (Equals(_read(Inner[i]), value)) return i;
            return -1;
        }

        public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Inner.Count; i++) array.SetValue(_read(Inner[i]), index + i);
        }

        public IEnumerator<object?> GetEnumerator()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Inner.Count; i++) yield return _read(Inner[i]);
        }

        IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => GetEnumerator();

        int IList.Add(object? value) => throw ReadOnly();
        void IList.Clear() => throw ReadOnly();
        void IList.Insert(int index, object? value) => throw ReadOnly();
        void IList.Remove(object? value) => throw ReadOnly();
        void IList.RemoveAt(int index) => throw ReadOnly();

        private static NotSupportedException ReadOnly() =>
            new NotSupportedException("a Godot array is changed by assigning the whole list (set props[\"name\"] = [...]), not element by element");
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/GameLogText.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>One entry of a game's log: what it printed, or an error / warning with the lines that locate it.</summary>
    public sealed class GameLogEntry
    {
        public GameLogEntry(int sequence, string logType, string message, string stackTrace)
        {
            Sequence = sequence; LogType = logType; Message = message; StackTrace = stackTrace;
        }

        [global::Rql.RqlDescription("position in the log, 1 = first entry")]
        public int Sequence { get; }

        [global::Rql.RqlDescription("Log (print), Error (ERROR, SCRIPT ERROR, USER ERROR, C# exceptions) or Warning")]
        public string LogType { get; }

        [global::Rql.RqlDescription("the printed text, or the error / warning message")]
        public string Message { get; }

        [global::Rql.RqlDescription("for an error or warning: where it happened (\"at: …\" and the GDScript backtrace), else empty")]
        public string StackTrace { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The text Godot's file logger writes (<c>user://logs/godot.log</c> of the game, the run started from the editor
    /// included) as entries: each <c>ERROR:</c> / <c>SCRIPT ERROR:</c> / <c>USER ERROR:</c> / <c>WARNING:</c> line is one
    /// entry with its indented continuation lines (<c>at: …</c>, the GDScript backtrace) as its stack trace; every other line
    /// is a print. The engine banner (the first lines up to the first blank line) is skipped. Pure (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public static class GameLogText
    {
        private static readonly (string prefix, string type)[] Kinds =
        {
            ("SCRIPT ERROR:", "Error"), ("USER SCRIPT ERROR:", "Error"), ("USER ERROR:", "Error"), ("ERROR:", "Error"),
            ("SHADER ERROR:", "Error"), ("USER WARNING:", "Warning"), ("USER SCRIPT WARNING:", "Warning"), ("SCRIPT WARNING:", "Warning"),
            ("WARNING:", "Warning"),
        };

        public static List<GameLogEntry> Parse(string? text)
        {
            var entries = new List<GameLogEntry>();
            var lines = (text ?? "").Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');
            int i = 0;
            // The banner: "Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable…", the renderer line(s) ("Vulkan 1.4 - Forward+ - Using Device …"), a blank line.
            if (lines.Length > 0 && lines[0].StartsWith("Godot Engine v", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                i = 1;
                while (i < lines.Length && IsRendererLine(lines[i])) i++;
                if (i < lines.Length && lines[i].Length == 0) i++;
            }
            string? type = null, message = null;
            var trace = new StringBuilder();
            void Flush()
            {
                if (message != null) entries.Add(new GameLogEntry(entries.Count + 1, type!, message, trace.ToString().TrimEnd('\n')));
                type = null; message = null; trace.Clear();
            }
            for (; i < lines.Length; i++)
            {
                var line = lines[i];
                if (type is "Error" or "Warning" && line.Length > 0 && (line[0] == ' ' || line[0] == '\t'))
                {
                    trace.Append(line.Trim()).Append('\n');
                    continue;
                }
                Flush();
                if (line.Length == 0 && i == lines.Length - 1) break; // the file's final newline
                var kind = Kind(line);
                if (kind != null)
                {
                    type = kind.Value.type;
                    message = line.Substring(kind.Value.prefix.Length).Trim();
                }
                else
                {
                    type = "Log";
                    message = line;
                }
            }
            Flush();
            return entries;
        }

        private static bool IsRendererLine(string line) =>
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(line, @"^(Vulkan|OpenGL|D3D12|Metal|Dummy)\b.* - ");

        private static (string prefix, string type)? Kind(string line)
        {
            foreach (var k in Kinds)
                if (line.StartsWith(k.prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal)) return k;
            return null;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/HistoryStepText.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>An undo history as seen before and after an Undo / Redo: its version and its current action's name.</summary>
    public readonly struct HistoryState
    {
        public HistoryState(ulong version, string? action) { Version = version; Action = action ?? ""; }
        public ulong Version { get; }
        public string Action { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// What <c>editor | call Undo()</c> / <c>Redo()</c> report, from the histories it watched (global, edited scene): the
    /// history whose version moved names the action (undo: its current action before the step; redo: after it). Nothing
    /// moved: there was nothing to undo / redo, which is an error rather than a silent no-op. Pure (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public static class HistoryStepText
    {
        /// <summary>Suffixes of the two actions one rql-mutate commits when it changed scene nodes and global objects (files, settings).</summary>
        public const string ScenePart = " [scene part]";
        public const string GlobalPart = " [file part]";

        /// <summary>Whether a step that undid / redid <paramref name="action"/> must step once more: the other part of the same mutation.</summary>
        public static bool IsPart(string action) => action.EndsWith(ScenePart, StringComparison.Ordinal) || action.EndsWith(GlobalPart, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        /// <summary>The undo-redo action name of an rql-mutate: "RQL: " and its query on one line, cut to a readable length.</summary>
        public static string ActionName(string? query, int max = 120)
        {
            var text = string.Join(" ", (query ?? "").Split((char[]?)null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries));
            if (text.Length == 0) return "RQL mutation";
            if (text.Length > max) text = text.Substring(0, max - 1) + "…";
            return "RQL: " + text;
        }

        /// <summary>How many actions <see cref="Pending"/> lists per history.</summary>
        public const int MaxListed = 20;

        /// <summary>
        /// The actions one history can still undo (newest first: the current action, then older ones) or redo (next first), at most
        /// <see cref="MaxListed"/>; <paramref name="tag"/> is appended to each name (" (global)" for the global history).
        /// <paramref name="current"/> is the history's current action index (-1 when nothing is done), <paramref name="count"/> its size.
        /// </summary>
        public static IEnumerable<string> Pending(bool undo, int current, int count, Func<int, string> name, string tag = "")
        {
            var listed = 0;
            for (int i = undo ? current : current + 1; i >= 0 && i < count && listed < MaxListed; i += undo ? -1 : 1, listed++)
            {
                var text = name(i);
                yield return (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? "(unnamed action)" : text) + tag;
            }
        }

        public static string Describe(bool undo, IReadOnlyList<HistoryState> before, IReadOnlyList<HistoryState> after)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < before.Count && i < after.Count; i++)
            {
                if (before[i].Version == after[i].Version) continue;
                var name = undo ? before[i].Action : after[i].Action;
                return (undo ? "undone: " : "redone: ") + (name.Length > 0 ? name : "(unnamed action)");
            }
            throw new InvalidOperationException(undo
                ? "nothing to undo: the edited scene's and the global undo histories have no action left to undo"
                : "nothing to redo: no undone action is waiting (a new change clears the redo history)");
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The options of <c>editor.CreateNode(class, {…})</c> / <c>editor.InstantiateScene(path, {…})</c> as written: <c>name</c>,
    /// <c>parent</c> (a node, a path or a ref; null = the scene root) and every other key a Godot property of the new node
    /// (<c>position</c>, <c>mesh</c>, <c>rotation_degrees</c> …). The values stay raw, with the kernel that coerced the literal, so
    /// each one is converted like a <c>set</c> would once the node's class tells its type. Pure (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class NodeOptions
    {
        public const string NameKey = "name";
        public const string ParentKey = "parent";

        internal NodeOptions(string? name, object? parent, IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object?>> properties, RqlKernel? kernel)
        {
            Name = name;
            Parent = parent;
            Properties = properties;
            Kernel = kernel;
        }

        /// <summary>The node's name; null = Godot's default (the class, or the scene root's name).</summary>
        public string? Name { get; }

        /// <summary>The parent as written (a node, a node path, a ref); null = the edited scene root.</summary>
        public object? Parent { get; }

        /// <summary>Godot properties to set on the new node, in the order written.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object?>> Properties { get; }

        internal RqlKernel? Kernel { get; }

        /// <summary>Split an object literal into name, parent and properties; the problem when it is not one.</summary>
        public static NodeOptions? From(object? value, RqlKernel? kernel, out string? problem)
        {
            problem = null;
            if (!(value is IDictionary<string, object?> literal))
            {
                problem = "expected an object literal of options, e.g. {name: \"Crate\", parent: \"Props\", position: [0, 1, 0]}";
                return null;
            }
            string? name = null;
            object? parent = null;
            var properties = new List<KeyValuePair<string, object?>>();
            foreach (var kv in literal)
            {
                if (string.Equals(kv.Key, NameKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    if (kv.Value != null && !(kv.Value is string)) { problem = $"'name' must be a string, e.g. \"Crate\" + $"; return null; }
                    name = (string?)kv.Value;
                }
                else if (string.Equals(kv.Key, ParentKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) parent = kv.Value;
                else properties.Add(kv);
            }
            return new NodeOptions(name, parent, properties, kernel);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The first name two items of one bulk create give under the same parent (Godot would rename the second one),
        /// or null. <paramref name="planned"/> holds (parent key, name) per item; unnamed items are skipped.
        /// </summary>
        public static string? DuplicateName(IEnumerable<(object parent, string? name)> planned)
        {
            var seen = new HashSet<(object, string)>();
            foreach (var (parent, name) in planned)
                if (name != null && !seen.Add((parent, name))) return name;
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Takes an object literal as <see cref="NodeOptions"/>.</summary>
    public sealed class Godot_NodeOptions_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<NodeOptions>
    {
        public override string Description => "options of a new node: {name: \"Crate\", parent: \"Props\", position: [0, 1, 0], <any Godot property>: …}";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<NodeOptions> m) { }

        public override AdapterOutcome TryCoerce(object? value, Type target, RqlKernel kernel, out object? result, out string? reason)
        {
            result = NodeOptions.From(value, kernel, out reason);
            return result != null ? AdapterOutcome.Ok : AdapterOutcome.Failed;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/RqlEditorApi.GameLog.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    public sealed partial class RqlEditorApi
    {
        /// <summary>Most entries the <c>gameLog</c> source returns (the last ones).</summary>
        public const int MaxGameLogEntries = 2000;

        /// <summary>Most bytes of the game's log file read (its end).</summary>
        private const long MaxGameLogBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

        /// <summary>
        /// The <c>gameLog</c> source: what the game run from the editor (PlayScene, isPlaying) printed, its errors and warnings,
        /// read from the log file Godot's file logger writes for the game (<c>debug/file_logging/log_path</c>,
        /// <c>user://logs/godot.log</c> by default; a new run starts a new file). The editor's Output panel gets the same lines
        /// over the debugger, which the editor's own log (the <c>console</c> source) never sees.
        /// </summary>
        public static List<GameLogEntry> GameLog()
        {
            if (!FileLogging())
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the project's file logging is off (debug/file_logging/enable_file_logging), so the game writes no log; " +
                    "turn it on with project | set settings[\"debug/file_logging/enable_file_logging\"] = true and run the game again");
            var path = GameLogPath();
            if (!File.Exists(path)) return new List<GameLogEntry>();
            string text;
            // The running game keeps the file open for writing.
            using (var stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, System.IO.FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete))
            using (var reader = new StreamReader(stream))
            {
                // A game that prints every frame writes megabytes: only the tail is read, from its first whole line.
                var cut = stream.Length > MaxGameLogBytes;
                if (cut) stream.Seek(-MaxGameLogBytes, SeekOrigin.End);
                if (cut) reader.ReadLine();
                text = reader.ReadToEnd();
            }
            var entries = GameLogText.Parse(text);
            return entries.Count > MaxGameLogEntries ? entries.GetRange(entries.Count - MaxGameLogEntries, MaxGameLogEntries) : entries;
        }

        // Whether the game writes a log on this desktop: the base setting or its .pc override (on by default), which the
        // editor process itself may not apply.
        private static bool FileLogging()
        {
            const string key = "debug/file_logging/enable_file_logging";
            return ProjectSettings.GetSettingWithOverride(key).AsBool()
                   || (ProjectSettings.HasSetting(key + ".pc") ? ProjectSettings.GetSetting(key + ".pc").AsBool() : ProjectSettings.GetSetting(key).AsBool());
        }

        /// <summary>The absolute path of the game's log file.</summary>
        public static string GameLogPath()
        {
            var setting = ProjectSettings.GetSettingWithOverride("debug/file_logging/log_path").AsString();
            return ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(setting) ? "user://logs/godot.log" : setting);
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/RqlEditorApi.History.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Undo / redo for agents: <c>editor | call Undo()</c> is the editor's own Undo (the Scene menu item behind Ctrl+Z), so the
    /// editor picks the history (the edited scene's or the global one) and keeps its bookkeeping, exactly as when a user
    /// presses Ctrl+Z. Godot's C# API has no editor-level undo: stepping a history's <see cref="UndoRedo"/> directly (what an
    /// agent otherwise does through script-execute) leaves the editor's own undo stack out of step.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed partial class RqlEditorApi
    {
        [RqlCallable("undo the last editor action, like Ctrl+Z (an rql-mutate, an edit in the Scene dock or the inspector …); " +
            "returns the undone action, e.g. \"RQL: nodes | … | set name = …\". Fails when there is nothing to undo")]
        public string Undo() => EditorHistory.Step(undo: true);

        [RqlCallable("redo the last undone action, like Ctrl+Shift+Z; returns the redone action. Fails when there is nothing to redo")]
        public string Redo() => EditorHistory.Step(undo: false);

        // "20" is HistoryStepText.MaxListed (an attribute argument cannot format an int constant).
        [RqlDescription("what Undo() can step back: the edited scene's actions newest first, then the global history's (files, project " +
            "settings) marked \"(global)\", at most 20 each; Undo() steps whichever history changed last")]
        public string[] undoHistory => EditorHistory.Pending(undo: true);

        [RqlDescription("what Redo() can step forward, next first, in the same form as undoHistory (a new change clears it)")]
        public string[] redoHistory => EditorHistory.Pending(undo: false);
    }

    internal static class EditorHistory
    {
        /// <summary>The pending undo / redo actions of the edited scene's history, then of the global one.</summary>
        public static string[] Pending(bool undo)
        {
            var scene = RqlGodot.UndoHistory(global: false);
            var global = RqlGodot.UndoHistory(global: true);
            IEnumerable<string> Of(UndoRedo? h, string tag) => h == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(h)
                ? Enumerable.Empty<string>()
                : HistoryStepText.Pending(undo, h.GetCurrentAction(), h.GetHistoryCount(), h.GetActionName, tag);
            return Of(scene, "").Concat(Of(global, " (global)")).ToArray();
        }

        // The Scene menu (a PopupMenu of the editor's MenuBar) found last; looked up again when it is gone.
        private static ulong _menuId;

        public static string Step(bool undo)
        {
            if (RqlGodot.UndoHistory(global: true) == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the editor's undo history is not available (the plugin is not installed)");
            var command = undo ? "Undo" : "Redo";
            var (menu, id) = FindMenuItem(command)
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"the editor's {command} menu item was not found");

            var histories = new[] { RqlGodot.UndoHistory(global: true), RqlGodot.UndoHistory(global: false) }.OfType<UndoRedo>().ToList();
            List<HistoryState> Snapshot() => histories.Select(h => new HistoryState(h.GetVersion(), h.GetCurrentActionName())).ToList();
            var before = Snapshot();
            menu.EmitSignal(PopupMenu.SignalName.IdPressed, id);
            RqlGodot.InvalidateGroups(); // the step may change groups behind RQL
            var text = HistoryStepText.Describe(undo, before, Snapshot());
            if (!HistoryStepText.IsPart(text)) return text;
            // One mutation that changed scene nodes and files committed two actions: step the other part too.
            before = Snapshot();
            menu.EmitSignal(PopupMenu.SignalName.IdPressed, id);
            RqlGodot.InvalidateGroups();
            try { return text + "; " + HistoryStepText.Describe(undo, before, Snapshot()); }
            catch (InvalidOperationException) { return text; }
        }

        private static (PopupMenu menu, int id)? FindMenuItem(string shortcutName)
        {
            if (GodotObject.InstanceFromId(_menuId) is PopupMenu cached && Item(cached, shortcutName) is { } cachedId)
                return (cached, cachedId);
            var found = Find(EditorInterface.Singleton.GetBaseControl(), shortcutName);
            if (found == null) return null;
            _menuId = found.Value.menu.GetInstanceId();
            return found;
        }

        // Depth-first; only a PopupMenu directly under a MenuBar (the editor's main menu) is considered.
        private static (PopupMenu menu, int id)? Find(Node node, string shortcutName)
        {
            if (node is PopupMenu popup && popup.GetParent() is MenuBar && Item(popup, shortcutName) is { } id) return (popup, id);
            var count = node.GetChildCount(includeInternal: true);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                if (Find(node.GetChild(i, includeInternal: true), shortcutName) is { } hit) return hit;
            return null;
        }

        // The item whose shortcut is the editor's "Undo" / "Redo" (shortcut names are not translated); the item text as a fallback.
        private static int? Item(PopupMenu popup, string shortcutName)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < popup.ItemCount; i++)
                if (popup.GetItemShortcut(i)?.ResourceName == shortcutName) return popup.GetItemId(i);
            var keys = shortcutName == "Undo" ? "Ctrl+Z" : "Ctrl+Shift+Z";
            for (int i = 0; i < popup.ItemCount; i++)
                if (popup.GetItemText(i) == shortcutName || popup.GetItemShortcut(i)?.GetAsText() == keys) return popup.GetItemId(i);
            return null;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/RqlEditorApi.Project.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>The project sources of the <c>editor</c> API: <c>files</c> (the editor filesystem) and <c>classes</c> (ClassDB).</summary>
    public sealed partial class RqlEditorApi
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The <c>files</c> source: every file the editor filesystem knows, depth-first, at most
        /// <see cref="RqlGodot.MaxFiles"/>; lazy, so <c>files | first 5</c> walks only that far.
        /// </summary>
        public static IEnumerable<RqlFile> Files()
        {
            var references = new FileReferences(); // one per query: deps read once, the usedBy index built on first use
            return RqlGodot.WalkFiles(EditorToolGuards.GetResourceFileSystemOrThrow().GetFilesystem())
                .Select(f => new RqlFile(f.path, f.type, references))
                .Take(RqlGodot.MaxFiles);
        }

        /// <summary>The <c>classes</c> source: every Godot class (ClassDB), sorted by name (the list is read once per session).</summary>
        public static List<RqlClass> Classes() => GodotTypes.GodotClasses().Select(c => new RqlClass(c)).ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>One file of the project (the <c>files</c> source).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlFile
    {
        private readonly FileReferences _references;

        internal RqlFile(string path, string type, FileReferences references)
        {
            this.path = path;
            this.type = type;
            _references = references;
        }

        [RqlDescription("res:// path")]
        public string path { get; }

        [RqlDescription("file name with extension")]
        public string name => path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('/') + 1);

        [RqlDescription("res:// folder (with a trailing slash)")]
        public string dir => ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(path);

        [RqlDescription("extension without the dot, lower case (\"tscn\", \"png\")")]
        public string ext => ReimportClassifier.ExtensionOf(path);

        [RqlDescription("resource type the importer assigned (\"PackedScene\", \"Texture2D\" …), empty when unknown")]
        public string type { get; }

        [RqlDescription("uid:// of the file, or null")]
        public string? uid => RqlGodot.UidOf(path);

        [RqlDescription("res:// paths this file loads (a material's textures, a scene's sub-scenes, scripts and resources …), as saved on disk")]
        public List<string> deps => _references.DepsOf(path);

        [RqlDescription("dependencies whose file no longer exists: broken references")]
        public List<string> missingDeps => _references.MissingDepsOf(path);

        [RqlDescription("the scenes and resources whose deps include this one, as saved (scripts' load / preload, project settings such as " +
            "the main scene, icon or autoloads, and unsaved edits are not seen); the first usedBy of a query scans the project")]
        public List<string> usedBy => _references.UsedBy(path);
    }

    /// <summary>A file's references are read on request only (<c>select deps</c>, <c>where usedBy.count() == 0</c>): reading them loads files.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlFile_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<RqlFile>
    {
        protected override void Members(MemberTable<RqlFile> m)
        {
            m.Untyped.AddMixedMap("importSettings",
                o => ImportSettings.Keys(((RqlFile)o).path),
                (o, key) => ImportSettings.TypeOf(((RqlFile)o).path, key),
                (o, key) => ImportSettings.Get(((RqlFile)o).path, key),
                (o, key, value) => ImportSettings.Set(((RqlFile)o).path, key, value),
                (o, key, value) => ImportSettings.Problem(((RqlFile)o).path, key),
                "an imported file's import options (the [params] of its .import: \"edit/loop_mode\" of a .wav, \"compress/mode\" of a " +
                "texture …); set one to change it and re-import the file (like the Import dock: not undoable)",
                // Every key reaches validate, which names the file's options.
                has: (o, key) => true);
            m.Untyped.ExplicitOnly("deps", "missingDeps", "usedBy", "importSettings");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The import options of an imported file: the <c>[params]</c> section of its <c>.import</c> sidecar (read once per query).</summary>
    internal static class ImportSettings
    {
        private const string Section = "params";

        private sealed class Sidecar
        {
            public ConfigFile? Config;
        }

        private static ConfigFile? Load(string path) => GodotVariants.Scoped(("import", path), () =>
        {
            var config = new ConfigFile();
            var sidecar = ReimportClassifier.ImportSidecarPath(path);
            return new Sidecar { Config = FileAccess.FileExists(sidecar) && config.Load(sidecar) == Error.Ok ? config : null };
        }).Config;

        private static string[] KeysOf(ConfigFile c) => c.HasSection(Section) ? c.GetSectionKeys(Section) : System.Array.Empty<string>();

        public static IEnumerable<string> Keys(string path) => Load(path) is { } c ? KeysOf(c) : System.Array.Empty<string>();

        public static System.Type TypeOf(string path, string key) =>
            Load(path) is { } c && c.HasSectionKey(Section, key) ? GodotVariants.ClrType(c.GetValue(Section, key).VariantType) : typeof(object);

        public static object? Get(string path, string key) =>
            Load(path) is { } c && c.HasSectionKey(Section, key) ? GodotVariants.ToClr(c.GetValue(Section, key)) : null;

        public static string? Problem(string path, string key) => Load(path) switch
        {
            null => $"'{path}' is not an imported file (it has no .import sidecar)",
            var c when c.HasSectionKey(Section, key) => null,
            var c => KeysOf(c).Length == 0
                ? $"'{path}' has no import options"
                : $"'{path}' has no import option '{key}'; its options: {string.Join(", ", KeysOf(c))}",
        };

        public static void Set(string path, string key, object? value)
        {
            var config = Load(path) ?? throw new System.InvalidOperationException(Problem(path, key));
            config.SetValue(Section, key, GodotVariants.ToVariant(value));
            var error = config.Save(ReimportClassifier.ImportSidecarPath(path));
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new System.InvalidOperationException($"could not write '{path}.import': {error}");
            var status = RqlReimport.Run(new[] { path });
            if (status.Contains("NOT imported", System.StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new System.InvalidOperationException(status);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Which file loads which, from <see cref="ResourceLoader.GetDependencies"/> (what the saved file references); one instance per
    /// <c>files</c> query, so a file's dependencies are read once and the reverse index (<see cref="UsedBy"/>) is built on first use.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class FileReferences
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, List<string>> _deps = new();
        private Dictionary<string, List<string>>? _usedBy;

        public List<string> DepsOf(string path)
        {
            if (!_deps.TryGetValue(path, out var deps))
                _deps[path] = deps = ResourceLoader.GetDependencies(path)
                    .Select(entry => Resolve(ResPathNormalizer.DependencyParts(entry)))
                    .Where(p => p.Length > 0)
                    .Distinct()
                    .ToList();
            return deps;
        }

        /// <summary>The dependencies of <paramref name="path"/> whose file no longer exists (broken references).</summary>
        public List<string> MissingDepsOf(string path) => DepsOf(path).Where(d => !Exists(d)).ToList();

        public List<string> UsedBy(string path)
        {
            if (_usedBy == null)
            {
                _usedBy = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
                // Only scenes and resources reference other files (as in DeleteResource's users check).
                foreach (var (file, _) in RqlGodot.WalkFiles(EditorToolGuards.GetResourceFileSystemOrThrow().GetFilesystem()).Take(RqlGodot.MaxFiles))
                {
                    if (!RqlReferences.CanDepend(file)) continue;
                    foreach (var dep in DepsOf(file))
                    {
                        if (!_usedBy.TryGetValue(dep, out var users)) _usedBy[dep] = users = new List<string>();
                        users.Add(file);
                    }
                }
            }
            return _usedBy.TryGetValue(path, out var found) ? found : new List<string>();
        }

        /// <summary>A file or an imported resource exists at <paramref name="path"/>.</summary>
        public static bool Exists(string path) => FileAccess.FileExists(path) || ResourceLoader.Exists(path);

        // Godot loads a dependency by its uid first: a uid that still names a file gives its current path (the file may have moved);
        // else the entry's fallback path, else the unresolved uid as written.
        private static string Resolve((string? uid, string? path) dep)
        {
            if (dep.uid != null)
            {
                var id = ResourceUid.TextToId(dep.uid);
                if (id != ResourceUid.InvalidId && ResourceUid.HasId(id)) return ResourceUid.GetIdPath(id);
            }
            return dep.path ?? dep.uid ?? "";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One Godot class (the <c>classes</c> source).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlClass
    {
        public RqlClass(string name) { this.name = name; }

        [RqlDescription("class name, e.g. \"OmniLight3D\"")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("parent class name (empty for Object)")]
        public string parent => ClassDB.GetParentClass(name).ToString();

        [RqlDescription("can be created (AddChild / CreateResource)")]
        public bool canInstantiate => ClassDB.CanInstantiate(name);

        [RqlDescription("a Node class")]
        public bool isNode => ClassDB.IsParentClass(name, "Node");

        [RqlDescription("a Resource class")]
        public bool isResource => ClassDB.IsParentClass(name, "Resource");
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/RqlEditorApi.Resources.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Resource files: the logic of the replaced <c>resource-create</c> / <c>resource-move</c> / <c>resource-delete</c>
    /// tools, unchanged — sidecars (<c>.import</c>, <c>.uid</c>) move and go with the file, the cached resource is rebound,
    /// open scenes follow a moved scene, the editor filesystem is rescanned.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed partial class RqlEditorApi
    {
        [RqlCallable("create a resource file (res://….tres / .res) of a Godot class or a script class_name (default Resource); returns the new resource")]
        public Resource CreateResource(string path, string className = "Resource")
        {
            var resPath = NewResourcePath(path);
            var resource = RqlGodot.Instantiate<Resource>(ResourceClass(className), "Resource", nameof(className));
            EditorToolGuards.EnsureDirectoryExists(ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(resPath));
            var error = ResourceSaver.Save(resource, resPath);
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not save the new resource to '{resPath}': {error}");
            resource.TakeOverPath(resPath);
            RqlReimport.Register(resPath);
            return resource;
        }

        // ---- call validators (RQL 0.2): run before the call, on dry runs too; nothing changes when they reject.

        public string? ValidateCreateResource(string path, string className) => RqlGodot.Rejection(() =>
        {
            NewResourcePath(path);
            RqlGodot.ScriptAwareClass(ResourceClass(className), "Resource", nameof(className), out _);
        });

        public string? ValidateMoveResource(string path, string newPath) => RqlGodot.Rejection(() => MovePaths(path, newPath));

        public string? ValidateDeleteResource(string path, bool force) => RqlGodot.Rejection(() => DeletablePath(path, force));

        private static string ResourceClass(string className) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(className) ? "Resource" : className;

        private static string NewResourcePath(string path)
        {
            var resPath = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, nameof(path));
            RequireUnprotected(resPath);
            if (!resPath.EndsWith(".tres", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !resPath.EndsWith(".res", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new ArgumentException($"a resource path must end with .tres or .res; got '{path}'");
            if (FileAccess.FileExists(resPath) || ResourceLoader.Exists(resPath))
                throw new ArgumentException($"a resource already exists at '{resPath}' (edit it with godot.resource(\"{resPath}\") | set …)");
            return resPath;
        }

        // The normalized source and destination of a move, and whether it is a case-only rename of the same file.
        private static (string src, string dst, bool caseOnly) MovePaths(string path, string newPath)
        {
            var src = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, nameof(path));
            var dst = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(newPath, nameof(newPath));
            if (src == dst) throw new ArgumentException("the source and destination paths are the same");
            RequireUnprotected(src);
            RequireUnprotected(dst);
            if (!FileAccess.FileExists(src)) throw new ArgumentException($"no file exists at '{src}'");
            if (ResPathNormalizer.MoveProblem(src, dst) is { } moveProblem) throw new ArgumentException(moveProblem);
            // A case-only rename names the same file on Windows / macOS: the destination "exists" and its sidecars are the
            // source's own.
            // On a case-sensitive file system both names can be real files: then the destination is another file.
            var caseOnly = ResPathNormalizer.IsCaseOnlyRename(src, dst)
                && !DirAccess.GetFilesAt(ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(dst)).Contains(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(dst));
            if (FileAccess.FileExists(dst) && !caseOnly)
                throw new ArgumentException($"a file already exists at '{dst}'");
            return (src, dst, caseOnly);
        }

        private static string DeletablePath(string path, bool force)
        {
            var resPath = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, nameof(path));
            RequireUnprotected(resPath);
            if (!FileAccess.FileExists(resPath)) throw new ArgumentException($"no file exists at '{resPath}'");
            if (!force && RqlReferences.UsersOf(resPath) is { Count: > 0 } users)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{resPath}' is still used by {RqlReferences.Describe(users)}; deleting it would break " +
                    $"those references. Point them elsewhere first, or delete anyway with DeleteResource(\"{resPath}\", true)");
            return resPath;
        }

        [RqlCallable("move or rename a file (its .import / .uid sidecars move with it); returns the new path")]
        public string MoveResource(string path, string newPath)
        {
            var (src, dst, caseOnly) = MovePaths(path, newPath);

            // Stale sidecars at the destination go.
            if (!caseOnly)
                foreach (var sidecar in EditorToolGuards.Sidecars)
                    if (FileAccess.FileExists(dst + sidecar)) DirAccess.RemoveAbsolute(dst + sidecar);
            EditorToolGuards.EnsureDirectoryExists(ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(dst));

            var moveError = DirAccess.RenameAbsolute(src, dst);
            if (moveError != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not move '{src}' to '{dst}': {moveError}");
            try
            {
                EditorToolGuards.RebindCachedResource(src, dst);
                if (ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(src)) EditorToolGuards.RetargetOpenScenes(src, dst);
                foreach (var sidecar in EditorToolGuards.Sidecars)
                {
                    string from = src + sidecar, to = dst + sidecar;
                    if (!FileAccess.FileExists(from)) continue;
                    var sidecarError = DirAccess.RenameAbsolute(from, to);
                    if (sidecarError != Error.Ok)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"the file moved to '{dst}' but its '{sidecar}' sidecar did not ('{from}' -> '{to}': {sidecarError}); move it by hand or reimport the file");
                }
            }
            finally { Ei.GetResourceFilesystem()?.Scan(); }
            return dst;
        }

        [RqlCallable("delete a file and its .import / .uid sidecars; returns the deleted path. Refused while a scene or resource " +
            "(the edited scene's unsaved changes included) still uses the file, unless force is true")]
        public string DeleteResource(string path, bool force = false)
        {
            var resPath = DeletablePath(path, force);
            var error = DirAccess.RemoveAbsolute(resPath);
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not delete '{resPath}': {error}");
            try
            {
                EditorToolGuards.RebindCachedResource(resPath, newPath: null);
                if (ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(resPath)) EditorToolGuards.CloseDeletedScene(resPath);
                foreach (var sidecar in EditorToolGuards.Sidecars)
                {
                    var sidecarPath = resPath + sidecar;
                    if (!FileAccess.FileExists(sidecarPath)) continue;
                    var sidecarError = DirAccess.RemoveAbsolute(sidecarPath);
                    if (sidecarError != Error.Ok)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{resPath}' was deleted but its '{sidecar}' sidecar could not be removed ({sidecarError}); remove it by hand");
                }
            }
            finally { Ei.GetResourceFilesystem()?.Scan(); }
            return resPath;
        }

        private static void RequireUnprotected(string resPath)
        {
            if (ResPathNormalizer.ProtectedFileProblem(resPath) is { } problem) throw new ArgumentException(problem + "; the file tools do not create, move or delete files there");
        }

        [RqlCallable("create a folder (and missing parents), e.g. \"res://art/materials\"; returns its path")]
        public string CreateFolder(string path)
        {
            var dir = ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir(path);
            EditorToolGuards.EnsureDirectoryExists(dir);
            RqlReimport.RegisterFolder(dir);
            return dir;
        }

        [RqlCallable("re-import files (res:// paths) after they changed on disk, verifying each import; no argument: a full filesystem scan. Returns a status (files NOT imported are listed first)")]
        public string Reimport(string[]? files = null) => RqlReimport.Run(files);
    }
}
#endif
```
