`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/RqlEditorApi.Scenes.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    public sealed partial class RqlEditorApi
    {
        [RqlCallable("create a scene file (res://….tscn) with a root node of a Godot class, save it and open it; returns the new root node. " +
            "A scene path as rootClass (\"res://enemies/enemy.tscn\") makes an inherited scene of it (Scene → New Inherited Scene)")]
        public Node NewScene(string path, string rootClass = "Node", string? rootName = null)
        {
            path = NewScenePath(path);
            if (IsBaseScene(rootClass)) return NewInheritedScene(path, rootClass, rootName);
            var root = EditorToolGuards.ValidateClassDbInstantiation<Node>(RootClass(rootClass), "rootClass", requireParentClass: "Node");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootName)) root.Name = rootName;
            try
            {
                var packed = new PackedScene();
                var packError = packed.Pack(root);
                if (packError != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not pack the new scene: {packError}");
                EditorToolGuards.EnsureDirectoryExists(ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(path));
                var saveError = ResourceSaver.Save(packed, path);
                if (saveError != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not save the new scene to '{path}': {saveError}");
            }
            finally { root.Free(); }
            RqlReimport.Register(path);
            EditorToolGuards.ReloadReplacedOpenScene(path);
            return OpenScene(path);
        }

        // An inherited scene is a scene whose root instances the base scene; the file is what the editor writes for one.
        private Node NewInheritedScene(string path, string basePath, string? rootName)
        {
            basePath = BaseScenePath(basePath, path);
            var name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rootName) ? BaseRootName(basePath) : rootName!;
            if (NodeNameRules.Problem(name, _ => false) is { } problem) throw new ArgumentException(problem, nameof(rootName));
            if (!path.EndsWith(".tscn", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new ArgumentException($"an inherited scene is written as text: give it a .tscn path, not '{path}'", nameof(path));
            var uid = RqlGodot.UidOf(basePath);
            var text = "[gd_scene load_steps=2 format=3]\n\n" +
                       $"[ext_resource type=\"PackedScene\"{(uid != null ? $" uid=\"{uid}\"" : "")} path=\"{basePath.CEscape()}\" id=\"1_base\"]\n\n" +
                       $"[node name=\"{name.CEscape()}\" instance=ExtResource(\"1_base\")]\n";
            EditorToolGuards.EnsureDirectoryExists(ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(path));
            using (var file = FileAccess.Open(path, FileAccess.ModeFlags.Write)
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not write '{path}': {FileAccess.GetOpenError()}"))
                file.StoreString(text);
            RqlReimport.Register(path);
            EditorToolGuards.ReloadReplacedOpenScene(path);
            return OpenScene(path);
        }

        private static bool IsBaseScene(string rootClass) =>
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rootClass) && (rootClass.Contains("://") || ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(rootClass.Trim()));

        private static string BaseScenePath(string basePath, string path)
        {
            basePath = RequireScenePath(basePath);
            EditorToolGuards.RequireResourceExists(basePath, "rootClass", $"no scene at '{basePath}' to inherit from");
            if (basePath == path) throw new ArgumentException("a scene cannot inherit from itself", "rootClass");
            return basePath;
        }

        // The base scene's root name (what the editor names an inherited scene's root).
        private static string BaseRootName(string basePath)
        {
            var state = ResourceLoader.Load<PackedScene>(basePath)?.GetState();
            return state != null && state.GetNodeCount() > 0 ? state.GetNodeName(0).ToString() : System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(basePath);
        }

        [RqlCallable("reload a scene from its file, discarding its unsaved changes (Scene → Reload Saved Scene): the edited scene, or the " +
            "scene at path (opened when it is not); returns its root node")]
        public Node ReloadScene(string? path = null)
        {
            string target;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) target = RequireScenePath(path!);
            else
            {
                target = RqlGodot.EditedRoot()?.SceneFilePath ?? "";
                if (target.Length == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("no saved scene is being edited; pass a res:// scene path");
            }
            EditorToolGuards.RequireResourceExists(target, nameof(path), $"no scene at '{target}'");
            if (Array.IndexOf(Ei.GetOpenScenes(), target) < 0) return OpenScene(target);
            if (RqlGodot.EditedRoot()?.SceneFilePath != target) OpenScene(target);
            EditorToolGuards.ReloadReplacedOpenScene(target); // replaces the cached PackedScene, then reloads the tab
            var root = RqlGodot.EditedRoot() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"reloaded '{target}' but the editor has no edited scene");
            if (root.SceneFilePath != target)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"reloaded '{target}' but the editor shows '{root.SceneFilePath}'");
            return root;
        }

        [RqlCallable("open a scene file (res://….tscn) and make it the edited scene; returns its root node")]
        public Node OpenScene(string path)
        {
            path = RequireScenePath(path);
            EditorToolGuards.RequireResourceExists(path, nameof(path), $"no scene at '{path}'");
            Ei.OpenSceneFromPath(path);
            if (RqlGodot.EditedRoot()?.SceneFilePath != path && OpenWithMissingDependencies(path) is { } missing)
                RqlGodot.Warn("missing-dependencies", $"'{path}' references files that no longer exist ({missing}); it was opened " +
                    "anyway (Open Anyway) and those references are empty: list them with rql-query files | where missingDeps.count() > 0");
            var root = RqlGodot.EditedRoot() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"opened '{path}' but the editor has no edited scene");
            if (root.SceneFilePath != path)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"opened '{path}' but the editor shows '{root.SceneFilePath}'");
            return root;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// A scene with a missing dependency does not open in a windowed editor: Godot shows its "Error loading" dialog
        /// (<c>DependencyErrorDialog</c>) and waits for Open Anyway / Fix Dependencies. When that dialog is up for
        /// <paramref name="path"/>, press Open Anyway (the scene opens with the broken references empty) and return the missing
        /// files; null when there is no such dialog. A headless editor opens such scenes without asking.
        /// </summary>
        private static string? OpenWithMissingDependencies(string path)
        {
            var root = (Engine.GetMainLoop() as SceneTree)?.Root;
            // Only the dialog for this file ("Error loading: <file name>"), never one another open left on screen.
            var fileName = path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('/') + 1);
            var dialog = root?.FindChildren("*", "DependencyErrorDialog", true, false).OfType<AcceptDialog>()
                .FirstOrDefault(d => d.Visible && d.Title.EndsWith(fileName, StringComparison.Ordinal));
            if (dialog == null) return null;
            var missing = string.Join(", ", new FileReferences().MissingDepsOf(path));
            dialog.GetOkButton().EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);
            return missing.Length > 0 ? missing : "see the editor output";
        }

        [RqlCallable("save the edited scene to its file, or to a new res://….tscn path (save as); returns the saved path")]
        public string SaveScene(string? path = null)
        {
            var root = RqlGodot.EditedRoot() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no scene is being edited; nothing to save");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            {
                path = RequireScenePath(path!);
                // Save-as onto another file would replace that scene (Godot overwrites without asking here).
                if (path != root.SceneFilePath && FileAccess.FileExists(path))
                    throw new ArgumentException($"a file already exists at '{path}'; save to a new path, or delete that file first with DeleteResource");
                EditorToolGuards.EnsureDirectoryExists(ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(path));
                Ei.SaveSceneAs(path);
                RqlReimport.Register(path!);
                var saved = RqlGodot.EditedRoot()?.SceneFilePath;
                if (saved != path) throw new InvalidOperationException($"save-as to '{path}' did not take effect (the scene path is '{saved ?? "none"}')");
                return path!;
            }
            var existing = root.SceneFilePath;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(existing)) throw new InvalidOperationException("the edited scene was never saved; pass a res:// path: SaveScene(\"res://scenes/x.tscn\")");
            // Saving back would silently recreate a scene file someone deleted (the editor keeps it open before Godot 4.5).
            if (!FileAccess.FileExists(existing))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"the scene file '{existing}' was deleted; pass a path to save as: SaveScene(\"res://scenes/x.tscn\")");
            var error = Ei.SaveScene();
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not save '{existing}': {error}");
            return existing;
        }

        [RqlCallable("save every open scene that has a file")]
        public void SaveAllScenes() => Ei.SaveAllScenes();

        /// <summary>The <c>scenes</c> source: the scenes open in the editor (tabs), the edited one marked active.</summary>
        public static List<RqlScene> OpenScenes()
        {
            var active = RqlGodot.EditedRoot()?.SceneFilePath ?? "";
            var list = new List<RqlScene>();
            foreach (var path in Ei.GetOpenScenes())
                list.Add(new RqlScene(path, path == active));
            if (active.Length == 0 && RqlGodot.EditedRoot() != null) list.Add(new RqlScene("", true));
            return list;
        }

        public string? ValidateReloadScene(string? path) => RqlGodot.Rejection(() =>
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RqlGodot.EditedRoot()?.SceneFilePath)) throw new InvalidOperationException("no saved scene is being edited; pass a res:// scene path");
                return;
            }
            var target = RequireScenePath(path!);
            EditorToolGuards.RequireResourceExists(target, nameof(path), $"no scene at '{target}'");
        });

        // Call validator (RQL 0.2, run before the call, on dry runs too): nothing is created or opened when it rejects.
        public string? ValidateNewScene(string path, string rootClass, string? rootName) => RqlGodot.Rejection(() =>
        {
            path = NewScenePath(path);
            if (IsBaseScene(rootClass))
            {
                BaseScenePath(rootClass, path);
                if (!path.EndsWith(".tscn", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    throw new ArgumentException($"an inherited scene is written as text: give it a .tscn path, not '{path}'", nameof(path));
            }
            else EditorToolGuards.CheckClassDbInstantiation(RootClass(rootClass), "rootClass", requireParentClass: "Node");
        });

        private static string RootClass(string rootClass) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rootClass) ? "Node" : rootClass;

        private static string NewScenePath(string path)
        {
            path = RequireScenePath(path);
            if (FileAccess.FileExists(path)) throw new ArgumentException($"a file already exists at '{path}' (open it with OpenScene)");
            return path;
        }

        /// <summary>The trimmed path when it names a res:// scene file (.tscn / .scn); throws otherwise.</summary>
        private static string RequireScenePath(string path)
        {
            var p = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, nameof(path));
            if (!ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(p)) throw new ArgumentException($"'{path}' is not a scene path ending in .tscn or .scn");
            return p.SimplifyPath(); // the form Godot stores as scene_file_path ('res://a/./b.tscn' -> 'res://a/b.tscn')
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One scene open in the editor (the <c>scenes</c> source).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlScene
    {
        public RqlScene(string path, bool active) { this.path = path; this.active = active; }

        [RqlDescription("res:// path of the scene file (empty for a scene never saved)")]
        public string path { get; }

        [RqlDescription("file name without extension")]
        public string name => path.Length == 0 ? "[unsaved]" : System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path);

        [RqlDescription("true for the scene being edited")]
        public bool active { get; }

        [RqlDescription("root node of the edited scene (null for the other open scenes)")]
        [RqlReference]
        public Node? root => active ? RqlGodot.EditedRoot() : null;

        [RqlCallable("make this the edited scene; returns its root node")]
        public Node Open() => active && RqlGodot.EditedRoot() is { } root ? root : RqlEditorApi.Instance.OpenScene(path);

        [RqlCallable("save this scene (it becomes the edited scene first); returns the saved path")]
        public string Save()
        {
            if (path.Length == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("this scene was never saved; use editor | call SaveScene(\"res://…tscn\")");
            Open();
            return RqlEditorApi.Instance.SaveScene();
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The <c>editor</c> source: editor state and the operations that have no natural owner object — the replacement of the
    /// <c>editor-application-*</c> / <c>editor-selection-*</c>, <c>scene-*</c>, <c>resource-create/move/delete</c> and
    /// <c>filesystem-reimport</c> tools, e.g. <c>editor | call NewScene("res://levels/a.tscn", "Node3D")</c>,
    /// <c>editor | set selection = [godot.find("Player")]</c>. Calls go through rql-mutate (mutation policy, dry-run,
    /// receipts).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed partial class RqlEditorApi
    {
        public static readonly RqlEditorApi Instance = new RqlEditorApi();

        private static EditorInterface Ei => EditorInterface.Singleton;

        [RqlDescription("true while a scene is running from the editor (a separate game process); assign true to run the main scene, false to stop")]
        public bool isPlaying
        {
            get => Ei.IsPlayingScene();
            set { if (value) Ei.PlayMainScene(); else Ei.StopPlayingScene(); }
        }

        [RqlDescription("res:// path of the running scene, or null")]
        public string? playingScene => Ei.IsPlayingScene() && Ei.GetPlayingScene() is { Length: > 0 } s ? s : null;

        [RqlDescription("res:// path of the scene being edited, or null (no scene open, or never saved)")]
        public string? editedScene => RqlGodot.EditedRoot() is { } root && root.SceneFilePath is { Length: > 0 } p ? p : null;

        [RqlDescription("Godot version string, e.g. \"4.4.1.stable.mono\"")]
        public string godotVersion => Engine.GetVersionInfo()["string"].AsString();

        [RqlDescription("absolute path of the project folder (res://)")]
        public string projectPath => ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://");

        [RqlDescription("nodes selected in the editor; assign a list of nodes (refs, godot.find(…), paths) to change the selection")]
        public Node[] selection
        {
            get => RqlGodot.SelectedNodes().ToArray();
            set
            {
                var editorSelection = Ei.GetSelection();
                editorSelection.Clear();
                foreach (var node in value ?? Array.Empty<Node>())
                    if (node != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(node)) editorSelection.AddNode(node);
            }
        }

        [RqlCallable("run a scene in a separate game process: a res:// path, or null for the scene being edited; returns the running scene's path")]
        public string? PlayScene(string? path = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            {
                if (RqlGodot.EditedRoot() == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("no scene is being edited; pass a res:// scene path");
                Ei.PlayCurrentScene();
            }
            else
            {
                Tools.EditorToolGuards.RequireResourceExists(path!, nameof(path), $"no scene at '{path}'");
                Ei.PlayCustomScene(path);
            }
            return playingScene;
        }

        [RqlCallable("stop the scene running from the editor")]
        public void StopScene() => Ei.StopPlayingScene();

        [RqlCallable("clear the captured editor log (the console source)")]
        public void ClearConsole() => Tools.GodotLogCollector.Current?.Clear();
    }
}
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/GodotTypes.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reflection;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The types an agent names (rql-schema "Node3D"): the Godot C# API (GodotSharp / GodotSharpEditor) plus the Godot
    /// object types and public structs / enums of the project assembly (and anything else loaded beside it, extensions
    /// included). One index per editor session, built on first use; lookups by short or full name or Godot class name
    /// (Object for GodotObject), case-insensitive (the C# binding writes some Godot classes differently, e.g. CsgBox3D for
    /// CSGBox3D), best match first (exact case, then the Godot namespace, then project types).
    /// </summary>
    public static class GodotTypes
    {
        private static Dictionary<string, Type[]>? _index;

        private static string[]? _classes;

        /// <summary>Drop the index and the class list (plugin teardown: the index holds types of the collectible project assembly).</summary>
        public static void Reset()
        {
            _index = null;
            _classes = null;
        }

        /// <summary>Every Godot class (ClassDB), sorted ordinally; read once per editor session.</summary>
        public static string[] GodotClasses() =>
            _classes ??= ClassDB.GetClassList().OrderBy(c => c, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();

        /// <summary>Candidate types for a name, best first.</summary>
        public static IReadOnlyList<Type> Candidates(string name) =>
            Index().TryGetValue(name, out var hits)
                ? hits.OrderBy(t => t.Name == name || t.FullName == name ? 0 : 1).ThenBy(t => IsGodot(t) ? 0 : 1).ToList()
                : (IReadOnlyList<Type>)Array.Empty<Type>();

        /// <summary>
        /// The C# type of a Godot class name (CSGBox3D → CsgBox3D), or null; GodotObject for an empty name is the caller's
        /// choice, see <see cref="GodotObjectType"/>.
        /// </summary>
        public static Type? GodotClassType(string className) =>
            Candidates(className).FirstOrDefault(t => typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t));

        /// <summary>The C# type a value for a Godot class slot converts to (Texture2D, Node …); GodotObject when unknown.</summary>
        public static Type GodotObjectType(string className) =>
            className.Length == 0 ? typeof(GodotObject) : GodotClassType(className) ?? typeof(GodotObject);

        /// <summary>Every indexed short name (for "did you mean" suggestions).</summary>
        public static IReadOnlyCollection<string> ShortNames() => Index().Keys.Where(k => k.IndexOf('.') < 0).ToList();

        /// <summary>Every indexed Godot object type (Godot classes, the project's script classes, extensions), once each.</summary>
        public static IEnumerable<Type> GodotObjectTypes() =>
            Index().Values.SelectMany(t => t).Where(t => typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t)).Distinct();

        private static Dictionary<string, Type[]> Index()
        {
            if (_index != null) return _index;
            var byName = new Dictionary<string, List<Type>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            void Add(Type t)
            {
                if (!t.IsVisible || t.IsGenericTypeDefinition) return;
                foreach (var key in new[] { t.Name, t.FullName, RqlHostNames.GodotClassName(t) })
                {
                    if (key == null) continue;
                    if (!byName.TryGetValue(key, out var list)) byName[key] = list = new List<Type>(1);
                    if (!list.Contains(t)) list.Add(t);
                }
            }
            foreach (var t in TypeModel.LoadableTypes(typeof(GodotObject).Assembly))
                if (t.Namespace == "Godot" && (typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t) || t.IsValueType)) Add(t);
            foreach (var t in TypeModel.LoadableTypes(typeof(EditorInterface).Assembly))
                if (t.Namespace == "Godot" && typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t)) Add(t);
            // The project assembly (this addon, the user's scripts, extensions compiled into it) and default-context
            // libraries: their Godot objects, plus this assembly's public structs and enums.
            foreach (var assembly in GodotAssemblyUtils.AllAssemblies)
            {
                if (GodotAssemblyUtils.IsSkippedForDiscovery(assembly, typeof(GodotTypes).Assembly)) continue;
                foreach (var t in TypeModel.LoadableTypes(assembly))
                    if (typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t) || (t.IsValueType && t.IsPublic && assembly == typeof(GodotTypes).Assembly)) Add(t);
            }
            return _index = byName.ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => kv.Value.ToArray(), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        private static bool IsGodot(Type t) => t.Namespace == "Godot";
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/GodotVariants.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Variant ⇄ CLR value conversion for the <c>props</c> map and <c>CallMethod</c>: Godot properties (including GDScript
    /// script variables and GDExtension properties, which have no C# member) are read with <see cref="GodotObject.Get"/>
    /// and written with <see cref="GodotObject.Set"/>, so RQL sees them as typed CLR values.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class GodotVariants
    {
        /// <summary>The CLR value of a Variant (null for Nil); a Godot array reads as a live view of the values its Variants hold.</summary>
        public static object? ToClr(Variant v) => v.VariantType switch
        {
            Variant.Type.Nil => null,
            Variant.Type.Array => Elements(v.AsGodotArray()),
            _ => v.Obj,
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// A Godot array as RQL lists it: the held values instead of Variant structs (whose only members are VariantType and Obj),
        /// so <c>get props["items"] | select props["name"]</c> reaches the elements (read-only: assign the whole list to change it).
        /// </summary>
        public static ConvertingList<Variant> Elements(global::Godot.Collections.Array array) => new ConvertingList<Variant>(array, ToClr);

        /// <summary>A Variant holding <paramref name="value"/>; RQL lists / object literals become Godot arrays / dictionaries.</summary>
        public static Variant ToVariant(object? value)
        {
            switch (value)
            {
                case null: return default;
                case Variant v: return v;
                case bool b: return b;
                case string s: return s;
                case int i: return i;
                case long l: return l;
                case double d: return d;
                case float f: return f;
                case byte or sbyte or short or ushort or uint: return Convert.ToInt64(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                case ulong ul: return unchecked((long)ul);
                case decimal m: return (double)m;
                case Enum e: return Convert.ToInt64(e, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                case Vector2 x: return x;
                case Vector2I x: return x;
                case Vector3 x: return x;
                case Vector3I x: return x;
                case Vector4 x: return x;
                case Vector4I x: return x;
                case Rect2 x: return x;
                case Rect2I x: return x;
                case Transform2D x: return x;
                case Plane x: return x;
                case Quaternion x: return x;
                case Aabb x: return x;
                case Basis x: return x;
                case Transform3D x: return x;
                case Projection x: return x;
                case Color x: return x;
                case Rid x: return x;
                case Callable x: return x;
                case StringName x: return x;
                case NodePath x: return x;
                case GodotObject x: return x;
                case global::Godot.Collections.Array x: return x;
                case ConvertingList<Variant> { Inner: global::Godot.Collections.Array x }: return x.Duplicate();
                case global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary x: return x;
                case byte[] x: return x;
                case int[] x: return x;
                case long[] x: return x;
                case float[] x: return x;
                case double[] x: return x;
                case string[] x: return x;
                case Vector2[] x: return x;
                case Vector3[] x: return x;
                case Color[] x: return x;
                case IDictionary map:
                {
                    var dictionary = new global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary();
                    foreach (DictionaryEntry entry in map) dictionary[ToVariant(entry.Key)] = ToVariant(entry.Value);
                    return dictionary;
                }
                case IEnumerable list:
                {
                    var array = new global::Godot.Collections.Array();
                    foreach (var item in list) array.Add(ToVariant(item));
                    return array;
                }
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentException($"a {value.GetType().Name} cannot be stored in a Godot property");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The CLR type RQL coerces a value to before it is written to a Godot property of <paramref name="type"/>
        /// (<paramref name="hint"/> / <paramref name="hintString"/> narrow object properties to Resource / Node).
        /// </summary>
        public static Type ClrType(Variant.Type type, PropertyHint hint = PropertyHint.None, string? hintString = null) => type switch
        {
            Variant.Type.Bool => typeof(bool),
            Variant.Type.Int => typeof(long),
            Variant.Type.Float => typeof(double),
            Variant.Type.String => typeof(string),
            Variant.Type.Vector2 => typeof(Vector2),
            Variant.Type.Vector2I => typeof(Vector2I),
            Variant.Type.Rect2 => typeof(Rect2),
            Variant.Type.Rect2I => typeof(Rect2I),
            Variant.Type.Vector3 => typeof(Vector3),
            Variant.Type.Vector3I => typeof(Vector3I),
            Variant.Type.Transform2D => typeof(Transform2D),
            Variant.Type.Vector4 => typeof(Vector4),
            Variant.Type.Vector4I => typeof(Vector4I),
            Variant.Type.Plane => typeof(Plane),
            Variant.Type.Quaternion => typeof(Quaternion),
            Variant.Type.Aabb => typeof(Aabb),
            Variant.Type.Basis => typeof(Basis),
            Variant.Type.Transform3D => typeof(Transform3D),
            Variant.Type.Projection => typeof(Projection),
            Variant.Type.Color => typeof(Color),
            Variant.Type.StringName => typeof(StringName),
            Variant.Type.NodePath => typeof(NodePath),
            Variant.Type.Rid => typeof(Rid),
            Variant.Type.Callable => typeof(Callable),
            Variant.Type.Object => hint == PropertyHint.ResourceType ? typeof(Resource)
                : hint == PropertyHint.NodeType ? typeof(Node) : typeof(GodotObject),
            Variant.Type.Dictionary => typeof(global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary),
            Variant.Type.Array => typeof(global::Godot.Collections.Array),
            Variant.Type.PackedByteArray => typeof(byte[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedInt32Array => typeof(int[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedInt64Array => typeof(long[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedFloat32Array => typeof(float[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedFloat64Array => typeof(double[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedStringArray => typeof(string[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedVector2Array => typeof(Vector2[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedVector3Array => typeof(Vector3[]),
            Variant.Type.PackedColorArray => typeof(Color[]),
            _ => typeof(object), // Nil (a Variant property), Signal, Packed types newer than 4.3
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// The one property-usage rule: a real property (not a category / group / subgroup header) that is stored — or,
        /// unless <paramref name="storageOnly"/>, at least shown in the inspector.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool IsExposed(PropertyUsageFlags usage, bool storageOnly)
        {
            if (IsHeader(usage)) return false;
            return (usage & (storageOnly ? PropertyUsageFlags.Storage : PropertyUsageFlags.Storage | PropertyUsageFlags.Editor)) != 0;
        }

        /// <summary>A category / group / subgroup header of a property list (not a property).</summary>
        public static bool IsHeader(PropertyUsageFlags usage) =>
            (usage & (PropertyUsageFlags.Category | PropertyUsageFlags.Group | PropertyUsageFlags.Subgroup)) != 0;

        /// <summary>One Godot property of an object: its Variant type and hint.</summary>
        public readonly struct GodotProperty
        {
            public GodotProperty(Variant.Type type, PropertyHint hint, string hintString) { Type = type; Hint = hint; HintString = hintString; }
            public Variant.Type Type { get; }
            public PropertyHint Hint { get; }
            public string HintString { get; }
            public Type ClrType => ClrType(Type, Hint, HintString);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// A property scripts can read and write that is neither stored nor shown in the inspector (usage none), such as
        /// Node3D <c>rotation_degrees</c> or <c>global_position</c>: reachable by name in <c>props["…"]</c> (not listed among its
        /// keys); null when <paramref name="o"/> has no such property.
        /// </summary>
        public static GodotProperty? ScriptOnlyProperty(GodotObject o, string name) =>
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && ScriptOnlyProperties(o).TryGetValue(name, out var info) ? info : (GodotProperty?)null;

        // Script-only properties kept out of props: node plumbing with its own checked member (name: the sibling check), or
        // none (owner, scene_file_path, multiplayer) — a raw write would skip the checks and the undo snapshot.
        private static readonly HashSet<string> ScriptOnlyExcluded = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            { "name", "owner", "scene_file_path", "multiplayer", "unique_name_in_owner" };

        // The script-only properties of an object by name, made once per query scope (like the props table).
        private static Dictionary<string, GodotProperty> ScriptOnlyProperties(GodotObject o) => Scoped(("script-only", o.GetInstanceId()), () =>
        {
            var table = new Dictionary<string, GodotProperty>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var info in o.GetPropertyList())
            {
                var usage = (PropertyUsageFlags)info["usage"].AsInt64();
                var name = info["name"].AsString();
                if (name.Length == 0 || IsHeader(usage) || IsExposed(usage, storageOnly: false) || table.ContainsKey(name)
                    || ScriptOnlyExcluded.Contains(name) || name.StartsWith("process_thread_", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                table[name] = new GodotProperty((Variant.Type)info["type"].AsInt64(), (PropertyHint)info["hint"].AsInt64(), info["hint_string"].AsString());
            }
            return table;
        });

        /// <summary>The names of the properties <see cref="IsExposed"/> accepts, in the object's order.</summary>
        public static IEnumerable<string> PropertyNames(GodotObject o, bool storageOnly)
        {
            foreach (var info in o.GetPropertyList())
                if (IsExposed((PropertyUsageFlags)info["usage"].AsInt64(), storageOnly) && info["name"].AsString() is { Length: > 0 } name)
                    yield return name;
        }

        // The props table of each object (instance id -> name -> info), cached while a query scope is open: a query asks
        // for the keys, the entry type, "has" and the validation of the same object many times. Outside a scope nothing is
        // cached (a property list can change with the object's state, e.g. a ShaderMaterial's shader parameters).
        private static Dictionary<ulong, Dictionary<string, GodotProperty>>? _tables;
        private static Dictionary<object, object>? _scoped;
        private static int _scopes;

        /// <summary>Cache property tables until the returned scope is disposed (one RQL query / mutation).</summary>
        public static IDisposable QueryScope()
        {
            if (_scopes++ == 0)
            {
                _tables = new Dictionary<ulong, Dictionary<string, GodotProperty>>();
                _scoped = new Dictionary<object, object>();
            }
            return new Scope();
        }

        private sealed class Scope : IDisposable
        {
            private bool _done;
            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_done) return;
                _done = true;
                if (--_scopes == 0) { _tables = null; _scoped = null; }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// <paramref name="make"/>'s value for <paramref name="key"/>, made once while a query scope is open (like the property
        /// tables), every time outside one.
        /// </summary>
        public static T Scoped<T>(object key, Func<T> make) where T : class
        {
            if (_scoped == null) return make();
            if (_scoped.TryGetValue(key, out var cached) && cached is T hit) return hit;
            var made = make();
            _scoped[key] = made;
            return made;
        }

        /// <summary>The exposed (stored or inspector) properties of <paramref name="o"/>, by name, in the object's order.</summary>
        public static Dictionary<string, GodotProperty> Properties(GodotObject o)
        {
            var id = o.GetInstanceId();
            if (_tables != null && _tables.TryGetValue(id, out var cached)) return cached;
            var table = new Dictionary<string, GodotProperty>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var info in o.GetPropertyList())
            {
                if (!IsExposed((PropertyUsageFlags)info["usage"].AsInt64(), storageOnly: false)) continue;
                var name = info["name"].AsString();
                if (name.Length == 0 || table.ContainsKey(name)) continue;
                table[name] = new GodotProperty((Variant.Type)info["type"].AsInt64(), (PropertyHint)info["hint"].AsInt64(), info["hint_string"].AsString());
            }
            if (_tables != null) _tables[id] = table;
            return table;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │

│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Modules
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The Godot core: sources, functions, the adapters for Godot's core types and the type blacklist. Extensions contribute
    /// their own <see cref="IRqlModule"/> (adapters, sources, functions, <c>ctx.AddGuide</c>) from the consumer project
    /// assembly; <see cref="RqlGodot"/> discovers every module in the loaded assemblies.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GodotCoreModule : IRqlModule
    {
        public int Order => 0;

        public void Configure(RqlModuleContext ctx)
        {
            ctx.AddSource("nodes", RqlGodot.AllNodes, "every node of the edited scene, depth-first, root first (internal children excluded)")
               .AddSource("root", RqlGodot.Roots, "the root node of the edited scene")
               .AddSource("selection", RqlGodot.SelectedNodes, "nodes selected in the editor")
               .AddSource("scenes", RqlEditorApi.OpenScenes, "scenes open in the editor: path name active root; calls Open, Save")
               .AddSource("files", RqlEditorApi.Files,
                   $"every file the editor filesystem knows (at most {RqlGodot.MaxFiles}): path name dir ext type uid; on request deps (what it loads), " +
                   "missingDeps (broken references), usedBy (the scenes / resources that load it) and importSettings[\"option\"] (writable)")
               .AddSource("classes", RqlEditorApi.Classes, "Godot classes (ClassDB): name parent canInstantiate isNode isResource")
               .AddSource("console", RqlEditorApi.ConsoleEntries, $"captured editor log lines, oldest first (last {RqlEditorApi.MaxLogEntries}): Sequence LogType Message Timestamp StackTrace")
               .AddSource("gameLog", RqlEditorApi.GameLog,
                   $"what the game run from the editor (PlayScene / isPlaying) printed, its errors and warnings, oldest first (last {RqlEditorApi.MaxGameLogEntries}): " +
                   "Sequence LogType Message StackTrace (the console source is the editor's own log)")
               .AddSource("editor", () => RqlEditorApi.Instance,
                   "editor state (isPlaying, playingScene, editedScene, selection, godotVersion, undoHistory, redoHistory) and operations: CreateNode, InstantiateScene " +
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Modules/TestHooksModule.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Modules
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Test-only functions for the live smoke (scripts/smoke_rql.py), registered only when the editor runs with
    /// <c>GODOT_MCP_RQL_TEST_HOOKS=1</c>: <c>test.undo(history)</c> / <c>test.redo(history)</c> step the undo history an RQL
    /// mutation committed to ("scene" or "global"), <c>test.action(history)</c> names its current action,
    /// <c>test.undoManager()</c> is true only when the editor's undo manager and its histories are reachable (the smoke's
    /// probe: without one, mutations apply without undo entries), <c>test.addToGroup(node, group, persistent)</c> joins a
    /// group like a tool script would (also without <c>persistent</c>, which RQL itself never does). Godot's C# API has
    /// no editor-level undo; these drive the history's UndoRedo directly, which the editor's own Undo bookkeeping does not
    /// see — fine for a disposable test editor, never for an agent, hence the gate.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TestHooksModule : IRqlModule
    {
        public const string EnvVar = "GODOT_MCP_RQL_TEST_HOOKS";

        public int Order => 100;

        public void Configure(RqlModuleContext ctx)
        {
            if (System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(EnvVar) != "1") return;
            ctx.AddFunction("test.undo", args => Step(args, undo: true), "TEST ONLY: undo the last action of a history (\"scene\" or \"global\")")
               .AddFunction("test.redo", args => Step(args, undo: false), "TEST ONLY: redo the next action of a history (\"scene\" or \"global\")")
               .AddFunction("test.action", args => History(args)?.GetCurrentActionName(), "TEST ONLY: the current action of a history (\"scene\" or \"global\")")
               .AddFunction("test.undoManager", args => HasUndoManager(), "TEST ONLY: whether the editor's undo manager and its histories are reachable")
               .AddFunction("test.addToGroup", AddToGroup, "TEST ONLY: Node.AddToGroup(group, persistent) on a node, bypassing RQL (no undo)");
        }

        private static object? Step(object?[] args, bool undo)
        {
            var history = History(args) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no undo manager (the plugin is not installed)");
            RqlGodot.InvalidateGroups(); // the step may change groups behind RQL
            return undo ? history.Undo() : history.Redo();
        }

        // Both histories a mutation commits to are reachable (global; the edited scene's, when one is open).
        private static bool HasUndoManager() =>
            History(new object?[] { "global" }) != null && (RqlGodot.EditedRoot() == null || History(new object?[] { "scene" }) != null);

        private static object? AddToGroup(object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length != 3 || !(args[0] is Node node) || !(args[1] is string group) || !(args[2] is bool persistent))
                return new RqlError("type-mismatch", "test.addToGroup(node, group, persistent) expects a node, a group name and a bool");
            node.AddToGroup(group, persistent);
            RqlGodot.InvalidateGroups(node);
            return true;
        }

        private static UndoRedo? History(object?[] args) =>
            RqlGodot.UndoHistory(global: args.Length > 0 && args[0] is string s && string.Equals(s, "global", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/OverrideDiff.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The pure part of a scene instance's <c>overrides</c>: whether a live property value differs from the template's, and a
    /// transform difference told as position / rotation_degrees / scale (what an agent sets) rather than one 3x4 matrix. Godot's
    /// math structs are plain C#, so this is unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    public static class OverrideDiff
    {
        private const float Epsilon = 1e-4f;

        /// <summary>The (property, live, template) differences of two transforms, by position, rotation_degrees and scale.</summary>
        public static IEnumerable<(string property, object live, object template)> Transform(Transform3D live, Transform3D template)
        {
            if (!Near(live.Origin, template.Origin)) yield return ("position", live.Origin, template.Origin);
            // A scaled basis gives wrong Euler angles: take them from the rotation part only.
            var liveRot = Degrees(live.Basis.Orthonormalized().GetEuler());
            var templateRot = Degrees(template.Basis.Orthonormalized().GetEuler());
            if (!Near(liveRot, templateRot)) yield return ("rotation_degrees", liveRot, templateRot);
            if (!Near(live.Basis.Scale, template.Basis.Scale)) yield return ("scale", live.Basis.Scale, template.Basis.Scale);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Float-noise tolerant equality for numbers, vectors and colors (what an edited value is compared by), or null for any
        /// other kind (the caller compares those exactly).
        /// </summary>
        public static bool? ApproxSame(object? live, object? template) => (live, template) switch
        {
            (float a, float b) => Math.Abs(a - b) <= Epsilon,
            (double a, double b) => Math.Abs(a - b) <= Epsilon,
            (Vector2 a, Vector2 b) => Near(a, b),
            (Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => Near(a, b),
            (Color a, Color b) => a.IsEqualApprox(b),
            _ => null,
        };

        private static Vector3 Degrees(Vector3 radians) => new Vector3(Mathf.RadToDeg(radians.X), Mathf.RadToDeg(radians.Y), Mathf.RadToDeg(radians.Z));
        private static bool Near(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => (a - b).Length() <= Epsilon;
        private static bool Near(Vector2 a, Vector2 b) => (a - b).Length() <= Epsilon;
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RotationUnits.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Godot's C# <c>Rotation</c> / <c>GlobalRotation</c> (Node3D, Node2D, Control) are radians; agents often write degrees
    /// there (<c>set Rotation = "(-45, 30, 0)"</c> turns a light by -45 rad). A written angle beyond one full turn (2π) is
    /// almost always meant as degrees: the mutation still applies (it is a valid value), and its receipt carries a warning
    /// naming the degree members. Pure (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public static class RotationUnits
    {
        private const double FullTurn = 2 * Math.PI + 1e-3;

        /// <summary>Whether <paramref name="member"/> (a receipt member path such as "Rotation", "Rotation.X" or "GlobalRotation") is a radians rotation.</summary>
        public static bool IsRadiansMember(string? member)
        {
            var head = (member ?? "").Split('.')[0];
            return string.Equals(head, "Rotation", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || string.Equals(head, "GlobalRotation", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        /// <summary>The warning for a radians member written with <paramref name="components"/>, or null when no angle exceeds a full turn.</summary>
        public static string? Warning(string member, double[] components)
        {
            if (!IsRadiansMember(member) || !components.Any(c => Math.Abs(c) > FullTurn)) return null;
            var head = member.Split('.')[0];
            var degrees = char.ToUpperInvariant(head[0]) + head.Substring(1) + "Degrees" + member.Substring(head.Length);
            string Format(Func<double, double> f)
            {
                var list = string.Join(", ", components.Select(c => f(c).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
                return components.Length == 1 ? list : "(" + list + ")";
            }
            var written = Format(c => c);
            var asDegrees = Format(c => c * 180 / Math.PI) + "°";
            return $"{member} is in radians: {written} turns by {asDegrees}. For degrees set {degrees} = {written} instead";
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodot.Create.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Bulk create behind <c>editor.CreateNode(class, {…})</c> and <c>editor.InstantiateScene(path, {…})</c>: RQL runs the call once per
    /// stream item (<c>range(0, 300) | call editor.CreateNode(…)</c>), checks every item first (class or scene, parent, name, each
    /// property and its value), and the nodes join the mutation's one undo action through <see cref="Attach"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static partial class RqlGodot
    {
        // The property list of each class / scene a running mutation creates (one throwaway instance per class or scene, not one
        // per item): name → the list entry (type, hint, hint_string, class_name, usage). Cleared with the mutation's state.
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>> _propertyTables =
            new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        /// <summary>A new node of <paramref name="className"/> with <paramref name="options"/>, added to the edited scene.</summary>
        public static Node CreateNode(string className, NodeOptions? options)
        {
            var root = RequireEditedRoot();
            var parent = NewNodeParent(options, root);
            var node = Instantiate(className);
            return AttachNew(node, parent, root, options, "class:" + className);
        }

        /// <summary>A new instance of the scene at <paramref name="path"/> with <paramref name="options"/>, added to the edited scene.</summary>
        public static Node InstantiateSceneWith(string path, NodeOptions? options)
        {
            var root = RequireEditedRoot();
            var parent = NewNodeParent(options, root);
            var node = InstantiableScene(path, root).Instantiate(PackedScene.GenEditState.Instance)
                       ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not instantiate '{path}'");
            return AttachNew(node, parent, root, options, "scene:" + path);
        }

        public static string? ValidateCreateNode(string className, NodeOptions? options) => Rejection(() =>
        {
            var root = RequireEditedRoot();
            var parent = NewNodeParent(options, root);
            NodeClass(className, out _);
            CheckNewNode(parent, options, "class:" + className, () => Instantiate(className));
        });

        public static string? ValidateInstantiateSceneWith(string path, NodeOptions? options) => Rejection(() =>
        {
            var root = RequireEditedRoot();
            var parent = NewNodeParent(options, root);
            var packed = InstantiableScene(path, root);
            CheckNewNode(parent, options, "scene:" + path, () => packed.Instantiate(PackedScene.GenEditState.Instance)
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"could not instantiate '{path}'"));
        });

        // The batch rule of a bulk create (after every item passed its own check): two items may not give the same name under
        // one parent (Godot would rename the second one, and the receipt would not show the name asked for).
        private static string? ValidateCreateBatch(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records)
        {
            var planned = new List<(object parent, string? name)>();
            var root = EditedRoot();
            foreach (var record in records)
            {
                if (!(record.Item is RqlEditorApi) || !IsCreateCall(record.Method?.Name) || record.Args.Count < 2) continue;
                var options = record.Args[1] as NodeOptions;
                if (options?.Name == null || root == null) continue;
                planned.Add((NewNodeParent(options, root), options.Name));
            }
            return NodeOptions.DuplicateName(planned) is { } name
                ? $"several items are named '{name}' under the same parent; give each a different name, e.g. \"{name}\" + $"
                : null;
        }

        private static bool IsCreateCall(string? method) =>
            method == nameof(RqlEditorApi.CreateNode) || method == nameof(RqlEditorApi.InstantiateScene);

        // The parent a new node goes under: the options' parent (a node, a path, a ref) or the scene root.
        private static Node NewNodeParent(NodeOptions? options, Node root)
        {
            if (options?.Parent == null) return root;
            var parent = options.Parent as Node;
            if (parent == null)
            {
                if (options.Kernel == null) throw new ArgumentException("parent: expected a node");
                if (!options.Kernel.TryCoerce(options.Parent, typeof(Node), out var coerced, out var why))
                    throw new ArgumentException($"parent: {why}");
                parent = (Node)coerced!;
            }
            if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(parent)) throw new ArgumentException("parent: the node was freed");
            RequireInEditedScene(parent, "parent");
            return parent;
        }

        // Every check of a new node that reads only: its name among the parent's children, and each property (it exists on the
        // class or scene, its value converts). Object literals of non-resource values are built only by the call itself.
        private static void CheckNewNode(Node parent, NodeOptions? options, string tableKey, Func<Node> instantiate)
        {
            if (options == null) return;
            CheckNewName(parent, options.Name);
            var table = PropertyTable(tableKey, instantiate);
            foreach (var kv in options.Properties)
            {
                var info = PropertyEntry(table, kv.Key, tableKey);
                if (kv.Value is IDictionary<string, object?> && (Variant.Type)info.Value["type"].AsInt32() == Variant.Type.Object
                    && !typeof(Resource).IsAssignableFrom(GodotCallArguments.ObjectType(GodotCallArguments.ObjectClasses(info.Value["class_name"].AsString()))))
                    continue;
                ConvertProperty(kv.Value, info, options);
            }
        }

        // Name, properties, then into the scene (owned by the root, one undo step with the rest of the mutation). A property that
        // fails frees the node before it joins the scene.
        private static Node AttachNew(Node node, Node parent, Node root, NodeOptions? options, string tableKey)
        {
            try
            {
                if (options?.Name != null)
                {
                    CheckNewName(parent, options.Name);
                    node.Name = options.Name;
                }
                if (options != null && options.Properties.Count > 0)
                {
                    var table = PropertyTable(tableKey, () => node, keep: true);
                    foreach (var kv in options.Properties)
                    {
                        var info = PropertyEntry(table, kv.Key, tableKey);
                        node.Set(info.Key, ConvertProperty(kv.Value, info, options));
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                node.Free();
                throw;
            }
            EnsureEditable(parent, root);
            return Attach(parent, node, root);
        }

        // A name Godot would change (a character it does not allow, a sibling's name) is refused, like a rename.
        private static void CheckNewName(Node parent, string? name)
        {
            if (name == null) return;
            if (parent.GetNodeOrNull(name) != null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"name: '{PathOf(parent)}' already has a child named '{name}'; pick another name");
            if (NodeNameRules.Problem(name, _ => false) is { } problem)
                throw new ArgumentException($"name: {problem}");
        }

        private static Variant ConvertProperty(object? value, KeyValuePair<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary> info, NodeOptions options)
        {
            if (options.Kernel == null) return GodotVariants.ToVariant(value);
            return GodotCallArguments.ConvertTo(value, info.Value, options.Kernel, info.Key);
        }

        // The property list of a class or scene, read from one instance (freed unless the caller keeps it) and cached for the
        // running mutation.
        private static Dictionary<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary> PropertyTable(string key, Func<Node> instantiate, bool keep = false)
        {
            if (_propertyTables.TryGetValue(key, out var table)) return table;
            var node = instantiate();
            try
            {
                table = new Dictionary<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                foreach (var entry in node.GetPropertyList())
                    if (!GodotVariants.IsHeader((PropertyUsageFlags)entry["usage"].AsInt64()))
                        table[entry["name"].AsString()] = entry;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (!keep) node.Free();
            }
            _propertyTables[key] = table;
            return table;
        }

        // The list entry of an option key: the Godot name (snake_case) or the C#-style one (Position, RotationDegrees).
        private static KeyValuePair<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary> PropertyEntry(
            Dictionary<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary> table, string key, string tableKey)
        {
            var name = table.ContainsKey(key) ? key : key.ToSnakeCase();
            // A global transform set before the node has a parent would be taken as its local one; a script set here would
            // replace the C# wrapper the call still holds.
            if (name.StartsWith("global_", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{key}' cannot be set on a node being created (it has no parent yet); use '{name.Substring(7)}', which is relative to the parent");
            if (name == "script")
                throw new ArgumentException("'script' cannot be set on a node being created; create the script class itself (CreateNode(\"<class_name>\")) or set script on the node afterwards");
            if (table.TryGetValue(name, out var entry)) return new KeyValuePair<string, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>(name, entry);
            var what = tableKey.StartsWith("scene:", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? $"the root of {tableKey.Substring(6)}" : $"a {tableKey.Substring(6)}";
            throw new ArgumentException($"{what} has no property '{key}'" + Similar(table.Keys, key) +
                $"; the options are {NodeOptions.NameKey}, {NodeOptions.ParentKey} and Godot properties of a new {tableKey.Substring(6)} (snake_case, " +
                "as in props[\"…\"]); a property that appears only once another one is set (a mesh's surface materials) takes a set on the returned nodes");
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodot.Names.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Adapters;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    public static partial class RqlGodot
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The member names <c>RqlEngine.IsKnownMember</c> knows: those some Godot object type declares. Node and resource
        /// streams are polymorphic (<c>nodes</c> is typed Node), so a member of MeshInstance3D or of a C# script class is not
        /// statically reachable; without this a <c>nodes | where … | set Mesh = …</c> that matched no mesh would be reported as
        /// a typo. Known: the C# members of every Godot class (the C# binding of ClassDB's properties: light_energy is
        /// LightEnergy), of the project's Godot object types (C# scripts, extensions) and the adapters' members (props, class,
        /// path …). Godot's snake_case names stay unknown as members: they are props["…"] keys, so <c>set light_energy = 2</c>
        /// is still the typo it is.
        /// </summary>
        internal static HashSet<string> KnownMemberNames(RqlEngine engine)
        {
            var known = RqlHostNames.MemberNames(GodotTypes.GodotObjectTypes());
            // Adapter members (props, params, colors …) come from the engine's type model: only the adapted types are built
            // there (building every Godot class would compile thousands of getters).
            foreach (var target in engine.Adapters.Select(a => a.Target).Distinct())
            {
                try { foreach (var member in engine.Types.Info(target).Members) known.Add(member.Name); }
                catch (Exception ex) { GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] RQL known members: {target.Name} skipped: {ex.Message}"); }
            }
            return known;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// <c>RqlEngine.EnumAliases</c>: the names Godot shows for the entries of a C# class enum — its ClassDB constants
        /// (<c>PRESET_FULL_RECT</c> for <c>Control.LayoutPreset.FullRect</c>, what the docs and GDScript use) and the inspector
        /// labels of the class's properties of that enum (<c>"Double-Sided"</c> for
        /// <c>GeometryInstance3D.ShadowCastingSetting.DoubleSided</c>). Global enums (Key, Error …) have no ClassDB entry and keep
        /// their C# names. Never throws: a failure means no aliases.
        /// </summary>
        internal static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? EnumAliases(Type enumType)
        {
            try { return GodotEnumAliases(enumType); }
            catch (Exception) { return null; }
        }

        private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? GodotEnumAliases(Type enumType)
        {
            if (enumType.Namespace != "Godot" || enumType.DeclaringType is not { } owner) return null;
            // The C# binding renames some classes (GodotObject is Object, CsgBox3D is CSGBox3D: [GodotClassName]) and enums
            // (Viewport.MSAA is Msaa, BaseMaterial3D.ShadingMode is ShadingModeEnum where a property has the same name).
            var godotClass = RqlHostNames.GodotClassName(owner) ?? owner.Name;
            if (!ClassDB.ClassExists(godotClass)) return null;
            var csName = enumType.Name.EndsWith("Enum", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? enumType.Name.Substring(0, enumType.Name.Length - 4) : null;
            var enums = ClassDB.ClassGetEnumList(godotClass, noInheritance: true);
            var enumName = enums.FirstOrDefault(n => string.Equals(n, enumType.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                ?? (csName == null ? null : enums.FirstOrDefault(n => string.Equals(n, csName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
            if (enumName == null) return null;
            var qualified = godotClass + "." + enumName;
            var names = GodotEnumOptions.Of(qualified, PropertyHint.None, "") ?? new List<(string name, long value)>();
            // ClassDB's property list leaves class_name empty for enum properties; the enum is the setter's argument type. Before
            // Godot 4.4 the setter is guessed as set_<property>: labels of a property whose setter is named otherwise are missed
            // there (constants always work).
            var setterArgs = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var method in ClassDB.ClassGetMethodList(godotClass, noInheritance: true))
                if (method["args"].AsGodotArray<global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary>() is { Count: 1 } args)
                    setterArgs[method["name"].AsString()] = args[0]["class_name"].AsString();
            foreach (var info in ClassDB.ClassGetPropertyList(godotClass, noInheritance: true))
            {
                var property = info["name"].AsString();
                if ((PropertyHint)info["hint"].AsInt64() == PropertyHint.Enum
                    && setterArgs.TryGetValue(GodotEnumOptions.PropertySetter(godotClass, property) ?? "set_" + property, out var argClass)
                    && argClass == qualified)
                    names.AddRange(GodotEnumNames.ParseHint(info["hint_string"].AsString()));
            }
            return RqlHostNames.EnumAliases(enumType, names);
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodot.Nodes.cs`:
