`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodot.Save.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The write side of the engine: undo, dirty marking and saving.
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><b>Undo.</b> One <see cref="EditorUndoRedoManager"/> action per <see cref="Mutate"/> (two when it touched both
    /// scene nodes and other objects: Godot keeps one undo history per scene plus a global one). <c>set</c>: the Godot
    /// properties (storage usage) of every changed object are snapshotted before the write and the differences become
    /// do/undo properties. Structural calls (AddChild, InstantiateScene, Duplicate, Free, Reparent, MoveChild) apply their
    /// change immediately and register do/undo methods through <see cref="RecordUndo"/>. Actions are committed with
    /// <c>execute: false</c> because the change is already applied. The steps' do parts are registered in the order the
    /// changes happened and their undo parts in reverse, so undoing a mutation of several dependent steps (two MoveChild
    /// calls, several siblings freed) restores the original state.</item>
    /// <item><b>Saving</b> — the same policy as the replaced <c>node-modify</c> / <c>resource-modify</c> tools: a change to a
    /// node of the edited scene marks the scene unsaved (it is written by <c>editor | call SaveScene()</c>, like Ctrl+S); a
    /// change to a resource stored in its own file (<c>res://….tres</c>) is saved to that file after the mutation; a built-in
    /// (scene-embedded) resource marks the scene unsaved. Nothing is saved after a dry run or a mutation that applied
    /// nothing.</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </summary>
    public static partial class RqlGodot
    {
        private static int _mutating;

        /// <summary>One undoable step: the operations that redo it and the ones that undo it (either may be null).</summary>
        private readonly struct UndoStep
        {
            public UndoStep(Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? redo, Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? undo) { Redo = redo; Undo = undo; }
            public Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? Redo { get; }
            public Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? Undo { get; }
        }

        // Per running Mutate: Godot property snapshots taken before the writes, the undo steps collected so far (scene
        // history / other history), the file resources to save afterwards and the nodes removed (kept alive by the undo
        // history; freed when there is none).
        private static readonly Dictionary<GodotObject, Dictionary<string, Variant>> _snapshots = new Dictionary<GodotObject, Dictionary<string, Variant>>();
        private static readonly List<UndoStep> _sceneUndo = new List<UndoStep>();
        private static readonly List<UndoStep> _otherUndo = new List<UndoStep>();
        private static readonly List<Resource> _toSave = new List<Resource>();
        private static readonly HashSet<Resource> _toSaveSet = new HashSet<Resource>();
        private static readonly HashSet<Node> _removed = new HashSet<Node>();
        private static bool _settingsChanged;

        // The editor's autoload tab when the running mutation changed an autoload: refreshed after saving (held for one mutation only).
        private static Node? _changedAutoloads;
        // Receipt warnings of the running mutation (code, text): a radians rotation written with degree-sized angles, a scene
        // opened with missing dependencies.
        private static readonly List<(string code, string text)> _warnings = new List<(string code, string text)>();

        /// <summary>Add a warning to the receipt of the running mutation (once per text).</summary>
        internal static void Warn(string code, string text)
        {
            if (!_warnings.Contains((code, text))) _warnings.Add((code, text));
        }
        // Objects whose change registered its own do/undo (structural edits such as adding a TileSet source or a Theme
        // item): their property snapshot is not turned into undo properties (setting a removed entry to null does not
        // remove it again), they are only marked changed / saved.
        private static readonly HashSet<GodotObject> _explicitUndo = new HashSet<GodotObject>();
        // The undo steps setters register during a set stage, held until the stage commits (dropped when it is rolled back).
        private static readonly RqlSetStageBuffer _setStages = new RqlSetStageBuffer();

        // Sub-resources an adapter reached through their container (a TileSet's atlas sources): a new sub-resource has no
        // "file::id" path until its file is loaded again, so this is how its changes find the file to save. The value is the
        // container's instance id, not the container: a strong value would keep the container alive, which keeps the
        // sub-resource (the key) alive natively, so neither would ever be freed.
        private static readonly System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<Resource, System.Runtime.CompilerServices.StrongBox<ulong>> _containers =
            new System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<Resource, System.Runtime.CompilerServices.StrongBox<ulong>>();

        /// <summary>
        /// The stored properties of <paramref name="o"/> as the running mutation saw them before its first write (its undo
        /// snapshot), or read now when there is none.
        /// </summary>
        internal static Dictionary<string, Variant> SnapshotOf(GodotObject o) =>
            _snapshots.TryGetValue(o, out var snapshot) ? snapshot : StoredProperties(o);

        /// <summary>Record that <paramref name="sub"/> is stored inside <paramref name="container"/> (saved with it).</summary>
        internal static void RegisterContainer(Resource sub, Resource container) =>
            _containers.AddOrUpdate(sub, new System.Runtime.CompilerServices.StrongBox<ulong>(container.GetInstanceId()));

        private static void ResetState()
        {
            _mutating = 0;
            _snapshots.Clear();
            _sceneUndo.Clear();
            _otherUndo.Clear();
            _toSave.Clear();
            _toSaveSet.Clear();
            _removed.Clear();
            _settingsChanged = false;
            _changedAutoloads = null;
            _warnings.Clear();
            _explicitUndo.Clear();
            _setStages.Clear();
            _propertyTables.Clear();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Run a set / call query, then commit its undo action and save the edited resource files (see the class summary).
        /// Saving problems become <c>not-saved</c> warnings on the receipt, never a tool error: the change is applied.
        /// </summary>
        public static QueryResult Mutate(string query, bool dryRun = false, int? maxTargets = null)
        {
            if (_mutating == 0) ResetState();
            _mutating++;
            QueryResult result;
            try
            {
                result = RunQuery(() => Engine.Execute(query, RqlTargetLimit.BudgetsFor(maxTargets), new QueryOptions { AllowMutation = true, DryRun = dryRun }));
            }
            finally
            {
                _mutating--;
                // A set stage of this query that never committed was rolled back: its setters' undo steps go with it.
                _setStages.DiscardAbove(_mutating);
                if (_mutating == 0) CommitUndo(query);
            }
            if (_mutating == 0)
                foreach (var (code, text) in _warnings)
                    result.Diagnostics.Add(Diagnostic.Warning(code, text));
            if (_mutating > 0 || dryRun) return result;

            List<string> problems;
            try { problems = SaveResources(); SaveProjectSettings(problems); }
            catch (Exception ex) { problems = new List<string> { $"saving failed: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}" }; }
            foreach (var problem in problems)
                result.Diagnostics.Add(Diagnostic.Warning("not-saved", problem));
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Register the do and the undo operations of a structural scene change a call already applied; they join the
        /// running mutation's scene-history action (committed with <c>execute: false</c>; undo parts of later steps run
        /// first). Calls only run inside rql-mutate. A step registered by a setter joins only when its set stage commits.
        /// </summary>
        internal static void RecordUndo(Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? redo, Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? undo)
        {
            var step = new UndoStep(redo, undo);
            _setStages.Record(() => _sceneUndo.Add(step));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Register the do / undo operations of a structural change of <paramref name="owner"/> (a resource such as a TileSet or
        /// Theme) that a call or setter already applied. The owner's property snapshot is then not diffed into undo properties;
        /// it is still saved (file resource) or marks the scene unsaved (built-in resource).
        /// </summary>
        internal static void RecordUndoFor(GodotObject owner, Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? redo, Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? undo)
        {
            var step = new UndoStep(redo, undo);
            _setStages.Record(() =>
            {
                (IsSceneObject(owner) ? _sceneUndo : _otherUndo).Add(step);
                _explicitUndo.Add(owner);
            });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Remove an entry of <paramref name="owner"/> whose stored properties start with <paramref name="prefix"/> (a TileSet tile
        /// "x:y/", a MeshLibrary item "item/&lt;id&gt;/") and register its undo: <paramref name="recreate"/>, then every saved
        /// property, so the entry comes back with all its settings.
        /// </summary>
        internal static void RecordRemoval(GodotObject owner, string prefix, Action remove, Action<EditorUndoRedoManager> redo,
            Action<EditorUndoRedoManager> recreate)
        {
            var saved = SnapshotOf(owner).Where(kv => kv.Key.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();
            remove();
            RecordUndoFor(owner, redo, ur =>
            {
                recreate(ur);
                foreach (var kv in saved) ur.AddUndoProperty(owner, kv.Key, kv.Value);
            });
        }

        /// <summary>Mark the edited scene as having unsaved changes.</summary>
        internal static void MarkSceneUnsaved()
        {
            if (EditedRoot() != null) EditorInterface.Singleton.MarkSceneAsUnsaved();
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ engine hooks

        private static void BeforeWrite(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records)
        {
            _setStages.BeforeWrite(records, _mutating);
            foreach (var r in records)
                if (r.Method == null && r.Owner is Node && RotationUnits.Warning(r.Member, Components(r.New)) is { } warning)
                    Warn("radians", warning);
            foreach (var owner in MutatedObjects(records))
                if (!_snapshots.ContainsKey(owner))
                    _snapshots[owner] = StoredProperties(owner);
        }

        // Committed gets exactly the applied records (every set after all writes succeeded, the completed calls when a later
        // call threw); a set the engine rolled back never gets here.
        private static void Committed(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records)
        {
            // First the undo steps the stage's setters registered (they also mark their owners as explicitly undone).
            _setStages.Committed(records, _mutating);
            var sceneChanged = false;
            var root = EditedRoot();
            var isCall = records.Count > 0 && records[0].Method != null; // set records carry no method
            foreach (var owner in MutatedObjects(records))
            {
                var hasSnapshot = _snapshots.TryGetValue(owner, out var snapshot);
                var propertiesChanged = !hasSnapshot; // no snapshot (never in practice): assume it changed
                // A structural change registered its own undo for the entries it added or removed (setting a removed
                // entry to null does not remove it again); values that changed in place are still diffed.
                var explicitUndo = _explicitUndo.Contains(owner);
                if (explicitUndo) propertiesChanged = true;
                if (hasSnapshot)
                {
                    var after = StoredProperties(owner);
                    var changed = new List<(string name, Variant before, Variant after)>();
                    foreach (var kv in after)
                    {
                        var known = snapshot!.TryGetValue(kv.Key, out var old);
                        if (explicitUndo && !known) continue;
                        if (!known || !Same(old, kv.Value)) changed.Add((kv.Key, known ? old : default, kv.Value));
                    }
                    // A removed project setting (custom setting, input action, autoload) is restored by its undo.
                    if (!explicitUndo && Settings.RqlProject.Is(owner))
                        foreach (var kv in snapshot!)
                            if (!after.ContainsKey(kv.Key)) changed.Add((kv.Key, kv.Value, default));
                    if (changed.Count > 0)
                    {
                        propertiesChanged = true;
                        var target = owner;
                        // Undoing / redoing a project setting also writes project.godot, like the Project Settings dialog.
                        var save = Settings.RqlProject.Is(owner);
                        // An autoload change also refreshes the editor's autoload registry (scripts then resolve the singleton).
                        var autoloads = save && changed.Any(c => c.name.StartsWith(Settings.RqlProject.AutoloadPrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                            ? Settings.RqlProject.EditorAutoloads() : null;
                        _changedAutoloads ??= autoloads;
                        (IsSceneObject(owner) ? _sceneUndo : _otherUndo).Add(new UndoStep(
                            ur =>
                            {
                                foreach (var c in changed) ur.AddDoProperty(target, c.name, c.after);
                                if (save) ur.AddDoMethod(target, ProjectSettings.MethodName.Save);
                                if (autoloads != null) ur.AddDoMethod(autoloads, Settings.RqlProject.UpdateAutoloadMethod);
                            },
                            ur =>
                            {
                                foreach (var c in changed) ur.AddUndoProperty(target, c.name, c.before);
                                if (save) ur.AddUndoMethod(target, ProjectSettings.MethodName.Save);
                                if (autoloads != null) ur.AddUndoMethod(autoloads, Settings.RqlProject.UpdateAutoloadMethod);
                            }));
                    }
                }

                switch (owner)
                {
                    case Node node when root != null && (node == root || root.IsAncestorOf(node)):
                        sceneChanged = true;
                        // A node inside an instance (a property override, a call such as AddChild on it) is saved only
                        // when the instance has Editable Children (a no-op for the scene's own nodes). A set that changed no
                        // stored property leaves the instance closed.
                        if (propertiesChanged || isCall) EnsureEditable(node, root);
                        break;
                    case Resource resource when IsFileResource(resource):
                        // Saved only when a Godot property actually changed: writing the same value again does not
                        // rewrite the file (the replaced resource-modify's "no modifications, not re-saved" rule).
                        if (propertiesChanged && _toSaveSet.Add(resource)) _toSave.Add(resource);
                        break;
                    case Resource resource when propertiesChanged:
                        // A sub-resource built into a resource file (a TileSet's atlas source, a mesh's material): saved
                        // with that file. One built into a scene marks the scene unsaved.
                        if (ContainerFile(resource) is { } container) { if (_toSaveSet.Add(container)) _toSave.Add(container); }
                        else sceneChanged = true;
                        break;
                    case GodotObject settings when propertiesChanged && Settings.RqlProject.Is(settings):
                        _settingsChanged = true;
                        break;
                }
            }
            if (sceneChanged) MarkSceneUnsaved();
        }

        // The numbers of a written rotation: a Vector3 / Vector2 or one angle.
        private static double[] Components(object? value) => value switch
        {
            Vector3 v => new double[] { v.X, v.Y, v.Z },
            Vector2 v => new double[] { v.X, v.Y },
            float f => new double[] { f },
            double d => new[] { d },
            _ => Array.Empty<double>(),
        };

        // The Godot object whose snapshot covers each change (see RqlMutationOwner.Nearest).
        private static List<GodotObject> MutatedObjects(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records)
        {
            var owners = new List<GodotObject>();
            var seen = new HashSet<GodotObject>();
            foreach (var r in records)
                if (RqlMutationOwner.Nearest<GodotObject>(r.Owners, ClassifyOwner) is { } owner && seen.Add(owner)) owners.Add(owner);
            return owners;
        }

        private static (GodotObject?, RqlOwnerKind) ClassifyOwner(object candidate)
        {
            var (o, view) = candidate is Settings.IRqlViewOf v ? (v.Owner, true) : (candidate as GodotObject, false);
            if (o == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o)) return (null, RqlOwnerKind.None);
            if (view) return (o, RqlOwnerKind.View);
            return (o, o is Node || o is Resource || Settings.RqlProject.Is(o) ? RqlOwnerKind.Stored : RqlOwnerKind.Plain);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The values of every stored Godot property (storage usage) of <paramref name="o"/>, by name, plus a node's
        /// <c>name</c> (its property has no storage usage: the .tscn writes it in the node header), so a rename is undoable.
        /// </summary>
        internal static Dictionary<string, Variant> StoredProperties(GodotObject o)
        {
            var values = new Dictionary<string, Variant>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            // Project settings at their default value have no storage usage: snapshot every listed setting.
            foreach (var name in GodotVariants.PropertyNames(o, storageOnly: !Settings.RqlProject.Is(o)))
                values[name] = o.Get(name);
            if (o is Node node) values["name"] = node.Name;
            return values;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether two property values are equal. Variant has no value equality: objects compare by identity, packed arrays
        /// element-wise, Godot arrays / dictionaries recursively, scalars and structs by value — no text conversion of
        /// large values; only the remaining kinds (Callable, Signal …) fall back to the text Godot writes to .tscn / .tres.
        /// </summary>
        internal static bool Same(Variant a, Variant b)
        {
            if (a.VariantType != b.VariantType) return false;
            switch (a.VariantType)
            {
                case Variant.Type.Nil: return true;
                case Variant.Type.Object: return ReferenceEquals(a.AsGodotObject(), b.AsGodotObject());
                case Variant.Type.Array: return a.AsGodotArray().RecursiveEqual(b.AsGodotArray());
                case Variant.Type.Dictionary: return a.AsGodotDictionary().RecursiveEqual(b.AsGodotDictionary());
                case Variant.Type.StringName:
                case Variant.Type.NodePath:
                    return a.Obj?.ToString() == b.Obj?.ToString();
                case Variant.Type.Callable:
                case Variant.Type.Signal:
                case Variant.Type.Rid:
                    return GD.VarToStr(a) == GD.VarToStr(b);
            }
            var x = a.Obj;
            var y = b.Obj;
            return x is System.Array xa && y is System.Array ya
                ? System.Collections.StructuralComparisons.StructuralEqualityComparer.Equals(xa, ya)
                : Equals(x, y);
        }

        // A node, or a resource built into the scene (not a file resource, nor a sub-resource of one).
        private static bool IsSceneObject(GodotObject o) => o is Node || (o is Resource r && !IsFileResource(r) && ContainerFile(r) == null);

        /// <summary>A node of the scene being edited (the root or one of its descendants).</summary>
        internal static bool IsInEditedScene(Node node)
        {
            var root = EditedRoot();
            return root != null && (node == root || root.IsAncestorOf(node));
        }

        /// <summary>A resource stored in its own file (not built into a scene or another resource).</summary>
        internal static bool IsFileResource(Resource resource)
        {
            var path = resource.ResourcePath;
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) && path.StartsWith("res://", StringComparison.Ordinal) && path.IndexOf("::", StringComparison.Ordinal) < 0;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ undo + save

        /// <summary>
        /// The editor's undo manager. Godot 4.3's C# API exposes it only on the EditorPlugin (EditorPlugin.GetUndoRedo), so
        /// the plugin assigns it at install (RqlInstaller); null = changes are applied without undo entries.
        /// </summary>
        internal static Func<EditorUndoRedoManager?>? UndoRedo { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The global undo history, or the edited scene's (null without an undo manager, or without a scene for the scene
        /// history): what an rql-mutate commits to, Undo / Redo step and the test hooks drive.
        /// </summary>
        internal static global::Godot.UndoRedo? UndoHistory(bool global)
        {
            var manager = UndoRedo?.Invoke();
            if (manager == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(manager)) return null;
            if (global) return manager.GetHistoryUndoRedo(0); // EditorUndoRedoManager.SpecialHistory.Global
            return EditedRoot() is { } root ? manager.GetHistoryUndoRedo(manager.GetObjectHistoryId(root)) : null;
        }

        // The undo action is named after the mutation's query ("RQL: nodes | … | set …").
        private static void CommitUndo(string query)
        {
            var undo = UndoRedo?.Invoke();
            if (undo == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(undo))
            {
                _sceneUndo.Clear();
                _otherUndo.Clear();
                // No undo history keeps the removed nodes alive: free them instead of leaking them as orphans.
                foreach (var node in _removed)
                    if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(node) && !node.IsInsideTree()) node.Free();
            }
            else
            {
                var name = HistoryStepText.ActionName(query);
                AddResaveSteps(_otherUndo, _toSave);
                // Split over the two histories: the parts are named so editor | call Undo() / Redo() step both.
                var split = _sceneUndo.Count > 0 && _otherUndo.Count > 0;
                Commit(undo, _sceneUndo, EditedRoot(), split ? name + HistoryStepText.ScenePart : name);
                Commit(undo, _otherUndo, GlobalHistoryContext, split ? name + HistoryStepText.GlobalPart : name);
            }
            _removed.Clear();
            _snapshots.Clear();
        }

        // The context that files an action under the global history, whatever objects its steps touch (Godot would file
        // one on a path-less resource, such as a TileSet source created in this session, under the edited scene): any
        // object that is neither a node nor a resource does; the ProjectSettings singleton is always there.
        private static GodotObject GlobalHistoryContext => Settings.RqlProject.Instance;

        /// <summary>
        /// The mutation saves the resource files it changed, so undo and redo save them again: the file never keeps a value
        /// the editor has undone. The saves are registered last on both sides (after every property of the action).
        /// </summary>
        private static void AddResaveSteps(List<UndoStep> steps, List<Resource> changedFiles)
        {
            var files = changedFiles.Where(r => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r) && IsFileResource(r)).ToList();
            if (steps.Count == 0 || files.Count == 0) return;
            var saver = global::Godot.Engine.GetSingleton("ResourceSaver");
            // An empty path saves to the resource's path at undo / redo time: a file moved since goes to its new place, and a
            // deleted one (its path cleared) is not written back.
            void Save(Action<GodotObject, StringName, Variant[]> add)
            {
                foreach (var r in files) add(saver, "save", new Variant[] { r, "" });
            }
            steps.Insert(0, new UndoStep(null, ur => Save(ur.AddUndoMethod)));
            steps.Add(new UndoStep(ur => Save(ur.AddDoMethod), null));
        }

        private static void Commit(EditorUndoRedoManager undo, List<UndoStep> steps, GodotObject? context, string name)
        {
            if (steps.Count == 0) return;
            try
            {
                undo.CreateAction(name, global::Godot.UndoRedo.MergeMode.Disable, context);
                // Every step joins the context's history: a built-in or path-less resource would otherwise be guessed into
                // another one ("UndoRedo history mismatch").
                undo.ForceFixedHistory();
                // Undo operations run in the order they are registered: the do parts go in the order the changes
                // happened, the undo parts in reverse, so the last change is undone first.
                foreach (var step in steps) Register(undo, step.Redo);
                for (int i = steps.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) Register(undo, steps[i].Undo);
                undo.CommitAction(execute: false);
            }
            finally { steps.Clear(); }
        }

        private static void Register(EditorUndoRedoManager undo, Action<EditorUndoRedoManager>? operations)
        {
            if (operations == null) return;
            try { operations(undo); }
            catch (Exception ex) { GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] RQL undo step skipped: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        /// <summary>Save every file resource the mutation changed; returns what could not be saved.</summary>
        private static List<string> SaveResources()
        {
            var problems = new List<string>();
            foreach (var resource in _toSave)
                if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(resource) && IsFileResource(resource) && SaveFile(resource) is { } problem)
                    problems.Add(problem);
            _toSave.Clear();
            return problems;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The resource file a built-in sub-resource is stored in (path "res://tiles.tres::TileSetAtlasSource_x"), when that
        /// file is a resource and not a scene (a scene's sub-resources are saved with the scene); null otherwise.
        /// </summary>
        private static Resource? ContainerFile(Resource resource, int depth = 0)
        {
            if (depth < 8 && _containers.TryGetValue(resource, out var id) && GodotObject.InstanceFromId(id.Value) is Resource container)
                return IsFileResource(container) ? container : ContainerFile(container, depth + 1);
            var path = resource.ResourcePath ?? "";
            var cut = path.IndexOf("::", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (cut <= 0 || !ResPathNormalizer.IsResPath(path)) return null;
            var file = path.Substring(0, cut);
            if (ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(file)) return null;
            // The loaded (cached) container: the one the sub-resource belongs to.
            return ResourceLoader.HasCached(file) ? ResourceLoader.Load(file) : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Save project.godot after a mutation that changed a project setting.</summary>
        private static void SaveProjectSettings(List<string> problems)
        {
            if (!_settingsChanged) return;
            _settingsChanged = false;
            var error = ProjectSettings.Save();
            if (error != Error.Ok) problems.Add($"project.godot could not be saved: {error}");
            if (_changedAutoloads != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_changedAutoloads))
                _changedAutoloads.Call(Settings.RqlProject.UpdateAutoloadMethod);
            _changedAutoloads = null;
        }

        /// <summary>Write a file resource to its res:// file and refresh the editor filesystem; the problem, or null when saved.</summary>
        internal static string? SaveFile(Resource resource)
        {
            var path = resource.ResourcePath;
            var error = ResourceSaver.Save(resource, path);
            if (error != Error.Ok) return $"resource '{path}' could not be saved: {error}";
            RqlReimport.Register(path);
            return null;
        }

        /// <summary>The uid:// text of the file at <paramref name="path"/>, or null when it has none.</summary>
        internal static string? UidOf(string path)
        {
            var id = ResourceLoader.GetResourceUid(path);
            return id == ResourceUid.InvalidId ? null : ResourceUid.IdToText(id);
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodot.Signals.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Signal connections and groups of the edited scene's nodes — what the editor's Node dock (Signals / Groups tabs)
    /// edits. Connections are persistent (<see cref="GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Persist"/>, saved in the .tscn as
    /// <c>[connection …]</c>) and groups are persistent groups (saved as <c>groups=[…]</c> in the node header). Both are not
    /// Godot properties, so each change registers its own do/undo methods and marks the scene unsaved.
    /// </summary>
    public static partial class RqlGodot
    {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------ signals

        /// <summary>The signals <paramref name="o"/> can emit (its class's and its script's), by name.</summary>
        public static List<RqlSignal> SignalsOf(GodotObject o) =>
            o.GetSignalList().Select(s => new RqlSignal(o, s)).OrderBy(s => s.name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();

        /// <summary>The persistent connections from the signals of <paramref name="node"/> (what the Node dock lists and the scene saves).</summary>
        public static List<RqlConnection> ConnectionsOf(Node node)
        {
            var list = new List<RqlConnection>();
            foreach (var signal in node.GetSignalList())
            {
                var name = signal["name"].AsStringName();
                foreach (var c in node.GetSignalConnectionList(name))
                {
                    var flags = c["flags"].AsInt64();
                    if ((flags & (long)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Persist) == 0) continue;
                    list.Add(new RqlConnection(node, name.ToString(), c["callable"].AsCallable(), flags));
                }
            }
            return list;
        }

        /// <summary>The persistent connections whose method is on <paramref name="node"/>.</summary>
        public static List<RqlConnection> IncomingConnectionsOf(Node node)
        {
            var list = new List<RqlConnection>();
            foreach (var c in node.GetIncomingConnections())
            {
                var flags = c["flags"].AsInt64();
                if ((flags & (long)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Persist) == 0) continue;
                var signal = c["signal"].AsSignal();
                if (signal.Owner is Node source)
                    list.Add(new RqlConnection(source, signal.Name.ToString(), c["callable"].AsCallable(), flags));
            }
            return list;
        }

        /// <summary>Connect a signal of <paramref name="source"/> to a method of <paramref name="target"/> (persistent, undoable).</summary>
        public static RqlConnection Connect(Node source, string signal, Node target, string method, bool deferred, bool oneShot)
        {
            var callable = CheckConnect(source, signal, target, method);
            var flags = (uint)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Persist
                        | (deferred ? (uint)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Deferred : 0)
                        | (oneShot ? (uint)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.OneShot : 0);
            var error = source.Connect(signal, callable, flags);
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"connecting '{source.Name}'.{signal} failed: {error}");
            RecordUndo(
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(source, GodotObject.MethodName.Connect, signal, callable, flags),
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(source, GodotObject.MethodName.Disconnect, signal, callable));
            MarkSceneUnsaved();
            return new RqlConnection(source, signal, callable, flags);
        }

        /// <summary>Connect's call validator: every target is checked before the first connection is made (all-or-nothing).</summary>
        public static string? ValidateConnect(Node source, string signal, Node? target, string method) =>
            target == null ? "Connect needs the target node, e.g. godot.find(\"Player\")" : Rejection(() => CheckConnect(source, signal, target, method));

        // The connection Connect would make, after every check (it changes nothing).
        private static Callable CheckConnect(Node source, string signal, Node target, string method)
        {
            RequireEditedRoot();
            RequireInEditedScene(source, "source");
            RequireInEditedScene(target, "target");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(signal)) throw new ArgumentException("a signal name is required, e.g. \"pressed\"");
            if (!source.HasSignal(signal))
                throw new ArgumentException($"{source.GetClass()} '{source.Name}' has no signal '{signal}'" + Similar(SignalsOf(source).Select(s => s.name), signal));
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(method)) throw new ArgumentException("a method name is required, e.g. \"_on_button_pressed\"");
            if (!HasCallableMethod(target, method))
                throw new ArgumentException($"{target.GetClass()} '{target.Name}' has no method '{method}': add it to the target's script first " +
                                            "(script-update), then connect");
            var callable = new Callable(target, method);
            if (source.IsConnected(signal, callable))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{source.Name}'.{signal} is already connected to '{target.Name}'.{method}");
            return callable;
        }

        /// <summary>Disconnect a connection made with <see cref="Connect"/> (or in the editor), undoably.</summary>
        public static void Disconnect(Node source, string signal, GodotObject target, string method)
        {
            RequireEditedRoot();
            RequireInEditedScene(source, "source");
            var callable = new Callable(target, method);
            var existing = source.HasSignal(signal) && source.IsConnected(signal, callable)
                ? source.GetSignalConnectionList(signal).FirstOrDefault(c => c["callable"].AsCallable().Equals(callable))
                : null;
            if (existing == null || (existing["flags"].AsInt64() & (long)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Persist) == 0)
            {
                var targetName = target is Node n ? n.Name.ToString() : target.GetClass();
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{source.Name}'.{signal} is not connected to '{targetName}'.{method}");
            }
            var flags = (uint)existing["flags"].AsInt64();
            source.Disconnect(signal, callable);
            RecordUndo(
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(source, GodotObject.MethodName.Disconnect, signal, callable),
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(source, GodotObject.MethodName.Connect, signal, callable, flags));
            MarkSceneUnsaved();
        }

        // A method the target (or its script, also a non-tool one whose instance is a placeholder) defines.
        internal static bool HasCallableMethod(GodotObject target, string method)
        {
            if (target.HasMethod(method)) return true;
            if (target.GetScript().As<Script>() is { } script)
                for (var s = script; s != null; s = s.GetBaseScript())
                    if (s.GetScriptMethodList().Any(m => m["name"].AsString() == method)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>" (similar: a, b)" for the names close to <paramref name="key"/> (containing it, or a typo away), or "".</summary>
        internal static string Similar(IEnumerable<string> names, string key)
        {
            var similar = names.Where(n => IsSimilar(n, key)).Take(5).ToList();
            return similar.Count > 0 ? $" (similar: {string.Join(", ", similar)})" : "";
        }

        /// <summary>A name that contains or is contained in <paramref name="key"/>, or is at most two edits from it (case-insensitive).</summary>
        internal static bool IsSimilar(string name, string key) =>
            name.Contains(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || key.Contains(name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || EditDistance(name.ToLowerInvariant(), key.ToLowerInvariant()) <= 2;

        private static int EditDistance(string a, string b)
        {
            if (Math.Abs(a.Length - b.Length) > 2) return 3;
            var row = Enumerable.Range(0, b.Length + 1).ToArray();
            for (int i = 1; i <= a.Length; i++)
            {
                var diagonal = row[0];
                row[0] = i;
                for (int j = 1; j <= b.Length; j++)
                {
                    var above = row[j];
                    row[j] = Math.Min(Math.Min(row[j] + 1, row[j - 1] + 1), diagonal + (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1));
                    diagonal = above;
                }
            }
            return row[b.Length];
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ groups

        /// <summary>
        /// The persistent groups of <paramref name="node"/> (what the scene saves and the Groups dock shows; internal "_…"
        /// groups excluded), sorted. A group a script joined at edit time without <c>persistent</c> is not listed.
        /// </summary>
        public static List<string> GroupsOf(Node node)
        {
            var groups = VisibleGroups(node);
            if (groups.Count == 0) return groups;
            var persistent = PersistentGroups(node);
            return persistent == null ? groups : groups.Where(persistent.Contains).ToList();
        }

        private static List<string> VisibleGroups(Node node) =>
            node.GetGroups().Select(g => g.ToString()).Where(g => g.Length > 0 && !g.StartsWith("_", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .OrderBy(g => g, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();

        // A node's persistent groups cost a pack (of the whole scene for its root), so a query packs each node once:
        // RunQuery scopes this cache to one query; AddToGroup / RemoveFromGroup update it (no re-pack), the undo test hooks
        // invalidate it.
        private static Dictionary<ulong, HashSet<string>?>? _persistentGroups;

        /// <summary>Run <paramref name="run"/> (one RQL query) with the persistent-groups cache; nested queries share it.</summary>
        internal static T RunQuery<T>(Func<T> run)
        {
            if (_persistentGroups != null) return run();
            _persistentGroups = new Dictionary<ulong, HashSet<string>?>();
            try { return run(); }
            finally { _persistentGroups = null; }
        }

        internal static void InvalidateGroups(Node? node = null)
        {
            if (node == null) _persistentGroups?.Clear();
            else _persistentGroups?.Remove(node.GetInstanceId());
        }

        // A persistent membership of node changed: keep its cached set (when packed) in step instead of re-packing it.
        private static void UpdatePersistentGroup(Node node, string group, bool persistent)
        {
            if (_persistentGroups == null || !_persistentGroups.TryGetValue(node.GetInstanceId(), out var set) || set == null) return;
            if (persistent) set.Add(group);
            else set.Remove(group);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The groups of <paramref name="node"/> a saved scene keeps, or null when that cannot be told (all count as
        /// persistent). Godot's API has no per-group persistent flag, but packing keeps exactly the persistent ones: the node
        /// packed on its own (a scene of the node and the descendants it owns — only itself, unless it is the scene root)
        /// lists them as its scene state's groups. The root of an inherited scene packs only the groups it adds; the base
        /// scenes' groups (persistent there) are read from the base scene states.
        /// </summary>
        private static HashSet<string>? PersistentGroups(Node node)
        {
            var id = node.GetInstanceId();
            if (_persistentGroups != null && _persistentGroups.TryGetValue(id, out var cached)) return cached;
            using var scene = new PackedScene();
            var state = scene.Pack(node) == Error.Ok ? scene.GetState() : null;
            HashSet<string>? groups = null;
            if (state != null && state.GetNodeCount() > 0)
            {
                groups = new HashSet<string>(state.GetNodeGroups(0), StringComparer.Ordinal);
                // An inherited root's node 0 instance is its base scene (null for any other packed node).
                for (int depth = 0; depth < 32 && state.GetNodeInstance(0) is { } baseScene && baseScene.GetState() is { } baseState
                         && baseState.GetNodeCount() > 0; depth++)
                {
                    state = baseState;
                    groups.UnionWith(state.GetNodeGroups(0));
                }
            }
            if (_persistentGroups != null) _persistentGroups[id] = groups;
            return groups;
        }

        private static bool IsPersistentGroup(Node node, string group) =>
            node.IsInGroup(group) && (PersistentGroups(node)?.Contains(group) ?? true);

        /// <summary>The nodes of the edited scene in the persistent group <paramref name="group"/>, depth-first.</summary>
        public static List<Node> NodesInGroup(string group) => AllNodes().Where(n => IsPersistentGroup(n, group)).ToList();

        /// <summary><c>godot.group("enemies")</c>: the nodes of the edited scene in a group.</summary>
        public static object? FindGroup(object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length != 1 || !(args[0] is string name) || name.Length == 0)
                return new RqlError("type-mismatch", "godot.group(name) expects a group name such as \"enemies\"");
            return NodesInGroup(name);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Add <paramref name="node"/> to a persistent group (saved with the scene); false when it already was in it. A node
        /// in the group only at edit time (joined without <c>persistent</c>) is made a persistent member.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool AddToGroup(Node node, string group)
        {
            RequireInEditedScene(node, "node");
            Settings.RqlProject.RequireGroupName(group);
            var member = node.IsInGroup(group);
            if (member && IsPersistentGroup(node, group)) return false;
            // Godot keeps the flag of the first AddToGroup: a non-persistent membership has to be replaced.
            if (member) node.RemoveFromGroup(group);
            node.AddToGroup(group, persistent: true);
            UpdatePersistentGroup(node, group, persistent: true);
            RecordUndo(
                ur =>
                {
                    if (member) ur.AddDoMethod(node, Node.MethodName.RemoveFromGroup, group);
                    ur.AddDoMethod(node, Node.MethodName.AddToGroup, group, true);
                },
                ur =>
                {
                    ur.AddUndoMethod(node, Node.MethodName.RemoveFromGroup, group);
                    if (member) ur.AddUndoMethod(node, Node.MethodName.AddToGroup, group, false);
                });
            MarkSceneUnsaved();
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Remove <paramref name="node"/> from a group; false when it was not in it.</summary>
        public static bool RemoveFromGroup(Node node, string group)
        {
            RequireInEditedScene(node, "node");
            if (!node.IsInGroup(group)) return false;
            var persistent = IsPersistentGroup(node, group);
            node.RemoveFromGroup(group);
            UpdatePersistentGroup(node, group, persistent: false);
            RecordUndo(
                ur => ur.AddDoMethod(node, Node.MethodName.RemoveFromGroup, group),
                ur => ur.AddUndoMethod(node, Node.MethodName.AddToGroup, group, persistent));
            MarkSceneUnsaved();
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Make the persistent groups of <paramref name="node"/> exactly <paramref name="groups"/> (internal groups and the
        /// unlisted edit-time ones are kept; a listed edit-time group becomes persistent).
        /// </summary>
        public static void SetGroups(Node node, IEnumerable<string> groups)
        {
            var wanted = groups.Select(g => g.Trim()).Where(g => g.Length > 0).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();
            foreach (var g in wanted) Settings.RqlProject.RequireGroupName(g);
            foreach (var g in GroupsOf(node).Where(g => !wanted.Contains(g))) RemoveFromGroup(node, g);
            foreach (var g in wanted) AddToGroup(node, g);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A signal an object can emit.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlSignal
    {
        private readonly GodotObject _owner;

        internal RqlSignal(GodotObject owner, global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary info)
        {
            _owner = owner;
            name = info["name"].AsString();
            args = info["args"].AsGodotArray().Select(a => a.AsGodotDictionary()).Select(Arg).ToList();
        }

        [RqlDescription("signal name, e.g. \"pressed\"")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("the arguments it is emitted with, as \"name: Type\"")]
        public List<string> args { get; }

        [RqlDescription("number of persistent connections from it (the ones saved with the scene)")]
        public int connections => _owner.GetSignalConnectionList(name).Count(c => (c["flags"].AsInt64() & (long)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Persist) != 0);

        private static string Arg(global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary a)
        {
            var type = (Variant.Type)a["type"].AsInt64();
            var cls = a.TryGetValue("class_name", out var c) ? c.AsString() : "";
            var typeName = cls.Length > 0 ? cls : type == Variant.Type.Nil ? "Variant" : type.ToString();
            return $"{a["name"].AsString()}: {typeName}";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A persistent signal connection (signal → target method), as the Node dock shows it.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlConnection
    {
        private readonly Callable _callable;

        internal RqlConnection(Node source, string signal, Callable callable, long flags)
        {
            this.source = source;
            this.signal = signal;
            _callable = callable;
            this.flags = flags;
        }

        [RqlDescription("node whose signal it is")]
        public Node source { get; }

        [RqlDescription("signal name")]
        public string signal { get; }

        [RqlDescription("object whose method is called (usually a node of the scene)")]
        public GodotObject? target => _callable.Target;

        [RqlDescription("method called on the target; empty for a custom callable (e.g. one with bound arguments)")]
        public string method => _callable.Method?.ToString() ?? "";

        [RqlDescription("connect flags (Godot's ConnectFlags: 1 deferred, 2 persistent, 4 one-shot, 8 reference-counted)")]
        public long flags { get; }

        [RqlDescription("the method runs at the end of the frame")]
        public bool deferred => (flags & (long)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.Deferred) != 0;

        [RqlDescription("the connection is removed after the first emission")]
        public bool oneShot => (flags & (long)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.OneShot) != 0;

        [RqlCallable("remove this connection (undoable)")]
        public void Disconnect()
        {
            if (target == null || method.Length == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("this connection has no target method to disconnect");
            RqlGodot.Disconnect(source, signal, target, method);
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodot.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.ToolFormat;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reflection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The RQL engine over the live Godot editor — the Godot counterpart of Unity-MCP's <c>RqlUnity</c>: engine factory,
    /// stable references (<c>Node3D#&lt;instance id&gt;</c>), sources and functions, and the editor integration for writes
    /// (one <see cref="EditorUndoRedoManager"/> action per mutation, the scene marked unsaved, edited resource files saved;
    /// see <c>RqlGodot.Save.cs</c>). Sources, functions and adapters come from modules: <see cref="Modules.GodotCoreModule"/>,
    /// <see cref="Modules.ToolTypesModule"/> and any <see cref="IRqlModule"/> in a loaded assembly (an extension's module in
    /// the consumer project assembly is found the same way). One engine per editor session: <see cref="Reset"/> drops it on
    /// plugin teardown / assembly reload. Every call must run on the main thread.
    /// </summary>
    public static partial class RqlGodot
    {
        /// <summary>Most resources <c>godot.resources(...)</c> loads per call (loading resources is expensive).</summary>
        public const int MaxResources = 200;

        /// <summary>Most entries the <c>files</c> source returns.</summary>
        public const int MaxFiles = 20000;

        private static RqlEngine? _engine;

        public static RqlEngine Engine => _engine ??= Create();

        /// <summary>
        /// Drop the engine and everything cached from it (tool signatures, mutation state). Returns whether an engine had
        /// been created since the last reset — only then can RQL's process-wide caches hold types of this collectible
        /// assembly (see <see cref="RqlStaticCaches"/>). Called on plugin teardown.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool Reset()
        {
            var used = _engine != null;
            _engine = null;
            RqlToolBinding.Instance.Reset();
            ResetState();
            return used;
        }

        public static RqlEngine Create()
        {
            // rql-query / rql-mutate take no budgets argument, so hints never advise raising budgets.*; hints name the finder
            // (ref("Name")), the schema tool and the mutation tool. $type, $ref, schemas and hints show Godot's class names
            // (GPUParticles3D, not the C# GpuParticles3D; `is` accepts both). Enum aliases and known members: RqlGodot.Names.cs;
            // target limit: RqlTargetLimit.
            var engine = new RqlEngine(AccessorMode.Compiled)
            {
                RuntimeName = "godot",
                FindHint = "godot.find(\"…\")",
                SchemaHint = Tool_Rql.SchemaToolId,
                MutateHint = Tool_Rql.MutateToolId,
                EnumAliases = EnumAliases,
                TypeDisplayName = RqlHostNames.GodotClassName,
            };
            engine.Defaults.BudgetsAdjustable = false;
            RqlTargetLimit.Configure(engine.Mutations);
            var knownMembers = new Lazy<HashSet<string>>(() => KnownMemberNames(engine), System.Threading.LazyThreadSafetyMode.PublicationOnly);
            engine.IsKnownMember = name => knownMembers.Value.Contains(name);
            engine.ResolveStableRef = ResolveStableRef;

            engine.Mutations.Enabled = true;
            // Rules that span the targets of one set / call stage, checked before anything runs (dry runs too).
            engine.Mutations.ValidateBatch = ValidateBatch;
            // One undo action per mutation: BeforeWrite snapshots the Godot properties of every object about to change,
            // Committed turns the differences into do/undo properties (structural calls such as AddChild / Free register
            // their own do/undo methods); Mutate commits the action once the query finished (RqlGodot.Save.cs).
            engine.Mutations.BeforeWrite = BeforeWrite;
            engine.Mutations.Committed = Committed;

            // Every module in the loaded assemblies (an extension's module compiled into the consumer project assembly
            // included); RQL reports a module or assembly that fails to load instead of skipping it silently.
            var reports = engine.AddModulesFrom(GodotAssemblyUtils.AllAssemblies,
                assembly => GodotAssemblyUtils.IsSkippedForDiscovery(assembly, typeof(RqlGodot).Assembly));
            foreach (var failed in reports.Where(r => !r.Ok))
                GodotMcpLog.Warning($"[Godot-MCP] RQL module skipped: {failed}");
            return engine;
        }

        /// <summary><c>Type#id</c> where id is the Godot instance id; the engine checks the type.</summary>
        internal static object? ResolveStableRef(string type, string id)
        {
            if (!ulong.TryParse(id, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var instanceId)) return null;
            if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceIdValid(instanceId)) return null;
            return GodotObject.InstanceFromId(instanceId);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ sources

        /// <summary>The root of the scene being edited, or null when no scene is open.</summary>
        public static Node? EditedRoot() => EditorInterface.Singleton.GetEditedSceneRoot();

        /// <summary>The edited scene root as a one-item list (empty when no scene is open).</summary>
        public static List<Node> Roots() => EditedRoot() is { } root ? new List<Node> { root } : new List<Node>();

        /// <summary>Every node of the edited scene, depth-first, root first, internal children excluded.</summary>
        public static List<Node> AllNodes()
        {
            var all = new List<Node>();
            if (EditedRoot() is { } root) Collect(root, all);
            return all;
        }

        private static void Collect(Node node, List<Node> sink)
        {
            sink.Add(node);
            var count = node.GetChildCount(includeInternal: false);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                if (node.GetChild(i, includeInternal: false) is { } child) Collect(child, sink);
        }

        /// <summary>The nodes selected in the editor.</summary>
        public static List<Node> SelectedNodes() =>
            EditorInterface.Singleton.GetSelection().GetSelectedNodes().Where(n => n != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(n)).ToList();

        /// <summary>The path of <paramref name="node"/> below the edited scene root ("." for the root itself).</summary>
        public static string PathOf(Node node)
        {
            var root = EditedRoot();
            if (root == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(root)) return node.GetPath().ToString();
            if (node == root) return ".";
            return root.IsAncestorOf(node) ? root.GetPathTo(node).ToString() : node.GetPath().ToString();
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ functions

        /// <summary>
        /// <c>godot.find("Player")</c> / <c>godot.find("Level/Player")</c>: the node of the edited scene at that path (below
        /// the root, the root's own name allowed as a prefix) or with that unique name; an error when there is none or several.
        /// </summary>
        public static object? FindNode(object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length != 1 || !(args[0] is string key) || key.Length == 0)
                return new RqlError("type-mismatch", "godot.find(name) expects a node name or a path below the scene root such as \"Level/Player\"");
            return TryFindNode(key, out var node, out var error) ? node : new RqlError(error!.Value.code, error.Value.message);
        }

        /// <summary>The node <paramref name="key"/> names (path below the edited root, or unique name).</summary>
        internal static bool TryFindNode(string key, out Node? node, out (string code, string message)? error)
        {
            node = null;
            error = null;
            var root = EditedRoot();
            if (root == null)
            {
                error = ("not-found", "no scene is being edited; open one with editor | call OpenScene(\"res://…\")");
                return false;
            }
            if (Tool_Node.FindByPath(root, key) is { } byPath) { node = byPath; return true; }
            if (key.IndexOf('/') < 0)
            {
                // A unique name anywhere in the scene: stop at the second match.
                Node? first = null, second = null;
                FindNamed(root, key, ref first, ref second);
                if (first != null && second == null) { node = first; return true; }
                if (second != null)
                {
                    error = ("ambiguous", $"several nodes are named '{key}': use the path below the scene root, e.g. \"{PathOf(first!)}\" or \"{PathOf(second)}\", or a ref");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            // Suggest nodes whose name is close to the last path segment (a typo, a missing parent folder).
            var leaf = key.Substring(key.LastIndexOf('/') + 1);
            var near = leaf.Length < 3 ? new List<string>() // a one- or two-letter name is "similar" to every short name
                : AllNodes().Where(n => n != root && IsSimilar(n.Name.ToString(), leaf)).Select(PathOf).Take(5).ToList();
            error = ("not-found", $"no node at '{key}' in the edited scene '{root.Name}'" + (near.Count > 0 ? $" (similar: {string.Join(", ", near)})" : ""));
            return false;
        }

        private static void FindNamed(Node node, string name, ref Node? first, ref Node? second)
        {
            if (node.Name.ToString() == name)
            {
                if (first == null) first = node;
                else { second = node; return; }
            }
            var count = node.GetChildCount(includeInternal: false);
            for (int i = 0; i < count && second == null; i++)
                if (node.GetChild(i, includeInternal: false) is { } child) FindNamed(child, name, ref first, ref second);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// <c>godot.resources("Texture2D", "res://art")</c>: resources whose type is (or derives from) the given Godot class,
        /// below an optional folder (at most <see cref="MaxResources"/>, loaded as needed). An empty type matches every file
        /// the editor recognises as a resource.
        /// </summary>
        public static object? FindResources(object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length < 1 || args.Length > 2 || !(args[0] is string type) || (args.Length == 2 && !(args[1] is string)))
                return new RqlError("type-mismatch", "godot.resources(type, folder?) expects a Godot class such as \"StandardMaterial3D\" and an optional res:// folder");
            var folder = args.Length == 2 ? (string)args[1]! : null;
            // Matched case-insensitively, like the file types below.
            if (type.Length > 0 && !ClassDB.ClassExists(type) && !ClassDB.GetClassList().Contains(type, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !IsGlobalScriptClass(type))
                return new RqlError("unknown-type", $"no Godot class '{type}'" +
                    Similar(ClassDB.GetClassList().Where(c => ClassDB.IsParentClass(c, "Resource")), type) +
                    "; godot.resources takes a resource class such as \"Texture2D\" or \"StandardMaterial3D\"");
            var efs = EditorToolGuards.GetResourceFileSystemOrThrow();
            string scope;
            try { scope = ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir(folder); }
            catch (ArgumentException ex) { return new RqlError("type-mismatch", ex.Message); }
            var dir = efs.GetFilesystemPath(scope);
            if (dir == null) return new RqlError("not-found", $"folder '{scope}' is not in the project filesystem");
            var resources = type.Length > 0 && !ClassDB.ClassExists(type) && IsGlobalScriptClass(type)
                ? ScriptClassResources(dir, type)
                : LoadResources(ResourceFiles(dir, type));
            return resources.Take(MaxResources);
        }

        /// <summary>Whether <paramref name="name"/> is a global script class (GDScript <c>class_name</c>, C# [GlobalClass]).</summary>
        internal static bool IsGlobalScriptClass(string name) => GlobalClassPath(name) != null;

        /// <summary>The res:// script that registers the global class <paramref name="name"/>, or null.</summary>
        internal static string? GlobalClassPath(string name)
        {
            foreach (var entry in ProjectSettings.GetGlobalClassList())
                if (entry["class"].AsString() == name) return entry["path"].AsString();
            return null;
        }

        // Lazy: a query that needs only a few resources (… | first 3) loads only those.
        private static IEnumerable<Resource> LoadResources(IEnumerable<string> paths)
        {
            foreach (var path in paths)
                if (ResourceLoader.Load(path) is { } resource) yield return resource;
        }

        // Resources of a script class (GDScript class_name, C# [GlobalClass]) or a class deriving from it: the editor reports a
        // scripted resource file's native type only ("Resource"), so the files of exactly that type are loaded (not every
        // resource deriving from it) and their script chain checked.
        private static IEnumerable<Resource> ScriptClassResources(EditorFileSystemDirectory dir, string type)
        {
            string native;
            try { native = ScriptAwareClass(type, "Resource", "type", out _); }
            catch (ArgumentException) { return Enumerable.Empty<Resource>(); }
            return LoadResources(ResourceFiles(dir, native, exact: true)).Where(r => HasScriptClass(r, type));
        }

        private static bool HasScriptClass(GodotObject o, string type)
        {
            for (var script = o.GetScript().As<Script>(); script != null; script = script.GetBaseScript())
                if (script.GetGlobalName().ToString() == type) return true;
            return false;
        }

        // The files of the requested type (exact: that type only, not its subclasses): the type check runs once per distinct
        // file type (ClassDB lookups), not per file.
        private static IEnumerable<string> ResourceFiles(EditorFileSystemDirectory dir, string type, bool exact = false)
        {
            var matches = new Dictionary<string, bool>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var typeIsClass = !exact && type.Length > 0 && ClassDB.ClassExists(type);
            foreach (var (path, fileType) in WalkFiles(dir))
            {
                if (!matches.TryGetValue(fileType, out var match))
                    matches[fileType] = match = TypeMatches(fileType, type, typeIsClass);
                if (match) yield return path;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Every file below <paramref name="dir"/> with its importer-assigned type, depth-first, lazily.</summary>
        internal static IEnumerable<(string path, string type)> WalkFiles(EditorFileSystemDirectory dir)
        {
            var fileCount = dir.GetFileCount();
            for (int i = 0; i < fileCount; i++)
                yield return (dir.GetFilePath(i), dir.GetFileType(i).ToString());
            var subCount = dir.GetSubdirCount();
            for (int i = 0; i < subCount; i++)
                if (dir.GetSubdir(i) is { } sub)
                    foreach (var file in WalkFiles(sub)) yield return file;
        }

        /// <summary>A file's importer-assigned type equals or derives from <paramref name="type"/> (empty = any resource).</summary>
        private static bool TypeMatches(string fileType, string type, bool typeIsClass)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileType)) return false;
            if (type.Length == 0) return ClassDB.ClassExists(fileType) && ClassDB.IsParentClass(fileType, "Resource");
            if (string.Equals(fileType, type, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return true;
            return typeIsClass && ClassDB.ClassExists(fileType) && ClassDB.IsParentClass(fileType, type);
        }

        /// <summary><c>godot.resource("res://materials/red.tres")</c> (or a <c>uid://</c>): the resource at a path, or null.</summary>
        public static object? LoadResource(object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length != 1 || !(args[0] is string path) || path.Length == 0)
                return new RqlError("type-mismatch", "godot.resource(path) expects a res:// or uid:// path");
            return TryLoadResource(path, out var resource, out _) ? resource : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Load the resource at a res:// or uid:// path; the reason when there is none.</summary>
        internal static bool TryLoadResource(string path, out Resource? resource, out string? reason)
        {
            resource = null;
            reason = null;
            if (!path.StartsWith("res://", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !path.StartsWith("uid://", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                reason = $"'{path}' is not a res:// or uid:// path";
                return false;
            }
            resource = Tool_Resource.LoadByPath(path, out reason);
            return resource != null;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGodotSchema.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Compact schema for agents (rql-schema), the Godot counterpart of Unity-MCP's RqlUnitySchema. RQL's generic schema
    /// walks every reachable type, which for Godot means hundreds of classes; the overview lists the sources, the functions
    /// and the node classes the edited scene actually contains, and a type name shows one type's members plus its Godot
    /// properties (ClassDB) — the <c>props["…"]</c> keys, which have no C# member. Lines use the core format
    /// (AgentFormat.TypeSchema).
    /// </summary>
    public static class RqlGodotSchema
    {
        public static string Render(RqlEngine engine, string? typeName)
        {
            if (typeName != null) return RenderType(engine, typeName);

            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.Append("sources:\n");
            foreach (var s in engine.Sources.Values)
                sb.Append("  ").Append(s.Name).Append(s.Description != null ? " — " + s.Description : "").Append('\n');
            sb.Append("functions:\n");
            foreach (var f in engine.Functions.Keys.OrderBy(k => k, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                sb.Append("  ").Append(engine.FunctionDescriptions.TryGetValue(f, out var d) ? d : f + "(…)").Append('\n');

            var counts = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var node in RqlGodot.AllNodes())
            {
                var cls = node.GetClass();
                counts[cls] = counts.TryGetValue(cls, out var n) ? n + 1 : 1;
            }
            sb.Append(counts.Count == 0
                ? "edited scene: none (open one with rql-mutate editor | call OpenScene(\"res://…\"))\n"
                : "node classes in the edited scene (rql-schema \"<class>\" for members and props): ");
            if (counts.Count > 0)
                sb.Append(string.Join(", ", counts.OrderByDescending(kv => kv.Value).ThenBy(kv => kv.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    .Select(kv => kv.Key + " ×" + kv.Value))).Append('\n');
            sb.Append(AgentFormat.TypeSchema(engine, typeof(Node), markExplicitOnly: true));
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>A source name ("editor", "files") or the type of a source's items, e.g. RqlEditorApi or RqlFile.</summary>
        private static IEnumerable<Type> SourceTypes(RqlEngine engine, string name)
        {
            foreach (var s in engine.Sources.Values)
            {
                var t = SourceItemType(engine, s);
                if (t == null) continue;
                if (string.Equals(s.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(t.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    yield return t;
            }
        }

        // A source's item type: from the getter's declared return type (method-group sources such as RqlGodot.AllNodes),
        // otherwise learned by calling the getter once; cached per engine and source (a source that returned nothing is
        // asked again next time).
        private static readonly System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<RqlEngine, Dictionary<string, Type>> ItemTypes =
            new System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<RqlEngine, Dictionary<string, Type>>();

        private static Type? SourceItemType(RqlEngine engine, SourceRegistration source)
        {
            var cache = ItemTypes.GetOrCreateValue(engine);
            if (cache.TryGetValue(source.Name, out var known)) return known;
            Type? t = source.Getter.Method.ReturnType;
            if (t == typeof(object) || t == typeof(void))
            {
                try { t = source.Getter()?.GetType(); } catch { return null; }
            }
            if (t == null) return null;
            var info = engine.Types.Info(t);
            if ((info.IsList || info.IsMap) && info.ElementType != null) t = info.ElementType;
            return cache[source.Name] = t;
        }

        private static string RenderType(RqlEngine engine, string typeName)
        {
            var candidates = SourceTypes(engine, typeName).Concat(GodotTypes.Candidates(typeName)).Distinct().Take(3).ToList();
            var godotClass = ClassDbClass(typeName, candidates);
            if (candidates.Count == 0 && godotClass == null)
            {
                // Types only reachable through sources (e.g. an extension's view objects): RQL's own schema walk finds them.
                var reachable = AgentFormat.Schema(engine, typeName);
                return reachable.StartsWith("error unknown-type", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                    ? AgentFormat.UnknownTypeError(typeName, GodotTypes.ShortNames())
                    : reachable;
            }
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            foreach (var t in candidates)
            {
                if (sb.Length > 0) sb.Append('\n');
                // Node subclasses list their own members; the shared Node / GodotObject ones are summarised once.
                var shared = typeof(Node).IsAssignableFrom(t) && t != typeof(Node) ? typeof(Node)
                    : typeof(Resource).IsAssignableFrom(t) && t != typeof(Resource) ? typeof(Resource) : null;
                sb.Append(AgentFormat.TypeSchema(engine, t, inheritedFrom: shared, markExplicitOnly: true));
                if (shared != null)
                {
                    var own = new HashSet<string>(engine.Types.Info(t).Members.Select(m => m.Name), StringComparer.Ordinal);
                    var inherited = engine.Types.Info(shared).Members.Select(m => m.Name).Where(own.Contains).ToList();
                    if (inherited.Count > 0) sb.Append("\n  (+ inherited: ").Append(string.Join(", ", inherited)).Append(')');
                }
            }
            if (godotClass != null)
            {
                if (sb.Length > 0) sb.Append('\n');
                sb.Append(GodotProperties(godotClass));
            }
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>The ClassDB class a name (or its C# type) stands for, or null.</summary>
        private static string? ClassDbClass(string typeName, IReadOnlyList<Type> candidates)
        {
            if (ClassDB.ClassExists(typeName)) return typeName;
            foreach (var t in candidates)
                if (typeof(GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t) && (RqlHostNames.GodotClassName(t) ?? t.Name) is var name && ClassDB.ClassExists(name))
                    return name;
            return GodotTypes.GodotClasses().FirstOrDefault(c => string.Equals(c, typeName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        /// <summary>The class's own Godot properties (props["…"] keys) with their types, then its parent chain.</summary>
        private static string GodotProperties(string godotClass)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("props of Godot class ").Append(godotClass);
            var parent = ClassDB.GetParentClass(godotClass).ToString();
            if (parent.Length > 0) sb.Append(" (extends ").Append(parent).Append(')');
            sb.Append(" — props[\"name\"]:");
            var any = false;
            foreach (var info in ClassDB.ClassGetPropertyList(godotClass, noInheritance: true))
            {
                if (!GodotVariants.IsExposed((PropertyUsageFlags)info["usage"].AsInt64(), storageOnly: false)) continue;
                var type = (Variant.Type)info["type"].AsInt64();
                var hint = info["hint_string"].AsString();
                sb.Append("\n  ").Append(info["name"].AsString()).Append(' ').Append(TypeText(type, (PropertyHint)info["hint"].AsInt64(), hint));
                any = true;
            }
            if (!any) sb.Append(" (none of its own)");
            var chain = new List<string>();
            for (var p = parent; p.Length > 0; p = ClassDB.GetParentClass(p).ToString()) chain.Add(p);
            if (chain.Count > 0) sb.Append("\n  (+ inherited props of ").Append(string.Join(" → ", chain)).Append(": rql-schema \"<class>\")");
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private static string TypeText(Variant.Type type, PropertyHint hint, string hintString) => type switch
        {
            Variant.Type.Object when hintString.Length > 0 => hintString,
            Variant.Type.Int when hint == PropertyHint.Enum && hintString.Length > 0 => "int (" + hintString + ")",
            Variant.Type.Nil => "Variant",
            _ => type.ToString(),
        };
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
/*
```
