```cs
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Agent-facing texts of the RQL tools (rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema) and the <c>godot-rql</c> skill — the Godot
    /// adaptation of Unity-MCP's RqlGuide. The guide travels in the tool descriptions (the agent loads them before first
    /// use); the one-line blurbs are what the always-visible tool catalog shows.
    /// <para>
    /// Pure strings (no Godot API, not behind <c>#if TOOLS</c>) so the xUnit suite parses every example, and
    /// <c>Godot-Tests/rql-guide-examples.json</c> mirrors <see cref="QueryExamples"/> / <see cref="MutateExamples"/> so
    /// the live CI smoke (<c>scripts/smoke_rql.py</c>) runs each one against a real editor. The examples are written
    /// against that smoke's fixture scene and run in the listed order, so keep them executable top to bottom.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RqlGuide
    {
        public const string QueryBlurb =
            "Query the live Godot editor (scene nodes, resources, files, scenes, classes, console, project settings, input map) with RQL in ONE call: filter, " +
            "project, sort, count, walk the scene tree. Far fewer calls/tokens than reading nodes one by one.";

        public const string MutateBlurb =
            "Change the live Godot editor with RQL set/call: bulk edits in one all-or-nothing, undoable call; add, duplicate, " +
            "reparent and remove nodes; connect signals, groups; project settings, input map, autoloads, layer names; TileSets, Themes, " +
            "shader parameters, MeshLibraries; " +
            "create, move and delete resources; open and save scenes. dry_run previews.";

        public const string SchemaBlurb =
            "List RQL sources and the node classes present in the edited scene; pass a type name for its members and Godot properties.";

        public const string Language =
            "RQL: source | stage | stage ...\n" +
            "Sources: nodes (every node of the edited scene, depth-first, root included), root (the edited scene root), " +
            "selection, scenes (open scenes), files (every res:// file the editor knows; on request deps, missingDeps, usedBy (scenes / resources that load it) and " +
            "importSettings[\"option\"]), classes (Godot classes, ClassDB), " +
            "console (captured editor log entries), gameLog (what the game run from the editor printed: Sequence LogType Message " +
            "StackTrace), editor (editor state, undoHistory / redoHistory, and operations), project (project settings: " +
            "settings[\"section/key\"], name, mainScene; input map, autoload and global group calls), settings (every project " +
            "setting: name section value type changed), inputActions (name events deadzone builtIn), autoloads (name path " +
            "singleton order), groups (name nodes count global), layers (kind index name: the project's layer names). " +
            "Resources: godot.resources(\"StandardMaterial3D\") or godot.resources(\"Texture2D\", \"res://art\"), " +
            "godot.resource(\"res://materials/red.tres\"). ref(\"Node3D#1234\") resolves a $ref; godot.find(\"Player\") or " +
            "godot.find(\"Level/Player\") a node by unique name or path below the scene root; godot.group(\"enemies\") the nodes of a group; " +
            "godot.callable(\"Player\", \"_on_hit\") a Callable.\n" +
            "Stages:\n" +
            "  where <predicate>   filter (a boolean condition: where Mesh != null, where has(Mesh), where children.count() > 0)\n" +
            "  select a b.c alias=(expr)   project columns (wrap computed expressions in parentheses)\n" +
            "  sort <expr> [desc], ...   stable sort\n" +
            "  first N | skip N | count\n" +
            "  get <path>   replace each item by a member (lists are flattened)\n" +
            "  recurse children [max-depth=N] [include-self=false]   walk the scene tree (input items included by default)\n" +
            "  distinct [expr] | sum expr | min expr | max expr | avg expr\n" +
            "  group-by expr   rows key|count; group-by a, b (or kind=class) gives one column per key, then count; " +
            "group-by class | select key, count, avgY = items.avg(Position.Y)\n" +
            "Expressions: == != < <= > >= and or not + - * / %; contains, starts-with, ends-with (case-insensitive); " +
            "matches \"regex\"; x in [a, b]; x is null; x is not null; $ is Node3D (includes subclasses); has(member). " +
            "Conditional: cond ? a : b, e.g. select name kind=($ is MeshInstance3D ? \"mesh\" : \"other\"). " +
            "Text: replace(s, from, to) (case-insensitive), replace-regex(s, pattern, repl) ($1 = group 1), substring(s, start[, length]), " +
            "split(s, sep), trim(s), pad(v, width[, fill]) — also as methods: name.replace(\"Old\", \"New\"), name.substring(0, 4). " +
            "Literals: numbers, \"strings\", true/false/null, lists [a, b], objects {x: 1, y: 2}; groups == [\"enemies\"] compares a list.\n" +
            "Paths: a.b.c, list[0], map[\"key\"]; .member on a list maps over its elements. List methods: .any(pred) .all(pred) " +
            ".count([pred]) .sum(e) .min(e) .max(e) .first([pred]); inside them bare names refer to the element, falling back to the outer item.\n" +
            "Meta: $ (current item), $ref (stable id such as Node3D#1234), $type, $path, $index, $depth. Enums compare to strings; " +
            "== on strings is case-sensitive.\n" +
            "Godot: every node has name, path (below the scene root, \".\" = root), class (the Godot class, e.g. \"OmniLight3D\"), " +
            "parent, owner, children (list), childCount, index, script (res:// path), groups (list) and id; signals, connections " +
            "(persistent: signal target method flags), incoming and overrides (how a scene instance differs from its scene file: node " +
            "property value template) are read on request (select connections, get overrides). " +
            "Members are the C# properties " +
            "(Position, Rotation, Scale, Visible, Text …), matched case-insensitively, so position works too; Rotation is in radians, " +
            "RotationDegrees in degrees. Every Godot property, " +
            "including GDScript script variables (in the editor: @export ones, every one of a @tool script) and GDExtension properties, is in props[\"snake_name\"] (e.g. props[\"light_energy\"], " +
            "props[\"speed\"] on a scripted node); a Godot array lists the values it holds (get props[\"items\"] | where props[\"price\"] > 10). " +
            "Vectors / colors print as (x, y, z); write \"(1, 2, 3)\", [1, 2, 3] or " +
            "{x: 1, y: 2, z: 3}; colors also \"#ff8800\". Vector2/3/4, their integer variants (whole results only) and Color compute " +
            "component-wise (set Scale = Scale * 1.5, Position + [0, 1, 0]); Quaternion, Basis and transforms do not. A resource path \"res://…\" works wherever a resource is expected, " +
            "a node path or name wherever a node is expected. Freed nodes read as null. Input events are text: \"Key:Space\", " +
            "\"Key:Ctrl+S\", \"PhysicalKey:W\", \"Mouse:Left\", \"JoypadButton:A\", \"JoypadMotion:LeftX-\". A TileSet has sources " +
            "(id kind atlas texture tileCount), physicsLayers, terrainSets, customDataLayers; an atlas source has tiles (coords size data). " +
            "A Theme has maps keyed \"ControlType/item\": colors, constants, fonts, fontSizes, icons, styleboxes. " +
            "A ShaderMaterial has uniforms (name type default value overridden) and params[\"uniform\"] (typed by the shader; null reverts " +
            "to the default); a MeshLibrary has items (id name mesh meshTransform shapes navigationMesh preview). Layer masks by name: " +
            "layerNames[\"collision_mask\"] on any object with layer properties is a list of layer names (a number for an unnamed layer). " +
            "Callables are \"Player::_on_hit\" (target::method); RIDs are read-only \"RID(…)\"; a Projection is 16 numbers. " +
            "Navigate with paths or get; select only " +
            "projects output columns.\n" +
            "Results come back as compact rows (header line, then col|col). Long results are truncated — refine with where/first or use count. " +
            "Unknown members produce warnings with suggestions (in rql-mutate a misspelt member that leaves no target is an error); " +
            "rql-schema(type) lists a type's members and Godot properties.\n\n" +
            // The rules every RQL host shares (conditions, ?:, list equality, group items, receipts, call, bulk create, vectors,
            // missing map entries), appended rather than copied so they follow the runtime.
            global::Rql.Execution.RqlLanguageGuide.Rules;

        /// <summary>
        /// rql-query examples, one per line ("  &lt;query&gt;"); run in order by the live CI smoke against its fixture scene.
        /// Const (not built at run time) because the tool's [Description] attribute embeds them.
        /// </summary>
        public const string QueryExampleText =
            "  nodes | where name contains \"Enemy\" | select $ref name class path\n" +

            "  root | recurse children | where childCount == 0 | select path class\n" +
            "  godot.resources(\"StandardMaterial3D\") | select path props[\"albedo_color\"]\n" +
            "  files | where ext == \"tscn\" | select path\n" +
            "  scenes | select name path active\n" +
            "  classes | where parent == \"Light3D\" | select name\n" +
            "  console | where logType == \"Error\" | sort sequence desc | first 5 | select message\n" +
            "  editor | select isPlaying editedScene selection\n" +
            "  godot.group(\"enemies\") | select name path\n" +
            "  nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get incoming | select source signal method\n" +
            "  settings | where section == \"display\" and changed | select name value\n" +
            "  inputActions | where builtIn == false | select name events\n" +

        private static string[] Examples(string text) =>
            text.Split('\n').Select(l => Regex.Split(l.Trim(), @"\s{3,}")[0]).Where(l => l.Length > 0).ToArray();

        public const string MutateStages =
            "  set path = expr, ...   assign members (paths may go through structs: set Position.Y = Position.Y + 1); values see each " +
            "target: $ and $index (its position in the stream entering set / call)\n" +
            "  call Method(args)   invoke a method the tools expose\n";

        public const string MutateExamplesBlock =
            "Examples:\n" + MutateExampleText + "\n" +
            "Editor state: editor | set isPlaying = true / false runs / stops the main scene; editor | call PlayScene(\"res://…\") runs one scene; " +
            "what the game prints and its errors: rql-query gameLog. editor | call Undo() / Redo() steps the editor's undo history like Ctrl+Z " +
            "(returns the action; rql-query editor | select undoHistory lists the scene's and the global history); editor | call ReloadScene() reloads the edited scene from its file; " +
            "NewScene(path, \"res://base.tscn\") makes an inherited scene.\n";

        public const string QueryDescription =
            "Run a read-only RQL query against the live Godot editor and return compact rows. One precise query beats many " +
            "exploratory calls. Changes need rql-mutate.\n\n" + Language + "\n\nExamples:\n" + QueryExampleText;

        public const string MutateDescription =
            "Change the live Godot editor with an RQL query whose last stage is set or call. All-or-nothing: every target and " +
            "value is checked before anything is written; a failure changes nothing. Undoable in the editor (Ctrl+Z). Scene " +
            "edits mark the scene unsaved (save with editor | call SaveScene()); edited resource files (res://….tres) are saved " +
            "to disk automatically. dry_run=true returns the receipt ($ref, member, old, new) without changing anything. The receipt " +
            "leaves out assignments that found the value already set; they are counted (\"N unchanged assignment(s) not listed\"). Do " +
            "exactly the change requested; a read-only member fails with readonly-member instead of being approximated.\n" +
            MutateStages + MutateExamplesBlock +
            "Bulk create: range(start, end) or a list literal streams items, and call editor.CreateNode(class, {…}) / " +
            "editor.InstantiateScene(path, {…}) runs once per item ($ and $index are the item's); the options are name, parent (a node, " +
            "its path or ref(\"Node3D#…\"); the scene root by default) and Godot properties of the new node (position, rotation_degrees, " +
            "scale, mesh, visible …; local, not global_*). Every item is checked before the first node is made; all of them are one " +
            "undo step.\n" +
            "Object literals build values: set Position = {x: 1, y: 2, z: 3}; {$type: \"PlaneMesh\"} picks a concrete class. Map entries " +
            "streamed by get write through their map: … | get colors | where Key starts-with \"Button/\" | set Value = \"#ffffff\". " +
            "Up to 200 targets per call; for an intended bulk change of more objects pass max_targets = the match count (at most " +
            "1000): still one all-or-nothing, undoable call. Nodes inside a scene " +
            "instance take property changes (saved as overrides; the instance gets Editable Children) but are removed, renamed " +
            "or moved in their own scene.\n\n" +
            QuerySyntaxShort;

        /// <summary>
        /// rql-mutate's reminder of the query part; the full language guide is in rql-query's description (sent once per
        /// request instead of twice).
        /// </summary>
        public const string QuerySyntaxShort =
            "Query part: the RQL of rql-query (full guide and the sources in its description); godot.resources(\"Texture2D\"), " +
            "godot.resource(path), godot.find(\"Name\"), ref(\"Node3D#1234\"). Stages: where, select, sort, first N, get <path>, " +
            "recurse children. Operators: == != < > and or not, contains, starts-with, $ is Node3D, cond ? a : b; conditions are " +
            "booleans (where Mesh != null, has(Mesh)). Paths a.b.c, list[0], " +
            "props[\"key\"]. Vectors/colors as \"(1, 2, 3)\" or \"#ff8800\"; enums as strings.";

        /// <summary>rql-mutate's max_targets argument (the numbers are <see cref="RqlTargetLimit"/>'s, checked by a test).</summary>
        public const string MaxTargetsDescription =
            "Most objects the set / call stage may change (default 200, at most 1000). Raise it to the match count for an intended " +
            "bulk change of more objects: the call stays all-or-nothing and one undo step.";

        public const string SchemaDescription =
            "Without a type: RQL sources, functions, and the node classes present in the edited scene (with counts), plus the " +
            "Node members. With a type name (e.g. \"Node3D\", \"OmniLight3D\", \"StandardMaterial3D\", \"Vector3\", \"editor\"): that " +
            "type's members (name type; ro = read-only), methods, and its Godot properties (props[\"name\"]). Use it before " +
            "querying an unfamiliar class.";
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlHostNames.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The pure halves of three RQL host hooks (the Godot halves are in <c>RqlGodot.Names.cs</c>): the member names the host's
    /// types declare (<c>RqlEngine.IsKnownMember</c>), the Godot names of C# binding types (<c>RqlEngine.TypeDisplayName</c>)
    /// and the alias names of an enum's entries (<c>RqlEngine.EnumAliases</c>). No Godot engine calls: unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RqlHostNames
    {
        /// <summary>The public instance properties and fields of <paramref name="types"/>, case-insensitive.</summary>
        public static HashSet<string> MemberNames(IEnumerable<Type> types)
        {
            var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var t in types)
            {
                try
                {
                    foreach (var p in t.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)) names.Add(p.Name);
                    foreach (var f in t.GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)) names.Add(f.Name);
                }
                catch (Exception) { } // a type whose members cannot load (a missing dependency) adds nothing
            }
            return names;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// <c>RqlEngine.TypeDisplayName</c>: the Godot (ClassDB) name of a Godot class whose C# binding is spelt differently,
        /// from the binding's <see cref="GodotClassNameAttribute"/> (GPUParticles3D for GpuParticles3D, CSGBox3D for CsgBox3D,
        /// Object for GodotObject); null keeps the C# name (Node3D, project script classes).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? GodotClassName(Type type) =>
            type.GetCustomAttribute<GodotClassNameAttribute>(inherit: false)?.Name is { Length: > 0 } name && name != type.Name ? name : null;

        /// <summary>
        /// Alias → entry name for <paramref name="enumType"/> from other names of its values (Godot's constants
        /// "PRESET_FULL_RECT" and inspector labels "Per-Pixel" for the C# entries FullRect / PerPixel), or null for none. A name
        /// that is already an entry name (any case) is left to RQL; a name that stands for two different entries is dropped.
        /// </summary>
        public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? EnumAliases(Type enumType, IEnumerable<(string name, long value)> names)
        {
            if (!enumType.IsEnum) return null;
            var entryNames = Enum.GetNames(enumType);
            var entries = new HashSet<string>(entryNames, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var byValue = new Dictionary<long, string>();
            foreach (var entry in entryNames)
            {
                long value;
                try { value = Convert.ToInt64(Enum.Parse(enumType, entry)); }
                catch (OverflowException) { continue; } // a ulong value no Godot constant can carry
                if (!byValue.ContainsKey(value)) byValue[value] = entry;
            }
            var aliases = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var ambiguous = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var (name, value) in names)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) || entries.Contains(name) || !byValue.TryGetValue(value, out var entry)) continue;
                if (aliases.TryGetValue(name, out var known) && known != entry) ambiguous.Add(name);
                else aliases[name] = entry;
            }
            foreach (var name in ambiguous) aliases.Remove(name);
            return aliases.Count == 0 ? null : new ReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>(aliases);
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlInstaller.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.ToolFormat;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Utils;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Wires RQL into the editor connection (the Godot counterpart of Unity-MCP's <c>ApplyToolFormat</c>). Installed by
    /// <c>GodotMcpPlugin</c> at boot, which hands <see cref="Configure"/> to the <see cref="GodotMcpConnection"/> it
    /// creates (its <c>configurePlugin</c> parameter), so the runtime-agnostic connection
    /// never references editor code. For every plugin the connection builds it:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>shapes the EDITOR tool surface: removes the runtime-safe data tools RQL replaces in the editor
    /// (<see cref="EditorReplacedTools"/>: console-* → the <c>console</c> source, reflection-method-* → <c>call</c> /
    /// <c>CallMethod</c> / rql-schema). The in-game runtime (<c>GodotMcpRuntime</c>) builds its own plugin and keeps them;</item>
    /// <item>installs the tool data layer the config asks for (<see cref="GodotMcpConfig.ActiveToolFormat"/>): RQL
    /// (<see cref="RqlToolBinding"/>) or ReflectorNet JSON.</item>
    /// </list>
    /// <see cref="Uninstall"/> (plugin teardown) clears the hook and drops the engine and RQL's caches.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RqlInstaller
    {
        /// <summary>Runtime tools that RQL replaces in the editor (they stay registered in a game build's runtime).</summary>
        internal static readonly string[] EditorReplacedTools =
        {
            Tool_Console.ConsoleGetLogsToolId,
            Tool_Console.ConsoleClearLogsToolId,
            Tool_Reflection.ReflectionMethodFindToolId,
            Tool_Reflection.ReflectionMethodCallToolId,
        };

        /// <summary>Wire the engine and the binding to the editor; returns the plugin configuration for the connection.</summary>
        public static Action<IMcpPlugin, GodotMcpConfig> Install(Func<global::Godot.EditorUndoRedoManager?> undoRedo)
        {
            RqlGodot.UndoRedo = undoRedo;
            RqlToolBinding.EngineProvider = () => RqlGodot.Engine;
            RqlToolBinding.MainThreadRunner = f => MainThread.Instance.Run(f);
            return Configure;
        }

        public static void Uninstall()
        {
            RqlToolBinding.EngineProvider = null;
            RqlToolBinding.MainThreadRunner = null;
            RqlGodot.UndoRedo = null;
            var used = RqlGodot.Reset();
            GodotTypes.Reset();
            if (!used) return; // no engine was ever built: RQL's process-wide caches hold nothing of this assembly
            var cleared = RqlStaticCaches.Clear();
            GodotMcpLog.Info($"[Godot-MCP] RQL reset ({cleared} RQL caches cleared).");
        }

        /// <summary>The plugin configuration: editor tool surface, then the tool data layer.</summary>
        private static void Configure(IMcpPlugin plugin, GodotMcpConfig config)
        {
            var tools = plugin.McpManager?.ToolManager;
            if (tools == null) return;
            foreach (var id in EditorReplacedTools)
                if (tools.HasTool(id)) tools.RemoveTool(id);
            try
            {
                RqlToolBinding.Apply(tools, config.ActiveToolFormat, config.ToolTextEscaping);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Without the binding every tool keeps ReflectorNet's JSON surface; the RQL tools still work.
                GodotMcpLog.Error($"[Godot-MCP] installing the RQL tool data layer failed ({ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}); tools keep the JSON format.");
                tools.ToolBinding = null;
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>What an object enclosing a change is, for <see cref="RqlMutationOwner.Nearest{T}"/>.</summary>
    internal enum RqlOwnerKind
    {
        /// <summary>Not an object with undo (a plain C# view, a freed object): passed over, whatever its target.</summary>
        None,
        /// <summary>A plain Godot object (not a node or resource).</summary>
        Plain,
        /// <summary>A node, resource or the project settings: what the scene / file / project.godot stores.</summary>
        Stored,
        /// <summary>A view row standing for an object (IRqlViewOf); the target is that object.</summary>
        View,
    }

    /// <summary>Picks the object whose undo snapshot covers a change. Pure managed: no Godot types (unit-tested).</summary>
    internal static class RqlMutationOwner
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The owner of a change from the objects enclosing it, nearest first (RQL's <c>MutationRecord.Owners</c>): the
        /// nearest node / resource / settings object, or the object a view stands for. A plain object on the way is the
        /// owner itself (a write to an Object held by a node property does not change the node's stored properties), except
        /// under a view: the view says it is stored by its object (a TileSet tile's TileData is saved by its atlas source).
        /// <paramref name="classify"/> returns a non-null target for every kind but <see cref="RqlOwnerKind.None"/>.
        /// </summary>
        public static T? Nearest<T>(IEnumerable<object> enclosing, Func<object, (T? target, RqlOwnerKind kind)> classify) where T : class
        {
            T? plain = null;
            foreach (var candidate in enclosing)
            {
                var (target, kind) = classify(candidate);
                switch (kind)
                {
                    case RqlOwnerKind.View: return target;
                    case RqlOwnerKind.Stored: return plain ?? target;
                    case RqlOwnerKind.Plain: plain ??= target; break;
                }
            }
            return plain;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlReferences.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Who still uses a file (the check behind <c>DeleteResource</c>, like the FileSystem dock's "Remove" dialog): the scenes
    /// and resources saved on disk that depend on it, and the nodes of the edited scene that hold it now, its unsaved
    /// changes included (a reference assigned since the last save is not on disk yet).
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RqlReferences
    {
        private static readonly HashSet<string> DependentExtensions = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { "tscn", "scn", "tres", "res" };

        /// <summary>Whether the file at <paramref name="path"/> can reference other files (a scene or resource).</summary>
        internal static bool CanDepend(string path) => DependentExtensions.Contains(System.IO.Path.GetExtension(path).TrimStart('.'));

        /// <summary>The users of <paramref name="resPath"/>: "res://…" files, then "node 'Path' of the edited scene" entries.</summary>
        public static List<string> UsersOf(string resPath)
        {
            var users = new List<string>();
            var uid = RqlGodot.UidOf(resPath);
            // Saved files first (the edited scene's file too: unsaved changes may still be discarded), then the live nodes.
            if (EditorInterface.Singleton.GetResourceFilesystem()?.GetFilesystem() is { } dir)
                foreach (var (path, _) in RqlGodot.WalkFiles(dir))
                {
                    if (string.Equals(path, resPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || !CanDepend(path)) continue;
                    if (ResourceLoader.GetDependencies(path).Any(d => ResPathNormalizer.DependencyNames(d, resPath, uid))) users.Add(path);
                }
            if (RqlGodot.EditedRoot() is { } root)
                foreach (var node in RqlGodot.AllNodes())
                    // An instance of the scene file, or a property holding the resource.
                    if ((node != root && string.Equals(node.SceneFilePath, resPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) || Holds(node, resPath, depth: 0))
                        users.Add($"node '{RqlGodot.PathOf(node)}' of the edited scene {root.SceneFilePath}".TrimEnd());
            return users;
        }

        /// <summary>At most five users, then how many more.</summary>
        public static string Describe(List<string> users) =>
            string.Join(", ", users.Take(5)) + (users.Count > 5 ? $" and {users.Count - 5} more" : "");

        // A stored property of the object holds the file's resource, directly or through built-in sub-resources (a mesh's material).
        private static bool Holds(GodotObject o, string resPath, int depth)
        {
            if (depth > 3) return false;
            foreach (var value in RqlGodot.StoredProperties(o).Values)
            {
                if (value.VariantType != Variant.Type.Object || !(value.AsGodotObject() is Resource r) || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r)) continue;
                if (string.Equals(r.ResourcePath, resPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return true;
                // Built-in sub-resources only: another file resource is checked through its own dependencies above.
                if (!RqlGodot.IsFileResource(r) && Holds(r, resPath, depth + 1)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlReimport.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// <c>editor | call Reimport(files?)</c> — the logic of the replaced <c>filesystem-reimport</c> tool, unchanged: with
    /// files, each is routed by type (an imported asset is reimported, a new importable file is registered and imported,
    /// Godot's native formats are refreshed with UpdateFile) and every import is verified; without files, a full
    /// EditorFileSystem scan. RQL calls run on the editor main thread, so a brand-new file in a folder the editor never
    /// scanned is reported as NOT imported (run Reimport() without files first) instead of waiting for editor frames.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RqlReimport
    {
        /// <summary>Reimport <paramref name="files"/> (res:// paths), or scan the whole filesystem when null / empty. Main thread.</summary>
        public static string Run(IReadOnlyList<string>? files) =>
            files != null && files.Count > 0 ? ReimportFiles(files) : FullScan();

        // Bounded settle tunables: a short Thread.Sleep on the editor main thread yields without re-entrancy issues.
        const int ReimportSleepMs = 25;
        const int ReimportMaxWaits = 200;          // 200 * 25ms = 5s settle ceiling
        const int ReimportPrimeWaits = 40;         // 40 * 25ms = 1s ceiling to observe the scan START

        /// <summary>
        /// The targeted (<c>files</c>) form, on the main thread: validate, classify, refresh the native files, register
        /// the importer-routed ones, then import and verify. No editor frame runs during the call, so a file in a folder
        /// the editor never scanned stays unregistered and is reported as NOT imported.
        /// </summary>
        static string ReimportFiles(IReadOnlyList<string> files)
        {
            var efs = Tools.EditorToolGuards.GetResourceFileSystemOrThrow();

            // Every import this request claims must have rewritten its sidecar at or after this instant.
            var startedUnix = (ulong)Math.Floor(Time.GetUnixTimeFromSystem());

            // Validate every path up front so a single bad entry is a clean error, not a partial refresh, and act on the
            // normalized paths (a raw path with surrounding whitespace would match no known file and silently no-op).
            var normalized = new List<string>(files.Count);
            foreach (var f in files)
            {
                var p = Tools.ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(f, nameof(files));
                if (!FileAccess.FileExists(p))
                    throw new ArgumentException($"No file exists at '{p}'.", nameof(files));
                normalized.Add(p);
            }

            // Never queue a NATIVE file (.tscn/.tres/.gd/…) for import (issue #310), and never route a brand-new
            // importable file (no sidecar yet) to UpdateFile alone — that registers it but does not import it (D32).
            // GetRecognizedExtensionsForType("") lists every loader's extensions, the importer's included;
            // ResourceLoader.Exists filters the ones a native loader handles directly.
            var plan = Tools.ReimportClassifier.Plan(
                normalized,
                FileAccess.FileExists,
                ResourceLoader.GetRecognizedExtensionsForType(string.Empty),
                p => ResourceLoader.Exists(p));

            foreach (var path in plan.Native)
                efs.UpdateFile(path);
            foreach (var path in RoutedToImporter(plan))
                if (!IsKnownToFileSystem(efs, path))
                    efs.UpdateFile(path);

            return FinishTargetedReimport(efs, plan, startedUnix);
        }

        static string FinishTargetedReimport(EditorFileSystem efs, Tools.ReimportPlan plan, ulong startedUnix)
        {
            var outcomes = new Dictionary<string, Tools.ImportOutcome>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var newFiles = new HashSet<string>(plan.NewImportable, StringComparer.Ordinal);

            // A file the editor still does not know cannot be imported at all (ReimportFiles would only log
            // "Can't find file"); a NEW file a scan already imported during this request needs no second import.
            var toImport = new List<string>();
            foreach (var path in RoutedToImporter(plan))
            {
                if (!IsKnownToFileSystem(efs, path))
                    outcomes[path] = Tools.ImportOutcome.Failure(
                        "the editor filesystem never registered the file, so it could not be imported (its folder " +
                        "may not have been scanned yet, or the path's letter case differs from the file on disk) — " +
                        "run editor | call Reimport() without files for a full scan");
                else if (newFiles.Contains(path) && VerifyImport(path, startedUnix).Imported)
                    outcomes[path] = Tools.ImportOutcome.Success();
                else
                    toImport.Add(path);
            }

            if (toImport.Count > 0)
                efs.ReimportFiles(toImport.ToArray());

            // Verify: an import is only claimed when its sidecar was (re)written during this request AND records
            // a valid import (Godot writes 'valid=false' when the importer fails, e.g. on a corrupt file).
            foreach (var path in toImport)
                outcomes[path] = VerifyImport(path, startedUnix);

            // ReimportFiles/UpdateFile are synchronous; only a tail scan (if any) may still be in flight. Do
            // NOT prime here — a prime that never observes a scan would falsely report "never started". Just
            // drain whatever scan is currently running (bounded).
            return DrainScan(efs, plan.Describe(outcomes));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Make the editor filesystem know a file just written to <paramref name="resPath"/>: <c>UpdateFile</c> when its
        /// folder is known, else a full scan (settled). <c>UpdateFile</c> ignores a file in a folder the editor never scanned
        /// (the <c>files</c> source, <c>godot.resources(type, folder)</c> and a GDScript <c>class_name</c> then never saw it),
        /// and a scan made before the write would not help: its result replaces the folder's listing a frame later.
        /// A second unknown-folder file in the same frame cannot get its own scan (the first one is swapped in only on the
        /// next frame, and a new Scan() is ignored until then): it is registered with <c>UpdateFile</c> once that scan
        /// lands. A folder the editor never lists (<c>.gdignore</c>, a dot-named folder) is not scanned for. Main-thread only.
        /// </summary>
        internal static void Register(string resPath)
        {
            var efs = EditorInterface.Singleton.GetResourceFilesystem();
            if (efs == null) return;
            var dir = Tools.ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(resPath);
            if (IsKnownFolder(efs, dir)) efs.UpdateFile(resPath);
            else if (IsIgnoredFolder(dir)) return;
            else if (_scanFrame == Engine.GetProcessFrames()) Defer(efs, resPath);
            else FullScanFor(efs);
        }

        /// <summary>A folder created on disk becomes known to the editor filesystem (a full scan, settled, if it is not yet).</summary>
        internal static void RegisterFolder(string resDir)
        {
            var efs = EditorInterface.Singleton.GetResourceFilesystem();
            if (efs == null || IsKnownFolder(efs, resDir) || IsIgnoredFolder(resDir)) return;
            if (_scanFrame == Engine.GetProcessFrames()) Defer(efs, null);
            else FullScanFor(efs);
        }

        // The frame of the last full scan Register ran, and the files written after it in that frame.
        static ulong _scanFrame = ulong.MaxValue;
        static readonly List<string?> _deferred = new List<string?>();

        static void FullScanFor(EditorFileSystem efs)
        {
            FullScan();
            _scanFrame = Engine.GetProcessFrames();
        }

        static void Defer(EditorFileSystem efs, string? resPath)
        {
            if (_deferred.Count == 0)
                efs.Connect(EditorFileSystem.SignalName.FilesystemChanged, Callable.From(FlushDeferred), (uint)GodotObject.ConnectFlags.OneShot);
            _deferred.Add(resPath);
        }

        // The scan of the frame is in: register the files written after it (their folders are known now), or scan again.
        static void FlushDeferred()
        {
            var efs = EditorInterface.Singleton.GetResourceFilesystem();
            var pending = _deferred.ToList();
            _deferred.Clear();
            if (efs == null) return;
            var rescan = false;
            foreach (var path in pending)
            {
                if (path != null && IsKnownFolder(efs, Tools.ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(path))) efs.UpdateFile(path);
                else rescan = true;
            }
            if (rescan) efs.Scan();
        }

        // The editor filesystem skips a folder holding a .gdignore file and dot-named folders (and everything below them).
        static bool IsIgnoredFolder(string resDir)
        {
            var dir = Tools.ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir(resDir).TrimEnd('/');
            while (dir.Length > "res://".Length)
            {
                var slash = dir.LastIndexOf('/');
                if (dir[slash + 1] == '.' || FileAccess.FileExists(dir + "/.gdignore")) return true;
                dir = dir.Substring(0, slash);
            }
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>Whether the editor filesystem has scanned the folder <paramref name="resDir"/>. Main-thread only.</summary>
        internal static bool IsKnownFolder(string resDir) =>
            EditorInterface.Singleton.GetResourceFilesystem() is { } efs && IsKnownFolder(efs, resDir);

        static bool IsKnownFolder(EditorFileSystem efs, string resDir) =>
            efs.GetFilesystemPath(Tools.ResPathNormalizer.NormalizeDir(resDir)) != null;

        static string FullScan()
        {
            var efs = Tools.EditorToolGuards.GetResourceFileSystemOrThrow();

            // Full scan. Scan() runs the index ASYNCHRONOUSLY, so IsScanning() can still be false on the
            // first check (the scan has not begun yet). A naive `while (IsScanning())` would exit
            // immediately and falsely report "settled" though nothing was indexed — defeating the tool's
            // purpose. So PRIME first: poll until the scan is observed running at least once (bounded),
            // and only then poll until it clears.
            efs.Scan();
            const string action = "Full filesystem scan";

            for (var primePolls = 0; primePolls < ReimportPrimeWaits && !efs.IsScanning(); primePolls++)
                Thread.Sleep(ReimportSleepMs);

            if (!efs.IsScanning())
                // The scan never started within the prime window. Report it explicitly rather than
                // silently claiming "settled" — the caller should not assume the index was refreshed.
                return $"{action}; scan did not start within {ReimportPrimeWaits * ReimportSleepMs}ms — filesystem may be unchanged or busy (NOT confirmed settled).";

            // Scan observed running; now drain it (bounded).
            return DrainScan(efs, action);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Wait (bounded) for any running scan to finish and suffix <paramref name="action"/> with whether the
        /// filesystem settled. Main-thread only.
        /// </summary>
        static string DrainScan(EditorFileSystem efs, string action)
        {
            for (var waits = 0; waits < ReimportMaxWaits && efs.IsScanning(); waits++)
                Thread.Sleep(ReimportSleepMs);

            return !efs.IsScanning()
                ? $"{action}; filesystem settled."
                : $"{action}; filesystem still scanning after {ReimportMaxWaits * ReimportSleepMs}ms (progress={efs.GetScanningProgress():0.00}).";
        }

        /// <summary>The plan's files that go to the importer: the already-imported ones and the new ones.</summary>
        static IEnumerable<string> RoutedToImporter(Tools.ReimportPlan plan) => plan.Importable.Concat(plan.NewImportable);

        /// <summary>Whether <c>EditorFileSystem</c> has an entry for <paramref name="resPath"/>. Main-thread only.</summary>
        static bool IsKnownToFileSystem(EditorFileSystem efs, string resPath)
        {
            var dir = efs.GetFilesystemPath(Tools.ResPathNormalizer.ParentDir(resPath));
            return dir != null && dir.FindFileIndex(GetLeafName(resPath)) >= 0;
        }

        /// <summary>Judge, from its sidecar, whether this request imported <paramref name="resPath"/>. Main-thread only.</summary>
        static Tools.ImportOutcome VerifyImport(string resPath, ulong startedUnix)
        {
            var sidecar = Tools.ReimportClassifier.ImportSidecarPath(resPath);
            return FileAccess.FileExists(sidecar)
                ? Tools.ReimportClassifier.JudgeImport(FileAccess.GetFileAsString(sidecar), FileAccess.GetModifiedTime(sidecar), startedUnix)
                : Tools.ReimportClassifier.JudgeImport(null, 0, startedUnix);
        }

        static string GetLeafName(string resPath)
        {
            var trimmed = resPath.TrimEnd('/');
            var idx = trimmed.LastIndexOf('/');
            return idx < 0 ? trimmed : trimmed.Substring(idx + 1);
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlSetStageBuffer.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Holds what setters record while an RQL <c>set</c> stage runs (their own undo steps) until the engine reports the
    /// stage's outcome. The engine runs <see cref="MutationPolicy.Committed"/> only after every write of a <c>set</c>
    /// succeeded; when a write throws it restores the earlier writes through the same setters and Committed never runs, so
    /// a stage that never commits leaves nothing behind (<see cref="DiscardAbove"/>). Completed calls are never rolled back,
    /// so what a <c>call</c> stage records is applied at once. Pure managed: no Godot types (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class RqlSetStageBuffer
    {
        private readonly List<(int depth, List<Action> pending)> _stages = new List<(int depth, List<Action> pending)>();

        /// <summary>A set stage at nesting depth <paramref name="depth"/> is about to write (the BeforeWrite hook).</summary>
        public void BeforeWrite(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records, int depth)
        {
            if (IsSet(records)) _stages.Add((depth, new List<Action>()));
        }

        /// <summary>Run <paramref name="apply"/> when the running set stage commits, or now when no set stage is running.</summary>
        public void Record(Action apply)
        {
            if (_stages.Count > 0) _stages[_stages.Count - 1].pending.Add(apply);
            else apply();
        }

        /// <summary>The set stage at <paramref name="depth"/> committed (the Committed hook): apply what it recorded, in order.</summary>
        public void Committed(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records, int depth)
        {
            if (!IsSet(records) || _stages.Count == 0 || _stages[_stages.Count - 1].depth != depth) return;
            var pending = _stages[_stages.Count - 1].pending;
            _stages.RemoveAt(_stages.Count - 1);
            // A stage nested in an enclosing set stage (a setter that runs a query) joins that stage's outcome.
            foreach (var apply in pending) Record(apply);
        }

        /// <summary>Drop the stages opened deeper than <paramref name="depth"/> that never committed (rolled back or vetoed).</summary>
        public void DiscardAbove(int depth)
        {
            while (_stages.Count > 0 && _stages[_stages.Count - 1].depth > depth) _stages.RemoveAt(_stages.Count - 1);
        }

        public void Clear() => _stages.Clear();

        // set records carry no method; call records do.
        private static bool IsSet(IReadOnlyList<MutationRecord> records) => records.Count > 0 && records[0].Method == null;
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlStaticCaches.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Releases RQL's process-wide caches on plugin teardown so a C# hot reload can unload the addon's collectible
    /// AssemblyLoadContext.
    /// <para>
    /// <b>Why.</b> The RQL assemblies (<c>com.IvanMurzak.Rql</c>) are NuGet dependencies, which
    /// <c>GodotMcpAssemblyResolver</c> loads into the DEFAULT (non-collectible) load context. RQL keeps a few static caches
    /// keyed by <see cref="Type"/> / <see cref="MemberInfo"/> (the shared type model, compiled member getters, the
    /// <c>$type</c> subtype index, object-kind overrides). Once a query has touched a type of the addon assembly (the
    /// <c>editor</c> source's view objects, a user's C# node script), those entries root the collectible context and the
    /// reload fails (".NET: Failed to unload assemblies") — the same class of problem the addon already avoids for
    /// System.Text.Json (GodotMcpConfigJsonContext) and clears for ReflectorNet in <c>GodotMcpPlugin.Teardown</c>.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// RQL 0.1 has no public "clear caches" API, so this clears them by reflection, defensively: every static dictionary in
    /// the RQL assemblies whose key involves a type or member, plus the shared <see cref="TypeModel"/>'s per-type cache. It
    /// never throws (a renamed field in a later RQL version just means nothing is cleared) and reports how many caches it
    /// cleared. The dock-reload CI legs (test_godot_dock_reload.yml) are the proof that the reload still unloads.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    public static class RqlStaticCaches
    {
        /// <summary>Clear the caches; returns the number of caches cleared (0 when none were found).</summary>
        public static int Clear()
        {
            var cleared = 0;
            foreach (var assembly in new[] { typeof(TypeModel).Assembly, typeof(global::Rql.RqlParser).Assembly })
            {
                foreach (var type in TypeModel.LoadableTypes(assembly))
                {
                    if (type.ContainsGenericParameters) continue;
                    foreach (var field in type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic))
                        if (TryClear(SafeGet(field, null))) cleared++;
                }
            }

            // The shared model (engines without adapters use it; TypeModel.Get(...) helpers read through it).
            var shared = TypeModel.Shared;
            foreach (var field in typeof(TypeModel).GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic))
                if (TryClear(SafeGet(field, shared))) cleared++;
            return cleared;
        }

        private static object? SafeGet(FieldInfo field, object? target)
        {
            try { return field.GetValue(target); }
            catch { return null; }
        }

        // A dictionary keyed by Type / MemberInfo (or a tuple holding one) is a per-type cache: clear it. Lookup tables of
        // BCL types (aliases), regex caches and parser keyword tables are left alone.
        private static bool TryClear(object? value)
        {
            if (!(value is IDictionary dictionary) || dictionary.IsReadOnly) return false;
            var keyType = KeyType(value.GetType());
            if (keyType == null || !HoldsTypeOrMember(keyType)) return false;
            if (IsBclAliasTable(dictionary)) return false;
            // Teardown runs on the main thread with no query in flight; the caches are concurrent dictionaries.
            try
            {
                dictionary.Clear();
                return true;
            }
            catch { return false; }
        }

        private static Type? KeyType(Type dictionaryType)
        {
            for (var t = dictionaryType; t != null; t = t.BaseType)
                if (t.IsGenericType && t.GetGenericArguments().Length == 2) return t.GetGenericArguments()[0];
            foreach (var i in dictionaryType.GetInterfaces())
                if (i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IDictionary<,>)) return i.GetGenericArguments()[0];
            return null;
        }

        private static bool HoldsTypeOrMember(Type key)
        {
            if (typeof(Type).IsAssignableFrom(key) || typeof(MemberInfo).IsAssignableFrom(key)) return true;
            if (key.IsGenericType && key.FullName?.StartsWith("System.ValueTuple", StringComparison.Ordinal) == true)
                foreach (var arg in key.GetGenericArguments())
                    if (HoldsTypeOrMember(arg)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        // TypeModel's display aliases map BCL types (int → "int"): static, immutable, never hold addon types.
        private static bool IsBclAliasTable(IDictionary dictionary)
        {
            foreach (var key in dictionary.Keys)
                if (!(key is Type t) || t.Assembly != typeof(object).Assembly) return false;
            return dictionary.Count > 0;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

```cs
#nullable enable
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// How many objects one rql-mutate set / call stage may change (RQL spec §8 "Target limit"). The limit guards the breadth
    /// of a change, not its correctness (all-or-nothing, rollback, dry runs and the one undo action hold at any size), so the
    /// editor default is <see cref="Default"/>; a request raises it with the <see cref="Argument"/> tool argument up to
    /// <see cref="Ceiling"/>. RQL refuses a value outside 1 … <see cref="Ceiling"/> (invalid-value, nothing runs); an omitted
    /// argument sends no budget, so the host default applies. Pure (no Godot API): unit-tested over a real engine.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RqlTargetLimit
    {
        /// <summary>The rql-mutate argument that sets the limit; RQL's mutation-limit hint names it.</summary>
        public const string Argument = "max_targets";

        public const int Default = 200;

        public const int Ceiling = 1000;

        public static void Configure(MutationPolicy mutations)
        {
            mutations.MaxTargets = Default;
            mutations.HardMaxTargets = Ceiling;
            mutations.LimitArgument = Argument;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The limit a rql-mutate <see cref="Argument"/> requests: null (not given, the host default applies) for
        /// <see cref="Default"/>, which the tool's plain int argument defaults to (an int? would put a $defs reference into the
        /// tool's MCP input schema); any other value, 0 included, goes to RQL, which refuses one outside 1 … <see cref="Ceiling"/>.
        /// </summary>
        public static int? Requested(int argument) => argument == Default ? (int?)null : argument;

        /// <summary>The request budgets for a requested limit: none when it was not given (never 0 for "unset").</summary>
        public static Budgets? BudgetsFor(int? maxTargets) => maxTargets is int n ? new Budgets { MaxMutationTargets = n } : null;
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Settings/InputEventText.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings
{
    /// <summary>The kinds of input event an input action can hold, as written in RQL text.</summary>
    public enum InputEventKind { Key, PhysicalKey, Mouse, JoypadButton, JoypadMotion }

    /// <summary>
    /// One input event of an input action as text, parsed: <c>Key:Ctrl+S</c> (the key text stays for the engine to resolve),
    /// <c>Mouse:Shift+Left</c>, <c>JoypadButton:A</c>, <c>JoypadMotion:LeftX-</c>. <see cref="Index"/> is the mouse button,
    /// joypad button or axis number Godot uses; <see cref="AxisSign"/> is -1 or +1 for an axis.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class InputEventSpec
    {
        public InputEventSpec(InputEventKind kind, string keys, IReadOnlyList<string> modifiers, int index, int axisSign)
        {
            Kind = kind;
            Keys = keys;
            Modifiers = modifiers;
            Index = index;
            AxisSign = axisSign;
        }

        public InputEventKind Kind { get; }

        /// <summary>For Key / PhysicalKey: the key with its modifiers as Godot writes it ("Ctrl+S"); empty otherwise.</summary>
        public string Keys { get; }

        /// <summary>For Mouse: the modifier names in canonical order (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Meta); empty otherwise.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<string> Modifiers { get; }

        public int Index { get; }

        public int AxisSign { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The text format of input events in RQL (<c>inputActions</c> / <c>AddInputEvent</c>): <c>&lt;Kind&gt;:&lt;value&gt;</c>.
    /// Kinds are case-insensitive. Key names are resolved by the engine (<c>OS.FindKeycodeFromString</c>), so this class only
    /// splits the text; mouse buttons, joypad buttons and axes are named here, so the same names read back.
    /// </summary>
    public static class InputEventText
    {
        public const string Help =
            "an input event is \"Key:W\", \"Key:Ctrl+S\", \"PhysicalKey:Space\", \"Mouse:Left\", \"Mouse:Shift+WheelUp\", " +
            "\"JoypadButton:A\" (or a button number), \"JoypadMotion:LeftX-\" / \"JoypadMotion:TriggerRight+\" (axis and direction)";

        /// <summary>Godot's MouseButton numbers (1-based; 0 is None).</summary>
        public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> MouseButtons = new[]
        {
            "None", "Left", "Right", "Middle", "WheelUp", "WheelDown", "WheelLeft", "WheelRight", "Xbutton1", "Xbutton2",
        };

        /// <summary>Godot's JoyButton numbers (SDL layout).</summary>
        public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> JoypadButtons = new[]
        {
            "A", "B", "X", "Y", "Back", "Guide", "Start", "LeftStick", "RightStick", "LeftShoulder", "RightShoulder",
            "DpadUp", "DpadDown", "DpadLeft", "DpadRight", "Misc1", "Paddle1", "Paddle2", "Paddle3", "Paddle4", "Touchpad",
        };

        /// <summary>Godot's JoyAxis numbers.</summary>
        public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> JoypadAxes = new[] { "LeftX", "LeftY", "RightX", "RightY", "TriggerLeft", "TriggerRight" };

        /// <summary>Modifier names in the order Godot writes them.</summary>
        public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> ModifierNames = new[] { "Shift", "Ctrl", "Alt", "Meta" };

        private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> ModifierAliases = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        {
            ["shift"] = "Shift", ["ctrl"] = "Ctrl", ["control"] = "Ctrl", ["alt"] = "Alt", ["option"] = "Alt",
            ["meta"] = "Meta", ["cmd"] = "Meta", ["command"] = "Meta", ["win"] = "Meta", ["super"] = "Meta",
        };

        /// <summary>Parse <paramref name="text"/>; false with the reason when it is not an input event.</summary>
        public static bool TryParse(string? text, out InputEventSpec? spec, out string? error)
        {
            spec = null;
            error = null;
            var t = (text ?? "").Trim();
            var colon = t.IndexOf(':');
            if (colon <= 0 || colon == t.Length - 1)
            {
                error = $"'{text}' is not an input event: {Help}";
                return false;
            }
            var kindText = t.Substring(0, colon).Trim();
            var value = t.Substring(colon + 1).Trim();
            if (!TryKind(kindText, out var kind))
            {
                error = $"unknown input event kind '{kindText}': {Help}";
                return false;
            }
            switch (kind)
            {
                case InputEventKind.Key:
                case InputEventKind.PhysicalKey:
                    spec = new InputEventSpec(kind, value, Array.Empty<string>(), 0, 0);
                    return true;
                case InputEventKind.Mouse:
                {
                    var parts = value.Split('+').Select(p => p.Trim()).ToList();
                    var mods = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                    for (int i = 0; i < parts.Count - 1; i++)
                    {
                        if (!ModifierAliases.TryGetValue(parts[i], out var mod))
                        {
                            error = $"unknown modifier '{parts[i]}' in '{text}' (use {string.Join(", ", ModifierNames)})";
                            return false;
                        }
                        mods.Add(mod);
                    }
                    var button = IndexOf(MouseButtons, parts[parts.Count - 1], first: 1);
                    if (button < 1)
                    {
                        error = $"unknown mouse button '{parts[parts.Count - 1]}' (use {string.Join(", ", MouseButtons.Skip(1))})";
                        return false;
                    }
                    spec = new InputEventSpec(kind, "", ModifierNames.Where(mods.Contains).ToList(), button, 0);
                    return true;
                }
                case InputEventKind.JoypadButton:
                {
                    var button = IndexOf(JoypadButtons, value, first: 0, max: 127);
                    if (button < 0)
                    {
                        error = $"unknown joypad button '{value}' (use {string.Join(", ", JoypadButtons)} or a number)";
                        return false;
                    }
                    spec = new InputEventSpec(kind, "", Array.Empty<string>(), button, 0);
                    return true;
                }
                default:
                {
                    int sign = 0;
                    var axisText = value;
                    if (axisText.EndsWith("+", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { sign = 1; axisText = axisText.Substring(0, axisText.Length - 1); }
                    else if (axisText.EndsWith("-", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { sign = -1; axisText = axisText.Substring(0, axisText.Length - 1); }
                    var axis = IndexOf(JoypadAxes, axisText.Trim(), first: 0, max: JoypadAxes.Count - 1);
                    if (axis < 0)
                    {
                        error = $"unknown joypad axis '{axisText}' (use {string.Join(", ", JoypadAxes)} followed by + or -)";
                        return false;
                    }
                    if (sign == 0)
                    {
                        // A trigger only moves one way; a stick needs the direction.
                        if (axis >= 4) sign = 1;
                        else
                        {
                            error = $"'{text}' needs a direction: \"JoypadMotion:{JoypadAxes[axis]}-\" or \"JoypadMotion:{JoypadAxes[axis]}+\"";
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                    spec = new InputEventSpec(kind, "", Array.Empty<string>(), axis, sign);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>The canonical text of a mouse button event.</summary>
        public static string Mouse(int button, IEnumerable<string> modifiers)
        {
            var name = button >= 1 && button < MouseButtons.Count ? MouseButtons[button] : button.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            var mods = ModifierNames.Where(modifiers.Contains).ToList();
            return "Mouse:" + (mods.Count > 0 ? string.Join("+", mods) + "+" : "") + name;
        }

        /// <summary>The canonical text of a joypad button event.</summary>
        public static string JoypadButton(int button) =>
            "JoypadButton:" + (button >= 0 && button < JoypadButtons.Count ? JoypadButtons[button] : button.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

        /// <summary>The canonical text of a joypad axis event (the direction from the sign of <paramref name="value"/>).</summary>
        public static string JoypadMotion(int axis, float value) =>
            "JoypadMotion:" + (axis >= 0 && axis < JoypadAxes.Count ? JoypadAxes[axis] : axis.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)) + (value < 0 ? "-" : "+");

        /// <summary>The canonical text of a key event (<paramref name="keys"/> is the engine's text, e.g. "Ctrl+S").</summary>
        public static string Key(string keys, bool physical) => (physical ? "PhysicalKey:" : "Key:") + keys;

        /// <summary>Whether two event texts name the same event (case-insensitive, canonical names).</summary>
        public static bool SameText(string a, string b) => string.Equals(a.Trim(), b.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        private static bool TryKind(string text, out InputEventKind kind)
        {
            switch (text.Replace("_", "").Replace(" ", "").ToLowerInvariant())
            {
                case "key": kind = InputEventKind.Key; return true;
                case "physicalkey": case "physical": kind = InputEventKind.PhysicalKey; return true;
                case "mouse": case "mousebutton": kind = InputEventKind.Mouse; return true;
                case "joypadbutton": case "joybutton": case "gamepadbutton": kind = InputEventKind.JoypadButton; return true;
                case "joypadmotion": case "joyaxis": case "joypadaxis": case "gamepadaxis": kind = InputEventKind.JoypadMotion; return true;
                default: kind = default; return false;
            }
        }

        // The index of a name (case-insensitive, '_' and spaces ignored) or a number in [first, max]; -1 when neither.
        private static int IndexOf(IReadOnlyList<string> names, string text, int first, int max = -1)
        {
            var key = text.Replace("_", "").Replace(" ", "");
            for (int i = first; i < names.Count; i++)
                if (string.Equals(names[i], key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return i;
            if (int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var n)
                && n >= first && n <= (max < 0 ? names.Count - 1 : max))
                return n;
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Settings/InputEvents.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Input events ⇄ the RQL text of <see cref="InputEventText"/>. Key names go through the engine
    /// (<see cref="OS.FindKeycodeFromString"/> / <see cref="OS.GetKeycodeString"/>), so "Key:Ctrl+S" reads back as Godot
    /// writes it. Every event is for all devices, like the events the Input Map editor creates.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class InputEvents
    {
        /// <summary>The deadzone the Input Map editor gives a new action (0.5 before Godot 4.4, 0.2 since).</summary>
        public static double DefaultDeadzone
        {
            get
            {
                var v = Engine.GetVersionInfo();
                var major = v["major"].AsInt32();
                var minor = v["minor"].AsInt32();
                return major > 4 || (major == 4 && minor >= 4) ? 0.2 : 0.5;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>A new input event from its text; throws with the format help when the text is not one.</summary>
        public static InputEvent Make(string text)
        {
            if (!InputEventText.TryParse(text, out var spec, out var error)) throw new ArgumentException(error);
            switch (spec!.Kind)
            {
                case InputEventKind.Key:
                case InputEventKind.PhysicalKey:
                {
                    var full = OS.FindKeycodeFromString(spec.Keys);
                    var code = (Key)((long)full & (long)KeyModifierMask.CodeMask);
                    if (code == Key.None) throw new ArgumentException($"unknown key '{spec.Keys}' in '{text}' (e.g. \"Key:W\", \"Key:Space\", \"Key:Ctrl+S\", \"Key:F1\")");
                    var key = new InputEventKey { Device = -1 };
                    if (spec.Kind == InputEventKind.PhysicalKey) key.PhysicalKeycode = code;
                    else key.Keycode = code;
                    var mods = (long)full;
                    key.ShiftPressed = (mods & (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskShift) != 0;
                    key.AltPressed = (mods & (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskAlt) != 0;
                    key.CtrlPressed = (mods & (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskCtrl) != 0;
                    key.MetaPressed = (mods & (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskMeta) != 0;
                    return key;
                }
                case InputEventKind.Mouse:
                    return new InputEventMouseButton
                    {
                        Device = -1,
                        ButtonIndex = (MouseButton)spec.Index,
                        ShiftPressed = spec.Modifiers.Contains("Shift"),
                        CtrlPressed = spec.Modifiers.Contains("Ctrl"),
                        AltPressed = spec.Modifiers.Contains("Alt"),
                        MetaPressed = spec.Modifiers.Contains("Meta"),
                    };
                case InputEventKind.JoypadButton:
                    return new InputEventJoypadButton { Device = -1, ButtonIndex = (JoyButton)spec.Index };
                default:
                    return new InputEventJoypadMotion { Device = -1, Axis = (JoyAxis)spec.Index, AxisValue = spec.AxisSign };
            }
        }

        /// <summary>The RQL text of an input event; other kinds read as "Class: text" (they can be removed by that text).</summary>
        public static string Text(InputEvent e)
        {
            switch (e)
            {
                case InputEventKey key:
                {
                    var physical = key.PhysicalKeycode != Key.None;
                    var code = physical ? key.PhysicalKeycode : key.Keycode;
                    if (code == Key.None) code = key.KeyLabel;
                    long mods = 0;
                    if (key.ShiftPressed) mods |= (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskShift;
                    if (key.AltPressed) mods |= (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskAlt;
                    if (key.CtrlPressed) mods |= (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskCtrl;
                    if (key.MetaPressed) mods |= (long)KeyModifierMask.MaskMeta;
                    return InputEventText.Key(OS.GetKeycodeString((Key)((long)code | mods)), physical);
                }
                case InputEventMouseButton mouse:
                {
                    var mods = new[] { mouse.ShiftPressed ? "Shift" : null, mouse.CtrlPressed ? "Ctrl" : null, mouse.AltPressed ? "Alt" : null, mouse.MetaPressed ? "Meta" : null };
                    return InputEventText.Mouse((int)mouse.ButtonIndex, mods.Where(m => m != null)!);
                }
                case InputEventJoypadButton button:
                    return InputEventText.JoypadButton((int)button.ButtonIndex);
                case InputEventJoypadMotion motion:
                    return InputEventText.JoypadMotion((int)motion.Axis, motion.AxisValue);
                default:
                    return $"{e.GetClass()}: {e.AsText()}";
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif
```
