`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Settings/LayerNames.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Layer bit masks ⇄ layer names (pure, unit-tested). A property whose hint is one of Godot's layer hints
    /// (<c>collision_layer</c>, <c>collision_mask</c>, <c>visibility_layer</c>, <c>layers</c>, <c>navigation_layers</c> …)
    /// holds a bit mask; the names come from the project settings <c>layer_names/&lt;kind&gt;/layer_&lt;n&gt;</c> (1-based, like
    /// the inspector). A layer is written by its name or its number; an unnamed layer reads as its number.
    /// </summary>
    public static class LayerNames
    {
        /// <summary>One kind of layers: its project-settings section, how many layers it has and the property hint using it.</summary>
        public readonly struct Kind
        {
            public Kind(string name, int count, PropertyHint hint) { Name = name; Count = count; Hint = hint; }
            public string Name { get; }
            public int Count { get; }
            public PropertyHint Hint { get; }
        }

        /// <summary>Every layer kind, in the Project Settings → Layer Names order.</summary>
        public static readonly IReadOnlyList<Kind> Kinds = new[]
        {
            new Kind("2d_render", 20, PropertyHint.Layers2DRender),
            new Kind("2d_physics", 32, PropertyHint.Layers2DPhysics),
            new Kind("2d_navigation", 32, PropertyHint.Layers2DNavigation),
            new Kind("3d_render", 20, PropertyHint.Layers3DRender),
            new Kind("3d_physics", 32, PropertyHint.Layers3DPhysics),
            new Kind("3d_navigation", 32, PropertyHint.Layers3DNavigation),
            new Kind("avoidance", 32, PropertyHint.LayersAvoidance),
        };

        /// <summary>The layer kind a property hint stands for; false for any other hint.</summary>
        public static bool TryKindOf(PropertyHint hint, out Kind kind)
        {
            foreach (var k in Kinds)
                if (k.Hint == hint) { kind = k; return true; }
            kind = default;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>The project setting that names a layer: <c>layer_names/3d_physics/layer_2</c>.</summary>
        public static string SettingName(string kind, int layer) => $"layer_names/{kind}/layer_{layer.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}";

        /// <summary>The bit of a layer (1-based).</summary>
        public static long Bit(int layer) => 1L << (layer - 1);

        /// <summary>
        /// The layers set in <paramref name="mask"/>, by name — or by number when unnamed (<paramref name="nameOf"/> returns
        /// null or empty) — lowest first. Bits above the kind's count are not listed (writes keep them).
        /// </summary>
        public static List<string> Names(long mask, Kind kind, Func<int, string?> nameOf)
        {
            var names = new List<string>();
            for (int layer = 1; layer <= kind.Count; layer++)
                if ((mask & Bit(layer)) != 0)
                    names.Add(nameOf(layer) is { Length: > 0 } name ? name : layer.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            return names;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The mask <paramref name="value"/> describes: a list of layers (names or numbers 1…count) or one layer name. Bits
        /// of <paramref name="current"/> above the kind's count are kept. Throws <see cref="ArgumentException"/> naming the
        /// known layers when an entry matches none.
        /// </summary>
        public static long Mask(object? value, long current, Kind kind, Func<int, string?> nameOf)
        {
            IEnumerable entries = value switch
            {
                null => Array.Empty<object>(),
                string s => new object[] { s },
                IEnumerable list => list,
                _ => throw new ArgumentException(
                    $"expected a list of {kind.Name} layers, e.g. [\"world\", 3] (layer names or numbers 1-{kind.Count}); a bare number is ambiguous, write [3]"),
            };
            long mask = 0;
            foreach (var entry in entries) mask |= Bit(Layer(entry, kind, nameOf));
            long all = kind.Count >= 64 ? -1L : (1L << kind.Count) - 1;
            return (current & ~all) | mask;
        }

        /// <summary>The layer number an entry names: a layer name (exact, then case-insensitive), or a number 1…count.</summary>
        public static int Layer(object? entry, Kind kind, Func<int, string?> nameOf)
        {
            switch (entry)
            {
                case string text:
                {
                    var trimmed = text.Trim();
                    int? loose = null;
                    for (int layer = 1; layer <= kind.Count; layer++)
                    {
                        var name = nameOf(layer);
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) continue;
                        if (name == trimmed) return layer;
                        if (loose == null && string.Equals(name, trimmed, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) loose = layer;
                    }
                    if (loose is { } found) return found;
                    if (int.TryParse(trimmed, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var number)) return InRange(number, kind);
                    throw new ArgumentException($"no {kind.Name} layer named '{text}' ({Known(kind, nameOf)})");
                }
                case double or float or int or long:
                {
                    var number = Convert.ToDouble(entry, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    if (Math.Floor(number) == number) return InRange(number, kind);
                    goto default;
                }
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentException($"a {kind.Name} layer is a name or a number 1-{kind.Count}, not {entry ?? "null"}");
            }
        }

        private static int InRange(double layer, Kind kind)
        {
            if (!(layer >= 1 && layer <= kind.Count))
                throw new ArgumentException($"{kind.Name} layers are numbered 1-{kind.Count}, not {layer.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
            return (int)layer;
        }

        // The named layers ("1 world, 2 enemies"), for errors.
        private static string Known(Kind kind, Func<int, string?> nameOf)
        {
            var named = Enumerable.Range(1, kind.Count).Where(l => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameOf(l)))
                .Select(l => $"{l.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {nameOf(l)}").ToList();
            return named.Count == 0
                ? $"no {kind.Name} layer is named yet: use a number 1-{kind.Count}, or name one in the layers source"
                : $"named: {string.Join(", ", named)}; or a number 1-{kind.Count}";
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Settings/RqlLayers.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Layer names (Project Settings → Layer Names) and the <c>layerNames["…"]</c> map every Godot object with layer
    /// properties gets: <c>collision_layer</c> / <c>collision_mask</c> of physics objects, <c>visibility_layer</c> /
    /// <c>light_mask</c> of canvas items, <c>layers</c> / <c>cull_mask</c> of 3D visuals and cameras, <c>navigation_layers</c>,
    /// <c>avoidance_layers</c> … — any property carrying one of Godot's layer hints (<see cref="LayerNames"/>). The raw int
    /// properties stay as they are; the map reads and writes the same bits by name.
    /// </summary>
    public static class RqlLayers
    {
        /// <summary>Every layer of every kind (the <c>layers</c> source).</summary>
        public static List<RqlLayer> All() =>
            LayerNames.Kinds.SelectMany(k => Enumerable.Range(1, k.Count).Select(i => new RqlLayer(k, i))).ToList();

        /// <summary>The name of a layer (empty when unnamed).</summary>
        public static string NameOf(LayerNames.Kind kind, int layer) =>
            ProjectSettings.GetSetting(LayerNames.SettingName(kind.Name, layer), "").AsString();

        // The names of a kind's layers, each read once for one read or write.
        private static Func<int, string?> Namer(LayerNames.Kind kind)
        {
            var names = new string?[kind.Count + 1];
            return layer => names[layer] ??= NameOf(kind, layer);
        }

        /// <summary>The layer properties of <paramref name="o"/> (layer-hinted ints), by name.</summary>
        public static IEnumerable<string> Properties(GodotObject o) =>
            GodotVariants.Properties(o).Where(kv => IsLayer(kv.Value, out _)).Select(kv => kv.Key);

        private static bool IsLayer(GodotVariants.GodotProperty info, out LayerNames.Kind kind)
        {
            kind = default;
            return info.Type == Variant.Type.Int && LayerNames.TryKindOf(info.Hint, out kind);
        }

        private static bool TryKind(GodotObject o, string property, out LayerNames.Kind kind)
        {
            kind = default;
            return GodotVariants.Properties(o).TryGetValue(property, out var info) && IsLayer(info, out kind);
        }

        /// <summary>The layers set in a layer property, by name (number when unnamed); null for any other key.</summary>
        public static List<string>? Read(GodotObject o, string property) =>
            TryKind(o, property, out var kind) ? LayerNames.Names(o.Get(property).AsInt64(), kind, Namer(kind)) : null;

        /// <summary>Why <paramref name="value"/> cannot be written to <paramref name="property"/>, or null.</summary>
        public static string? Validate(GodotObject o, string property, object? value)
        {
            if (!TryKind(o, property, out var kind))
            {
                var keys = Properties(o).ToList();
                return keys.Count == 0
                    ? $"{o.GetClass()} has no layer properties"
                    : $"'{property}' is not a layer property of {o.GetClass()} (its layer properties: {string.Join(", ", keys)})";
            }
            try { LayerNames.Mask(value, 0, kind, Namer(kind)); return null; }
            catch (ArgumentException ex) { return ex.Message; }
        }

        /// <summary>Set a layer property to the layers <paramref name="value"/> lists (names or numbers).</summary>
        public static void Write(GodotObject o, string property, object? value)
        {
            if (!TryKind(o, property, out var kind)) throw new ArgumentException(Validate(o, property, value));
            o.Set(property, LayerNames.Mask(value, o.Get(property).AsInt64(), kind, Namer(kind)));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One layer of the project: its kind, number and name (writable: renames it in project.godot).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlLayer : IRqlViewOf
    {
        private readonly LayerNames.Kind _kind;

        public RqlLayer(LayerNames.Kind kind, int index) { _kind = kind; this.index = index; }

        GodotObject IRqlViewOf.Owner => RqlProject.Instance;

        [RqlDescription("2d_render, 2d_physics, 2d_navigation, 3d_render, 3d_physics, 3d_navigation or avoidance")]
        public string kind => _kind.Name;

        [RqlDescription("layer number (1-based, like the inspector)")]
        public int index { get; }

        [RqlDescription("its bit in a layer mask (1 << (index - 1))")]
        public long bit => LayerNames.Bit(index);

        [RqlDescription("the layer's name (\"\" when unnamed); set it to rename the layer")]
        public string name
        {
            get => RqlLayers.NameOf(_kind, index);
            set => RqlProject.Set(setting, value ?? "");
        }

        [RqlDescription("the project setting holding the name, e.g. layer_names/3d_physics/layer_2")]
        public string setting => LayerNames.SettingName(_kind.Name, index);
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Settings/RqlProject.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools;
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.Settings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A view row (input action, autoload) whose writes change a Godot object: the mutation hooks treat a write or call on
    /// the row as a change of <see cref="Owner"/>, so it gets the owner's undo snapshot and saving.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IRqlViewOf
    {
        GodotObject Owner { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The project settings (<c>project.godot</c>) behind the <c>project</c>, <c>settings</c>, <c>inputActions</c>,
    /// <c>autoloads</c> and <c>groups</c> sources. Every change goes through <see cref="ProjectSettings.SetSetting"/> on the
    /// ProjectSettings singleton, which the mutation hooks snapshot like any Godot object (one undo action, see
    /// <c>RqlGodot.Save.cs</c>) and then save to <c>project.godot</c>.
    /// </summary>
    public static class RqlProject
    {
        public const string InputPrefix = "input/";
        public const string AutoloadPrefix = "autoload/";
        public const string GlobalGroupPrefix = "global_group/";

        private static GodotObject? _instance;

        /// <summary>The ProjectSettings singleton object (one per process).</summary>
        public static GodotObject Instance => _instance != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_instance) ? _instance : _instance = Engine.GetSingleton("ProjectSettings");

        /// <summary>The method of the editor's autoload tab that re-reads <c>autoload/*</c> into the editor (the GDScript singletons).</summary>
        public const string UpdateAutoloadMethod = "update_autoload";

        /// <summary>
        /// The editor's Project Settings → Autoload tab (<c>EditorAutoloadSettings</c>), or null. Setting <c>autoload/*</c>
        /// alone does not register a singleton with the running editor: until its <c>update_autoload</c> runs, a script using
        /// the autoload fails to compile ("Identifier not found") in script-validate and the script editor.
        /// </summary>
        public static Node? EditorAutoloads()
        {
            // Looked up on each autoload change (rare) rather than cached: no editor node is held across a C# reload.
            var root = (Engine.GetMainLoop() as SceneTree)?.Root;
            var found = root?.FindChildren("*", "EditorAutoloadSettings", true, false).FirstOrDefault();
            return found != null && found.HasMethod(UpdateAutoloadMethod) ? found : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Whether <paramref name="o"/> is the ProjectSettings singleton (no native call for nodes and resources).</summary>
        public static bool Is(GodotObject o) => !(o is Node) && !(o is Resource) && o.GetInstanceId() == Instance.GetInstanceId();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ settings

        /// <summary>Every project setting the editor knows (built-in and custom), in the editor's order.</summary>
        public static List<RqlSetting> Settings() =>
            GodotVariants.Properties(Instance).Select(kv => new RqlSetting(kv.Key, kv.Value.Type)).ToList();

        /// <summary>Set (or create) a setting; a null value removes a custom setting (a built-in one returns to its default).</summary>
        public static void Set(string name, Variant value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) throw new ArgumentException("a setting name is required, e.g. \"application/config/name\"");
            if (name.IndexOf('/') <= 0) throw new ArgumentException($"'{name}' is not a setting path: settings are named \"section/key\", e.g. \"application/config/name\"");
            ProjectSettings.SetSetting(name, value);
        }

        /// <summary>The value of a setting, or null when there is none.</summary>
        public static object? Get(string name) => ProjectSettings.HasSetting(name) ? GodotVariants.ToClr(ProjectSettings.GetSetting(name)) : null;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ input map

        /// <summary>Every input action of the project (the built-in ui_* actions included).</summary>
        public static List<RqlInputAction> InputActions() =>
            SettingNames(InputPrefix).Select(n => new RqlInputAction(n.Substring(InputPrefix.Length))).ToList();

        public static RqlInputAction AddInputAction(string name, string[]? events, double? deadzone)
        {
            RequireName(name, "an input action");
            if (ProjectSettings.HasSetting(InputPrefix + name)) throw new ArgumentException($"input action '{name}' already exists");
            if (deadzone is { } dz) RequireDeadzone(dz);
            var list = new global::Godot.Collections.Array();
            foreach (var text in events ?? Array.Empty<string>()) list.Add(InputEvents.Make(text));
            var action = new global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary
            {
                ["deadzone"] = deadzone ?? InputEvents.DefaultDeadzone,
                ["events"] = list,
            };
            Set(InputPrefix + name, action);
            return new RqlInputAction(name);
        }

        public static void RemoveInputAction(string name)
        {
            RequireInputAction(name);
            // A built-in action (ui_*) has a default: erasing it lasts only until the editor restarts (project.godot never
            // held it), and the Input Map editor does not remove one either.
            if (Instance.PropertyGetRevert(InputPrefix + name).VariantType != Variant.Type.Nil)
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{name}' is a built-in input action and cannot be removed: set its events = [] to clear it, " +
                                            $"or project | call ClearSetting(\"{InputPrefix}{name}\") to restore its default");
            Set(InputPrefix + name, default);
        }

        internal static void RequireDeadzone(double value)
        {
            if (double.IsNaN(value) || value < 0 || value > 1)
                throw new ArgumentException($"deadzone must be between 0 and 1, got {value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
        }

        internal static string RequireInputAction(string name)
        {
            if (!ProjectSettings.HasSetting(InputPrefix + name))
                throw new ArgumentException($"no input action '{name}'" + RqlGodot.Similar(SettingNames(InputPrefix).Select(n => n.Substring(InputPrefix.Length)), name));
            return name;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ autoloads

        /// <summary>The project's autoloads, in load order.</summary>
        public static List<RqlAutoload> Autoloads() =>
            SettingNames(AutoloadPrefix).Select(n => new RqlAutoload(n.Substring(AutoloadPrefix.Length)))
                .OrderBy(a => a.order).ToList();

        public static RqlAutoload AddAutoload(string name, string path, bool singleton)
        {
            RequireName(name, "an autoload");
            if (!name.IsValidIdentifier())
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{name}' is not a valid autoload name (letters, digits and '_', not starting with a digit)");
            if (ProjectSettings.HasSetting(AutoloadPrefix + name)) throw new ArgumentException($"autoload '{name}' already exists");
            if (ClassDB.ClassExists(name)) throw new ArgumentException($"'{name}' is the name of a Godot class; an autoload cannot use it");
            if (RqlGodot.IsGlobalScriptClass(name))
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{name}' is a global script class (class_name); an autoload cannot use it");
            Set(AutoloadPrefix + name, AutoloadValue(RequireAutoloadPath(path), singleton));
            return new RqlAutoload(name);
        }

        public static void RemoveAutoload(string name) => Set(AutoloadPrefix + RequireAutoload(name), default);

        internal static string RequireAutoload(string name)
        {
            if (!ProjectSettings.HasSetting(AutoloadPrefix + name)) throw new ArgumentException($"no autoload '{name}'");
            return name;
        }

        internal static string RequireAutoloadPath(string path)
        {
            var p = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, nameof(path));
            if (!ScriptLang_.IsScriptExtension(p) && !ResPathNormalizer.IsScenePath(p))
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{p}' is not a script or scene (.gd, .cs, .tscn, .scn)");
            if (!FileAccess.FileExists(p)) throw new ArgumentException($"no file at '{p}'");
            return p;
        }

        internal static string AutoloadValue(string path, bool singleton) => (singleton ? "*" : "") + path;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ groups

        /// <summary>
        /// Every group used in the edited scene plus the project's global groups (Project Settings → Global Groups), by name.
        /// </summary>
        public static List<RqlGroup> Groups()
        {
            // One walk of the scene: each group gets its nodes.
            var groups = new SortedDictionary<string, List<Node>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var node in RqlGodot.AllNodes())
                foreach (var g in RqlGodot.GroupsOf(node))
                {
                    if (!groups.TryGetValue(g, out var members)) groups[g] = members = new List<Node>();
                    members.Add(node);
                }
            foreach (var n in SettingNames(GlobalGroupPrefix))
                if (!groups.ContainsKey(n.Substring(GlobalGroupPrefix.Length))) groups[n.Substring(GlobalGroupPrefix.Length)] = new List<Node>();
            return groups.Select(kv => new RqlGroup(kv.Key, kv.Value)).ToList();
        }

        public static void AddGlobalGroup(string name, string? description)
        {
            RequireGroupName(name);
            if (ProjectSettings.HasSetting(GlobalGroupPrefix + name)) throw new ArgumentException($"global group '{name}' already exists");
            Set(GlobalGroupPrefix + name, description ?? "");
        }

        public static void RemoveGlobalGroup(string name)
        {
            if (!ProjectSettings.HasSetting(GlobalGroupPrefix + name)) throw new ArgumentException($"no global group '{name}'");
            Set(GlobalGroupPrefix + name, default);
        }

        internal static void RequireGroupName(string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) throw new ArgumentException("a group name is required");
            if (name.IndexOf('/') >= 0) throw new ArgumentException($"a group name cannot contain '/': '{name}'");
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

        /// <summary>The names of the settings below <paramref name="prefix"/>, in the editor's order.</summary>
        internal static IEnumerable<string> SettingNames(string prefix) =>
            GodotVariants.Properties(Instance).Keys.Where(k => k.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal) && k.Length > prefix.Length);

        private static void RequireName(string name, string what)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) throw new ArgumentException($"{what} needs a name");
            if (name.IndexOf('/') >= 0 || name.IndexOf(':') >= 0 || name.IndexOf('"') >= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException($"{what} name cannot contain '/', ':' or '\"': '{name}'");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A project setting: its path, value (read-only here: write it with <c>project | set settings["…"] = …</c>) and type.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlSetting
    {
        private readonly Variant.Type _type;

        public RqlSetting(string name, Variant.Type type) { this.name = name; _type = type; }

        [RqlDescription("setting path, e.g. \"application/config/name\" (the section before the first '/')")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("first part of the path, e.g. \"application\"")]
        public string section => name.Substring(0, Math.Max(0, name.IndexOf('/')));

        [RqlDescription("current value; change it with project | set settings[\"<name>\"] = …")]
        public object? value => RqlProject.Get(name);

        [RqlDescription("Godot value type, e.g. \"Int\", \"String\", \"Vector2I\"")]
        public string type => _type.ToString();

        [RqlDescription("true when the value differs from the default (it is written to project.godot)")]
        public bool changed
        {
            get
            {
                var ps = RqlProject.Instance;
                return ps.PropertyCanRevert(name) && !RqlGodot.Same(ps.Get(name), ps.PropertyGetRevert(name));
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>An input action of the project: its deadzone and events (text, see <see cref="InputEventText"/>).</summary>
    public sealed class RqlInputAction : IRqlViewOf
    {
        public RqlInputAction(string name) { this.name = name; }

        GodotObject IRqlViewOf.Owner => RqlProject.Instance;

        [RqlDescription("action name, e.g. \"jump\" (ui_* are Godot's built-in actions)")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("true for Godot's built-in ui_* actions")]
        public bool builtIn => name.StartsWith("ui_", StringComparison.Ordinal);

        [RqlDescription("analog deadzone (0..1)")]
        public double deadzone
        {
            get => Action().TryGetValue("deadzone", out var d) ? d.AsDouble() : InputEvents.DefaultDeadzone;
            set
            {
                RqlProject.RequireDeadzone(value);
                var action = Action().Duplicate(true);
                action["deadzone"] = value;
                RqlProject.Set(RqlProject.InputPrefix + name, action);
            }
        }

        [RqlDescription("the events that trigger the action, e.g. [\"Key:W\", \"JoypadButton:A\"]; assign a list to replace them")]
        public List<string> events
        {
            get => Events().Select(InputEvents.Text).ToList();
            set => WriteEvents((value ?? new List<string>()).Select(InputEvents.Make));
        }

        [RqlCallable("add an input event, e.g. \"Key:Space\", \"Mouse:Left\", \"JoypadButton:A\", \"JoypadMotion:LeftX-\"; returns the events")]
        public List<string> AddEvent(string input)
        {
            var made = InputEvents.Make(input);
            var text = InputEvents.Text(made);
            var current = Events();
            if (current.Any(e => InputEventText.SameText(InputEvents.Text(e), text)))
                throw new ArgumentException($"input action '{name}' already has the event '{text}'");
            WriteEvents(current.Append(made));
            return events;
        }

        [RqlCallable("remove an input event by its text (as listed in events); returns the events")]
        public List<string> RemoveEvent(string input)
        {
            var current = Events();
            // The canonical text when the input is a valid event; otherwise (other kinds, or a listed key text the engine
            // cannot build back) the text as given, so every listed event can be removed by its text.
            var key = input;
            if (InputEventText.TryParse(input, out _, out _))
            {
                try { key = InputEvents.Text(InputEvents.Make(input)); }
                catch (ArgumentException) { }
            }
            var kept = current.Where(e => !InputEventText.SameText(InputEvents.Text(e), key)).ToList();
            if (kept.Count == current.Count)
                throw new ArgumentException($"input action '{name}' has no event '{input}' (it has: {string.Join(", ", current.Select(InputEvents.Text))})");
            WriteEvents(kept);
            return events;
        }

        [RqlCallable("remove this input action from the project")]
        public void Remove() => RqlProject.RemoveInputAction(name);

        private global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary Action()
        {
            RqlProject.RequireInputAction(name);
            var v = ProjectSettings.GetSetting(RqlProject.InputPrefix + name);
            return v.VariantType == Variant.Type.Dictionary ? v.AsGodotDictionary() : new global::Godot.Collections.Dictionary();
        }

        private List<InputEvent> Events() =>
            Action().TryGetValue("events", out var list) && list.VariantType == Variant.Type.Array
                ? list.AsGodotArray().Select(e => e.As<InputEvent>()).Where(e => e != null).ToList()
                : new List<InputEvent>();

        private void WriteEvents(IEnumerable<InputEvent> events)
        {
            var action = Action().Duplicate(false);
            var array = new global::Godot.Collections.Array();
            foreach (var e in events) array.Add(e);
            action["events"] = array;
            if (!action.ContainsKey("deadzone")) action["deadzone"] = InputEvents.DefaultDeadzone;
            RqlProject.Set(RqlProject.InputPrefix + name, action);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>An autoload (singleton) of the project.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlAutoload : IRqlViewOf
    {
        public RqlAutoload(string name) { this.name = name; }

        GodotObject IRqlViewOf.Owner => RqlProject.Instance;

        [RqlDescription("autoload name (the global name of the singleton)")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("res:// path of the script or scene it loads")]
        public string path
        {
            get => Raw().TrimStart('*');
            set => RqlProject.Set(RqlProject.AutoloadPrefix + name, RqlProject.AutoloadValue(RqlProject.RequireAutoloadPath(value), singleton));
        }

        [RqlDescription("true when it is a global variable (the \"Global Variable\" checkbox)")]
        public bool singleton
        {
            get => Raw().StartsWith("*", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            set => RqlProject.Set(RqlProject.AutoloadPrefix + name, RqlProject.AutoloadValue(path, value));
        }

        [RqlDescription("load order (lower loads first)")]
        public int order => ProjectSettings.GetOrder(RqlProject.AutoloadPrefix + name);

        [RqlCallable("remove this autoload from the project")]
        public void Remove() => RqlProject.RemoveAutoload(name);

        private string Raw() => ProjectSettings.GetSetting(RqlProject.AutoloadPrefix + RqlProject.RequireAutoload(name)).AsString();
    }

    /// <summary>A node group: the nodes of the edited scene in it, and its global-group entry when it has one.</summary>
    public sealed class RqlGroup
    {
        public RqlGroup(string name, List<Node> nodes) { this.name = name; this.nodes = nodes; }

        [RqlDescription("group name")]
        public string name { get; }

        [RqlDescription("nodes of the edited scene in the group")]
        public List<Node> nodes { get; }

        [RqlDescription("number of nodes of the edited scene in the group")]
        public int count => nodes.Count;

        [RqlDescription("true for a global group (Project Settings → Global Groups)")]
        public bool global => ProjectSettings.HasSetting(RqlProject.GlobalGroupPrefix + name);

        [RqlDescription("description of a global group, or null")]
        public string? description => global ? ProjectSettings.GetSetting(RqlProject.GlobalGroupPrefix + name).AsString() : null;
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/Skill_Rql.cs`:

/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Utils;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The <c>godot-rql</c> skill: the language, the editor operations, and — generated from the live engine — every source
    /// and function plus the guides that modules contribute. An extension that adds an RQL module (sources, adapters,
    /// <c>ctx.AddGuide</c>) therefore appears in this skill as soon as it is installed. The Godot counterpart of Unity-MCP's
    /// <c>unity-rql</c> skill.
    /// </summary>
    [AiSkillType]
    public static class Skill_Rql
    {
        public const string SkillId = "godot-rql";

        [AiSkill(SkillId,
@"How to read and change anything in the Godot editor with RQL (rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema): the query
language, operators, sources (scene nodes, resources, files, scenes, classes, console logs, editor state), editor
operations (add / duplicate / reparent / remove nodes, scenes, resource files, selection, play) and what installed
extensions add.")]
        public static string Markdown => MainThread.Instance.Run(Render);

        public static string Render()
        {
            var engine = RqlGodot.Engine;
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            // Plain strings, not verbatim ones: a line starting with '#' inside a verbatim string breaks the
            // ExportRelease build, where this file sits in a disabled #if TOOLS region the preprocessor still scans.
            sb.Append("# RQL — query and change the Godot editor\n\n")
              .Append("RQL is one pipeline language for the whole editor: find nodes and resources, read members and Godot properties, filter,\n")
              .Append("aggregate, and change them in one call. Prefer one precise query over many exploratory calls.\n\n")
              .Append("- `rql-query` — read-only queries, compact table results.\n")
              .Append("- `rql-mutate` — queries ending with `set` / `call`; all-or-nothing, undoable (Ctrl+Z), `dry_run: true` previews. Scene\n")
              .Append("  edits mark the scene unsaved (`editor | call SaveScene()` writes the `.tscn`); edited resource files are saved.\n")
              .Append("- `rql-schema` — sources and the node classes in the scene; `rql-schema(type)` lists one type's members, methods and\n")
              .Append("  Godot properties.\n\n")
              .Append("```bash\n")
              .Append("godot-cli run-tool rql-query --input '{\"query\": \"nodes | where name contains \\\"Enemy\\\" | select $ref name\"}'\n")
              .Append("godot-cli run-tool rql-mutate --input '{\"query\": \"nodes | where name == \\\"Player\\\" | set Visible = false\"}'\n")
              .Append("```\n\n")
              .Append("## Language\n\n```\n").Append(RqlGuide.Language).Append("\n```\n\n")
              .Append("## Examples\n\n```\n").Append(RqlGuide.QueryExampleText).Append("\n```\n\n")
              .Append("## Changing things (rql-mutate)\n\n```\n").Append(RqlGuide.MutateStages).Append(RqlGuide.MutateExamplesBlock).Append("```\n\n")
              .Append("## Sources\n\n| Source | What |\n|---|---|\n");
            foreach (var s in engine.Sources.Values.OrderBy(s => s.Name, System.StringComparer.Ordinal))
                sb.Append("| `").Append(s.Name).Append("` | ").Append(Cell(s.Description ?? "")).Append(" |\n");
            foreach (var f in engine.Functions.Keys.OrderBy(k => k, System.StringComparer.Ordinal))
                sb.Append("| `").Append(f).Append("(…)` | ").Append(Cell(engine.FunctionDescriptions.TryGetValue(f, out var d) ? d : "")).Append(" |\n");

            foreach (var g in engine.Guides)
                sb.Append("\n## ").Append(g.Key).Append("\n\n").Append(g.Value.Trim()).Append('\n');

            sb.Append("\n## Installed RQL modules\n\n");
            foreach (var m in engine.Modules)
                sb.Append("- `").Append(m.Module).Append('`').Append(m.Ok ? "" : " — failed: " + m.Error).Append('\n');
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private static string Cell(string text) => text.Replace("|", "\\|").Replace("\n", " ");
    }
}

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/ToolFormat/CompactText.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS

#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.ToolFormat
{
    /// <summary>JSON result (a ResponseCallTool built by the tool itself) → compact text: <c>key: value</c> lines, RQL-style literals, tables for lists of flat objects.</summary>
    internal sealed class CompactText
    {
        private static readonly char[] Separators = { '|', ',', '\n', '\r', '{', '}', '[', ']', '"', ':' };
        private static readonly char[] RowBreakers = { '|', '\n', '\r' };

        private readonly ToolTextEscaping _escaping;

        public CompactText(ToolTextEscaping escaping) { _escaping = escaping; }

        public ToolTextEscaping Escaping => _escaping;

        /// <summary>
        /// The columns of <paramref name="items"/> when they are at least two objects whose values are all scalars (rows), in
        /// first-seen order, keeping the keys whose value passes <paramref name="keep"/>; null when they are not rows.
        /// </summary>
        public static List<string>? FlatColumns(IList<JsonNode?> items, Func<JsonNode?, bool> keep)
        {
            if (items.Count < 2 || !items.All(x => x is JsonObject xo && xo.All(kv => !(kv.Value is JsonObject) && !(kv.Value is JsonArray))))
                return null;
            var columns = new List<string>();
            foreach (var row in items.OfType<JsonObject>())
                foreach (var kv in row)
                    if (keep(kv.Value) && !columns.Contains(kv.Key)) columns.Add(kv.Key);
            return columns;
        }

        /// <summary>One cell of an "a|b" row: text bare unless it is empty or holds a row separator.</summary>
        public string RowCell(JsonNode? v) => v switch
        {
            null => "null",
            JsonValue jv when jv.GetValueKind() == JsonValueKind.String => jv.GetValue<string>() is var s && (s.Length == 0 || s.IndexOfAny(RowBreakers) >= 0)
                ? ToolText.Quote(s, _escaping) : s,
            _ => v.ToJsonString(),
        };

        public string Render(JsonNode? node)
        {
            if (node is JsonObject o && o.Count > 0)
            {
                var sb = new StringBuilder();
                foreach (var kv in o)
                {
                    if (IsEmpty(kv.Value)) continue;
                    if (sb.Length > 0) sb.Append('\n');
                    sb.Append(Key(kv.Key)).Append(':');
                    if (Table(kv.Value) is string table) sb.Append('\n').Append(table);
                    else sb.Append(' ').Append(Inline(kv.Value));
                }
                return sb.ToString();
            }
            return Table(node) ?? Inline(node);
        }

        /// <summary>A list of at least two objects whose values are all scalars, as <c>a | b</c> rows under a header.</summary>
        private string? Table(JsonNode? node)
        {
            if (!(node is JsonArray a) || !(FlatColumns(a, v => !IsEmpty(v)) is List<string> columns))
                return null;
            var sb = new StringBuilder(string.Join(" | ", columns.Select(Key)));
            foreach (var row in a.OfType<JsonObject>())
                sb.Append('\n').Append(string.Join(" | ", columns.Select(c => row.TryGetPropertyValue(c, out var v) && !IsEmpty(v) ? Inline(v) : "")));
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private string Inline(JsonNode? node)
        {
            switch (node)
            {
                case null: return "null";
                case JsonObject o:
                    return "{" + string.Join(", ", o.Where(kv => !IsEmpty(kv.Value)).Select(kv => Key(kv.Key) + ": " + Inline(kv.Value))) + "}";
                case JsonArray a:
                    return "[" + string.Join(", ", a.Select(Inline)) + "]";
                case JsonValue v when v.GetValueKind() == JsonValueKind.String:
                    var s = v.GetValue<string>();
                    var quoted = ToolText.Quote(s, _escaping);
                    return NeedsQuotes(s, quoted) ? quoted : s;
                default:
                    return node.ToJsonString();
            }
        }

        // Bare text unless it could be misread (empty, separators, a number / keyword look-alike, surrounding spaces) or the
        // configured escaping has to escape something in it.
        private static bool NeedsQuotes(string s, string quoted) =>
            s.Length == 0 || s.Trim() != s || s.IndexOfAny(Separators) >= 0 ||
            s == "null" || s == "true" || s == "false" || double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out _) ||
            quoted.Length != s.Length + 2;

        private string Key(string key) =>
            key.Length > 0 && (char.IsLetter(key[0]) || key[0] == '_' || key[0] == '$') && key.All(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_' || c == '$')
                ? key : ToolText.Quote(key, _escaping);

        private static bool IsEmpty(JsonNode? v) => v == null || (v is JsonArray a && a.Count == 0) || (v is JsonObject o && o.Count == 0);
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/ToolFormat/RqlToolBinding.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS

#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Threading;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Connection;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin.Common.Model;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model;
using Rql;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.ToolFormat
{
    /// <summary>
    /// RQL is the data layer of every tool (McpPlugin <see cref="IToolBinding"/>), in place of ReflectorNet (mirrors
    /// Unity-MCP's RqlToolBinding). One type model, one set of adapters and one literal syntax for rql-query / rql-mutate and for every
    /// other tool:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>schema: simple parameters (text, number, bool, enum, lists of those) are plain JSON schema; every other parameter
    /// is an RQL value given as text, its type described once per tool from RQL's type model and adapters;</item>
    /// <item>arguments: evaluated by RQL (literals, <c>ref("Node3D#12")</c>, <c>godot.find("Name")</c>) and coerced with
    /// the same rules as <c>set</c>;</item>
    /// <item>results: returned values are shown as RQL query results; JSON results as compact text.</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class RqlToolBinding : IToolBinding
    {
        public static readonly RqlToolBinding Instance = new RqlToolBinding();

        /// <summary>
        /// Install the data layer the configuration asks for on <paramref name="tools"/>: <see cref="ToolPresentationFormat.Rql"/>
        /// = this binding, <see cref="ToolPresentationFormat.Json"/> = none (ReflectorNet).
        /// </summary>
        public static void Apply(IToolManager? tools, ToolPresentationFormat format, ToolTextEscaping escaping)
        {
            Instance.Escaping = escaping;
            if (tools == null) return;
            if (format == ToolPresentationFormat.Rql) Instance.Prebuild(tools);
            tools.ToolBinding = format == ToolPresentationFormat.Rql ? Instance : null;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Build every tool's signature now, on the calling (main) thread, before the binding is installed. McpPlugin asks
        /// for a signature inside a locked Lazy, and building one waits for the main thread: a tools/list on a background
        /// thread would otherwise hold that lock while the main thread (a tools window reading the schema) waits on it.
        /// Prebuilt signatures come from the cache without touching the main thread.
        /// </summary>
        private void Prebuild(IToolManager tools)
        {
            foreach (var tool in tools.GetAllTools())
                if (tool is RunTool run && run.Method != null)
                {
                    // The class member is ReflectorNet's description, the one McpPlugin passes. A failure here is left to
                    // McpPlugin's guarded Describe (it logs and keeps ReflectorNet's signature for that tool).
                    try { Describe(run.Name, run.Method, run.Description); }
                    catch (Exception) { }
                }
        }

        private CompactText _compact = new CompactText(ToolTextEscaping.Minimal);

        /// <summary>How quoted text in results is escaped (Minimal keeps non-ASCII and most characters as they are).</summary>
        public ToolTextEscaping Escaping
        {
            get => _compact.Escaping;
            set { if (value != _compact.Escaping) _compact = new CompactText(value); }
        }

        private const string TypesHeader =
            "Argument types — give these arguments as RQL values (as in rql-mutate): {key: value, …}, [a, b], \"text\", 1.5, true, " +
            "ref(\"Node3D#12\") from a query result, godot.find(\"Name\"); leave out keys you do not need:";

        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<MethodInfo, ToolSignature> _signatures = new ConcurrentDictionary<MethodInfo, ToolSignature>();

        /// <summary>
        /// The engine the binding evaluates arguments and presents results with. The editor assigns it at install
        /// (<c>RqlGodot.Engine</c>); tests assign a plain engine. Kept a delegate so this file stays pure-managed.
        /// </summary>
        public static Func<RqlEngine>? EngineProvider { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Runs a callback on the Godot main thread (Godot objects are touched while building schemas, evaluating
        /// arguments and presenting results). The editor assigns ReflectorNet's MainThread; null = run inline (tests).
        /// </summary>
        public static Func<Func<object?>, object?>? MainThreadRunner { get; set; }

        private static RqlEngine Engine => (EngineProvider ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("RQL engine is not installed"))();

        private static T OnMain<T>(Func<T> f) => MainThreadRunner == null ? f() : (T)MainThreadRunner(() => f())!;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ schema

        public ToolSignature? Describe(string toolName, MethodInfo method, string? description) =>
            _signatures.GetOrAdd(method, m => OnMain(() => Build(m, description)));

        /// <summary>Forget cached signatures (after modules / adapters change).</summary>
        public void Reset()
        {
            _signatures.Clear();
        }

        private ToolSignature Build(MethodInfo method, string? description)
        {
            var writer = new TypeWriter(Engine);
            var properties = new JsonObject();
            var required = new JsonArray();
            foreach (var p in AgentParameters(method))
            {
                var nullable = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(p.ParameterType) != null;
                var text = (p.GetCustomAttribute<RqlArgumentAttribute>()?.Description ?? p.GetCustomAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>()?.Description)?.Trim();
                var schema = Simple(p.ParameterType);
                if (schema == null)
                {
                    schema = new JsonObject { ["type"] = "string" };
                    text = (text == null ? "" : text + " ") + "RQL: " + writer.Ref(p.ParameterType);
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) schema["description"] = text;
                properties[p.Name!] = schema;
                if (!p.HasDefaultValue && !p.IsOptional && !nullable) required.Add(p.Name);
            }
            var block = writer.Block();
            foreach (var kv in properties)
                if (kv.Value is JsonObject schema && schema["description"] is JsonValue d && d.TryGetValue<string>(out var text))
                    schema["description"] = writer.Resolve(text);
            var input = new JsonObject { ["type"] = "object", ["properties"] = properties };
            if (required.Count > 0) input["required"] = required;
            var full = block.Length == 0 ? description : string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description) ? block : description!.TrimEnd() + "\n\n" + block;
            return new ToolSignature(full, input, outputSchema: null);
        }

        private static IEnumerable<ParameterInfo> AgentParameters(MethodInfo method) =>
            method.GetParameters().Where(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<RequestIDAttribute>() == null && p.ParameterType != typeof(CancellationToken));

        private enum Scalar { None, Text, Bool, Enum, Int, Float }

        /// <summary>The scalar kind of <paramref name="t"/> (already unwrapped from Nullable), shared by the schema and the type text.</summary>
        private static Scalar ScalarOf(Type t)
        {
            if (t == typeof(string) || t == typeof(char)) return Scalar.Text;
            if (t == typeof(bool)) return Scalar.Bool;
            if (t.IsEnum) return Scalar.Enum;
            switch (Type.GetTypeCode(t))
            {
                case TypeCode.Byte: case TypeCode.SByte: case TypeCode.Int16: case TypeCode.UInt16:
                case TypeCode.Int32: case TypeCode.UInt32: case TypeCode.Int64: case TypeCode.UInt64:
                    return Scalar.Int;
                case TypeCode.Single: case TypeCode.Double: case TypeCode.Decimal:
                    return Scalar.Float;
                default:
                    return Scalar.None;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Plain JSON schema for text, numbers, bools, enums and lists of those; null for anything else.</summary>
        private static JsonObject? Simple(Type t)
        {
            t = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(t) ?? t;
            switch (ScalarOf(t))
            {
                case Scalar.Text: return new JsonObject { ["type"] = "string" };
                case Scalar.Bool: return new JsonObject { ["type"] = "boolean" };
                case Scalar.Enum: return new JsonObject { ["type"] = "string", ["enum"] = new JsonArray(Enum.GetNames(t).Select(n => (JsonNode)JsonValue.Create(n)!).ToArray()) };
                case Scalar.Int: return new JsonObject { ["type"] = "integer" };
                case Scalar.Float: return new JsonObject { ["type"] = "number" };
            }
            var element = t.IsArray ? t.GetElementType() : t.IsGenericType && t.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(List<>) ? t.GetGenericArguments()[0] : null;
            return element != null && Simple(element) is JsonObject item ? new JsonObject { ["type"] = "array", ["items"] = item } : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Types of one tool as RQL text: inline refs plus a block that describes each named type once.</summary>
        private sealed class TypeWriter
        {
            private readonly RqlEngine _engine;
            private readonly List<Type> _named = new List<Type>();
            private readonly Dictionary<Type, string> _names = new Dictionary<Type, string>();

            public TypeWriter(RqlEngine engine) { _engine = engine; }

            public string Ref(Type t, int depth = 0)
            {
                t = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(t) ?? t;
                if (depth > 8) return "any";
                switch (ScalarOf(t))
                {
                    case Scalar.Text: return "string";
                    case Scalar.Bool: return "bool";
                    case Scalar.Enum: return string.Join("|", Enum.GetNames(t));
                    case Scalar.Int: return "int";
                    case Scalar.Float: return "float";
                }
                if (t == typeof(object) || t == typeof(JsonElement) || t == typeof(JsonNode)) return "any";
                var info = _engine.Types.Info(t);
                if (info.Description == null)
                {
                    if (info.Kind == TypeKind.List && info.ElementType != null) return "[" + Ref(info.ElementType, depth + 1) + "]";
                    if (info.Kind == TypeKind.Map && info.ElementType != null) return "{" + Ref(info.KeyType ?? typeof(string), depth + 1) + ": " + Ref(info.ElementType, depth + 1) + "}";
                }
                if (!_named.Contains(t)) _named.Add(t);
                if (info.Description == null && !typeof(global::Godot.GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t))
                    foreach (var m in Writable(info)) Ref(m.Type, depth + 1); // name the member types too
                return Placeholder(t);
            }

            // Names are final only when every type is known (clashes rename all types involved): refs use a placeholder.
            private static string Placeholder(Type t) => "\u0001" + t.AssemblyQualifiedName + "\u0002";

            private static IEnumerable<MemberAccessor> Writable(global::Rql.Execution.TypeInfo info) => info.Members.Where(m => m.CanWrite && !m.ExplicitOnly);

            public string Block()
            {
                var assigned = TypeNames.Assign(_named.Select(TypeNames.FullName));
                foreach (var t in _named) _names[t] = assigned[TypeNames.FullName(t)];
                if (_named.Count == 0) return "";
                var sb = new StringBuilder(TypesHeader).Append('\n');
                foreach (var t in _named.ToList())
                {
                    var info = _engine.Types.Info(t);
                    sb.Append(_names[t]);
                    if (info.Description != null) sb.Append(" — ").Append(info.Description);
                    else if (typeof(global::Godot.GodotObject).IsAssignableFrom(t))
                        sb.Append(" — ref(\"").Append(info.ShortName).Append("#12\") from a query")
                          .Append(typeof(global::Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(t) ? ", godot.find(\"Name\") or a node path \"Root/Child\"" : "")
                          .Append(typeof(global::Godot.Resource).IsAssignableFrom(t) ? " or a resource path \"res://…\"" : "");
                    else
                    {
                        sb.Append(" {").Append(string.Join(", ", Writable(info).Select(m =>
                        {
                            var part = m.Name + " " + Ref(m.Type, 1);
                            var d = m.Description ?? m.Member?.GetCustomAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>()?.Description;
                            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(d) ? part : part + " (" + d!.Trim() + ")";
                        }))).Append('}');
                        var typeDescription = t.GetCustomAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>()?.Description;
                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(typeDescription)) sb.Append(" — ").Append(typeDescription!.Trim());
                    }
                    sb.Append('\n');
                }
                return Resolve(sb.ToString().TrimEnd());
            }

            /// <summary>Text with final type names in place of the placeholders (names are final after <see cref="Block"/>).</summary>
            public string Resolve(string text)
            {
                foreach (var kv in _names) text = text.Replace(Placeholder(kv.Key), kv.Value);
                // A type first met while writing the block (beyond the discovery depth): its plain short name.
                return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(text, "\u0001([^\u0002]*)\u0002",
                    m => Type.GetType(m.Groups[1].Value) is Type t ? TypeModel.FriendlyName(t) : "any");
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ arguments

        public bool TryConvert(MethodInfo method, ParameterInfo parameter, JsonElement value, out object? converted)
        {
            converted = null;
            var type = parameter.ParameterType;
            var target = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) ?? type;
            if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null || value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Undefined)
            {
                if (type.IsValueType && Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) == null) return false;
                return true;
            }
            if (target == typeof(string))
            {
                converted = value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? value.GetString() : value.GetRawText();
                return true;
            }
            // A JSON string carries RQL text ("3", "Front", "{a: 1}", "ref(\"Node3D#12\")"); other JSON is RQL already.
            var text = value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? value.GetString() ?? "" : value.GetRawText();
            object? result = null;
            string? error = null;
            var ok = OnMain(() =>
                Engine.TryEvaluateValue(text, target, out result, out error)
                // Not an expression (e.g. "Root/Lamp" reads as a division): the text itself is the value.
                || (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String && Engine.TryEvaluateValue(JsonSerializer.Serialize(text), target, out result, out _)));
            if (!ok)
                throw new ArgumentException($"'{parameter.Name}': {error}. Expected {OnMain(() => TypeText(target))}");
            converted = result;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>One type as the agent sees it in a tool's schema (for error messages).</summary>
        private static string TypeText(Type type)
        {
            var writer = new TypeWriter(Engine);
            var inline = writer.Ref(type);
            var block = writer.Block();
            var name = writer.Resolve(inline);
            var line = block.Split('\n').Skip(1).FirstOrDefault(l => l.StartsWith(name + " ", StringComparison.Ordinal));
            return line ?? name;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ results

        public ResponseCallTool? Result(MethodInfo method, object? value)
        {
            switch (value)
            {
                case null:
                    return null;
                case ResponseCallTool response:
                    if (response.StructuredContent == null) return null;
                    var node = response.StructuredContent is JsonObject o && o.Count == 1 && o.ContainsKey("result") ? o["result"] : response.StructuredContent;
                    response.StructuredContent = null;
                    response.Content = new List<ContentBlock> { Text(_compact.Render(node)) };
                    return response;
                case string s:
                    return ResponseCallTool.Success(s);
                case SerializedMember member:
                    return ResponseCallTool.Success(Render(member));
                case ScriptExecuteResult script:
                    // script-execute: the value as a member, then what the code printed.
                    var shown = script.Text ?? (script.Result != null ? Render(script.Result) : "null");
                    if (script.Logs is { Count: > 0 } logs)
                        shown += "\nlogs:\n" + string.Join("\n", logs);
                    return ResponseCallTool.Success(shown);
                default:
                    return OnMain(() =>
                    {
                        var presented = Engine.Present(value);
                        // A value RQL could not present is reported as an error, not as success with error text.
                        if (!presented.Ok) return ResponseCallTool.Error(Show(presented));
                        // One object (not a list) reads as the object itself, without a "1 result" header.
                        return ResponseCallTool.Success(Engine.Types.Info(value.GetType()).Kind != TypeKind.List && presented.Items is { Count: 1 } one
                            ? AgentFormat.Cell(one[0])
                            : Show(presented));
                    });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// A presented value as text: a list of flat objects as rows ("2 results / name|count / a|1 …", like rql-query
        /// output, keys once instead of on every line); anything else in RQL's agent format.
        /// </summary>
        internal string Show(QueryResult r)
        {
            if (r.Ok && r.Items is { } items && CompactText.FlatColumns(items, v => v != null) is List<string> columns)
            {
                // One column would read like a list of plain values: keep the "{k:v}" item lines then.
                if (columns.Count < 2) return AgentFormat.Render(r, OutputFormat.Table);
                var sb = new StringBuilder();
                sb.Append(items.Count).Append(" results");
                if (r.Total is long total && total > items.Count) sb.Append(" (of ").Append(total).Append(')');
                sb.Append('\n').Append(string.Join("|", columns));
                foreach (var row in items.OfType<JsonObject>())
                    sb.Append('\n').Append(string.Join("|", columns.Select(c => row.TryGetPropertyValue(c, out var v) ? _compact.RowCell(v) : "")));
                return sb.ToString();
            }
            return AgentFormat.Render(r, OutputFormat.Table);
        }

        private static ContentBlock Text(string text) => new ContentBlock { Type = com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin.Common.Consts.ContentType.Text, Text = text };

        /// <summary>A ReflectorNet SerializedMember result: "System.Int32: 42"; nested fields / properties as compact text.</summary>
        private string Render(SerializedMember member)
        {
            var value = member.valueJsonElement is JsonElement e && e.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Undefined ? JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(e) : null;
            var text = member.typeName + ": " + _compact.Render(value);
            if (member.fields is { Count: > 0 } || member.props is { Count: > 0 })
            {
                var nested = new JsonObject();
                foreach (var f in (member.fields ?? new SerializedMemberList()).Concat(member.props ?? new SerializedMemberList()))
                    nested[f.name ?? "?"] = f.valueJsonElement is JsonElement fe ? JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(fe) : null;
                text += "\n" + _compact.Render(nested);
            }
            return text;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/ToolFormat/TypeNames.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS

#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Editor.Rql.ToolFormat
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Short, unique display names for the types one tool describes. A type gets its short name ("Settings") unless another
    /// type of the same tool shares it; then every type in that clash keeps as many trailing namespace segments as it takes to
    /// tell them apart ("Alpha.Settings", "Beta.Settings"), independent of the order they appear in. Generic arguments are
    /// shortened the same way and written as &lt;…&gt;: "Wrapper(Game.Item)" → "Wrapper&lt;Item&gt;".
    /// </summary>
    internal static class TypeNames
    {
        public static Dictionary<string, string> Assign(IEnumerable<string> fullNames)
        {
            var keys = fullNames.Distinct().ToList();
            var result = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            var pending = keys;
            for (int depth = 1; pending.Count > 0 && depth <= 12; depth++)
            {
                var names = pending.ToDictionary(k => k, k => Display(k, depth));
                var taken = new HashSet<string>(result.Values);
                var clashing = new HashSet<string>(names.GroupBy(kv => kv.Value).Where(g => g.Count() > 1).SelectMany(g => g.Select(kv => kv.Key)));
                foreach (var kv in names)
                    if (!clashing.Contains(kv.Key) && !taken.Contains(kv.Value))
                        result[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
                pending = pending.Where(k => !result.ContainsKey(k)).ToList();
            }
            foreach (var k in pending) result[k] = k; // identical displays at every depth: keep the full name
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The name with each identifier cut to its last <paramref name="depth"/> segments ('.', '+' nested, '-' ReflectorNet
        /// nested); ReflectorNet's generic form "A(B,C)" written as "A&lt;B, C&gt;".
        /// </summary>
        public static string Display(string fullName, int depth)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            var ident = new StringBuilder();
            void Flush()
            {
                if (ident.Length == 0) return;
                var segments = ident.ToString().Split('.', '+', '-');
                sb.Append(string.Join(".", segments.Skip(System.Math.Max(0, segments.Length - depth))));
                ident.Clear();
            }
            foreach (var c in fullName)
            {
                if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '+' || c == '-') { ident.Append(c); continue; }
                Flush();
                if (c == '(') sb.Append('<');
                else if (c == ')') sb.Append('>');
                else if (c == ',') sb.Append(", ");
            }
            Flush();
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The full name <see cref="Display"/> shortens: "Ns.Outer+Inner", generics "Ns.Box(Ns.Item)" (ReflectorNet's
        /// generic notation). Only feeds the binding's display names; nothing looks a type up by it, so it need not equal
        /// ReflectorNet's <c>TypeUtils.GetTypeId</c> (which also sanitizes and rewrites nested generic names).
        /// </summary>
        public static string FullName(System.Type type)
        {
            if (type.IsArray) return FullName(type.GetElementType()!) + "[]";
            var name = (type.IsGenericType ? type.GetGenericTypeDefinition().FullName : type.FullName) ?? type.Name;
            var tick = name.IndexOf('`');
            if (tick >= 0) name = name.Substring(0, tick);
            return type.IsGenericType ? name + "(" + string.Join(",", type.GetGenericArguments().Select(FullName)) + ")" : name;
        }
    }
}
#endif
```

`addons/godot_mcp/Editor/SessionLease.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin.AgentConfig;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The CLI's editor-session lease, <c>&lt;project&gt;/.ai-game-dev/session.json</c> (written by
    /// <c>@baizor/gamedev-cli-core</c> EditorSession when it starts an editor, with the same nonce in
    /// <c>AIGD_SESSION_NONCE</c>). The editor removes it when it exits, but only its own: a lease with another
    /// nonce belongs to another editor. Pure-managed.
    /// </summary>
    public static class SessionLease
    {
        public static string PathFor(string projectRoot) => Path.Combine(projectRoot, ProjectMarker.DirectoryName, "session.json");

        /// <summary>Delete the lease when its nonce is <paramref name="nonce"/>. Never throws; true when deleted.</summary>
        public static bool DeleteIfOwned(string projectRoot, string? nonce)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nonce))
                return false;
            var path = PathFor(projectRoot);
            try
            {
                if (!File.Exists(path))
                    return false;
                using (var document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path)))
                {
                    if (!document.RootElement.TryGetProperty("nonce", out var value)
                        || value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String
                        || !string.Equals(value.GetString(), nonce, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                        return false;
                }
                File.Delete(path);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return false; // unreadable or concurrently replaced: leave it to the CLI's stale-lease check
            }
        }
    }
}
```
