/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
// script-execute: the editor, a game built with the in-game opt-in (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), and the xUnit suite.
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec;
using SerializedMember = com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model.SerializedMember;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The pure-managed half of <c>script-execute</c> (no Godot API, so it is unit-testable): mode detection, where the
    /// game assembly lives on disk, which results must be flattened before their snippet unloads, and error text.
    /// Mirrors Unity-MCP's Script.Execute.cs.
    /// </summary>
    public static class ScriptExecuteSource
    {
        /// <summary>Room for compiling and answering between the end of a snippet's time budget and the server's tool timeout.</summary>
        public const int ToolTimeoutMarginMs = 60_000;

        /// <summary>
        /// How long one script-execute call may take (ms): McpPlugin's default tool timeout (300 s, which the local server's
        /// <c>GodotMcpServerView.ToolTimeoutMs</c> keeps) minus <see cref="ToolTimeoutMarginMs"/>, so Code-Exec's guard stops an
        /// endless loop with a Timeout result before the server gives up on the call. It is the runner's <c>DefaultTimeoutMs</c>;
        /// each request gets what is left of it when its snippet starts (<see cref="RemainingRunTimeoutMs"/>), never 0 (since
        /// Code-Exec 0.4 that means the host default; before, no bound).
        /// </summary>
        public const int RunTimeoutMs = com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin.Common.Consts.Hub.DefaultToolTimeoutMs - ToolTimeoutMarginMs;

        /// <summary>
        /// The time budget of a snippet that starts <paramref name="elapsedMs"/> after its call arrived (compiling, waiting for the
        /// main thread or for an earlier snippet): the rest of <see cref="RunTimeoutMs"/>, at least 1 ms (0 would mean the default).
        /// </summary>
        public static int RemainingRunTimeoutMs(long elapsedMs) => (int)Math.Max(1, Math.Min(RunTimeoutMs, RunTimeoutMs - elapsedMs));

        /// <summary>Usings every snippet gets; Godot's namespace on top of Unity-MCP's System set.</summary>
        public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> DefaultUsings = new[]
        {
            "System", "System.Collections", "System.Collections.Generic", "System.Linq", "System.Threading.Tasks", "Godot",
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// Full mode when the code declares class <paramref name="className"/> (namespace-qualified or not) with a static
        /// method <paramref name="methodName"/>: returns its runtime type name. Null = run the code as a snippet.
        /// Code with top-level statements is always a snippet (its own helper types may reuse the name); code with only
        /// type declarations and none of them the entry point is an error, since as a snippet nothing would run.
        /// </summary>
        public static string? FullSourceEntryType(string code, string className, string methodName)
        {
            // Parsed as a script, the way the snippet writer reads it: anything but a type or namespace is snippet code.
            var script = (CompilationUnitSyntax)CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(code, ScriptParseOptions).GetRoot();
            if (script.Members.Any(m => !(m is BaseNamespaceDeclarationSyntax || m is BaseTypeDeclarationSyntax || m is DelegateDeclarationSyntax)))
                return null;
            var declaresTypes = false;
            foreach (var type in script.DescendantNodes(n => n is CompilationUnitSyntax || n is BaseNamespaceDeclarationSyntax || n is TypeDeclarationSyntax)
                .OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())
            {
                declaresTypes = true;
                var fullName = RuntimeName(type);
                if (type.Identifier.Text != className && fullName != className)
                    continue;
                if (type.Members.OfType<MethodDeclarationSyntax>().Any(m => m.Identifier.Text == methodName && m.Modifiers.Any(SyntaxKind.StaticKeyword)))
                    return fullName;
                throw new Exception($"Class '{className}' is declared, but it has no static method '{methodName}'.");
            }
            if (!declaresTypes)
                return null;
            throw new Exception($"'csharpCode' declares no class '{className}' and has no statements to run. " +
                "Set 'className' / 'methodName' to the entry point, or write plain statements.");
        }

        // Tool text shared by the editor (Tool_Script.Execute) and the in-game (Tool_GameScript) script-execute.
        internal const string SkillSnippetModeTail =
            " Own `using` lines, local classes and functions are allowed; " +
            "`await` works. Usings for System, LINQ and Godot are already there; an unknown type name (also one of the game's own " +
            "classes) is imported automatically when exactly one namespace has it.\n" +
            "- **Full code**: when `csharpCode` declares class `className` with a static method `methodName`, that method runs.\n" +
            "- `isMethodBody=true` forces snippet mode.\n\n";
        internal const string SkillOutputAndUsings =
            "## Output\n\n" +
            "`result` holds the value (type name and serialized value; `Success` when nothing is returned). `logs` holds what " +
            "the code printed: `Console` always; `GD.Print`, `GD.PushWarning` / `GD.PushError` when the project builds with Godot.NET.Sdk 4.5+. " +
            "Both are capped (20000 characters each, 2000 per output line; the cut is noted): return a count, a summary or a slice " +
            "rather than a whole data set. A lazy sequence (LINQ query, iterator) is enumerated, at most 1000 items (one that never yields an item would block the editor).\n\n" +
            "## usings / include\n\n" +
            "- `usings`: extra namespaces, e.g. `[\"MyGame.Gameplay\"]`.\n";
        internal const string SkillParameters =
            "## Parameters\n\n" +
            "Parameters become the snippet's variables (or the method's arguments, in order); each has `name`, `typeName` and a value.";
        /// <summary>The csharpCode description after the tool's snippet example (editor and in-game tools).</summary>
        internal const string CodeDescriptionTail =
            " (System, LINQ and Godot are imported; the last expression is the result, so no ';' after it). " +
            "Full: 'using Godot;\\npublic class Script { public static int Main() { return 42; } }' (full code brings its own usings).";
        internal const string ClassNameDescription = "Full mode: the class whose static method runs (namespace-qualified or not).";
        internal const string MethodNameDescription = "Full mode: the static method to run.";
        internal const string ParametersDescription = "Parameters, each with 'name' and 'typeName': the snippet's variables or the method's arguments in order. " +
            "Leave empty when none.";
        internal const string IsMethodBodyDescription = "Force snippet mode even when the code declares 'className'.";
        internal const string UsingsDescription = "Extra namespaces for snippet mode, e.g. [\"MyGame.Gameplay\"].";

        static readonly CSharpParseOptions ScriptParseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, DocumentationMode.None, SourceCodeKind.Script);

        static string RuntimeName(TypeDeclarationSyntax type)
        {
            var name = type.Identifier.Text;
            for (var parent = type.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
            {
                if (parent is TypeDeclarationSyntax outer)
                    name = outer.Identifier.Text + "+" + name;
                else if (parent is BaseNamespaceDeclarationSyntax ns)
                    name = ns.Name + "." + name;
            }
            return name;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The folder snippet paths (<c>include</c>) are relative to: the Godot project when the process runs from an
        /// editor build (the editor itself, or a game started from it), else the folder of the game executable. An
        /// exported game has no project folder; its <c>res://</c> is inside the pack.
        /// </summary>
        public static string ProjectRoot(bool editorBuild, string globalizedResRoot, string executablePath)
        {
            if (editorBuild || string.IsNullOrEmpty(executablePath))
                return globalizedResRoot;
            return Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(executablePath)) ?? globalizedResRoot;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The DLL an assembly loaded from memory was built to. Godot loads the game assembly from a stream (empty
        /// <c>Location</c>), so snippets compile against <c>res://.godot/mono/temp/bin/&lt;configuration&gt;/&lt;name&gt;.dll</c>:
        /// the editor's own <c>Debug</c> build, else the newest configuration. Null when there is none.
        /// </summary>
        public static string? BuiltAssemblyPath(string binRoot, string? assemblyName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(assemblyName) || !Directory.Exists(binRoot))
                return null;
            var editorBuild = Path.Combine(binRoot, "Debug", assemblyName + ".dll");
            if (File.Exists(editorBuild))
                return editorBuild;
            return Directory.EnumerateDirectories(binRoot)
                .Select(dir => Path.Combine(dir, assemblyName + ".dll"))
                .Where(File.Exists)
                .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
                .FirstOrDefault();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// A type of the snippet's own assembly (or built from one, like <c>List&lt;SnippetType&gt;</c>). Such a result is
        /// turned into text: serializing it would cache the type and keep the snippet from unloading.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool IsSnippetType(Type type)
        {
            if (type.Assembly.FullName?.StartsWith(CodeRunner.SnippetAssemblyPrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal) == true)
                return true;
            if (type.HasElementType && type.GetElementType() is { } element)
                return IsSnippetType(element);
            return type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericArguments().Any(IsSnippetType);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Most characters of the result returned to the agent. Code-Exec bounds logs, errors and text values; the object
        /// this plugin's value converter returns is the one thing it cannot measure, so it is cut here with its limit.
        /// </summary>
        public const int MaxValueChars = OutputLimits.DefaultValueChars;
        /// <summary>Most items of a lazy sequence (LINQ query, iterator) enumerated for the result.</summary>
        public const int MaxSequenceItems = 1_000;

        /// <summary>Captured output (already bounded by Code-Exec) as lines: <c>message</c> for info, <c>level: message</c> otherwise.</summary>
        public static List<string> LogLines(IEnumerable<LogEntry> logs) =>
            logs.Select(l => l.Level == "info" ? l.Message : l.Level + ": " + l.Message).ToList();

        /// <summary>
        /// The result as returned: a value whose serialized form is longer than <see cref="MaxValueChars"/> becomes that form
        /// as text, clipped the way Code-Exec clips everything else (<c>... [truncated: N of M characters shown; hint]</c>).
        /// </summary>
        public static SerializedMember CapValue(SerializedMember member)
        {
            // A plain text value is measured and cut as text; anything else as its serialized form.
            string full;
            if (member.fields == null && member.props == null && member.valueJsonElement is { ValueKind: System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.String } element)
                full = element.GetString() ?? "";
            else
            {
                try { full = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(member, CapJson); }
                catch (Exception) { return member; } // not measurable as JSON: leave it to the transport
            }
            return full.Length <= MaxValueChars ? member : TextMember(member.name, member.typeName, CapText(full));
        }

        /// <summary><paramref name="text"/>, clipped to <see cref="MaxValueChars"/> the way Code-Exec clips its output.</summary>
        public static string CapText(string text) =>
            text.Length <= MaxValueChars ? text : OutputLimits.Clip(text, MaxValueChars, "return a count, a summary or a slice");

        /// <summary>A result member holding <paramref name="text"/> as its value.</summary>
        public static SerializedMember TextMember(string? name, string typeName, string? text) =>
            new SerializedMember { name = name, typeName = typeName }.SetJsonValue(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(text));

        static readonly System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions CapJson = new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions { IncludeFields = true };

        /// <summary>
        /// A lazy sequence: enumerable, but neither a string nor a collection (a LINQ query, an iterator). Its own members
        /// (Current, the source iterator) say nothing about its items, so it is enumerated first (<see cref="Materialize"/>).
        /// </summary>
        public static bool IsLazySequence(Type type) =>
            typeof(System.Collections.IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type)
            && type != typeof(string)
            && !typeof(System.Collections.ICollection).IsAssignableFrom(type)
            && !type.GetInterfaces().Any(i => i.IsGenericType && (i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(ICollection<>) || i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IReadOnlyCollection<>)));

        /// <summary>
        /// The first <see cref="MaxSequenceItems"/> items of a sequence (an endless one stops there, with a last item saying so),
        /// each passed through <paramref name="item"/> (the caller's per-value rules); items of the snippet's own types become
        /// their text, as a snippet-typed result does (<see cref="IsSnippetType"/>).
        /// </summary>
        public static List<object?> Materialize(System.Collections.IEnumerable sequence, Func<object?, object?>? item = null)
        {
            var items = new List<object?>();
            var e = sequence.GetEnumerator();
            try
            {
                // Past the cap only one more item is asked for, to tell whether the sequence has more.
                while (items.Count < MaxSequenceItems && e.MoveNext())
                {
                    var value = e.Current;
                    items.Add(value != null && IsSnippetType(value.GetType()) ? value.ToString() : item != null ? item(value) : value);
                }
                if (items.Count == MaxSequenceItems && e.MoveNext())
                    items.Add($"… (the first {MaxSequenceItems} items; the sequence has more)");
            }
            finally { (e as IDisposable)?.Dispose(); }
            return items;
        }

        // Godot value types the reflector has no converter for (it would print "{}"): their ToString text is the value.
        static readonly HashSet<string> GodotTextValues = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
        {
            "Godot.Basis", "Godot.Transform2D", "Godot.Transform3D", "Godot.Quaternion", "Godot.Aabb", "Godot.Rect2", "Godot.Rect2I",
            "Godot.Plane", "Godot.Projection", "Godot.Vector2I", "Godot.Vector3I", "Godot.Vector4", "Godot.Vector4I", "Godot.Rid",
            "Godot.StringName",
        };

        /// <summary>A Godot value returned as its text (e.g. a Basis as "[X: (1, 0, 0), Y: …]").</summary>
        public static bool IsGodotTextValue(Type type) => type.FullName != null && GodotTextValues.Contains(type.FullName);

        /// <summary>
        /// The error text of a failed run (error and output bounded by Code-Exec, at most 20 diagnostics): diagnostics in
        /// the snippet's coordinates, then auto-imports, what Code-Exec cut, and output.
        /// </summary>
        public static string Describe(ExecuteResult result)
        {
            var text = result.ErrorKind == ErrorKind.Compile
                ? "Compilation failed:\n" + string.Join("\n", result.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.ToString()))
                : $"Execution failed ({result.ErrorKind}): {result.Error}";
            if (result.AutoImported.Count > 0)
                text += "\nAuto-imported: " + string.Join(", ", result.AutoImported);
            if (result.Truncated.Count > 0)
                text += "\nTruncated: " + string.Join(", ", result.Truncated);
            if (result.Logs.Count > 0)
                text += "\nOutput:\n" + string.Join("\n", LogLines(result.Logs));
            return text;
        }
    }
}
#endif

│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │

// The editor and a game built with the in-game opt-in (GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec;
using com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec.Roslyn;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reflection;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Utils;
using Godot;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs <c>script-execute</c> on Code-Exec (NuGet <c>com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec</c> + the source-only Roslyn adapter),
    /// for the editor tool (<c>Tool_Script.Execute</c>) and the in-game one (<see cref="Tool_GameScript"/>).
    /// Compiles on the calling thread (MCP calls arrive off the main thread), runs on the Godot main thread. Each run is
    /// loaded into its own collectible context and unloaded afterwards, so the result is serialized before that.
    /// The runner lives in a static of THIS (reloadable) assembly and subscribes to nothing, so a C# rebuild drops it.
    /// </summary>
    static class ScriptExecutor
    {
        static CodeRunner? _runner;
        static readonly object _runnerLock = new object();

        // One snippet runs at a time: an awaiting snippet frees the main thread, and overlapping runs would interleave the
        // process-wide Console / engine-logger capture (Code-Exec runs must not overlap).
        static readonly SemaphoreSlim _runGate = new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1);
        static int _inFlight;

        /// <summary>A call is compiling or running (an awaiting snippet neither moves the tool-call counter nor stalls frames).</summary>
        public static bool IsBusy => Volatile.Read(ref _inFlight) > 0;

        public static async Task<ScriptExecuteResult> Execute(string csharpCode, string className, string methodName,
            SerializedMemberList? parameters, bool isMethodBody, string[]? usings, string[]? include)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(csharpCode))
                throw new Exception("'csharpCode' is null or empty. Please provide valid C# code to execute.");

            Interlocked.Increment(ref _inFlight);
            try
            {
                return await Run(csharpCode, className, methodName, parameters, isMethodBody, usings, include);
            }
            finally
            {
                Interlocked.Decrement(ref _inFlight);
            }
        }

        static async Task<ScriptExecuteResult> Run(string csharpCode, string className, string methodName,
            SerializedMemberList? parameters, bool isMethodBody, string[]? usings, string[]? include)
        {
            // The time budget counts from the call's arrival: compiling and waiting for an earlier snippet use it up too.
            var arrived = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var runner = Runner();
            // Only the parameter TYPES are needed to compile; the values are deserialized on the main thread.
            var request = new ExecuteRequest
            {
                Code = csharpCode,
                Usings = usings ?? Array.Empty<string>(),
                Include = include ?? Array.Empty<string>(),
                Parameters = parameters?.Select((p, i) => new SnippetParameter(ParameterName(p, i), ParameterType(p, i), null)).ToList()
                    ?? (IReadOnlyList<SnippetParameter>)Array.Empty<SnippetParameter>(),
                TimeoutMs = ScriptExecuteSource.RunTimeoutMs,
            };
            if (!isMethodBody && ScriptExecuteSource.FullSourceEntryType(csharpCode, className, methodName) is { } entryType)
            {
                request.EntryType = entryType;
                request.EntryMethod = methodName;
            }
            var prepared = runner.Prepare(request);
            if (!prepared.Succeeded)
                throw new Exception(ScriptExecuteSource.Describe(runner.Run(prepared))); // a failed Prepare runs nothing

            // Awaits inside the snippet resume on the main thread (Godot's synchronization context).
            return await MainThread.Instance.RunAsync(() => RunOnMainThread(runner, request, prepared, parameters, arrived)).Unwrap();
        }

        static async Task<ScriptExecuteResult> RunOnMainThread(CodeRunner runner, ExecuteRequest request, PreparedSnippet prepared,
            SerializedMemberList? parameters, System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch arrived)
        {
            if (parameters != null)
            {
                var reflector = GodotMcpReflector.GetOrCreate();
                prepared = prepared.WithValues(parameters.Select(p => reflector.Deserialize(data: p)).ToList());
            }

            ExecuteResult result;
            await _runGate.WaitAsync();
            try
            {
                // Code-Exec reads the budget when the run starts (the prepared snippet holds this request).
                request.TimeoutMs = ScriptExecuteSource.RemainingRunTimeoutMs(arrived.ElapsedMilliseconds);
                result = await runner.RunAsync(prepared);
            }
            finally
            {
                _runGate.Release();
            }
            if (!result.Success)
                throw new Exception(ScriptExecuteSource.Describe(result));

            var converted = result.Value as ConvertedValue;
            return new ScriptExecuteResult
            {
                Result = converted?.Member ?? NoValue(result.ReturnType),
                Text = converted?.Text,
                Logs = result.Logs.Count > 0 ? ScriptExecuteSource.LogLines(result.Logs) : null,
            };
        }

        /// <summary>Typed null reports the result type; nothing returned (System.Void) reads "Success".</summary>
        static SerializedMember NoValue(string? returnType)
        {
            var member = new SerializedMember { name = JsonSchema.Result, typeName = returnType ?? JsonSchema.Object };
            return member.SetJsonValue(returnType == "System.Void" ? "\"Success\"" : "\"null\"");
        }

        static CodeRunner Runner()
        {
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _runner) is { } existing)
                return existing;
            // res:// resolves on the main thread; taking it outside the lock keeps a main-thread caller from waiting on us.
            var projectRoot = MainThread.Instance.Run(() => ScriptExecuteSource.ProjectRoot(
                OS.HasFeature("editor"), ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://"), OS.GetExecutablePath()));
            lock (_runnerLock)
                return _runner ??= Create(projectRoot);
        }

        static CodeRunner Create(string projectRoot)
        {
            // Only the editor build has it (an exported game loads its assemblies from files, so the fallback is unused there).
            var binRoot = Path.Combine(projectRoot, ".godot", "mono", "temp", "bin");
            // The default host binds snippets to the LIVE game assembly and GodotSharp (Code-Exec 0.2.1+), never to the
            // second copies GodotMcpAssemblyResolver would load into the default context; `Console` binds to System.Console
            // (not CoreLib's Internal.Console), so its output is captured.
            return new CodeRunner(new RoslynCSharpCompiler(), new CodeRunnerOptions
            {
                DefaultUsings = ScriptExecuteSource.DefaultUsings,
                IncludeRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(projectRoot, McpPlugin.AgentConfig.ProjectMarker.DirectoryName, "snippets")),
                // Godot loads the game assembly from memory: point the compiler at the DLL it was built to.
                References = new LoadedAssembliesReferenceProvider(assembly => ScriptExecuteSource.BuiltAssemblyPath(binRoot, assembly.GetName().Name)),
                ValueConverter = Serialize,
                LogCaptures = new List<ILogCapture> { new ConsoleLogCapture(), new GodotPrintLogCapture() },
                // Code-Exec's guards (recursion, loops) stop a runaway snippet with a Runtime / Timeout result instead of a stack
                // overflow that kills the editor or a loop that freezes it; the budget ends before the server's tool timeout.
                DefaultTimeoutMs = ScriptExecuteSource.RunTimeoutMs,
                ExecutionGuards = true,
            });
        }

        /// <summary>The serialized result and its compact text (null for a scalar), made before the snippet unloads.</summary>
        sealed record ConvertedValue(SerializedMember Member, string? Text);

        /// <summary>Runs on the main thread before the snippet unloads: nothing of the snippet may outlive this.</summary>
        static object? Serialize(object? value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return null;
            var type = value.GetType();
            if (value is GodotObject godotObject && !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(godotObject))
                return new ConvertedValue(Text(type, Freed(godotObject)), null);
            // A lazy sequence (LINQ query, iterator) would show the enumerator's state, not its items: enumerated once, its
            // text names the element type (the materialized list is a List<object>), the serialized form gets the item rules.
            string? text;
            if (ScriptExecuteSource.IsLazySequence(type))
            {
                var items = ScriptExecuteSource.Materialize((System.Collections.IEnumerable)value);
                text = CompactText(items, "IEnumerable<" + ScriptResultText.TypeName(ElementType(type)) + ">");
                value = items.Select(AsItem).ToList();
            }
            else
            {
                text = CompactText(value);
            }
            // Godot structs without a reflection converter (Basis, Transform3D …) and StringName serialize as "{}": their text.
            if (ScriptExecuteSource.IsSnippetType(type) || ScriptExecuteSource.IsGodotTextValue(type))
                return new ConvertedValue(Text(type, value.ToString()), text);
            var member = GodotMcpReflector.GetOrCreate().Serialize(obj: value);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.name))
                member.name = JsonSchema.Result;
            return new ConvertedValue(ScriptExecuteSource.CapValue(member), text);
        }

        // The RQL format's text of the value, capped like the serialized value; null for a scalar.
        static string? CompactText(object? value, string? typeName = null)
        {
            string? text;
            try { text = ScriptResultText.Format(value, EngineValueText, Unwrap, typeName); }
            catch (Exception) { return null; } // a member that cannot be read this way: the serialized form stays
            return text == null ? null : ScriptExecuteSource.CapText(text);
        }

        // A Variant (an item of a Godot collection) is read as the value it holds.
        static object? Unwrap(object value) => value is Variant v ? v.Obj : value;

        // The element type of a sequence (IEnumerable<T>), object when it has none.
        static Type ElementType(Type sequence) =>
            (sequence.IsGenericType && sequence.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IEnumerable<>) ? sequence : sequence.GetInterfaces()
                .FirstOrDefault(i => i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IEnumerable<>)))?.GetGenericArguments()[0] ?? typeof(object);

        // Nodes and resources the way rql-query prints them (Node3D#123(Geometry/Floor), PlaneMesh#45(res://m.tres)),
        // Godot structs by their text.
        static string? EngineValueText(object value)
        {
            switch (value)
            {
                case GodotObject o when !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o):
                    return Freed(o);
                case Node n:
                    return $"{n.GetClass()}#{n.GetInstanceId()}({(n.Owner != null && n.Owner.IsAncestorOf(n) ? n.Owner.GetPathTo(n).ToString() : n.Name.ToString())})";
                case Resource r:
                    return $"{r.GetClass()}#{r.GetInstanceId()}({r.ResourcePath})";
                case GodotObject o:
                    return $"{o.GetClass()}#{o.GetInstanceId()}";
                case StringName or NodePath:
                    return value.ToString();
            }
            // Every Godot struct (Vector3, Color, Basis …) by its text, not only the IsGodotTextValue ones: here the text is
            // the whole output, while the serialized form keeps the struct's members where it has a converter.
            var type = value.GetType();
            return type.IsValueType && type.Namespace == "Godot" ? value.ToString() : null;
        }

        static string Freed(GodotObject o) => $"<freed {o.GetType().Name}>";

        // An item of an enumerated sequence: the same text rules as a top-level value (a freed object, a Godot struct).
        static object? AsItem(object? item) => item switch
        {
            GodotObject o when !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(o) => Freed(o),
            not null when ScriptExecuteSource.IsGodotTextValue(item.GetType()) => item.ToString(),
            _ => item,
        };

        static SerializedMember Text(Type type, string? text) =>
            ScriptExecuteSource.CapValue(ScriptExecuteSource.TextMember(JsonSchema.Result, type.FullName ?? type.Name, text));

        static string ParameterName(SerializedMember parameter, int index) => parameter.name ?? $"param{index}";

        /// <summary>An unknown type name fails here, by name, instead of surfacing as an untyped <c>object</c> variable.</summary>
        static Type ParameterType(SerializedMember parameter, int index) =>
            string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameter.typeName)
                ? typeof(object)
                : TypeUtils.GetType(parameter.typeName)
                    ?? throw new Exception($"Parameter '{ParameterName(parameter, index)}': type '{parameter.typeName}' not found.");
    }
}
#endif

`addons/godot_mcp/Runtime/Tools/ScriptLang.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Godot's two first-class scripting languages, distinguished by file extension. <see cref="CSharp"/>
    /// (<c>.cs</c>) compiles into the project assembly (a build/reload is needed before a freshly-added
    /// type is usable); <see cref="GDScript"/> (<c>.gd</c>) is interpreted and re-parsed on load.
    /// </summary>
    public enum ScriptLang
    {
        CSharp,
        GDScript,
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Pure-string helpers shared by the script tool family (<c>script-*</c>): extension → language
    /// detection and <c>res://</c> script-path validation. Extracted from the editor-only
    /// (<c>#if TOOLS</c>) handlers — like <see cref="ResPathNormalizer"/> / <see cref="NodePathNormalizer"/>
    /// — so the extension/validation logic is unit-testable in the plain xUnit host with no live Godot
    /// scripting runtime.
    ///
    /// <para>
    /// A "script" here is a source file Godot recognizes as a <see cref="global::Godot.Script"/>: a C#
    /// (<c>.cs</c>) or GDScript (<c>.gd</c>) file under <c>res://</c>. The editor-side handlers additionally
    /// re-use <see cref="ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath"/> for the shared <c>res://</c> + <c>..</c>
    /// + bare-scheme guards; this class layers the language-specific extension contract on top.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    public static class ScriptLang_
    {
        public const string CSharpExtension = ".cs";
        public const string GDScriptExtension = ".gd";

        /// <summary>
        /// True when <paramref name="path"/> ends with a recognized script extension (<c>.cs</c> or
        /// <c>.gd</c>), case-insensitively. Does NOT validate the <c>res://</c> scheme — pair with
        /// <see cref="ResPathNormalizer.IsResPath"/> / <see cref="RequireScriptResPath"/> for that.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool IsScriptExtension(string? path)
            => TryGetLang(path, out _);

        /// <summary>
        /// Resolve a script file path to its <see cref="ScriptLang"/> by extension. Returns false (and
        /// <paramref name="lang"/> = <see cref="ScriptLang.CSharp"/> as an unused default) when the path
        /// has no recognized script extension.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool TryGetLang(string? path, out ScriptLang lang)
        {
            lang = ScriptLang.CSharp;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                return false;

            if (path!.EndsWith(CSharpExtension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                lang = ScriptLang.CSharp;
                return true;
            }
            if (path.EndsWith(GDScriptExtension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                lang = ScriptLang.GDScript;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The canonical lowercase extension (including the leading dot) for a language.
        /// </summary>
        public static string ExtensionFor(ScriptLang lang)
            => lang == ScriptLang.GDScript ? GDScriptExtension : CSharpExtension;

        /// <summary>
        /// Where a scene or resource file is read instead (agents reach for the script tools to read a .tscn / .tres), or empty
        /// for any other file.
        /// </summary>
        public static string NotAScriptHint(string path) => ReimportClassifier.ExtensionOf(path) switch
        {
            "tscn" or "scn" => " A scene is not a script: open it with rql-mutate editor | call OpenScene(\"" + path + "\"), then query its nodes " +
                               "with rql-query nodes | …, or read its text with script-execute (FileAccess.GetFileAsString).",
            "tres" or "res" => " A resource is not a script: query it with rql-query godot.resource(\"" + path + "\") | select props, or read " +
                               "its text with script-execute (FileAccess.GetFileAsString).",
            _ => "",
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// Validate that <paramref name="path"/> is a <c>res://</c> script file path (a file under
        /// <c>res://</c>, not the bare root or a directory, with no <c>..</c> segment, ending in
        /// <c>.cs</c>/<c>.gd</c>), throwing <see cref="ArgumentException"/> (with
        /// <paramref name="paramName"/>) otherwise. Returns the trimmed path and its detected language on
        /// success. Layers the script-extension contract on top of
        /// <see cref="ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath"/> so the two share one set of res:// guards.
        /// </summary>
        public static string RequireScriptResPath(string? path, string paramName, out ScriptLang lang)
        {
            var p = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, paramName);
            if (!TryGetLang(p, out lang))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    $"Script path must end with '{CSharpExtension}' (C#) or '{GDScriptExtension}' (GDScript); got '{path}'." + NotAScriptHint(p),
                    paramName);
            return p;
        }
    }
}

`addons/godot_mcp/Runtime/Tools/ScriptResultText.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
// script-execute: the editor, a game built with the in-game opt-in (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), and the xUnit suite.
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The compact text of a script-execute result in the RQL tool format, the vocabulary rql-query answers in:
    /// <c>Dictionary&lt;string, int&gt;: {a: 1, b: 2}</c>, <c>List&lt;Vector3&gt;: [(1, 2, 3)]</c>,
    /// <c>anonymous: {name: x, count: 3}</c>, a node as <c>Node3D#123(Geometry/Floor)</c>. ReflectorNet's form printed
    /// a dictionary's internals instead of its entries, a list as name/typeName/value tables and a node with the editor's
    /// own absolute path. Engine values (nodes, resources, Godot structs) are rendered by the caller's <c>special</c>
    /// function and engine wrappers (a Variant) unwrapped by its <c>unwrap</c> function. Pure managed: no Godot types
    /// (unit-tested).
    /// </summary>
    public static class ScriptResultText
    {
        /// <summary>Most items of a collection that are listed (the rest is counted).</summary>
        public const int MaxItems = 100;

        /// <summary>Most values rendered for one result; past it every value reads "…" (the text is clipped later anyway).</summary>
        public const int MaxValues = 5_000;

        const int MaxDepth = 4;
        const int MaxCounted = MaxItems * 100;

        /// <summary>
        /// "Type: value" for a value that is not a plain scalar, or null for a scalar / string (those keep the existing
        /// "System.Int32: 42" form). <paramref name="special"/> returns the text of an engine value, or null when it does not
        /// handle it; <paramref name="unwrap"/> returns the value an engine wrapper holds (or the value itself).
        /// <paramref name="typeName"/> replaces the value's own type name (a lazy sequence the caller enumerated).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? Format(object? value, Func<object, string?> special, Func<object, object?>? unwrap = null, string? typeName = null)
        {
            if (value == null || IsScalar(value.GetType())) return null;
            var walk = new Walk(special, unwrap ?? (o => o));
            return (typeName ?? TypeName(value.GetType())) + ": " + walk.Value(value, 0);
        }

        /// <summary>A C#-style type name: <c>List&lt;Vector3&gt;</c>, <c>Dictionary&lt;string, int&gt;</c>, <c>int[]</c>, <c>anonymous</c>.</summary>
        public static string TypeName(Type type)
        {
            if (IsAnonymous(type)) return "anonymous";
            if (type.IsArray) return TypeName(type.GetElementType()!) + "[]";
            if (Aliases.TryGetValue(type, out var alias)) return alias;
            if (typeof(ITuple).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type.IsGenericType)
                return "(" + string.Join(", ", type.GetGenericArguments().Select(TypeName)) + ")";
            var name = type.Name;
            var tick = name.IndexOf('`');
            if (tick >= 0) name = name.Substring(0, tick);
            return type.IsGenericType ? name + "<" + string.Join(", ", type.GetGenericArguments().Select(TypeName)) + ">" : name;
        }

        /// <summary>One result's rendering: the caller's hooks, the remaining value budget and per-type facts.</summary>
        sealed class Walk
        {
            readonly Func<object, string?> _special;
            readonly Func<object, object?> _unwrap;
            readonly Dictionary<Type, TypeFacts> _facts = new Dictionary<Type, TypeFacts>();
            int _budget = MaxValues;

            public Walk(Func<object, string?> special, Func<object, object?> unwrap)
            {
                _special = special;
                _unwrap = unwrap;
            }

            /// <summary>The value's text: collections as [..], maps and objects as {k: v}, tuples as (a, b).</summary>
            public string Value(object? value, int depth)
            {
                if (value != null) value = _unwrap(value);
                switch (value)
                {
                    case null: return "null";
                    case string s: return Quote(s);
                    case bool b: return b ? "true" : "false";
                    case char c: return Quote(c.ToString());
                    case Enum e: return e.ToString();
                    case IFormattable f when IsNumber(value.GetType()): return f.ToString(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                }
                if (_special(value) is { } text) return text;
                if (depth >= MaxDepth || --_budget < 0) return "…";
                var type = value.GetType();
                var facts = Facts(type);
                if (facts.Leaf) return Safe(value);
                if (value is ITuple tuple)
                    return "(" + string.Join(", ", Enumerable.Range(0, tuple.Length).Select(i => Value(tuple[i], depth + 1))) + ")";
                if (value is IEnumerable items)
                    return Items(value, items, facts, depth);
                if (facts.Members.Length == 0) return Safe(value);
                return "{" + string.Join(", ", facts.Members.Select(m => m.Name + ": " + Value(Read(m, value), depth + 1))) + "}";
            }

            string Items(object value, IEnumerable items, TypeFacts facts, int depth)
            {
                var known = value is ICollection collection ? collection.Count : facts.Count?.GetValue(value) as int?;
                var list = new List<string>();
                var count = 0;
                foreach (var item in items)
                {
                    if (count++ >= MaxItems)
                    {
                        // The size is known: no need to walk the rest; a huge or endless sequence: stop counting.
                        if (known != null || count > MaxCounted) break;
                        continue;
                    }
                    list.Add(facts.IsMap && item != null && KeyValue(item) is { } kv
                        ? Key(kv.key) + ": " + Value(kv.value, depth + 1)
                        : Value(item, depth + 1));
                }
                var shown = string.Join(", ", list);
                if (known != null ? known > list.Count : count > list.Count)
                    shown += known != null ? $", … ({known} items)" : count > MaxCounted ? $", … ({MaxCounted}+ items)" : $", … ({count} items)";
                return facts.IsMap ? "{" + shown + "}" : "[" + shown + "]";
            }

            // A key reads bare unless it could be confused with the separators.
            string Key(object? key)
            {
                if (key != null) key = _unwrap(key);
                var text = key is string or char ? key.ToString()! : Value(key, MaxDepth - 1);
                return text.Length == 0 || text.IndexOfAny(KeySeparators) >= 0 || text.Contains(": ", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                    ? Quote(text) : text;
            }

            TypeFacts Facts(Type type)
            {
                if (!_facts.TryGetValue(type, out var facts))
                    _facts[type] = facts = new TypeFacts(type);
                return facts;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>What the walk needs to know about a type, looked up once per result (never cached across results: the
        /// snippet's types must not outlive its collectible load context).</summary>
        sealed class TypeFacts
        {
            public readonly bool Leaf;
            public readonly bool IsMap;
            public readonly PropertyInfo? Count;
            public readonly MemberInfo[] Members;

            public TypeFacts(Type type)
            {
                var interfaces = type.GetInterfaces();
                Leaf = IsLeaf(type);
                IsMap = typeof(IDictionary).IsAssignableFrom(type) || interfaces.Any(i => i.IsGenericType
                    && (i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IDictionary<,>) || i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IReadOnlyDictionary<,>)));
                // A collection that is only a generic one (HashSet<T>, Godot.Collections.Array<T> …) still has a size.
                Count = typeof(ICollection).IsAssignableFrom(type) ? null : interfaces
                    .Where(i => i.IsGenericType && (i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(ICollection<>) || i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IReadOnlyCollection<>)))
                    .Select(i => i.GetProperty("Count")).FirstOrDefault(p => p != null);
                Members = Leaf || typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type) ? Array.Empty<MemberInfo>() : ReadMembers(type);
            }

            // Values read by their text: reflection objects, delegates, tasks, lazies and exceptions (their members lead far
            // away or run code: Task.Result blocks, Lazy.Value runs its factory), and any type with its own ToString
            // (DateTime, TimeSpan, Version, Uri …) except anonymous types and records, whose ToString lists the members.
            static bool IsLeaf(Type type) =>
                typeof(MemberInfo).IsAssignableFrom(type) || typeof(Assembly).IsAssignableFrom(type) || typeof(Module).IsAssignableFrom(type)
                || typeof(Delegate).IsAssignableFrom(type) || typeof(Task).IsAssignableFrom(type) || typeof(Exception).IsAssignableFrom(type)
                || type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Lazy<>)
                || OwnToString(type) && !IsAnonymous(type) && type.GetProperty("EqualityContract", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance) == null
                   && !typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type) && !typeof(ITuple).IsAssignableFrom(type);

            static bool OwnToString(Type type)
            {
                var declaring = type.GetMethod(nameof(ToString), Type.EmptyTypes)?.DeclaringType;
                return declaring != null && declaring != typeof(object) && declaring != typeof(ValueType);
            }

            // Public instance properties without parameters, then public fields (records, anonymous types, plain classes).
            static MemberInfo[] ReadMembers(Type type) =>
                type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)
                    .Where(p => p.CanRead && p.GetIndexParameters().Length == 0 && p.Name != "EqualityContract")
                    .Cast<MemberInfo>()
                    .Concat(type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance))
                    .ToArray();
        }

        static readonly Dictionary<Type, string> Aliases = new Dictionary<Type, string>
        {
            [typeof(object)] = "object", [typeof(string)] = "string", [typeof(bool)] = "bool", [typeof(int)] = "int",
            [typeof(long)] = "long", [typeof(float)] = "float", [typeof(double)] = "double", [typeof(decimal)] = "decimal",
            [typeof(byte)] = "byte", [typeof(short)] = "short", [typeof(uint)] = "uint", [typeof(ulong)] = "ulong", [typeof(char)] = "char",
        };

        static readonly char[] KeySeparators = { ',', '{', '}', '[', ']', '"' };

        static bool IsScalar(Type t) => t == typeof(string) || t == typeof(bool) || t == typeof(char) || t.IsEnum || IsNumber(t);

        static bool IsNumber(Type t) => t.IsPrimitive && t != typeof(bool) && t != typeof(char) || t == typeof(decimal);

        static bool IsAnonymous(Type t) =>
            t.Name.Contains("AnonymousType", StringComparison.Ordinal) && t.IsDefined(typeof(CompilerGeneratedAttribute), false);

        static string Safe(object value)
        {
            try { return (value is IFormattable f ? f.ToString(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : value.ToString()) ?? value.GetType().Name; }
            catch (Exception e) { return "<" + e.GetType().Name + ">"; }
        }

        static string Quote(string s)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
            foreach (var c in s)
            {
                switch (c)
                {
                    case '"': sb.Append("\\\""); break;
                    case '\\': sb.Append("\\\\"); break;
                    case '\n': sb.Append("\\n"); break;
                    case '\r': sb.Append("\\r"); break;
                    case '\t': sb.Append("\\t"); break;
                    default: sb.Append(c); break;
                }
            }
            return sb.Append('"').ToString();
        }

        // The Key and Value of a DictionaryEntry or a KeyValuePair<K, V> (any K, V), or null for another item.
        static (object? key, object? value)? KeyValue(object item)
        {
            if (item is DictionaryEntry e) return (e.Key, e.Value);
            var t = item.GetType();
            if (!t.IsGenericType || t.GetGenericTypeDefinition() != typeof(KeyValuePair<,>)) return null;
            return (t.GetProperty("Key")!.GetValue(item), t.GetProperty("Value")!.GetValue(item));
        }

        static object? Read(MemberInfo m, object o)
        {
            try { return m is PropertyInfo p ? p.GetValue(o) : ((FieldInfo)m).GetValue(o); }
            catch (Exception e) { return "<" + (e.InnerException ?? e).GetType().Name + ">"; }
        }
    }
}
#endif

/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Pure-string argument validation for the <c>godot-skill-*</c> SYSTEM tools (<see cref="Tool_Skills"/>) —
    /// the Godot analog of the inline path guards Unity-MCP's <c>Tool_Skills.Create</c>/<c>GenerateAll</c>
    /// perform. Extracted here (no Godot API, no <c>#if TOOLS</c>) so the guards — the part an AI agent is
    /// most likely to probe with a hostile path — are unit-tested in the plain xUnit host.
    ///
    /// <para>
    /// Two different path contracts are enforced, because the two tools address two different roots:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    ///   <item><c>godot-skill-create</c> writes a C# tool file into the Godot project, so it takes a
    ///   <c>res://</c> path (the project's own virtual root) — validated by
    ///   <see cref="RequireSkillFileResPath"/> on top of the shared
    ///   <see cref="ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath"/> guards.</item>
    ///   <item><c>godot-skill-generate</c> takes an OPTIONAL project-RELATIVE output folder (e.g.
    ///   <c>.claude/skills</c>), matching Unity's <c>path</c> argument, validated by
    ///   <see cref="RequireRelativeSkillsFolder"/>. Null/empty means "use the selected agent's configured
    ///   folder", which is the normal case.</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    public static class SkillsToolPaths
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Validate the <c>godot-skill-create</c> target path: a <c>res://</c> FILE path, with no <c>..</c>
        /// segment, ending in <c>.cs</c>. A skill/tool is C# ONLY — a GDScript file cannot carry the
        /// <c>[AiToolType]</c>/<c>[AiTool]</c> attributes the McpPlugin assembly scanner discovers — so
        /// (unlike <c>script-create</c>, which accepts both languages) <c>.gd</c> is rejected here with an
        /// explicit pointer at <c>script-create</c>. Returns the trimmed path on success.
        /// </summary>
        public static string RequireSkillFileResPath(string? path, string paramName)
        {
            var resPath = ResPathNormalizer.RequireResFilePath(path, paramName);

            if (!resPath.EndsWith(ScriptLang_.CSharpExtension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    $"A skill must be a C# file: path must end with '{ScriptLang_.CSharpExtension}'; got '{path}'. " +
                    $"Only C# can carry the [AiToolType]/[AiTool] attributes the MCP tool scanner discovers — " +
                    $"use the '{ScriptCreateToolIdRef}' tool for a GDScript ('{ScriptLang_.GDScriptExtension}') file.",
                    paramName);

            return resPath;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The <c>script-create</c> tool id, quoted by <see cref="RequireSkillFileResPath"/>'s rejection
        /// message. Held as a local literal rather than a reference to <c>Tool_Script.ScriptCreateToolId</c>
        /// because that family is editor-only (<c>#if TOOLS</c>) while this file must stay compilable — and
        /// unit-testable — outside the editor. <c>internal</c> (not <c>public</c>) so the CLI's
        /// <c>discoverAddonToolIds</c> scan, which keys on <c>public const string …ToolId</c>, never
        /// double-counts it. Pinned against drift by <c>SystemToolsTests</c>.
        /// </summary>
        internal const string ScriptCreateToolIdRef = "script-create";

        /// <summary>
        /// Validate the OPTIONAL <c>godot-skill-generate</c> output-folder override. Returns <c>null</c> for a
        /// null/empty input (meaning: fall back to the selected agent's configured skills folder — the normal
        /// case), otherwise the normalized (forward-slash, no trailing slash) project-relative folder.
        /// Rejects an ABSOLUTE/rooted path and any <c>..</c> traversal segment, exactly like Unity's
        /// <c>GenerateAll</c> guards, reusing the OS-independent
        /// <see cref="UI.SkillsPathUtils.IsSafeRelativeSkillsPath"/> predicate so a Windows drive-letter path
        /// is rejected on a Linux host too.
        /// </summary>
        public static string? RequireRelativeSkillsFolder(string? path, string paramName)
        {
            // Null, empty, and whitespace-only all mean "use the selected agent's configured folder".
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
                return null;

            var trimmed = path!.Trim();

            if (ResPathNormalizer.IsResPath(trimmed))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    $"Path must be a project-RELATIVE folder (e.g. '.claude/skills'), not a " +
                    $"'{ResPathNormalizer.ResScheme}' path; got '{path}'.", paramName);

            if (!UI.SkillsPathUtils.IsSafeRelativeSkillsPath(trimmed))
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    $"Path must be a relative folder inside the Godot project with no '..' traversal " +
                    $"segments (e.g. '.claude/skills'); got '{path}'.", paramName);

            return trimmed.Replace('\\', '/').TrimEnd('/');
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    public partial class Tool_Console
    {
        public const string ConsoleGetLogsToolId = "console-get-logs";

        [AiTool
        (
            ConsoleGetLogsToolId,
            Title = "Console / Get Logs",
            ReadOnlyHint = true,
            IdempotentHint = true,
            OpenWorldHint = false
        )]
        [Description("Retrieve the Godot-MCP log lines captured in this process — the running game, where the " +
            "in-game runtime (GodotMcpRuntime) registers this tool: newest-first by default, oldest-first when " +
            "polling with 'sinceSequence'. To fetch only new lines, pass the highest 'sequence' you have received " +
            "as 'sinceSequence'. The Godot analog of Unity's 'console-get-logs'. NOTE: Godot's C# API exposes no global log " +
            "hook, so this returns what the plugin captured (its own GD.* routing, connection lifecycle diagnostics, and " +
            "on Godot 4.5+ engine errors), not every line the game printed — an empty result is NOT evidence that the game " +
            "printed nothing. For the game's errors (GDScript runtime errors, push_error, C# exceptions) prefer " +
            "'runtime-errors-get' (enable it with GodotMcpRuntime.Initialize(b => b.WithRuntimeErrorCapture())).\n" +
            "Inputs:\n" +
            "  - 'sinceSequence' (default 0, min 0): polling cursor. 0 = newest-first. > 0 = only lines with a " +
            "higher sequence, oldest-first, so the next poll (with the highest sequence returned) continues where " +
            "this page stopped. If returned sequences are lower than your cursor, the log restarted. Lines evicted " +
            "from the 1000-line buffer or cleared before you poll are not returned.\n" +
            "  - 'maxEntries' (default 100, min 1): caps the returned array — the most recent lines at " +
            "sinceSequence=0, the oldest page with a cursor.\n" +
            "  - 'logTypeFilter' (default null = all): restrict to Log / Warning / Error.\n" +
            "  - 'includeStackTrace' (default false): include stack-trace strings.\n" +
            "  - 'lastMinutes' (default 0 = all): only lines captured in the last N minutes.")]
        public LogEntry[] GetLogs
        (
            [Description("Maximum number of log entries to return. Minimum 1, default 100.")]
            int maxEntries = 100,
            [Description("Filter by severity (Log / Warning / Error). Null means all severities.")]
            GodotLogType? logTypeFilter = null,
            [Description("Include stack traces in the output. Default false.")]
            bool includeStackTrace = false,
            [Description("Return logs from the last N minutes. 0 returns all available logs. Default 0.")]
            int lastMinutes = 0,
            [Description("Polling cursor: pass the highest 'sequence' you have received to get only newer lines, " +
                "oldest-first. 0 returns lines newest-first. Minimum 0, default 0.")]
            long sinceSequence = 0
        )
        {
            if (maxEntries < 1)
                throw new ArgumentException($"maxEntries must be >= 1; got {maxEntries}.", nameof(maxEntries));
            if (sinceSequence < 0)
                throw new ArgumentException($"sinceSequence must be >= 0; got {sinceSequence}.", nameof(sinceSequence));

            var collector = GodotLogCollector.GetOrCreate();
            return collector.Query(
                maxEntries: maxEntries,
                logTypeFilter: logTypeFilter,
                includeStackTrace: includeStackTrace,
                lastMinutes: lastMinutes,
                sinceSequence: sinceSequence);
        }
    }
}

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

// The editor and a game built with the in-game opt-in (GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME
#nullable enable
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Data;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    /// <summary>
    /// <c>script-execute</c> inside a RUNNING GAME: compiles C# with Roslyn and runs it on the game's main thread.
    /// Registered only by <c>GodotMcpRuntimeBuilder.WithScriptExecute()</c>. Deliberately NOT an <c>[AiToolType]</c>:
    /// the editor's assembly scan must never pick it up next to the editor <c>script-execute</c>
    /// (<c>Tool_Script.Execute</c>), which has the same name.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Tool_GameScript
    {
        public const string ScriptExecuteToolId = "script-execute";
        const string ScriptExecuteTitle = "Script / Execute (in game)";

        [AiTool
        (
            ScriptExecuteToolId,
            Title = ScriptExecuteTitle,
            OpenWorldHint = true
        )]
        [AiSkillDescription("Compiles and runs C# INSIDE THE RUNNING GAME (Roslyn): plain statements with the last expression as the " +
            "result, or a full class with a static method. See the skill body for the modes, usings/include, output and parameters.")]
        [AiSkillBody(
            "## Where it runs\n\n" +
            "Inside the running game process, on its main thread. The game's own C# types, autoloads and the scene tree are " +
            "available: `((SceneTree)Engine.GetMainLoop()).Root` is the root window, `GetTree()` is not (there is no `this`). " +
            "There is no editor: `EditorInterface` and other editor APIs do not exist here.\n\n" +
            "## Modes\n\n" +
            "- **Snippet** (default): plain statements. The last expression is the result " +
            "(`((SceneTree)Engine.GetMainLoop()).Root.GetChildCount()`)." + ScriptExecuteSource.SkillSnippetModeTail +
            "Compile errors point at your own lines (`snippet.cs(2,5)`). Nothing is kept between calls: use `include` for " +
            "shared helpers.\n\n" +
            ScriptExecuteSource.SkillOutputAndUsings +
            "- `include`: helper `.cs` files or folders (recursive), relative to `.ai-game-dev/snippets` in the Godot project " +
            "(a game started from the editor) or next to the game executable (an exported game).\n\n" +
            ScriptExecuteSource.SkillParameters)]
        [Description("Compiles and runs C# inside the running game (main thread; game types, autoloads and the scene tree via " +
            "((SceneTree)Engine.GetMainLoop()).Root; no editor APIs): plain statements with the last expression as the result " +
            "(own usings, local classes, await allowed), or a declared class 'className' with static method 'methodName'. " +
            "Returns the result and the printed output (Console; GD.Print on Godot 4.5+).")]
        public Task<ScriptExecuteResult> Execute
        (
            [Description("C# code. Snippet: 'var root = ((SceneTree)Engine.GetMainLoop()).Root;\\nroot.GetChildCount()'" +
                ScriptExecuteSource.CodeDescriptionTail)]
            string csharpCode,
            [Description(ScriptExecuteSource.ClassNameDescription)]
            string className = "Script",
            [Description(ScriptExecuteSource.MethodNameDescription)]
            string methodName = "Main",
            [Description(ScriptExecuteSource.ParametersDescription)]
            SerializedMemberList? parameters = null,
            [Description(ScriptExecuteSource.IsMethodBodyDescription)]
            bool isMethodBody = false,
            [Description(ScriptExecuteSource.UsingsDescription)]
            string[]? usings = null,
            [Description("Helper .cs files or folders (recursive) compiled with the code, relative to .ai-game-dev/snippets " +
                "(in the project, or next to the game executable).")]
            string[]? include = null
        )
            => ScriptExecutor.Execute(csharpCode, className, methodName, parameters, isMethodBody, usings, include);

        /// <summary>
        /// Makes THIS tool the plugin's <c>script-execute</c>. A game that also registers the addon assembly
        /// (<c>WithToolsFromAssembly</c>) in an editor build (<c>TOOLS</c>, e.g. a game started from the editor) gets the
        /// editor <c>Tool_Script.Execute</c> from that scan, and McpPlugin processes the scan after the explicit types (the
        /// last registration of a name wins). Returns true when it replaced another runner.
        /// </summary>
        internal static bool EnsureRegistered(IToolManager? tools, Reflector reflector)
        {
            if (tools == null)
                return false;
            var current = tools.GetAllTools().FirstOrDefault(t => t.Name == ScriptExecuteToolId);
            if (current is RunTool { Method: var method } && method.DeclaringType == typeof(Tool_GameScript))
                return false;
            if (current != null)
                tools.RemoveTool(ScriptExecuteToolId);
            var execute = typeof(Tool_GameScript).GetMethod(nameof(Execute))!;
            tools.AddTool(ScriptExecuteToolId, RunTool.CreateFromClassMethod(
                reflector, logger: null, ScriptExecuteToolId, typeof(Tool_GameScript), execute,
                title: ScriptExecuteTitle, openWorldHint: true));
            return current != null;
        }
    }
}

    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight readiness/connectivity probe. The single tool that proves the end-to-end
    /// MCP path (editor boot → SignalR connect → tool dispatch → structured result) is wired up,
    /// before any engine-driving tool families are added. The Godot analog of a plain echo/pong tool.
    ///
    /// <para>
    /// This is engine-runtime logic with no Godot editor API surface, so it intentionally lives

    /// of 2026-07-25 is that liveness/skill tooling must be reachable on the SAME surface across all three
    /// engines: <c>McpPluginBuilder</c> partitions tools by <c>ToolType</c> into two DISJOINT registries —
    /// Standard tools go to the MCP tool manager (and are advertised to AI agents), System tools go to the

        [AiTool
        (
            PingToolId,
            Title = "Ping",
            ReadOnlyHint = true,
            IdempotentHint = true,
            OpenWorldHint = false,
            ToolType = McpToolType.System
        )]
        [Description("Lightweight readiness probe for the Godot-MCP connection. Returns the input " +
            "'message' echoed back, or 'pong' when omitted. Useful for verifying SignalR connectivity " +
            "end-to-end after the editor plugin connects to the MCP server.")]
        public string Ping
        (
            [Description("Optional message to echo back. When null or empty, the tool returns 'pong'.")]
            string? message = null
        )
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(message) ? "pong" : message;
        }
    }

            Title = "Method C# / Call"
        )]
        [Description("Call a C# method by reflection — including private methods. The Godot analog of " +
            "Unity's 'reflection-method-call'. Requires a method schema obtained via " +
            "'reflection-method-find'. Supports static methods, instance methods (with optional target " +
            "deserialization), and main-thread / off-thread execution.\n" +
            "Inputs:\n" +
            "  - 'targetObject' (optional) — for instance methods; { typeName, value } where value is " +
            "deserialized to typeName. Null for static methods (or to construct a fresh instance). A Node " +
            "target is written as { \"typeName\": \"Godot.Control\", \"value\": { \"instanceId\": 123 } } " +
            "(or { \"path\": \"/root/Main/Player\" }); a Resource target as { \"resourcePath\": \"res://x.tres\" }.\n" +
            "  - 'inputParameters' (optional) — list of { typeName, name, value }; names/types are enhanced " +
            "against the resolved signature when omitted.\n" +
            "  - 'executeInMainThread' (default true) — keep true for Godot-API-touching methods; set false " +
            "only for thread-safe pure logic.\n" +
            "Godot.Variant parameters: " + GodotVariantPayload.WireFormatHelp + "\n" +
            "An argument whose value cannot be read is an ERROR — the method is never invoked with a " +
            "silently defaulted argument.")]
        public SerializedMember MethodCall
        (
            [Description("Method filter: Namespace / TypeName / MethodName / InputParameters identifying the method.")]
            MethodRef filter,
            [Description("Set true if 'filter.Namespace' is a known full namespace name; otherwise false.")]
            bool knownNamespace = false,
            [Description("Minimal match level for 'filter.TypeName' (0 ignore, 1 contains-ic [default], " +
                "2 contains-cs, 3 starts-ic, 4 starts-cs, 5 equals-ic, 6 equals-cs).")]
            int typeNameMatchLevel = 1,
            [Description("Minimal match level for 'filter.MethodName' (0 ignore, 1 contains-ic [default], " +
                "2 contains-cs, 3 starts-ic, 4 starts-cs, 5 equals-ic, 6 equals-cs).")]
            int methodNameMatchLevel = 1,
            [Description("Minimal match level for 'filter.InputParameters' (0 ignore, 1 count matches, " +
                "2 equals [default]).")]
            int parametersMatchLevel = 2,
            [Description("Target object for an instance method ({ type, value }). Null for a static method, " +
                "or to construct a fresh instance of the declaring type.")]
            SerializedMember? targetObject = null,
            [Description("Method input parameters, each { type, name, value }.")]
            SerializedMemberList? inputParameters = null,
            [Description("Run the call on the editor main thread. Keep true for Godot-API methods; false " +
                "for thread-safe pure logic.")]
            bool executeInMainThread = true
        )
        {
            // Enhance filter with input parameters if the filter carries none.
            if ((filter.InputParameters?.Count ?? 0) == 0 && (inputParameters?.Count ?? 0) > 0)
                filter.EnhanceInputParameters(inputParameters);

            var methods = FindMethods(
                filter: filter,
                knownNamespace: knownNamespace,
                typeNameMatchLevel: typeNameMatchLevel,
                methodNameMatchLevel: methodNameMatchLevel,
                parametersMatchLevel: parametersMatchLevel).ToList();

            if (methods.Count == 0)
                throw new Exception($"Method not found.\n{filter}");

            MethodInfo method;

            if (methods.Count > 1)
            {
                var isValidParameterTypeName = inputParameters.IsValidTypeNames(
                    fieldName: nameof(inputParameters),
                    out _);

                var filtered = isValidParameterTypeName
                    ? methods.FilterByParameters(inputParameters)
                    : null;

                if (filtered == null)
                    throw new Exception(Error.MoreThanOneMethodFound(GodotMcpReflector.GetOrCreate(), methods));

                method = filtered;
            }
            else
            {
                method = methods.First();
            }

            inputParameters?.EnhanceNames(method);
            inputParameters?.EnhanceTypes(method);

            Func<SerializedMember> action = () =>
            {
                var reflector = GodotMcpReflector.GetOrCreate();
                var logger = NullLogger.Instance;

                // Each argument gets its own diagnostics sink: ReflectorNet reports an unreadable payload
                // ONLY through these logs (it still returns the type's default), so without this the call
                // would proceed with a bogus argument and report success — issue #292.
                var dictInputParameters = inputParameters?.ToDictionary(
                    keySelector: p => p.name ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "Input parameter name is null. Please specify 'name' for each input parameter."),
                    elementSelector: p => DeserializeArgument(reflector, p, p.name!, logger));

                MethodWrapper methodWrapper;

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetObject?.typeName))
                {
                    // No instance needed — static method (or a fresh instance constructed by the wrapper).
                    methodWrapper = new MethodWrapper(reflector, logger, method);
                }
                else
                {
                    var obj = DeserializeArgument(reflector, targetObject!, nameof(targetObject), logger);
                    if (obj == null)
                        throw new Exception($"'{nameof(targetObject)}' deserialized instance is null. " +
                            $"Please specify '{nameof(targetObject)}' properly.");

                    methodWrapper = new MethodWrapper(reflector, logger, targetInstance: obj, methodInfo: method);
                }

                if (!methodWrapper.VerifyParameters(dictInputParameters, out var error))
                    throw new Exception(error);

                var task = dictInputParameters != null
                    ? methodWrapper.InvokeDict(dictInputParameters, CancellationToken.None)
                    : methodWrapper.Invoke(Array.Empty<object>());

                var result = task.Result;
                if (result is SerializedMember serializedResult)
                    return serializedResult;

                return reflector.Serialize(
                    obj: result,
                    fallbackType: method.ReturnType,
                    logger: logger);
            };

            if (executeInMainThread)
                return MainThread.Instance.Run(action);

            return action();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Deserialize one reflection argument and REFUSE the call when ReflectorNet reported that it could
        /// not read the payload. See <see cref="ReflectionArgumentGuard"/> for why the diagnostics sink is
        /// the only available failure signal.
        /// </summary>
        static object? DeserializeArgument(Reflector reflector, SerializedMember member, string argumentName, ILogger logger)
        {
            var logs = new Logs();
            var value = reflector.Deserialize(member, logs: logs, logger: logger);
            ReflectionArgumentGuard.RequireNoErrors(logs, argumentName, member.typeName);
            return value;
        }
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Reflection;
using com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Model;
using com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet.Utils;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tools
{
    public partial class Tool_Reflection
    {
        public const string ReflectionMethodFindToolId = "reflection-method-find";

        [AiTool
        (
            ReflectionMethodFindToolId,
            Title = "Method C# / Find",
            ReadOnlyHint = true,
            IdempotentHint = true
        )]
        [Description("Find C# methods across every loaded assembly by name / declaring-type / parameters — " +
            "including private methods. The Godot analog of Unity's 'reflection-method-find'. Returns " +
            "serialized MethodData entries usable as schemas for 'reflection-method-call'.\n" +
            "Match levels (apply to typeName / MethodName / Parameters):\n" +
            "  - typeNameMatchLevel / methodNameMatchLevel (default 1 = contains-ignoring-case): " +
            "0 ignore filter, 1 contains-ic, 2 contains-cs, 3 starts-with-ic, 4 starts-with-cs, 5 equals-ic, " +
            "6 equals-cs.\n" +
            "  - parametersMatchLevel (default 0 = ignore filter): 0 ignore, 1 count matches, 2 equals.")]
        public string MethodFind
        (
            [Description("Method filter: Namespace / TypeName / MethodName / InputParameters to match against.")]
            MethodRef filter,
            [Description("Set true if 'filter.Namespace' is a known full namespace name; otherwise false.")]
            bool knownNamespace = false,
            [Description("Minimal match level for 'filter.TypeName' (0 ignore, 1 contains-ic [default], " +
                "2 contains-cs, 3 starts-ic, 4 starts-cs, 5 equals-ic, 6 equals-cs).")]
            int typeNameMatchLevel = 1,
            [Description("Minimal match level for 'filter.MethodName' (0 ignore, 1 contains-ic [default], " +
                "2 contains-cs, 3 starts-ic, 4 starts-cs, 5 equals-ic, 6 equals-cs).")]
            int methodNameMatchLevel = 1,
            [Description("Minimal match level for 'filter.InputParameters' (0 ignore [default], " +
                "1 count matches, 2 equals).")]
            int parametersMatchLevel = 0
        )
        {
            return MainThread.Instance.Run(() =>
            {
                var methods = FindMethods(
                    filter: filter,
                    knownNamespace: knownNamespace,
                    typeNameMatchLevel: typeNameMatchLevel,
                    methodNameMatchLevel: methodNameMatchLevel,
                    parametersMatchLevel: parametersMatchLevel).ToList();

                if (methods.Count == 0)
                    return $"[Success] Method not found. With request:\n{filter}";

                var reflector = GodotMcpReflector.GetOrCreate();

                var methodRefs = methods
                    .Select(method => new MethodData(reflector, method, justRef: false))
                    .ToList();

                return $@"[Success] Found {methods.Count} method(s):
```json
{methodRefs.ToJson(reflector)}
```";
            });
        }
    }
}
