/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The agent guide of the Animation RQL module, rendered into the <c>godot-rql</c> skill (<see cref="AnimationModule"/>).
    /// Pure strings (no Godot API, not behind <c>#if TOOLS</c>) so the xUnit suite parses every example; the live e2e
    /// manifest (<c>tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json</c>) runs each one, in this order, against a scene whose root is a Node3D.
    /// </summary>
    public static class AnimationGuide
    {
        public const string Topic = "Animation";

        /// <summary>One example per line: the query, three or more spaces, a note.</summary>
        public const string Examples =
            "root | call AddChild(\"Node3D\", \"Mover\")   the node to animate\n" +
            "root | call AddChild(\"AnimationPlayer\", \"Player\")   a player; track paths are relative to its parent (Root)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | call AddLibrary(\"\")   the global library (\"\"); named ones too: AddLibrary(\"Extra\")\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get libraries[\"\"] | call CreateAnimation(\"Idle\", 2, \"linear\")   an animation: name, length (s), loop mode none / linear / pingpong\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | call CreateAnimation(\"Walk\", 1, \"none\", \"Extra\")   on the player: the library is added when missing (animation \"Extra/Walk\")\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get animations[\"Idle\"] | call AddTrack(\"value\", \"Mover:position:x\")   a value track \"node:property\"; returns its index\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get animations[\"Idle\"] | call InsertKey(0, 0.5, 1.5)   key track 0 at 0.5 s\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get animations[\"Idle\"] | call AddTrack(\"rotation-3d\", \"Mover\")   a 3D transform track: position-3d, rotation-3d or scale-3d\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get animations[\"Idle\"] | call InsertTransformKey(1, 1, \"(0, 90, 0)\")   key it: a position / scale, or a rotation in Euler degrees\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get animations[\"Idle\"] | set Length = 1.5, LoopMode = \"Pingpong\"   animation settings (Length validated)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Player\" | get animations[\"Idle\"].tracks | select index kind path keyCount   read the tracks\n" +
            "nodes | where $ is AnimationPlayer | select name animations.keys() libraries.keys()   the players, their animations and libraries";

        public const string Markdown =
            "Animations live in the AnimationLibrary resources of an AnimationPlayer (or AnimationTree): `libraries[\"name\"]` " +
            "(\"\" = the global library) and `animations[\"name\"]` (qualified: \"Idle\" in the global library, \"Extra/Walk\" in " +
            "library Extra) reach them. Add the player with `AddChild`, then:\n\n```\n" + Examples + "\n```\n\n" +
            "`AddTrack` kinds: `value` (path \"node:property\", e.g. \"Mover:modulate\" or \"Mover:position:x\"), `position-3d`, " +
            "`rotation-3d`, `scale-3d` (path \"node\"); node paths are relative to the player's root node (its parent by default, " +
            "\".\" = that node). `InsertKey` keys value tracks (a number, bool, text or resource); `InsertTransformKey` keys the " +
            "transform tracks with \"(x, y, z)\". Every change is undoable (it changes the animation or library it is called on) " +
            "and marks the scene unsaved, except `CreateAnimation` on the player into a library that already exists: call it on " +
            "the library (`get libraries[\"…\"] | call CreateAnimation(…)`) to undo it. Typical values: length 1 s, loop mode none. " +
            "`Length` (at least 0.001 s), key times (0 or more), track indexes and names (no '/', ':', ',' or '[') are validated: a " +
            "rejected value changes nothing. Other settings are C# members (`LoopMode`, `Step` …) or " +
            "`props[\"…\"]`; `rql-schema \"Animation\"` lists them.";
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/Editor/Rql/AnimationLoopMode.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// How a Godot <c>Animation</c> resource loops, mirroring Godot's <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum</c>
    /// (<c>None</c>=0, <c>Linear</c>=1, <c>Pingpong</c>=2). Pure-managed (no Godot native types) so the
    /// parse/format logic is CI-unit-testable with no Godot binary.
    /// </summary>
    public enum AnimationLoopMode
    {
        /// <summary>Play once and stop (Godot <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum.None</c> = 0).</summary>
        None,

        /// <summary>Loop from the start each time (Godot <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum.Linear</c> = 1).</summary>
        Linear,

        /// <summary>Loop back and forth (Godot <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum.Pingpong</c> = 2).</summary>
        PingPong
    }

    /// <summary>Pure-managed helpers for <see cref="AnimationLoopMode"/> parsing, display and Godot mapping.</summary>
    public static class AnimationLoopModes
    {
        /// <summary>The integer that maps to Godot's <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum</c> (0 / 1 / 2).</summary>
        public static int ToGodotValue(this AnimationLoopMode mode) => mode switch
        {
            AnimationLoopMode.None => 0,
            AnimationLoopMode.Linear => 1,
            AnimationLoopMode.PingPong => 2,
            _ => 0
        };

        /// <summary>Map a Godot <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum</c> integer back to <see cref="AnimationLoopMode"/>.</summary>
        public static AnimationLoopMode FromGodotValue(int value) => value switch
        {
            1 => AnimationLoopMode.Linear,
            2 => AnimationLoopMode.PingPong,
            _ => AnimationLoopMode.None
        };

        /// <summary>The short display label (<c>"none"</c> / <c>"linear"</c> / <c>"pingpong"</c>).</summary>
        public static string ToLabel(this AnimationLoopMode mode) => mode switch
        {
            AnimationLoopMode.Linear => "linear",
            AnimationLoopMode.PingPong => "pingpong",
            _ => "none"
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse a user/LLM-supplied loop-mode string. Accepts (case- and whitespace-insensitive):
        /// <c>"none"/"once"/"0"</c> → <see cref="AnimationLoopMode.None"/>;
        /// <c>"linear"/"loop"/"1"</c> → <see cref="AnimationLoopMode.Linear"/>;
        /// <c>"pingpong"/"ping-pong"/"ping pong"/"2"</c> → <see cref="AnimationLoopMode.PingPong"/>.
        /// Returns false for anything else (and for null/empty).
        /// </summary>
        public static bool TryParse(string? value, out AnimationLoopMode mode)
        {
            mode = AnimationLoopMode.None;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                return false;

            switch (value!.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
            {
                case "none":
                case "once":
                case "0":
                    mode = AnimationLoopMode.None;
                    return true;
                case "linear":
                case "loop":
                case "1":
                    mode = AnimationLoopMode.Linear;
                    return true;
                case "pingpong":
                case "ping-pong":
                case "ping pong":
                case "pong":
                case "2":
                    mode = AnimationLoopMode.PingPong;
                    return true;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse a loop-mode string, throwing <see cref="ArgumentException"/> on an unrecognized value. Used
        /// by the module (the loopMode argument of CreateAnimation).
        /// </summary>
        public static AnimationLoopMode Parse(string? value)
        {
            if (TryParse(value, out var mode))
                return mode;
            throw new ArgumentException(
                $"Unrecognized animation loop mode '{value}'. Use 'none', 'linear' or 'pingpong'.", nameof(value));
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/Editor/Rql/AnimationOps.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
// The root namespace ends in '.Animation', which shadows the type 'Godot.Animation': alias it.
using GodotAnimation = Godot.Animation;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The Godot operations behind the adapters' calls. Each one checks every argument (<see cref="AnimationRules"/>, the
    /// label parsers, existing names) before it changes anything, so a rejected call changes nothing and Godot never logs
    /// an error for it. Runs on the editor main thread (every RQL query does).
    /// </summary>
    internal static class AnimationOps
    {
        public static AnimationLibrary AddLibrary(AnimationMixer mixer, string name)
        {
            Require(AnimationRules.LibraryName(name));
            if (mixer.HasAnimationLibrary(name))
                throw new ArgumentException($"{mixer.Name} already has a library named '{name}'");
            var library = new AnimationLibrary();
            var error = mixer.AddAnimationLibrary(name, library);
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Godot refused to add library '{name}' ({error})");
            return library;
        }

        /// <summary>Create an animation in <paramref name="library"/> of <paramref name="mixer"/>, adding the library when it is missing.</summary>
        public static GodotAnimation CreateAnimation(AnimationMixer mixer, string name, double length, string? loopMode, string library)
        {
            Require(AnimationRules.LibraryName(library));
            var mode = CheckNew(name, length, loopMode);
            var existing = mixer.HasAnimationLibrary(library) ? mixer.GetAnimationLibrary(library) : null;
            if (existing != null) RequireFree(existing, name);
            return Add(existing ?? AddLibrary(mixer, library), name, length, mode);
        }

        public static GodotAnimation CreateAnimation(AnimationLibrary library, string name, double length, string? loopMode)
        {
            var mode = CheckNew(name, length, loopMode);
            RequireFree(library, name);
            return Add(library, name, length, mode);
        }

        private static void RequireFree(AnimationLibrary library, string name)
        {
            if (library.HasAnimation(name)) throw new ArgumentException($"the library already has an animation named '{name}'");
        }

        public static int AddTrack(GodotAnimation animation, string kindLabel, string path)
        {
            var kind = AnimationTrackKinds.Parse(kindLabel);
            Require(AnimationRules.TrackPath(kind, path));
            int index = animation.AddTrack((GodotAnimation.TrackType)kind.ToGodotTrackType());
            animation.TrackSetPath(index, new NodePath(path));
            return index;
        }

        public static int InsertKey(GodotAnimation animation, int track, double time, Variant value)
        {
            var kind = CheckKey(animation, track, time);
            if (kind != GodotAnimation.TrackType.Value)
                throw new ArgumentException(IsTransform(kind)
                    ? $"track {track} is a {Label(kind)} track: key it with InsertTransformKey(track, time, \"(x, y, z)\")"
                    : $"track {track} is a {Label(kind)} track; InsertKey keys value tracks only");
            return animation.TrackInsertKey(track, time, value);
        }

        /// <summary>Key a 3D transform track: a position, a scale, or a rotation given as Euler angles in degrees.</summary>
        public static int InsertTransformKey(GodotAnimation animation, int track, double time, Vector3 value)
        {
            var kind = CheckKey(animation, track, time);
            switch (kind)
            {
                case GodotAnimation.TrackType.Position3D:
                    return animation.PositionTrackInsertKey(track, time, value);
                case GodotAnimation.TrackType.Scale3D:
                    return animation.ScaleTrackInsertKey(track, time, value);
                case GodotAnimation.TrackType.Rotation3D:
                    var radians = new Vector3(Mathf.DegToRad(value.X), Mathf.DegToRad(value.Y), Mathf.DegToRad(value.Z));
                    return animation.RotationTrackInsertKey(track, time, Quaternion.FromEuler(radians));
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentException($"track {track} is a {Label(kind)} track: InsertTransformKey keys position-3d, rotation-3d and scale-3d tracks (InsertKey keys value tracks)");
            }
        }

        public static List<AnimationTrackRow> Tracks(GodotAnimation animation)
        {
            var count = animation.GetTrackCount();
            var rows = new List<AnimationTrackRow>(count);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                rows.Add(new AnimationTrackRow(i, Label(animation.TrackGetType(i)), animation.TrackGetPath(i).ToString(), animation.TrackGetKeyCount(i)));
            return rows;
        }

        public static IEnumerable<string> LibraryNames(AnimationMixer mixer) => mixer.GetAnimationLibraryList().Select(n => n.ToString());

        public static IEnumerable<string> AnimationNames(AnimationMixer mixer) => mixer.GetAnimationList().Select(n => n.ToString());

        public static IEnumerable<string> AnimationNames(AnimationLibrary library) => library.GetAnimationList().Select(n => n.ToString());

        private static bool IsTransform(GodotAnimation.TrackType kind) =>
            kind is GodotAnimation.TrackType.Position3D or GodotAnimation.TrackType.Rotation3D or GodotAnimation.TrackType.Scale3D;

        private static string Label(GodotAnimation.TrackType type) =>
            AnimationTrackKinds.FromGodotTrackType((int)type)?.ToLabel() ?? type.ToString();

        private static AnimationLoopMode CheckNew(string name, double length, string? loopMode)
        {
            Require(AnimationRules.AnimationName(name));
            Require(AnimationRules.Length(length));
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(loopMode) ? AnimationLoopMode.None : AnimationLoopModes.Parse(loopMode);
        }

        private static GodotAnimation.TrackType CheckKey(GodotAnimation animation, int track, double time)
        {
            Require(AnimationRules.TrackIndex(track, animation.GetTrackCount()));
            Require(AnimationRules.KeyTime(time));
            return animation.TrackGetType(track);
        }

        private static GodotAnimation Add(AnimationLibrary library, string name, double length, AnimationLoopMode mode)
        {
            var animation = new GodotAnimation
            {
                Length = (float)length,
                LoopMode = (GodotAnimation.LoopModeEnum)mode.ToGodotValue(),
            };
            var error = library.AddAnimation(name, animation);
            if (error != Error.Ok) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Godot refused to add animation '{name}' ({error})");
            return animation;
        }

        private static void Require(string? reason)
        {
            if (reason != null) throw new ArgumentException(reason);
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/Editor/Rql/AnimationRules.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Globalization;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The value rules the module enforces before an animation, library, track or key is written: what Godot itself rejects
    /// (it logs an error and ignores the call) plus what the replaced 0.x tools refused. Each returns the rejection reason, or
    /// null when the value is valid. The adapters run them as RQL <c>validate</c> callbacks (members) or before a call changes
    /// anything (methods throw the reason), so a rejected value changes nothing. Pure-managed (no Godot API), so it is
    /// unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    public static class AnimationRules
    {
        /// <summary>Godot's smallest animation length (<c>ANIM_MIN_LENGTH</c>; <c>set_length</c> refuses less).</summary>
        public const double MinLength = 0.001;

        /// <summary>Animation length in seconds: at least <see cref="MinLength"/> and finite.</summary>
        public static string? Length(double length) =>
            length >= MinLength && !double.IsInfinity(length)
                ? null
                : $"Length must be a number of seconds of at least {MinLength.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} (got {Format(length)})";

        /// <summary>A key time in seconds: zero or more and finite.</summary>
        public static string? KeyTime(double time) =>
            time >= 0 && !double.IsInfinity(time)
                ? null
                : $"key time must be a number of seconds of at least 0 (got {Format(time)})";

        /// <summary>
        /// An animation name inside a library: not empty and without '/', ':', ',' or '[' (Godot's
        /// <c>AnimationLibrary::is_valid_animation_name</c>; '/' separates the library in a qualified name).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? AnimationName(string? name) =>
            string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) ? "an animation name cannot be empty"
            : name!.IndexOfAny(Forbidden) >= 0 ? $"animation name '{name}' cannot contain '/', ':', ',' or '['"
            : null;

        /// <summary>A library name: may be empty (the global library) but without '/', ':', ',' or '[' (Godot's <c>is_valid_library_name</c>).</summary>
        public static string? LibraryName(string? name) =>
            name == null ? "a library name cannot be null (\"\" is the global library)"
            : name.IndexOfAny(Forbidden) >= 0 ? $"library name '{name}' cannot contain '/', ':', ',' or '['"
            : null;

        /// <summary>A track index of an animation with <paramref name="trackCount"/> tracks.</summary>
        public static string? TrackIndex(int index, int trackCount) =>
            index >= 0 && index < trackCount
                ? null
                : $"track {index} does not exist (the animation has {trackCount} track(s): 0 to {trackCount - 1})";

        /// <summary>
        /// The path of a new track: not empty; a value track animates a property, so its path is <c>"node:property"</c>
        /// (e.g. <c>"Mover:position:x"</c>) — the 0.x tool required the property too.
        /// </summary>
        public static string? TrackPath(AnimationTrackKind kind, string? path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return "a track path cannot be empty (\"Node\" or \"Node:property\")";
            if (kind == AnimationTrackKind.Value && path!.IndexOf(':') < 0)
                return $"a value track animates a property: give the path as \"node:property\" (e.g. \"{path}:position:x\"), got '{path}'";
            return null;
        }

        private static readonly char[] Forbidden = { '/', ':', ',', '[' };

        private static string Format(double value) => value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/Editor/Rql/AnimationTrackKind.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The kind of track <c>Animation.AddTrack(kind, path)</c> creates, mapping onto the subset of Godot's
    /// <c>Animation.TrackType</c> the module supports: a generic <c>Value</c> track (<c>"node:property"</c>)
    /// plus the three dedicated 3D transform tracks (<c>Position3D</c> / <c>Rotation3D</c> / <c>Scale3D</c>).
    /// Pure-managed (no Godot native types) so the parse/map logic is CI-unit-testable.
    /// </summary>
    public enum AnimationTrackKind
    {
        /// <summary>A generic value track — animates a node sub-property (Godot <c>TrackType.Value</c> = 0).</summary>
        Value,

        /// <summary>A 3D position track (Godot <c>TrackType.Position3D</c> = 1).</summary>
        Position3D,

        /// <summary>A 3D rotation track (Godot <c>TrackType.Rotation3D</c> = 2).</summary>
        Rotation3D,

        /// <summary>A 3D scale track (Godot <c>TrackType.Scale3D</c> = 3).</summary>
        Scale3D
    }

    /// <summary>Pure-managed helpers for <see cref="AnimationTrackKind"/> parsing, display and Godot mapping.</summary>
    public static class AnimationTrackKinds
    {
        /// <summary>The integer that maps to Godot's <c>Animation.TrackType</c> (0 / 1 / 2 / 3).</summary>
        public static int ToGodotTrackType(this AnimationTrackKind kind) => kind switch
        {
            AnimationTrackKind.Value => 0,
            AnimationTrackKind.Position3D => 1,
            AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D => 2,
            AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D => 3,
            _ => 0
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// Map a Godot <c>Animation.TrackType</c> integer back to <see cref="AnimationTrackKind"/>, or
        /// <c>null</c> for track types the module does not model (method/bezier/audio/blend-shape/animation).
        /// </summary>
        public static AnimationTrackKind? FromGodotTrackType(int trackType) => trackType switch
        {
            0 => AnimationTrackKind.Value,
            1 => AnimationTrackKind.Position3D,
            2 => AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D,
            3 => AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D,
            _ => null
        };

        /// <summary>Whether this kind is one of the dedicated 3D transform tracks (not a generic value track).</summary>
        public static bool IsTransform3D(this AnimationTrackKind kind) =>
            kind != AnimationTrackKind.Value;

        /// <summary>The short display label (<c>"value"</c> / <c>"position-3d"</c> / <c>"rotation-3d"</c> / <c>"scale-3d"</c>).</summary>
        public static string ToLabel(this AnimationTrackKind kind) => kind switch
        {
            AnimationTrackKind.Position3D => "position-3d",
            AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D => "rotation-3d",
            AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D => "scale-3d",
            _ => "value"
        };

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse a user/LLM-supplied track-kind string (case-, whitespace- and separator-insensitive). Accepts
        /// <c>"value"/"val"</c>; <c>"position-3d"/"position3d"/"pos3d"/"position"/"pos"</c>;
        /// <c>"rotation-3d"/"rotation3d"/"rot3d"/"rotation"/"rot"</c>;
        /// <c>"scale-3d"/"scale3d"/"scale"</c>. Returns false for anything else (and for null/empty).
        /// </summary>
        public static bool TryParse(string? value, out AnimationTrackKind kind)
        {
            kind = AnimationTrackKind.Value;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                return false;

            // Normalize: lower-case and strip '-', '_' and spaces so '3d', '3-d', '3_d' all collapse.
            var n = value!.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
                .Replace("-", "").Replace("_", "").Replace(" ", "");

            switch (n)
            {
                case "value":
                case "val":
                    kind = AnimationTrackKind.Value;
                    return true;
                case "position3d":
                case "pos3d":
                case "position":
                case "pos":
                    kind = AnimationTrackKind.Position3D;
                    return true;
                case "rotation3d":
                case "rot3d":
                case "rotation":
                case "rot":
                    kind = AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D;
                    return true;
                case "scale3d":
                case "scale":
                    kind = AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D;
                    return true;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse a track-kind string, throwing <see cref="ArgumentException"/> on an unrecognized value. Used
        /// by the module (the kind argument of AddTrack).
        /// </summary>
        public static AnimationTrackKind Parse(string? value)
        {
            if (TryParse(value, out var kind))
                return kind;
            throw new ArgumentException(
                $"Unrecognized animation track kind '{value}'. Use 'value', 'position-3d', " +
                "'rotation-3d' or 'scale-3d'.", nameof(value));
        }
    }
}

/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

#nullable enable
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// One track of an animation, as a read-only row of <c>Animation.tracks</c>: a snapshot with no Godot type, so it is
    /// built by the adapter and unit-testable. Change a track with the Animation's calls (<c>InsertKey</c>,
    /// <c>InsertTransformKey</c>) or by Godot property name (<c>props["tracks/0/path"]</c>).
    /// </summary>
    [RqlDescription("Animation track (read-only): index kind path keyCount")]
    public sealed class AnimationTrackRow
    {
        public AnimationTrackRow(int index, string kind, string path, int keyCount)
        {
            this.index = index;
            this.kind = kind;
            this.path = path;
            this.keyCount = keyCount;
        }

        [RqlDescription("0-based track index (the track argument of InsertKey / InsertTransformKey)")]
        public int index { get; }

        [RqlDescription("value, position-3d, rotation-3d, scale-3d, or Godot's track type name for other kinds")]
        public string kind { get; }

        [RqlDescription("animated path: \"Node:property\" for a value track, \"Node\" for a transform track")]
        public string path { get; }

        [RqlDescription("number of keys on the track")]
        public int keyCount { get; }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;
using GodotAnimation = Godot.Animation;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Animation: validated <c>Length</c>, read-only <c>tracks</c> rows and <c>trackCount</c>; calls <c>AddTrack(kind, path)</c>,
    /// <c>InsertKey(track, time, value)</c> (value tracks) and <c>InsertTransformKey(track, time, "(x, y, z)")</c> (3D transform
    /// tracks; rotation in Euler degrees). Undoable: the calls change the animation itself.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_Animation_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<GodotAnimation>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "Animation (Animation extension): Length (seconds, validated), LoopMode, tracks (index kind path keyCount), trackCount; " +
            "call AddTrack(kind, path), InsertKey(track, time, value), InsertTransformKey(track, time, \"(x, y, z)\")";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<GodotAnimation> m)
        {
            // The C# Length is a float up to Godot 4.6 and a double from 4.7: the casts compile against both.
            m.Add<double>("Length", a => (double)a.Length, (a, v) => a.Length = (float)v,
                    validate: (a, v) => AnimationRules.Length(v), description: "length in seconds (at least 0.001)")
             .Add<List<AnimationTrackRow>>("tracks", AnimationOps.Tracks, description: "the tracks (read-only rows: index kind path keyCount)")
             .Add<int>("trackCount", a => a.GetTrackCount(), description: "number of tracks");

            m.Function<string, string, int>("AddTrack", AnimationOps.AddTrack, "kind", "path",
                "add a track and return its index: kind value (path \"Node:property\", e.g. \"Mover:position:x\"), position-3d, rotation-3d " +
                "or scale-3d (path \"Node\"); node paths are relative to the player's root node (its parent by default; \".\" = that node)");
            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("InsertKey", new[] { new CallableParameter("track", typeof(int)), new CallableParameter("time", typeof(double)), new CallableParameter("value", typeof(Variant)) },
                    typeof(int), (o, a) => AnimationOps.InsertKey((GodotAnimation)o, (int)a[0]!, (double)a[1]!, (Variant)a[2]!),
                    "key a value track at a time (seconds) with a value (number, bool, text, resource …); returns the key index")
                .AddMethod("InsertTransformKey", new[] { new CallableParameter("track", typeof(int)), new CallableParameter("time", typeof(double)), new CallableParameter("value", typeof(Vector3)) },
                    typeof(int), (o, a) => AnimationOps.InsertTransformKey((GodotAnimation)o, (int)a[0]!, (double)a[1]!, (Vector3)a[2]!),
                    "key a position-3d / scale-3d track with \"(x, y, z)\", or a rotation-3d track with Euler angles in degrees; returns the key index");

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/Godot-AI-Animation.csproj`:

```csproj
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE-ONLY NuGet package recipe — the load-bearing detail of a Godot-MCP extension.          │
  │  Full rationale + the consumer story: docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md.                        │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Why source-only? An extension's RQL module (adapters, sources, methods) calls Godot's C# API (Node,
  Resource, EditorInterface, …). Shipping a
  pre-compiled DLL would LOCK the package to one GodotSharp version. Instead we ship the .cs SOURCE and
  let it compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project, against the CONSUMER's own GodotSharp (supplied by
  their `Godot.NET.Sdk`). No bundled Godot, no version lock.

  How (3 levers):
    1. <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>  — do NOT put this project's compiled DLL in the package.
    2. The .cs are packed under `src/` (plain files) and injected as <Compile> items in the consumer by
       `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet). See that props file.
    3. NO GodotSharp dependency is declared (DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences + PrivateAssets=all below)
       — the consumer provides it. Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is declared as a (min-version) dependency,
       which the consumer already has via the core Godot-MCP addon.

  This project ALSO uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` for AUTHORING only: so the editor-only module (#if TOOLS) compiles
  + the `Godot` namespace resolves when you build/test locally.
  No Godot binary is needed — `Godot.NET.Sdk` pulls `GodotSharp` from NuGet at compile time.
-->
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <RootNamespace>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation</AssemblyName>

    <!-- ===== Package identity (bump-version.ps1 / get-version.ps1 own the Version element) ===== -->
    <IsPackable>true</IsPackable>
    <PackageId>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation</PackageId>
    <Version>1.0.1</Version>
    <Title>Animation Tools</Title>
    <Authors>Ivan Murzak</Authors>
    <Description>RQL module for Godot Animation.</Description>
    <PackageTags>godot;mcp;ai;tools;godot-mcp;ai-game-developer</PackageTags>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>Apache-2.0</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP</RepositoryUrl>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP</PackageProjectUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>

    <!-- ===== Source-only levers ===== -->
    <!-- 1) Do not ship the compiled DLL; the consumer compiles our source against their GodotSharp. -->
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>
    <!-- NU5128: source-only package (dependencies but no lib/ref) — expected, silence it.
         NU1504: Godot.SourceGenerators is re-stated PrivateAssets=all to keep it out of deps (see below). -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <NoPackageAnalysis>true</NoPackageAnalysis>
    <!-- We hand-pick exactly which files ship (below); turn off default None globbing to avoid duplicates. -->
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
    <!-- Drop the SDK's implicit GodotSharp/GodotSharpEditor so we can re-add them PrivateAssets=all (a body
         <PackageReference Update> does NOT work — the SDK adds them after the project body is evaluated). -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!--
    Package DEPENDENCIES: only the engine-agnostic MCP / reflection / query stack (com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL
    module API: IRqlModule, type adapters). A NuGet Version="x" is a ">= x" floor; the pins EQUAL the core
    Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise): a lower
    ReflectorNet than the McpPlugin requires is a NU1605 downgrade, a higher pin cannot restore in a consumer
    pinned to the core. `update-core.ps1` / `update-core.py` keep package, tests and testbed in lockstep.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    GodotSharp is needed for AUTHORING compile only, NOT as a package dependency (the consumer supplies its
    own, version-matched). PrivateAssets=all stops these flowing into the package's dependency list — this
    is the "no GodotSharp dependency" guarantee, verified by inspecting the generated .nuspec.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <!-- Godot.SourceGenerators has no SDK opt-out property, so re-state it (Include) PrivateAssets=all to
         keep it out of the package deps too. This duplicates the SDK's implicit add -> NU1504 (suppressed
         above). The analyzer still runs locally (PrivateAssets governs only what flows to CONSUMERS). -->
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    What ships in the .nupkg:
      • the .cs SOURCE under `src/` (plain files — NOT contentFiles; injected by the props below),
      • `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet in the consumer; does the <Compile> injection),
      • README.md (package page).
    The .cs are <Compile> items in THIS authoring build (Godot.NET.Sdk default glob) so they compile +
    unit-test locally; adding them to <None Pack="true"> just also bundles them into the package.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>

    <None Include="build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/README.md`:

```md
# Animation Tools

RQL module for Godot AnimationPlayer: libraries, animations, tracks and keys for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

Optional Godot-MCP extension, independently versioned as NuGet package `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation` (1.0.1).
Requires a Godot C# project (4.3.0+) with a core `godot_mcp` addon that has the RQL tools
(`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, the release after 0.28.0).

## Install

```sh
godot-cli install-plugin /path/to/project
godot-cli install-extension com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation /path/to/project
godot-cli build /path/to/project
```

The installer resolves the latest stable version from NuGet; use `--version 1.0.1` to request an exact version.
Packages contain C# source and build props, compiled against the project's own GodotSharp.
Previous NuGet versions remain installable after the repository migration.

## RQL

Since 1.0.0 the extension is an **RQL module**: it adds no MCP tools. Agents create players, libraries,
animations, tracks and keys with the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools, and the module's guide
is part of the core `godot-rql` skill. The module adds:

- **AnimationPlayer / AnimationTree** (any `AnimationMixer`): the read-only maps `libraries["name"]` (`""` = the
  global library) and `animations["library/name"]`; calls `AddLibrary(name)` and
  `CreateAnimation(name, length = 1, loopMode = "none", library = "")` (adds the library when it is missing).
- **AnimationLibrary**: `animations["name"]` and `CreateAnimation(name, length = 1, loopMode = "none")`.
- **Animation**: a validated `Length` (at least 0.001 s), read-only `tracks` rows (`index kind path keyCount`) and
  `trackCount`; calls `AddTrack(kind, path)` (`value`, `position-3d`, `rotation-3d`, `scale-3d`; returns the
  index), `InsertKey(track, time, value)` for value tracks and `InsertTransformKey(track, time, "(x, y, z)")` for
  the 3D transform tracks (rotation as Euler degrees).

```
root | call AddChild("Node3D", "Mover")
root | call AddChild("AnimationPlayer", "Player")
nodes | where name == "Player" | call AddLibrary("")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get libraries[""] | call CreateAnimation("Idle", 2, "linear")
nodes | where name == "Player" | call CreateAnimation("Walk", 1, "none", "Extra")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call AddTrack("value", "Mover:position:x")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call InsertKey(0, 0.5, 1.5)
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call AddTrack("rotation-3d", "Mover")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call InsertTransformKey(1, 1, "(0, 90, 0)")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | set Length = 1.5, LoopMode = "Pingpong"
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"].tracks | select index kind path keyCount
nodes | where $ is AnimationPlayer | select name animations.keys() libraries.keys()
```

Every write is one undoable action (it changes the animation, library or player it is called on) and marks the
scene unsaved (`editor | call SaveScene()` writes it). One exception: `CreateAnimation` on the player into a
library that already exists changes only that library, so it is not undoable; call it on the library
(`get libraries["…"] | call CreateAnimation(…)`) instead. Invalid values (a length below 0.001, a negative key
time, a missing track, a name with `/`, `:`, `,` or `[`, an existing name) fail the call and change nothing
(0.x clamped lengths and key times).

### Migrating from 0.x

| 0.x tool | RQL |
| --- | --- |
| `animation-defaults` | removed: typical values (length 1 s, loop mode none) are the call defaults and in the guide |
| `animation-player-create` | `rql-mutate` `root \| call AddChild("AnimationPlayer", "Player")` |
| `animation-library-add` | `rql-mutate` `nodes \| where name == "Player" \| call AddLibrary("Extra")` |
| `animation-create` | `rql-mutate` `… \| get libraries[""] \| call CreateAnimation("Idle", 2, "linear")` or `… \| call CreateAnimation("Idle", 2, "linear", "")` on the player |
| `animation-add-track` | `rql-mutate` `… \| get animations["Idle"] \| call AddTrack("value", "Mover:position:x")` |
| `animation-insert-key` | `rql-mutate` `… \| get animations["Idle"] \| call InsertKey(0, 0.5, 1.5)`; transform tracks: `call InsertTransformKey(1, 1, "(0, 90, 0)")` |
| `animation-get` | `rql-query` `nodes \| where $ is AnimationPlayer \| select name animations.keys() libraries.keys()`; `… \| get animations["Idle"] \| select Length LoopMode tracks` |

## Development and releases

See the [monorepo test and release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md).
This module retains its own package, version, tests and Apache-2.0 [license](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/LICENSE).
Releasing another module does not rebuild or republish this package.

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/src/Godot-AI-Animation/build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.props`:

```props
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE INJECTION — the consumer half of the source-only package recipe.                       │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  NuGet auto-imports `build/<PackageId>.props` into any project that references this package. This file
  MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props` (com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.props) or NuGet will
  not import it. `bump-version` / `init` keep the name in lockstep with <PackageId>.

  It adds this package's packed `.cs` (which sit in the NuGet cache under `<package>/<version>/src/`) as
  <Compile> items in the CONSUMER's project, so they compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project against
  the consumer's own GodotSharp. Because the consumer is a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, `Godot` types resolve
  and `#if TOOLS` is defined for the editor build — exactly as if the source lived in the consumer's repo.

  • $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory) resolves to `<package>/<version>/build/` in the NuGet cache, so
    `../src/**/*.cs` is the packed source.
  • Exclude="@(Compile)" is belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion (the consumer's own default
    glob never reaches the NuGet cache, so it normally excludes nothing).
  • Link groups the injected files under the package id in IDEs (cosmetic).
-->
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/tests/Godot-AI-Animation.Tests/AnimationLoopModeTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Pure-managed specs for <see cref="AnimationLoopModes"/> — the loop-mode parsing every animation tool
    /// uses to map an LLM-supplied string onto Godot's <c>Animation.LoopModeEnum</c>. No Godot binary required.
    /// </summary>
    public class AnimationLoopModeTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData("none", AnimationLoopMode.None)]
        [InlineData("NONE", AnimationLoopMode.None)]
        [InlineData("once", AnimationLoopMode.None)]
        [InlineData("0", AnimationLoopMode.None)]
        [InlineData("linear", AnimationLoopMode.Linear)]
        [InlineData("loop", AnimationLoopMode.Linear)]
        [InlineData(" 1 ", AnimationLoopMode.Linear)]
        [InlineData("pingpong", AnimationLoopMode.PingPong)]
        [InlineData("ping-pong", AnimationLoopMode.PingPong)]
        [InlineData("2", AnimationLoopMode.PingPong)]
        public void TryParse_KnownValues_ParseToExpected(string input, AnimationLoopMode expected)
        {
            Assert.True(AnimationLoopModes.TryParse(input, out var mode));
            Assert.Equal(expected, mode);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(null)]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData("   ")]
        [InlineData("bounce")]
        [InlineData("3")]
        public void TryParse_UnknownOrEmpty_ReturnsFalse(string? input)
        {
            Assert.False(AnimationLoopModes.TryParse(input, out _));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Parse_Unknown_Throws()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => AnimationLoopModes.Parse("spiral"));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(AnimationLoopMode.None, "none", 0)]
        [InlineData(AnimationLoopMode.Linear, "linear", 1)]
        [InlineData(AnimationLoopMode.PingPong, "pingpong", 2)]
        public void Label_And_GodotValue_AreStable(AnimationLoopMode mode, string label, int godotValue)
        {
            Assert.Equal(label, mode.ToLabel());
            Assert.Equal(godotValue, mode.ToGodotValue());
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0, AnimationLoopMode.None)]
        [InlineData(1, AnimationLoopMode.Linear)]
        [InlineData(2, AnimationLoopMode.PingPong)]
        [InlineData(99, AnimationLoopMode.None)]
        public void FromGodotValue_MapsBack(int value, AnimationLoopMode expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, AnimationLoopModes.FromGodotValue(value));
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/tests/Godot-AI-Animation.Tests/AnimationModuleTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;
using Xunit;
using GodotAnimation = Godot.Animation;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The module configures cleanly and shapes the animation types: an RQL engine discovers it, registers its guide, and the
    /// member tables of AnimationMixer (so AnimationPlayer / AnimationTree), AnimationLibrary and Animation carry the maps,
    /// rows and calls. Metadata only: no Godot object is created.
    /// </summary>
    public class AnimationModuleTests
    {
        private static RqlEngine Engine()
        {
            var engine = new RqlEngine();
            var reports = engine.AddModulesFrom(new[] { typeof(AnimationModule).Assembly });
            Assert.All(reports, r => Assert.True(r.Ok, r.ToString()));
            Assert.Contains(reports, r => r.Module == typeof(AnimationModule).FullName);
            return engine;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ModuleRegistersItsGuide()
        {
            var guide = Assert.Single(Engine().Guides, g => g.Key == AnimationGuide.Topic);
            Assert.Equal(AnimationGuide.Markdown, guide.Value);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(AnimationPlayer))]
        [InlineData(typeof(AnimationTree))]
        public void MixersHaveLibrariesAnimationsAndCalls(System.Type type)
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(type);
            foreach (var name in new[] { "libraries", "animations" })
            {
                var member = Assert.Single(info.Members, m => m.Name == name);
                Assert.False(member.CanWrite);
                Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.Description));
            }
            var add = Assert.Single(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "AddLibrary");
            Assert.Equal(typeof(AnimationLibrary), add.ReturnType);
            var create = Assert.Single(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "CreateAnimation");
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "name", "length", "loopMode", "library" }, create.Parameters.Select(p => p.Name));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { false, true, true, true }, create.Parameters.Select(p => p.HasDefault));
            Assert.Equal(typeof(GodotAnimation), create.ReturnType);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LibraryHasAnimationsAndCreateAnimation()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(AnimationLibrary));
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "animations" && !m.CanWrite);
            var create = Assert.Single(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "CreateAnimation");
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "name", "length", "loopMode" }, create.Parameters.Select(p => p.Name));
            Assert.Equal(1.0, create.Parameters[1].Default);
            Assert.Equal("none", create.Parameters[2].Default);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AnimationHasValidatedLengthTracksAndKeyCalls()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(GodotAnimation));
            var length = Assert.Single(info.Members, m => m.Name == "Length");
            Assert.Null(length.Member); // the adapter's validated member replaced the C# property
            Assert.Equal(typeof(double), length.Type); // version-independent (float before Godot 4.7, double since)
            Assert.True(length.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "tracks" && !m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "trackCount" && m.Type == typeof(int) && !m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "LoopMode" && m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "AddTrack" && c.ReturnType == typeof(int) && c.Parameters.Count == 2);
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "InsertKey" && c.Parameters[2].Type == typeof(Variant));
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "InsertTransformKey" && c.Parameters[2].Type == typeof(Vector3));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TrackRowsAreReadOnlyColumns()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(AnimationTrackRow));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "index", "kind", "path", "keyCount" }, info.Members.Select(m => m.Name));
            Assert.All(info.Members, m => Assert.False(m.CanWrite));
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/tests/Godot-AI-Animation.Tests/AnimationRulesTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.Tests
{
    public class AnimationRulesTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0.001)]
        [InlineData(1.0)]
        [InlineData(120.0)]
        public void LengthOfAtLeastAMillisecondIsValid(double length) => Assert.Null(AnimationRules.Length(length));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0.0)]
        [InlineData(0.0005)]
        [InlineData(-1.0)]
        [InlineData(double.NaN)]
        [InlineData(double.PositiveInfinity)]
        public void ShorterOrNonFiniteLengthIsRejected(double length) => Assert.StartsWith("Length must be", AnimationRules.Length(length));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0.0)]
        [InlineData(2.5)]
        public void KeyTimeOfZeroOrMoreIsValid(double time) => Assert.Null(AnimationRules.KeyTime(time));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(-0.1)]
        [InlineData(double.NaN)]
        [InlineData(double.NegativeInfinity)]
        public void NegativeOrNonFiniteKeyTimeIsRejected(double time) => Assert.Contains("at least 0", AnimationRules.KeyTime(time));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("Idle")]
        [InlineData("walk cycle 2")]
        public void PlainAnimationNamesAreValid(string name) => Assert.Null(AnimationRules.AnimationName(name));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData(null)]
        [InlineData("Extra/Walk")]
        [InlineData("a:b")]
        [InlineData("a,b")]
        [InlineData("a[0]")]
        public void EmptyOrSeparatorAnimationNamesAreRejected(string? name) => Assert.NotNull(AnimationRules.AnimationName(name));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData("Extra")]
        public void GlobalAndPlainLibraryNamesAreValid(string name) => Assert.Null(AnimationRules.LibraryName(name));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(null)]
        [InlineData("a/b")]
        [InlineData("a:b")]
        public void NullOrSeparatorLibraryNamesAreRejected(string? name) => Assert.NotNull(AnimationRules.LibraryName(name));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0, 1)]
        [InlineData(2, 3)]
        public void ExistingTrackIndexIsValid(int index, int count) => Assert.Null(AnimationRules.TrackIndex(index, count));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(-1, 3)]
        [InlineData(3, 3)]
        [InlineData(0, 0)]
        public void MissingTrackIndexIsRejected(int index, int count) => Assert.Contains($"track {index} does not exist", AnimationRules.TrackIndex(index, count));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Value, "Mover:position:x")]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Position3D, "Mover")]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D, ".")]
        public void TrackPathsAreValid(AnimationTrackKind kind, string path) => Assert.Null(AnimationRules.TrackPath(kind, path));

        [Fact]
        public void ValueTrackPathNeedsAProperty() =>
            Assert.Contains("\"node:property\"", AnimationRules.TrackPath(AnimationTrackKind.Value, "Mover"));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData("  ")]
        [InlineData(null)]
        public void EmptyTrackPathIsRejected(string? path) => Assert.Contains("cannot be empty", AnimationRules.TrackPath(AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D, path));
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Animation/tests/Godot-AI-Animation.Tests/AnimationTrackKindTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Animation.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Pure-managed specs for <see cref="AnimationTrackKinds"/> — the track-kind parsing the
    /// <c>animation-add-track</c> / <c>-insert-key</c> tools use to map an LLM-supplied string onto Godot's
    /// <c>Animation.TrackType</c>. No Godot binary required.
    /// </summary>
    public class AnimationTrackKindTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData("value", AnimationTrackKind.Value)]
        [InlineData("VAL", AnimationTrackKind.Value)]
        [InlineData("position-3d", AnimationTrackKind.Position3D)]
        [InlineData("position3d", AnimationTrackKind.Position3D)]
        [InlineData("pos", AnimationTrackKind.Position3D)]
        [InlineData("rotation-3d", AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D)]
        [InlineData("rot3d", AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D)]
        [InlineData("scale-3d", AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D)]
        [InlineData(" scale ", AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D)]
        public void TryParse_KnownValues_ParseToExpected(string input, AnimationTrackKind expected)
        {
            Assert.True(AnimationTrackKinds.TryParse(input, out var kind));
            Assert.Equal(expected, kind);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(null)]
        [InlineData("")]
        [InlineData("   ")]
        [InlineData("bezier")]
        [InlineData("method")]
        public void TryParse_UnknownOrEmpty_ReturnsFalse(string? input)
        {
            Assert.False(AnimationTrackKinds.TryParse(input, out _));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Parse_Unknown_Throws()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => AnimationTrackKinds.Parse("audio"));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Value, "value", 0)]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Position3D, "position-3d", 1)]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D, "rotation-3d", 2)]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D, "scale-3d", 3)]
        public void Label_And_GodotTrackType_AreStable(AnimationTrackKind kind, string label, int trackType)
        {
            Assert.Equal(label, kind.ToLabel());
            Assert.Equal(trackType, kind.ToGodotTrackType());
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0, AnimationTrackKind.Value)]
        [InlineData(1, AnimationTrackKind.Position3D)]
        [InlineData(2, AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D)]
        [InlineData(3, AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D)]
        public void FromGodotTrackType_KnownTypes_MapBack(int trackType, AnimationTrackKind expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, AnimationTrackKinds.FromGodotTrackType(trackType));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(4)] // blend-shape
        [InlineData(5)] // method
        [InlineData(6)] // bezier
        public void FromGodotTrackType_UnmodeledTypes_ReturnNull(int trackType)
        {
            Assert.Null(AnimationTrackKinds.FromGodotTrackType(trackType));
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Value, false)]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Position3D, true)]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Rotation3D, true)]
        [InlineData(AnimationTrackKind.Scale3D, true)]
        public void IsTransform3D_TrueForTransformTracks(AnimationTrackKind kind, bool expected)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, kind.IsTransform3D());
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Beehave/AGENTS.md`:

```md
# AGENTS.md — Godot-AI-Beehave

A **Godot-MCP extension** for the third-party [**Beehave**](https://github.com/bitbrain/beehave) addon (behaviour
trees), shipped as an **RQL module**: it adds no MCP tools, only what the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` /
`rql-schema` tools need to work with Beehave nodes (the `beehave` source and an agent guide rendered into the core
`godot-rql` skill). A **source-only NuGet package** (`com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave`) compiled inside the
consumer's Godot project against the consumer's own GodotSharp; the packaging recipe is in
`docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md`.

## Layout

- `src/Godot-AI-Beehave/Editor/Rql/` — the module:
  - `BeehaveModule.cs` — the `IRqlModule` (Order 100, `#if TOOLS`): the `beehave` source and the guide. Its class
    name is load-bearing: `scripts/test_extensions.py`'s isolation canary references
    `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave.BeehaveModule`.
  - `BeehaveApi.cs` (the source: `installed`, `hint`, `trees`, `nodes`), `BeehaveTreeRow.cs`, `BeehaveNodeRow.cs`
    (read-only rows holding `node`), `BeehaveScripts.cs` (global script classes of a node) — `#if TOOLS`.
  - `BeehaveNames.cs` (addon class / property names, kinds, install hint) and `BeehaveGuide.cs` (the guide) —
    pure-managed, NOT behind `#if TOOLS`.
- `src/Godot-AI-Beehave/build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave.props` — source-injection props, auto-imported by
  NuGet in the consumer; MUST stay named `<PackageId>.props`.
- `tests/Godot-AI-Beehave.Tests/` — xUnit (no Godot binary): names / kinds, guide examples parse, the module's view
  types (GodotSharp metadata, `TOOLS` defined), and the e2e manifest runs every guide example.
- `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` — the live calls (`rql-*`), driven by `scripts/extension_e2e.py` from the monorepo suite, which
  installs the pinned addon from `extension.json` `testAddon`.
- `testbed/Beehave-Testbed.csproj` — consumer project restoring the local-packed package (injection proof).
- `commands/` — `bump-version`, `update-core`, `init` (`.ps1` + `.py`), `get-version.ps1`.
- CI and publishing are centralized in the monorepo; see `../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md`.

## Critical invariants

- **No compile-time dependency on Beehave.** Its classes are GDScript `class_name`s: no C# type (so no adapter can
  target them), not in ClassDB, `GetClass()` returns the native base `Node`. They are named by string only
  (`BeehaveNames`) and recognized through the node's script chain against `ProjectSettings.GetGlobalClassList()`.
  `dotnet build -c Debug` must pass with the addon absent, and configuring the module never touches Godot.
- **Rows are read-only views; writes go through `node`.** `get node | set props["…"]` is the core's write, so it is
  undoable and marks the scene unsaved. Creation is the core `AddChild("BeehaveTree", …)` (global script classes).
- **Absent addon:** `installed` false, `hint` = the install hint, empty lists; never throw.
- Every guide example runs, in order, in `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` (xUnit-asserted). The module uses only Godot,
  `com.IvanMurzak.Rql` and the BCL, never core-addon types (the authoring build has no core).

## Build / test (no Godot binary, addon absent)

```bash
dotnet build src/Godot-AI-Beehave/Godot-AI-Beehave.csproj -c Debug   # the module (#if TOOLS included)
dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-Beehave.Tests/Godot-AI-Beehave.Tests.csproj
```

The live suite (one headless editor for every module, the pinned addon installed) is
`python scripts/test_extensions.py` from the monorepo root. `dotnet pack` reuses the **global NuGet cache** for an
already-cached version: when re-packing the same `Version`, clear
`~/.nuget/packages/com.ivanmurzak.godot.mcp.beehave/<ver>` (or pack a unique version).

## Conventions

- Root namespace `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave`. Every `.cs` starts with the Apache-2.0 header and
  `#nullable enable`.
- The package declares only the `com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin` / `ReflectorNet` / `Rql` pins (equal to the core's); **GodotSharp and the
  Beehave addon must never become package dependencies** (CI asserts the nuspec). Bump them with
  `commands/update-core.ps1`.

`extensions/Godot-AI-Beehave/README.md`:

```md
# Beehave Tools

RQL module for the Godot Beehave addon (behaviour trees): a beehave source that lists trees and their nodes with their Beehave classes; build trees with the core AddChild.

Optional Godot-MCP extension, independently versioned as NuGet package `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave` (1.0.1).
Requires a Godot C# project (4.3.0+) with a core `godot_mcp` addon that has the RQL tools
(`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, the release after 0.28.0).

## Required prerequisite — install the Beehave addon yourself

This extension drives the **Beehave** addon but does **not** ship it. Before the module can do
anything, install Beehave into your own project:

- Install **Beehave** from the **Godot Asset Library**, or download the pinned release `v2.9.2` from the
  upstream repo [`bitbrain/beehave`](https://github.com/bitbrain/beehave/releases/tag/v2.9.2) and unzip it
  so the addon lives at `addons/beehave/`.
- **Enable it** under **Project Settings → Plugins**. Beehave registers GDScript `class_name` types
  (e.g. `BeehaveTree`) in the global script-class list; `beehave | select installed hint` reports whether it is there.

> **Attribution & disclaimer.** Beehave is © its authors under the **MIT** license; this extension is
> **not affiliated** with or endorsed by it. The addon is your project's own runtime dependency — this
> package never vendors, downloads, or redistributes it.

## Install

```sh
godot-cli install-plugin /path/to/project
godot-cli install-extension com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave /path/to/project
godot-cli build /path/to/project
```

The installer resolves the latest stable version from NuGet; use `--version 1.0.1` to request an exact version.
Packages contain C# source and build props, compiled against the project's own GodotSharp.
Previous NuGet versions remain installable after the repository migration.

## RQL

Since 1.0.0 the extension is an **RQL module**: it adds no MCP tools. Agents build and read behaviour trees with the
core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools, and the module's guide is part of the core `godot-rql` skill.
Beehave classes are GDScript `class_name`s (no C# type; `class` shows the native base `Node`), so the module adds:

- **The `beehave` source**: `installed`, `hint` (how to install the addon when it is missing), and the Beehave nodes of
  the edited scene as **read-only rows**: `beehave.trees` (`name path scriptClass enabled tickRate processThread actor
  childCount nodeCount node`) and `beehave.nodes` (`name path scriptClass kind tree depth parent childCount node`).
- **Writes go through the row's `node`** (`get node | set props["…"]`, `call AddChild(…)`, `Free()` …): they are the
  core's writes, so they are undoable and mark the scene unsaved. Nodes are created with the core `AddChild`, which
  instantiates global script classes by name.

```
beehave | select installed hint
root | call AddChild("BeehaveTree", "BT")
godot.find("BT") | call AddChild("SelectorComposite", "Sel")
godot.find("BT/Sel") | call AddChild("InverterDecorator", "Inv")
godot.find("BT/Sel/Inv") | call AddChild("ActionLeaf", "Act")
beehave.trees | where name == "BT" | get node | set props["tick_rate"] = 2, props["enabled"] = true
beehave.trees | select name enabled tickRate processThread actor nodeCount
beehave.nodes | where tree == "BT" | select name scriptClass kind depth path
```

Without the addon the module still loads: `beehave | select installed hint` returns `false` and the install hint,
and the lists are empty. Save the scene with `editor | call SaveScene()`.

### Migrating from 0.x

| 0.x tool | RQL |
| --- | --- |
| `beehave-defaults` | removed: the guide lists the classes and a typical tree (BeehaveTree, SelectorComposite, condition + action leaves, `tick_rate` 1) |
| `beehave-tree-create` | `rql-mutate` `root \| call AddChild("BeehaveTree", "BT")`, then `… \| get node \| set props["tick_rate"] = 2, props["enabled"] = true, props["actor"] = "Player"` |
| `beehave-add-composite` | `rql-mutate` `godot.find("BT") \| call AddChild("SelectorComposite", "Sel")` (or `SequenceComposite` …) |
| `beehave-add-decorator` | `rql-mutate` `godot.find("BT/Sel") \| call AddChild("InverterDecorator", "Inv")` (or `LimiterDecorator` …) |
| `beehave-add-leaf` | `rql-mutate` `godot.find("BT/Sel/Inv") \| call AddChild("ActionLeaf", "Act")` (or `ConditionLeaf`) |
| `beehave-get` | `rql-query` `beehave.trees \| select name enabled tickRate actor nodeCount` and `beehave.nodes \| where tree == "BT" \| select name scriptClass kind depth path` |
| `Installed: false` results | `beehave \| select installed hint` |

## Development and releases

See the [monorepo test and release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md).
This module retains its own package, version, tests and Apache-2.0 [license](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/extensions/Godot-AI-Beehave/LICENSE).
Releasing another module does not rebuild or republish this package.

## Asset Library installation

The independent Asset Library entry is named **Godot MCP - Beehave** and becomes public after moderator approval.
It downloads only this extension from its versioned GitHub release. Install Godot MCP core
and configure its NuGet dependencies first, then install the archive into the project and build C#.
The archive includes its own license, README and installation instructions. Third-party addon
prerequisites listed above still apply. Use either this source installation or this extension
NuGet package in a project; installing both creates duplicate C# types.

See the [Asset Library release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md#godot-asset-library).

`extensions/Godot-AI-Beehave/commands/bump-version.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Set the extension package version (the single source of truth: the package csproj <Version>).

.DESCRIPTION
    Updates <Version> in the source-only package csproj under src/. The release workflow is version-gated
    on this value (it publishes only when <Version> increases AND the tag does not yet exist).

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/bump-version.ps1 -NewVersion "1.0.1"
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/bump-version.ps1 -NewVersion "1.0.1" -WhatIf
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$NewVersion,
    [switch]$WhatIf
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "../extension.json")) {
    $pythonCommand = Get-Command py, python3, python -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $pythonCommand) { throw "Python 3 is required for the central version helper." }
    $pythonArguments = @()
    if ($pythonCommand.Name -match '^py(\.exe)?$') { $pythonArguments += '-3' }
    $pythonArguments += @((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "bump-version.py"), $NewVersion)
    if ($WhatIf) { $pythonArguments += '--what-if' }
    & $pythonCommand.Source @pythonArguments
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

if ($NewVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z\.\-]+)?$') {
    throw "Invalid semantic version: '$NewVersion' (expected major.minor.patch[-prerelease])."
}

$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$csproj = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot "src") -Recurse -Filter *.csproj |
    Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -match '<PackageId>' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $csproj) { throw "Could not find the package csproj (with <PackageId>) under src/." }

$content = Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw
if ($content -notmatch '<Version>([^<]+)</Version>') { throw "No <Version> element in $($csproj.Name)." }
$current = $Matches[1]
$new = $content -replace '<Version>[^<]+</Version>', "<Version>$NewVersion</Version>"

Write-Host "Package: $($csproj.Name)"
Write-Host "Version: $current -> $NewVersion"
if ($WhatIf) { Write-Host "(WhatIf — no changes written)" -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 }
Set-Content -Path $csproj.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline
Write-Host "Updated." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Remember to commit, then push to main to trigger the version-gated release."

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Beehave/commands/bump-version.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Set the extension package version (the package csproj <Version>). POSIX/Python mirror of bump-version.ps1.

Usage:
  python commands/bump-version.py 1.0.1
  python commands/bump-version.py 1.0.1 --what-if
  python commands/bump-version.py --get        # print current version
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SEMVER = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.\-]+)?$")


def find_package_csproj(root: Path) -> Path:
    for p in (root / "src").rglob("*.csproj"):
        if "<PackageId>" in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
            return p
    raise SystemExit("error: could not find the package csproj (with <PackageId>) under src/")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("version", nargs="?", help="new semantic version, e.g. 1.0.1")
    ap.add_argument("--what-if", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--get", action="store_true", help="print current version and exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    if (root / "extension.json").is_file():
        # Keep the monorepo inventory and package README versions in sync.
        sys.path.insert(0, str(root.parents[1] / "scripts"))
        from extension_release import bump
        from extensions import modules, SEMVER as stable_version
        module = modules(only=[root.name])[0]
        if args.get:
            print(module["version"])
            return 0
        if not args.version or not stable_version.fullmatch(args.version):
            ap.error("pass a stable major.minor.patch version")
        if args.what_if:
            print(f"{module['name']}: {module['version']} -> {args.version} (what-if)")
            return 0
        bump(module, args.version)
        return 0
    csproj = find_package_csproj(root)
    content = csproj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r"<Version>([^<]+)</Version>", content)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(f"error: no <Version> element in {csproj.name}")
    current = m.group(1)

    if args.get:
        print(current)
        return 0

    if not args.version or not SEMVER.match(args.version):
        print("error: pass a semantic version major.minor.patch[-prerelease]", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    print(f"Package: {csproj.name}")
    print(f"Version: {current} -> {args.version}")
    if args.what_if:
        print("(what-if — no changes written)")
        return 0
    csproj.write_text(re.sub(r"<Version>[^<]+</Version>", f"<Version>{args.version}</Version>", content),
                       encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    print("Updated.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```
