`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/commands/init.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Initialize a new Godot-MCP extension from this template: replace placeholders, rename files/folders,
    and activate the CI workflows.

.DESCRIPTION
    From a single -Feature name (PascalCase, e.g. "Particles") this derives and substitutes every
    placeholder, then renames any file/folder whose name contains YOUR_FEATURE, then activates CI by
    renaming `.github/workflows/*.yml-sample` -> `*.yml`.

    Derived values (override any with the matching parameter):
      Package id  : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>     (the NuGet <PackageId>)
      Repo        : IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-<Feature>          (-GitHubRepository)
      Display name: "<Feature> Tools"                       (-DisplayName)
      Description : "RQL module for Godot <Feature>."      (-Description)
      RQL source  : <feature-lowercased>                     (-SourceName; the module's RQL source name)

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/init.ps1 -Feature "Particles"

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/init.ps1 -Feature "Particles" -GitHubRepository "myuser/Godot-AI-Particles" -DisplayName "Particle Tools"
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string]$Feature,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$DisplayName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$Description,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$GitHubRepository,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$SourceName
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if ($Feature -notmatch '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$') {
    throw "Feature must be alphanumeric PascalCase (letters/digits, starts with a letter). Got: '$Feature'"
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DisplayName))      { $DisplayName = "$Feature Tools" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Description))       { $Description = "RQL module for Godot $Feature." }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($GitHubRepository))  { $GitHubRepository = "IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-$Feature" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SourceName))        { $SourceName = $Feature.ToLower() }

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$RepoRoot  = Split-Path -Parent $ScriptDir

# Longest tokens first so no token is a prefix of another mid-replacement.
$Replacements = [ordered]@{
    "YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY" = $GitHubRepository
    "YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME"               = $DisplayName
    "YOUR_DESCRIPTION"                = $Description
    "YOUR_SOURCE"                     = $SourceName
    "YOUR_FEATURE"                    = $Feature
}

Write-Host "Initializing Godot-MCP extension:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Feature      : $Feature"
Write-Host "  Package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.$Feature"
Write-Host "  Repository   : $GitHubRepository"
Write-Host "  Display name : $DisplayName"
Write-Host "  RQL source   : $SourceName"
Write-Host ""

$ExcludeDirs = @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', '.godot', 'local-nuget', '.vs')

function Test-Excluded([string]$path) {
    foreach ($d in $ExcludeDirs) {
        if ($path -match "[\\/]$([regex]::Escape($d))([\\/]|$)") { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

# 1) Replace placeholder content in all text files.
Write-Host "Replacing placeholders in file content..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$textExt = @('.cs','.csproj','.props','.targets','.md','.json','.yml','.yaml','.yml-sample','.godot','.config','.sh','.ps1','.py','.editorconfig','.gitignore','.txt')
Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoRoot -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object {
    $file = $_
    if (Test-Excluded $file.FullName) { return }
    if ($file.Name -eq 'init.ps1' -or $file.Name -eq 'init.py') { return }  # don't rewrite the running script
    $ext = $file.Extension.ToLower()
    $isText = ($textExt -contains $ext) -or ($file.Name -like '*.yml-sample') -or ($file.Name -eq 'LICENSE')
    if (-not $isText) { return }
    $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $content) { return }
    $new = $content
    foreach ($k in $Replacements.Keys) { $new = $new.Replace($k, $Replacements[$k]) }
    if ($new -ne $content) {
        Set-Content -Path $file.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline
        Write-Host "  updated $($file.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length+1))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

# 2) Rename files/folders whose NAME contains YOUR_FEATURE (deepest-first so children rename before parents).
Write-Host "Renaming files and folders..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoRoot -Recurse | Where-Object { -not (Test-Excluded $_.FullName) } |
    Sort-Object { $_.FullName.Length } -Descending | ForEach-Object {
        if ($_.Name -like '*YOUR_FEATURE*') {
            $newName = $_.Name.Replace('YOUR_FEATURE', $Feature)
            Rename-Item -Path $_.FullName -NewName $newName
            Write-Host "  renamed $($_.Name) -> $newName" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        }
    }

# 3) Activate CI: *.yml-sample -> *.yml
Write-Host "Activating CI workflows (*.yml-sample -> *.yml)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$wf = Join-Path $RepoRoot ".github/workflows"
if (Test-Path $wf) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $wf -Filter "*.yml-sample" | ForEach-Object {
        $target = $_.FullName -replace '\.yml-sample$', '.yml'
        Move-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $target -Force
        Write-Host "  activated $($_.Name) -> $([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($target))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Done. Next:" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  1. Review the changes, then build + test:"
Write-Host "       dotnet build src/Godot-AI-$Feature/Godot-AI-$Feature.csproj"
Write-Host "       dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-$Feature.Tests/Godot-AI-$Feature.Tests.csproj"
Write-Host "  2. Write the RQL module under src/Godot-AI-$Feature/Editor/Rql (adapters, sources, guide; see AGENTS.md)."
Write-Host "  3. Configure the NUGET_API_KEY secret, then push to main with a bumped <Version> to release."

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/commands/init.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Initialize a new Godot-MCP extension from this template (POSIX/Python path; mirrors init.ps1).

From a single --feature name (PascalCase, e.g. "Particles") this substitutes every placeholder, renames
files/folders whose name contains YOUR_FEATURE, then activates CI (*.yml-sample -> *.yml).

Derived (override with the matching flag):
  package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>
  repo         : IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-<Feature>      (--github-repository)
  display name : "<Feature> Tools"                   (--display-name)
  description  : "RQL module for Godot <Feature>."  (--description)
  RQL source   : <feature lowercased>                 (--source-name; the module's source, e.g. "particles | select …")

Usage:
  python commands/init.py --feature Particles
  python commands/init.py --feature Particles --github-repository myuser/Godot-AI-Particles
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {".git", "bin", "obj", ".godot", "local-nuget", ".vs"}
TEXT_EXT = {".cs", ".csproj", ".props", ".targets", ".md", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml",
            ".yml-sample", ".godot", ".config", ".sh", ".ps1", ".py", ".editorconfig",
            ".gitignore", ".txt"}
SELF = {"init.py", "init.ps1"}


def is_excluded(path: Path, root: Path) -> bool:
    rel_parts = path.relative_to(root).parts
    return any(part in EXCLUDE_DIRS for part in rel_parts)


def is_text(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name
    if name == "LICENSE":
        return True
    if name.endswith(".yml-sample"):
        return True
    return path.suffix.lower() in TEXT_EXT


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Initialize a Godot-MCP extension from the template.")
    ap.add_argument("--feature", required=True, help="PascalCase feature name, e.g. Particles")
    ap.add_argument("--display-name")
    ap.add_argument("--description")
    ap.add_argument("--github-repository")
    ap.add_argument("--source-name")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    feature = args.feature
    if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$", feature):
        print(f"error: --feature must be alphanumeric PascalCase. Got: {feature!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    display = args.display_name or f"{feature} Tools"
    description = args.description or f"RQL module for Godot {feature}."
    repo = args.github_repository or f"IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-{feature}"
    source = args.source_name or feature.lower()

    # Longest tokens first so no token is a prefix of another mid-replacement.
    replacements = [
        ("YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY", repo),
        ("YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME", display),
        ("YOUR_DESCRIPTION", description),
        ("YOUR_SOURCE", source),
        ("YOUR_FEATURE", feature),
    ]

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

    print("Initializing Godot-MCP extension:")
    print(f"  Feature      : {feature}")
    print(f"  Package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.{feature}")
    print(f"  Repository   : {repo}")
    print(f"  Display name : {display}")
    print(f"  RQL source   : {source}\n")

    # 1) Replace placeholder content.
    print("Replacing placeholders in file content...")
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file() or is_excluded(path, root) or path.name in SELF or not is_text(path):
            continue
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
            continue
        new = text
        for token, value in replacements:
            new = new.replace(token, value)
        if new != text:
            path.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
            print(f"  updated {path.relative_to(root)}")

    # 2) Rename files/folders containing YOUR_FEATURE, deepest-first.
    print("Renaming files and folders...")
    entries = [p for p in root.rglob("*") if not is_excluded(p, root)]
    for path in sorted(entries, key=lambda p: len(str(p)), reverse=True):
        if "YOUR_FEATURE" in path.name:
            new_name = path.name.replace("YOUR_FEATURE", feature)
            path.rename(path.with_name(new_name))
            print(f"  renamed {path.name} -> {new_name}")

    # 3) Activate CI.
    print("Activating CI workflows (*.yml-sample -> *.yml)...")
    wf = root / ".github" / "workflows"
    if wf.is_dir():
        for sample in wf.glob("*.yml-sample"):
            target = sample.with_name(sample.name[: -len("-sample")])
            sample.replace(target)
            print(f"  activated {sample.name} -> {target.name}")

    print("\nDone. Next:")
    print(f"  dotnet build src/Godot-AI-{feature}/Godot-AI-{feature}.csproj")
    print(f"  dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-{feature}.Tests/Godot-AI-{feature}.Tests.csproj")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Update the core MCP / reflection / query pins (com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin / com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet /
    com.IvanMurzak.Rql) in lockstep across the package, tests, and testbed csproj files.

.DESCRIPTION
    These pins MUST equal the core Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP/Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py
    core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise); com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL module API. When the core advances its pins,
    run this in the same change. Pass any of the three.

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -McpPlugin "6.11.0"
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -McpPlugin "6.11.0" -ReflectorNet "5.4.0" -WhatIf
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -Rql "0.2.0"
#>
param(
    [string]$McpPlugin,
    [string]$ReflectorNet,
    [string]$Rql,
    [switch]$WhatIf
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if (-not $McpPlugin -and -not $ReflectorNet -and -not $Rql) { throw "Pass -McpPlugin, -ReflectorNet and/or -Rql." }

$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$targets = @('src', 'tests', 'testbed') | ForEach-Object {
    $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $_
    if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Recurse -Filter *.csproj }
}

$pins = @{}
if ($McpPlugin)    { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin']  = $McpPlugin }
if ($ReflectorNet) { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet'] = $ReflectorNet }
if ($Rql)          { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.Rql']          = $Rql }

foreach ($csproj in $targets) {
    $content = Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw
    $new = $content
    foreach ($id in $pins.Keys) {
        $pattern = '(<PackageReference\s+Include="' + [regex]::Escape($id) + '"\s+Version=")[^"]+(")'
        $new = [regex]::Replace($new, $pattern, "`${1}$($pins[$id])`${2}")
    }
    if ($new -ne $content) {
        Write-Host "Updating $($csproj.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length+1))"
        foreach ($id in $pins.Keys) { Write-Host "  $id -> $($pins[$id])" }
        if (-not $WhatIf) { Set-Content -Path $csproj.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline }
    }
}
if ($WhatIf) { Write-Host "(WhatIf — no changes written)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
else { Write-Host "Done. Rebuild + test to confirm compatibility." -ForegroundColor Green }

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/commands/update-core.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Update the core MCP / reflection / query pins in lockstep across package/tests/testbed. Mirror of update-core.ps1.

The pins (com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin, com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet, com.IvanMurzak.Rql = the RQL module API) must
EQUAL the core Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP/Godot-MCP.csproj); scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise.

Usage:
  python commands/update-core.py --mcp-plugin 6.11.0
  python commands/update-core.py --mcp-plugin 6.11.0 --reflector-net 5.4.0 --what-if
  python commands/update-core.py --rql 0.2.0
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--mcp-plugin")
    ap.add_argument("--reflector-net")
    ap.add_argument("--rql")
    ap.add_argument("--what-if", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not args.mcp_plugin and not args.reflector_net and not args.rql:
        raise SystemExit("error: pass --mcp-plugin, --reflector-net and/or --rql")

    pins = {}
    if args.mcp_plugin:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin"] = args.mcp_plugin
    if args.reflector_net:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet"] = args.reflector_net
    if args.rql:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.Rql"] = args.rql

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    csprojs = []
    for sub in ("src", "tests", "testbed"):
        d = root / sub
        if d.is_dir():
            csprojs += list(d.rglob("*.csproj"))

    for csproj in csprojs:
        content = csproj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        new = content
        for pid, ver in pins.items():
            new = re.sub(
                r'(<PackageReference\s+Include="' + re.escape(pid) + r'"\s+Version=")[^"]+(")',
                r"\g<1>" + ver + r"\g<2>", new)
        if new != content:
            print(f"Updating {csproj.relative_to(root)}")
            for pid, ver in pins.items():
                print(f"  {pid} -> {ver}")
            if not args.what_if:
                csproj.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")

    print("(what-if — no changes written)" if args.what_if else "Done. Rebuild + test to confirm.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md`:

```md
# The source-only NuGet recipe (the centerpiece)

A Godot-MCP extension is distributed as a **source-only** NuGet package: it ships C# **source**, not a
compiled DLL. The source compiles **inside the consumer's Godot project**, against the **consumer's own
GodotSharp**. This is what lets one package work across Godot versions with no bundled engine and no
version lock.

This recipe is **verified** end-to-end with `dotnet` alone (no Godot binary): build the package → unit
test → `dotnet pack` → restore+build a consumer `Godot.NET.Sdk` project that references it → the injected
source compiles clean against the consumer's GodotSharp.

## Why not a normal (DLL) package?

The RQL module calls Godot's C# API (`Node`, `Resource`, `EditorInterface`, …) which lives in
**GodotSharp**. A pre-compiled DLL is built against **one** GodotSharp version and is therefore locked to
it — a consumer on a different Godot version gets binary-incompatibility. Shipping **source** sidesteps
this: the consumer is itself a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, so its build supplies GodotSharp at compile time
and our source compiles against *that* exact version.

## The three levers (in the package csproj)

```xml
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">   <!-- min-version floor; consumer uses its own -->
  <PropertyGroup>
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>            <!-- (1) ship no DLL -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>  <!-- (3) -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is a package dependency (the consumer already has it); pins = the core's. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin"   Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql"         Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- (3) GodotSharp is needed to COMPILE locally but must NOT be a package dependency. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp"            Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor"      Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- (2) Pack the .cs as plain files under src/ + the injection props under build/. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Editor/**/*.cs"  Pack="true" PackagePath="src/Editor/" />
    <None Include="build/<PackageId>.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

**Lever 1 — no DLL.** `IncludeBuildOutput=false` keeps the compiled assembly out of the package; the
package's payload is the `.cs` files + the injection props.

**Lever 2 — inject source as `<Compile>` in the consumer.** The `.cs` are packed as plain files under
`src/`. The package ships `build/<PackageId>.props`, which **NuGet auto-imports** into any consuming
project (this is why the file MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props`). The props adds the packed `.cs`
as `<Compile>` items:

```xml
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="<PackageId>\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

`$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)` resolves into the NuGet cache (`…/<package>/<version>/build/`), so
`..\src\**\*.cs` is the packed source. The consumer's own default glob never reaches the cache, so
`Exclude="@(Compile)"` is just belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion.

**Lever 3 — declare NO GodotSharp dependency.** The authoring project uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` so the
`Godot` namespace resolves and `#if TOOLS` compiles locally — but GodotSharp must NOT leak into the
package's dependency list (the consumer provides its own). Two steps are required because a plain
`<PackageReference Update="GodotSharp" PrivateAssets="all">` in the project body **does not work** (the
SDK adds GodotSharp *after* the body is evaluated, so there is nothing to update yet):

1. `DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences=true` drops the SDK's implicit `GodotSharp` + `GodotSharpEditor`.
2. Re-add `GodotSharp`/`GodotSharpEditor` explicitly with `PrivateAssets="all"` (kept for the local
   compile, excluded from the package deps). `Godot.SourceGenerators` has **no** SDK opt-out, so it is
   re-stated as an explicit `Include … PrivateAssets="all"` (this duplicates the implicit add → the
   harmless `NU1504`, suppressed via `NoWarn`).

Verify it worked by inspecting the generated `.nuspec` — its `<dependencies>` must list **only**
`com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin`, `com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet` and `com.IvanMurzak.Rql`, with **no** `GodotSharp` /
`Godot.SourceGenerators`. CI asserts exactly this (`scripts/extensions.py` `verify_package`).

## Why `build/*.props` injection, not `contentFiles`?

NuGet's `contentFiles` with `buildAction="Compile"` is the other documented way to inject source. We use
the **`build/*.props`** mechanism instead because:

- **SDK-agnostic and deterministic.** It is plain MSBuild `<Compile Include>` — it does not depend on
  NuGet's `contentFiles`-Compile auto-injection behaving identically under `Godot.NET.Sdk` (which
  customizes globbing); the props is auto-imported the same way for every SDK.
- **One obvious file to read and override.** The whole injection is one short, visible props file rather
  than `contentFiles` metadata split between the nuspec and NuGet's restore-generated targets.
- **No double-compile risk.** `EnableDefaultNoneItems=false` + the explicit `<None Pack>` list controls
  exactly what ships; the consumer's project-dir glob never overlaps the cache.

`contentFiles` remains a valid alternative; if you switch, drop the props and pack the `.cs` under
`contentFiles/cs/any/…` with `buildAction="Compile"`, and re-verify the consumer build + the `.nuspec`
dependency list.

## Editor-only API: `#if TOOLS`

The RQL module, its adapters and sources sit behind `#if TOOLS`: RQL is the editor's data layer, so they
compile in the editor and are excluded from shipped games — exactly as in the core addon (Godot defines
`TOOLS` for the editor/Debug build and **not** for an exported game build). The agent guide and other
pure-managed helpers (validation rules, label maps) stay outside the guard so they are CI-unit-testable.
The core runs every RQL query on the editor main thread, so module code may touch `Node` / `Resource` /
`EditorInterface` directly.

## The consumer story

1. The consumer is a Godot **C#** project with the core `godot_mcp` addon enabled (which already
   references `com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin`, `com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet` and `com.IvanMurzak.Rql`).
2. Installing the extension adds one line to the consumer's `.csproj`:
   `<PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>" Version="x.y.z" />`
   (done by the **Extensions dock**, `godot-cli install-extension`, or by hand).
3. Rebuild. NuGet imports `build/<PackageId>.props` → the extension's `.cs` compile into the consumer's
   single project assembly against the consumer's GodotSharp.
4. The core's RQL engine discovers the module (`IRqlModule`) in the project assembly — **no registry edit**.
   Its adapters, sources and guide appear in `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` and the `godot-rql`
   skill, inside the user's real Godot editor.

## Publishing & the shared catalog

`release.yml` publishes the source-only package to NuGet (version-gated) and cuts an atomic GitHub
Release. To make the extension appear in the in-editor **Extensions** dock and `godot-cli
install-extension`, append one entry to the shared catalog `addons/godot_mcp/extensions.catalog.json` in
**Godot-MCP** (schema in `extensions.catalog.md`): `name`, `description`, `packageId`
(`com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>`), optional `version`, `gitUrl`, and `tools` (empty for an RQL module). That
single source of truth is consumed by the dock, the CLI, and the app.

using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation
{
    /// <summary>NavigationAgent2D: validated radius, distances, speed, time horizons and avoidance priority.</summary>
    public sealed class Godot_NavigationAgent2D_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<NavigationAgent2D>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "NavigationAgent2D pathfinding + avoidance helper (Navigation extension): Radius > 0; PathDesiredDistance, " +
            "TargetDesiredDistance, MaxSpeed, TimeHorizonAgents, TimeHorizonObstacles >= 0; AvoidancePriority 0..1";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<NavigationAgent2D> m) =>
            m.Add<float>("Radius", a => a.Radius, (a, v) => a.Radius = v,
                    validate: (a, v) => NavigationRules.Radius(v), description: "avoidance radius in pixels (above 0)")
             .NonNegative("PathDesiredDistance", a => a.PathDesiredDistance, (a, v) => a.PathDesiredDistance = v,
                    "distance at which the next path point counts as reached")
             .NonNegative("TargetDesiredDistance", a => a.TargetDesiredDistance, (a, v) => a.TargetDesiredDistance = v,
                    "distance at which the target counts as reached")
             .NonNegative("MaxSpeed", a => a.MaxSpeed, (a, v) => a.MaxSpeed = v, "maximum speed used by avoidance, pixels per second")
             .NonNegative("TimeHorizonAgents", a => a.TimeHorizonAgents, (a, v) => a.TimeHorizonAgents = v,
                    "seconds ahead that avoidance looks for other agents")
             .NonNegative("TimeHorizonObstacles", a => a.TimeHorizonObstacles, (a, v) => a.TimeHorizonObstacles = v,
                    "seconds ahead that avoidance looks for obstacles")
             .Add<float>("AvoidancePriority", a => a.AvoidancePriority, (a, v) => a.AvoidancePriority = v,
                    validate: (a, v) => NavigationRules.Priority(v), description: "avoidance priority (0 to 1; higher agents are avoided by lower ones)");
    }
}
#endif

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/Editor/Rql/Godot_NavigationPolygon_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// NavigationPolygon (the 2D region's resource): <c>AddOutline(points)</c> / <c>ClearOutlines()</c> as calls on the resource
    /// itself (so they are undoable), and <c>outlineCount</c>.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_NavigationPolygon_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<NavigationPolygon>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "NavigationPolygon (Navigation extension): call AddOutline([\"(0, 0)\", \"(100, 0)\", …]) / ClearOutlines(), then Bake() the region; outlineCount";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<NavigationPolygon> m) =>
            m.Add<int>("outlineCount", p => p.GetOutlineCount(), description: "outlines the bake starts from")
             // Typed calls, not Expose: the CLR overload set of AddOutline differs between GodotSharp versions (Vector2[] in
             // 4.3, ReadOnlySpan<Vector2> later), and a span parameter cannot be built from a query literal.
             .Method<Vector2[]>("AddOutline", AddOutline, "points",
                    "add a closed outline (a list of at least 3 \"(x, y)\" points) that the bake fills with polygons")
             .Method("ClearOutlines", p => p.ClearOutlines(), "remove every outline");

        private static void AddOutline(NavigationPolygon polygon, Vector2[] points)
        {
            if (NavigationRules.Outline(points?.Length ?? 0) is { } reason) throw new ArgumentException(reason);
            polygon.AddOutline(points!);
        }
    }
}
#endif

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/Editor/Rql/Godot_NavigationRegion2D_Adapter.cs`:

/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation
{
    /// <summary>NavigationRegion2D: validated costs, <c>polygonCount</c>, and <c>Bake()</c> (a synchronous navigation polygon bake).</summary>
    public sealed class Godot_NavigationRegion2D_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<NavigationRegion2D>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "NavigationRegion2D navigable area (Navigation extension): set NavigationPolygon = {\"$type\": \"NavigationPolygon\"} (or a res:// path), " +
            "add outlines to it, call Bake(); EnterCost / TravelCost >= 0; polygonCount";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<NavigationRegion2D> m) =>
            m.Costs(r => r.EnterCost, (r, v) => r.EnterCost = v, r => r.TravelCost, (r, v) => r.TravelCost = v)
             .Add<int>("polygonCount", r => r.NavigationPolygon?.GetPolygonCount() ?? 0,
                    description: "polygons in the NavigationPolygon (0 before a bake or without one)")
             .Function<int>("Bake", Bake,
                    "bake the NavigationPolygon from its outlines and the geometry below the region, on the main thread; returns the " +
                    "polygon count. The baked polygons are not undoable: bake again");

        private static int Bake(NavigationRegion2D region)
        {
            if (NavigationRules.CanBake($"NavigationRegion2D '{region.Name}'", "NavigationPolygon", region.NavigationPolygon != null, region.IsBaking()) is { } reason)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(reason);
            region.BakeNavigationPolygon(onThread: false);
            return region.NavigationPolygon!.GetPolygonCount();
        }
    }
}
#endif

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/Editor/Rql/NavigationGuide.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The agent guide of the Navigation RQL module, rendered into the <c>godot-rql</c> skill (<see cref="NavigationModule"/>).
    /// Pure strings (no Godot API, not behind <c>#if TOOLS</c>) so the xUnit suite parses every example; the live e2e manifest
    /// (<c>tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json</c>) runs each one, in this order, against a scene whose root is a Node3D.
    /// </summary>
    public static class NavigationGuide
    {
        public const string Topic = "Navigation";

        /// <summary>One example per line: the query, three or more spaces, a note.</summary>
        public const string Examples =
            "root | call AddChild(\"NavigationRegion3D\", \"NavRegion\")   a navigable area (NavigationRegion2D in 2D)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"NavRegion\" | set NavigationMesh = {\"$type\": \"NavigationMesh\"}   a new mesh (2D: NavigationPolygon = {\"$type\": \"NavigationPolygon\"}; or a res:// path)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"NavRegion\" | set NavigationMesh.GeometryParsedGeometryType = \"StaticColliders\", NavigationMesh.AgentRadius = 0.5   bake settings: parse collision shapes\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"NavRegion\" | call AddChild(\"StaticBody3D\", \"Floor\")   geometry below the region\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Floor\" | call AddChild(\"CollisionShape3D\", \"FloorShape\")   its collision shape\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"FloorShape\" | set Shape = {\"$type\": \"BoxShape3D\", \"Size\": \"(10, 1, 10)\"}   a 10 x 10 floor\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"NavRegion\" | call Bake()   bake the mesh now; returns the polygon count\n" +
            "nodes | where $ is NavigationRegion3D | select name Enabled polygonCount NavigationMesh   the regions and their baked polygons\n" +
            "root | call AddChild(\"NavigationAgent3D\", \"NavAgent\")   a pathfinding agent (usually a child of the moving body)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"NavAgent\" | set Radius = 0.75, MaxSpeed = 8, PathDesiredDistance = 1, TargetDesiredDistance = 1, AvoidanceEnabled = true   agent settings (validated)\n" +
            "root | call AddChild(\"NavigationLink3D\", \"NavLink\")   an off-mesh connection (a jump, a ladder)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"NavLink\" | set StartPosition = \"(0, 0, 0)\", EndPosition = \"(5, 0, 0)\", Bidirectional = true   its two ends, in local space\n" +
            "nodes | where $ is NavigationAgent3D | select name Radius MaxSpeed PathDesiredDistance AvoidanceEnabled   read the agents";

        public const string Markdown =
            "Navigation nodes come in 2D and 3D: NavigationRegion2D/3D (a navigable area holding a NavigationPolygon / NavigationMesh), " +
            "NavigationAgent2D/3D (pathfinding and avoidance for a moving node) and NavigationLink2D/3D (an off-mesh connection). Add them " +
            "with `AddChild`, then set their members (undoable; the scene is marked unsaved):\n\n```\n" + Examples + "\n```\n\n" +
            "Validated (an invalid value fails the whole mutation and changes nothing): agent `Radius` (above 0), `PathDesiredDistance`, " +
            "`TargetDesiredDistance`, `MaxSpeed`, `Height` (3D), `TimeHorizonAgents`, `TimeHorizonObstacles` (0 or more), " +
            "`AvoidancePriority` (0 to 1); region and link `EnterCost` / `TravelCost` (0 or more). `Bake()` on a region bakes on the main " +
            "thread and needs its NavigationMesh / NavigationPolygon; the baked polygons are not undoable (bake again). The 3D mesh's " +
            "`GeometryParsedGeometryType` decides what is parsed (\"MeshInstances\", \"StaticColliders\", \"Both\"); a 2D NavigationPolygon " +
            "bakes from its outlines: `nodes | where name == \"NavRegion2D\" | get NavigationPolygon | call AddOutline([\"(0, 0)\", " +
            "\"(400, 0)\", \"(400, 300)\", \"(0, 300)\"])`. Godot's agent defaults: 3D radius 0.5 m, desired distances 1 m, max speed " +
            "10 m/s; 2D radius 10 px, path distance 20 px, target distance 10 px, max speed 100 px/s. `rql-schema \"NavigationAgent3D\"` " +
            "lists every member.";
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/Editor/Rql/NavigationMembers.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The validated members the navigation adapters share. The 2D and 3D node of each family have no common base class
    /// with these properties, so each adapter passes its own typed getter / setter; the member replaces the C# property of
    /// the same name and type and adds the <see cref="NavigationRules"/> check.
    /// </summary>
    internal static class NavigationMembers
    {
        public static MemberTable<T> NonNegative<T>(this MemberTable<T> m, string name, Func<T, float> get, Action<T, float> set, string description) =>
            m.Add<float>(name, get, set, validate: (o, v) => NavigationRules.NonNegative(name, v), description: description + " (0 or more)");

        /// <summary>EnterCost / TravelCost of a region or link.</summary>
        public static MemberTable<T> Costs<T>(this MemberTable<T> m, Func<T, float> enter, Action<T, float> setEnter,
            Func<T, float> travel, Action<T, float> setTravel) =>
            m.NonNegative("EnterCost", enter, setEnter, "cost added when a path enters this from another region / link")
             .NonNegative("TravelCost", travel, setTravel, "multiplier of the travelled distance inside it");
    }
}
#endif

    /// <summary>
    /// The extension's RQL module, discovered by the core addon in the consumer project assembly once this package is
    /// installed: validated members on the navigation agents, regions and links (2D and 3D), <c>Bake()</c> and
    /// <c>polygonCount</c> on the regions, outline calls on NavigationPolygon, and the agent guide rendered into the
    /// <c>godot-rql</c> skill. Creating nodes and assigning their resources are ordinary RQL (the core <c>AddChild</c> call,
    /// <c>set NavigationMesh = {"$type": "NavigationMesh"}</c>), so the extension has no MCP tools of its own.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class NavigationModule : IRqlModule
    {
        public int Order => 100;

        public void Configure(RqlModuleContext ctx) =>
            ctx.AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationRegion3D_Adapter())
               .AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationRegion2D_Adapter())
               .AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationAgent3D_Adapter())
               .AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationAgent2D_Adapter())
               .AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationLink3D_Adapter())
               .AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationLink2D_Adapter())
               .AddAdapter(new Godot_NavigationPolygon_Adapter())
               .AddGuide(NavigationGuide.Topic, NavigationGuide.Markdown);
    }
}
#endif

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/Editor/Rql/NavigationRules.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Globalization;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The value rules the module's adapters enforce before a navigation node is written (an RQL <c>validate</c> runs before
    /// any write, so a rejected value fails the whole mutation and changes nothing), and the preconditions of the bake calls.
    /// Each returns the rejection reason, or null when the value is valid. Pure-managed (no Godot API), so it is unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    public static class NavigationRules
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// An agent's avoidance radius: above 0 (0.x clamped it to a small positive value; Godot itself logs an error for a
        /// negative radius and keeps the old one).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? Radius(float value) =>
            value > 0f && Finite(value) ? null : $"Radius must be above 0 (got {Text(value)})";

        /// <summary>
        /// Distances, speeds, times and costs that cannot be negative: PathDesiredDistance, TargetDesiredDistance (0.x clamped
        /// them), MaxSpeed, Height, TimeHorizonAgents / TimeHorizonObstacles, EnterCost / TravelCost (Godot logs an error for a
        /// negative value and keeps the old one).
        /// </summary>
        public static string? NonNegative(string member, float value) =>
            value >= 0f && Finite(value) ? null : $"{member} must be 0 or more (got {Text(value)})";

        /// <summary>AvoidancePriority: Godot refuses a value outside 0 to 1 (logs an error, keeps the old one).</summary>
        public static string? Priority(float value) =>
            value >= 0f && value <= 1f ? null : $"AvoidancePriority must be between 0 and 1 (got {Text(value)})";

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether a region can bake: it needs its navigation resource (Godot logs an error without one) and must not be
        /// baking already. <paramref name="resource"/> names it ("NavigationMesh" / "NavigationPolygon").
        /// </summary>
        public static string? CanBake(string region, string resource, bool hasResource, bool baking) =>
            !hasResource ? $"{region} has no {resource} to bake into: set {resource} = {{\"$type\": \"{resource}\"}} first"
            : baking ? $"{region} is already baking"
            : null;

        /// <summary>A NavigationPolygon outline is a closed shape: at least 3 points (fewer make the bake fail).</summary>
        public static string? Outline(int points) =>
            points >= 3 ? null : $"an outline needs at least 3 points (got {points})";

        private static bool Finite(float value) => !float.IsNaN(value) && !float.IsInfinity(value);

        private static string Text(float value) => value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }
}

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/Godot-AI-Navigation.csproj`:

```csproj
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE-ONLY NuGet package recipe — the load-bearing detail of a Godot-MCP extension.          │
  │  Full rationale + the consumer story: docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md.                        │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Why source-only? An extension's RQL module (adapters, sources, methods) calls Godot's C# API (Node,
  Resource, EditorInterface, …). Shipping a
  pre-compiled DLL would LOCK the package to one GodotSharp version. Instead we ship the .cs SOURCE and
  let it compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project, against the CONSUMER's own GodotSharp (supplied by
  their `Godot.NET.Sdk`). No bundled Godot, no version lock.

  How (3 levers):
    1. <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>  — do NOT put this project's compiled DLL in the package.
    2. The .cs are packed under `src/` (plain files) and injected as <Compile> items in the consumer by
       `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet). See that props file.
    3. NO GodotSharp dependency is declared (DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences + PrivateAssets=all below)
       — the consumer provides it. Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is declared as a (min-version) dependency,
       which the consumer already has via the core Godot-MCP addon.

  This project ALSO uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` for AUTHORING only: so the editor-only module (#if TOOLS) compiles
  + the `Godot` namespace resolves when you build/test locally.
  No Godot binary is needed — `Godot.NET.Sdk` pulls `GodotSharp` from NuGet at compile time.
-->
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <RootNamespace>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation</AssemblyName>

    <!-- ===== Package identity (bump-version.ps1 / get-version.ps1 own the Version element) ===== -->
    <IsPackable>true</IsPackable>
    <PackageId>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation</PackageId>
    <Version>1.0.1</Version>
    <Title>Navigation Tools</Title>
    <Authors>Ivan Murzak</Authors>
    <Description>RQL module for Godot Navigation.</Description>
    <PackageTags>godot;mcp;ai;tools;godot-mcp;ai-game-developer</PackageTags>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>Apache-2.0</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP</RepositoryUrl>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP</PackageProjectUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>

    <!-- ===== Source-only levers ===== -->
    <!-- 1) Do not ship the compiled DLL; the consumer compiles our source against their GodotSharp. -->
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>
    <!-- NU5128: source-only package (dependencies but no lib/ref) — expected, silence it.
         NU1504: Godot.SourceGenerators is re-stated PrivateAssets=all to keep it out of deps (see below). -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <NoPackageAnalysis>true</NoPackageAnalysis>
    <!-- We hand-pick exactly which files ship (below); turn off default None globbing to avoid duplicates. -->
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
    <!-- Drop the SDK's implicit GodotSharp/GodotSharpEditor so we can re-add them PrivateAssets=all (a body
         <PackageReference Update> does NOT work — the SDK adds them after the project body is evaluated). -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!--
    Package DEPENDENCIES: only the engine-agnostic MCP / reflection / query stack (com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL
    module API: IRqlModule, type adapters). A NuGet Version="x" is a ">= x" floor; the pins EQUAL the core
    Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise): a lower
    ReflectorNet than the McpPlugin requires is a NU1605 downgrade, a higher pin cannot restore in a consumer
    pinned to the core. `update-core.ps1` / `update-core.py` keep package, tests and testbed in lockstep.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    GodotSharp is needed for AUTHORING compile only, NOT as a package dependency (the consumer supplies its
    own, version-matched). PrivateAssets=all stops these flowing into the package's dependency list — this
    is the "no GodotSharp dependency" guarantee, verified by inspecting the generated .nuspec.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <!-- Godot.SourceGenerators has no SDK opt-out property, so re-state it (Include) PrivateAssets=all to
         keep it out of the package deps too. This duplicates the SDK's implicit add -> NU1504 (suppressed
         above). The analyzer still runs locally (PrivateAssets governs only what flows to CONSUMERS). -->
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    What ships in the .nupkg:
      • the .cs SOURCE under `src/` (plain files — NOT contentFiles; injected by the props below),
      • `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet in the consumer; does the <Compile> injection),
      • README.md (package page).
    The .cs are <Compile> items in THIS authoring build (Godot.NET.Sdk default glob) so they compile +
    unit-test locally; adding them to <None Pack="true"> just also bundles them into the package.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Editor/**/*.cs" Pack="true" PackagePath="src/Editor/" />
    <None Include="build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/README.md`:

```md
# Navigation Tools

RQL module for Godot navigation (2D & 3D): validated agent, region and link settings, region Bake() and polygon outlines for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

Optional Godot-MCP extension, independently versioned as NuGet package `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation` (1.0.1).
Requires a Godot C# project (4.3.0+) with a core `godot_mcp` addon that has the RQL tools
(`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, the release after 0.28.0).

## Install

```sh
godot-cli install-plugin /path/to/project
godot-cli install-extension com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation /path/to/project
godot-cli build /path/to/project
```

The installer resolves the latest stable version from NuGet; use `--version 1.0.1` to request an exact version.
Packages contain C# source and build props, compiled against the project's own GodotSharp.
Previous NuGet versions remain installable after the repository migration.

## RQL

Since 1.0.0 the extension is an **RQL module**: it adds no MCP tools. Agents create, configure, bake and read
navigation nodes with the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools, and the module's guide is part of
the core `godot-rql` skill. The module adds, for the 2D and 3D nodes:

- **Validated members** on NavigationAgent2D/3D: `Radius` (above 0), `PathDesiredDistance`,
  `TargetDesiredDistance`, `MaxSpeed`, `Height` (3D), `TimeHorizonAgents`, `TimeHorizonObstacles` (0 or more),
  `AvoidancePriority` (0 to 1); on NavigationRegion2D/3D and NavigationLink2D/3D: `EnterCost` / `TravelCost`
  (0 or more). An invalid value fails the whole mutation and changes nothing (0.x clamped it).
- **`Bake()`** on the regions (a synchronous bake of the NavigationMesh / NavigationPolygon, returning the
  polygon count) and **`polygonCount`**; **`AddOutline(points)`** / **`ClearOutlines()`** and `outlineCount` on
  NavigationPolygon.

```
root | call AddChild("NavigationRegion3D", "NavRegion")
nodes | where name == "NavRegion" | set NavigationMesh = {"$type": "NavigationMesh"}
nodes | where name == "NavRegion" | set NavigationMesh.GeometryParsedGeometryType = "StaticColliders", NavigationMesh.AgentRadius = 0.5
nodes | where name == "NavRegion" | call AddChild("StaticBody3D", "Floor")
nodes | where name == "Floor" | call AddChild("CollisionShape3D", "FloorShape")
nodes | where name == "FloorShape" | set Shape = {"$type": "BoxShape3D", "Size": "(10, 1, 10)"}
nodes | where name == "NavRegion" | call Bake()
nodes | where $ is NavigationRegion3D | select name Enabled polygonCount NavigationMesh
root | call AddChild("NavigationAgent3D", "NavAgent")
nodes | where name == "NavAgent" | set Radius = 0.75, MaxSpeed = 8, PathDesiredDistance = 1, TargetDesiredDistance = 1, AvoidanceEnabled = true
root | call AddChild("NavigationLink3D", "NavLink")
nodes | where name == "NavLink" | set StartPosition = "(0, 0, 0)", EndPosition = "(5, 0, 0)", Bidirectional = true
nodes | where $ is NavigationAgent3D | select name Radius MaxSpeed PathDesiredDistance AvoidanceEnabled
```

Every write is one undoable action and marks the scene unsaved (`editor | call SaveScene()` writes it); the
polygons a `Bake()` produces are not undoable (bake again).

### Migrating from 0.x

| 0.x tool | RQL |
| --- | --- |
| `navigation-defaults` | removed: a new agent starts with Godot's defaults (3D radius 0.5 m, max speed 10 m/s; 2D radius 10 px, max speed 100 px/s); the guide lists them |
| `navigation-region-create` | `rql-mutate` `root \| call AddChild("NavigationRegion3D", "NavRegion")` (or `NavigationRegion2D`) |
| `navigation-region-set-mesh` | `rql-mutate` `… \| set NavigationMesh = {"$type": "NavigationMesh"}` (2D: `NavigationPolygon = {"$type": "NavigationPolygon"}`), or a `"res://…"` path; new: `call Bake()` |
| `navigation-agent-create` | `rql-mutate` `root \| call AddChild("NavigationAgent3D", "NavAgent")` (or `NavigationAgent2D`) |
| `navigation-agent-configure` | `rql-mutate` `nodes \| where name == "NavAgent" \| set Radius = 0.75, MaxSpeed = 8, AvoidanceEnabled = true` |
| `navigation-link-create` | `rql-mutate` `… \| call AddChild("NavigationLink3D", "NavLink")`, then `set StartPosition = "(0, 0, 0)", EndPosition = "(5, 0, 0)"` |
| `navigation-get` | `rql-query` `nodes \| where $ is NavigationAgent3D \| select name Radius MaxSpeed …` (regions: `Enabled polygonCount NavigationMesh`; links: `StartPosition EndPosition Bidirectional`) |

## Development and releases

See the [monorepo test and release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md).
This module retains its own package, version, tests and Apache-2.0 [license](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/LICENSE).
Releasing another module does not rebuild or republish this package.

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/src/Godot-AI-Navigation/build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation.props`:

```props
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE INJECTION — the consumer half of the source-only package recipe.                       │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  NuGet auto-imports `build/<PackageId>.props` into any project that references this package. This file
  MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props` (com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation.props) or NuGet will
  not import it. `bump-version` / `init` keep the name in lockstep with <PackageId>.

  It adds this package's packed `.cs` (which sit in the NuGet cache under `<package>/<version>/src/`) as
  <Compile> items in the CONSUMER's project, so they compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project against
  the consumer's own GodotSharp. Because the consumer is a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, `Godot` types resolve
  and `#if TOOLS` is defined for the editor build — exactly as if the source lived in the consumer's repo.

  • $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory) resolves to `<package>/<version>/build/` in the NuGet cache, so
    `../src/**/*.cs` is the packed source.
  • Exclude="@(Compile)" is belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion (the consumer's own default
    glob never reaches the NuGet cache, so it normally excludes nothing).
  • Link groups the injected files under the package id in IDEs (cosmetic).
-->
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/tests/Godot-AI-Navigation.Tests/NavigationModuleTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The module configures cleanly and shapes the navigation types: an RQL engine discovers it, registers its guide, and the
    /// member tables of the agents, regions, links and NavigationPolygon carry the validated members (replacing the C#
    /// properties of the same name and type), the virtual read members and the calls. Metadata only: no Godot object is created.
    /// </summary>
    public class NavigationModuleTests
    {
        private static RqlEngine Engine()
        {
            var engine = new RqlEngine();
            var reports = engine.AddModulesFrom(new[] { typeof(NavigationModule).Assembly });
            Assert.All(reports, r => Assert.True(r.Ok, r.ToString()));
            Assert.Contains(reports, r => r.Module == typeof(NavigationModule).FullName);
            return engine;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ModuleRegistersItsGuide()
        {
            var guide = Assert.Single(Engine().Guides, g => g.Key == NavigationGuide.Topic);
            Assert.Equal(NavigationGuide.Markdown, guide.Value);
        }

        private static readonly string[] AgentMembers =
            { "Radius", "PathDesiredDistance", "TargetDesiredDistance", "MaxSpeed", "TimeHorizonAgents", "TimeHorizonObstacles", "AvoidancePriority" };

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(NavigationAgent3D), true)]
        [InlineData(typeof(NavigationAgent2D), false)]
        public void AgentsHaveValidatedMembers(Type type, bool hasHeight)
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(type);
            foreach (var name in hasHeight ? AgentMembers.Append("Height") : AgentMembers)
                AssertValidated(info, name);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "AvoidanceEnabled" && m.CanWrite);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(NavigationRegion3D))]
        [InlineData(typeof(NavigationRegion2D))]
        public void RegionsHaveCostsPolygonCountAndBake(Type type)
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(type);
            AssertValidated(info, "EnterCost");
            AssertValidated(info, "TravelCost");
            var count = Assert.Single(info.Members, m => m.Name == "polygonCount");
            Assert.Equal(typeof(int), count.Type);
            Assert.False(count.CanWrite);
            var bake = Assert.Single(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "Bake");
            Assert.Empty(bake.Parameters);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(typeof(NavigationLink3D))]
        [InlineData(typeof(NavigationLink2D))]
        public void LinksHaveValidatedCostsAndPlainEnds(Type type)
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(type);
            AssertValidated(info, "EnterCost");
            AssertValidated(info, "TravelCost");
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "StartPosition" && m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "EndPosition" && m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "Bidirectional" && m.CanWrite);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NavigationPolygonHasOutlineCalls()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(NavigationPolygon));
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "AddOutline" && c.Parameters.Count == 1 && c.Parameters[0].Type == typeof(Vector2[]));
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "ClearOutlines");
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "outlineCount" && !m.CanWrite);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void EveryAdapterNamesTheExtension()
        {
            var adapters = new RqlTypeAdapter[]
            {
                new Godot_NavigationRegion3D_Adapter(), new Godot_NavigationRegion2D_Adapter(), new Godot_NavigationAgent3D_Adapter(),
                new Godot_NavigationAgent2D_Adapter(), new Godot_NavigationLink3D_Adapter(), new Godot_NavigationLink2D_Adapter(),
                new Godot_NavigationPolygon_Adapter(),
            };
            Assert.All(adapters, a => Assert.Contains("(Navigation extension)", a.Description));
        }

        private static void AssertValidated(TypeInfo info, string name)
        {
            var member = Assert.Single(info.Members, m => m.Name == name);
            Assert.Null(member.Member); // the adapter's validated member replaced the C# property
            Assert.Equal(typeof(float), member.Type);
            Assert.True(member.CanWrite);
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.Description));
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Navigation/tests/Godot-AI-Navigation.Tests/NavigationRulesTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Navigation.Tests
{
    public class NavigationRulesTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0.01f)]
        [InlineData(0.75f)]
        public void PositiveRadiusIsValid(float radius) => Assert.Null(NavigationRules.Radius(radius));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0f)]
        [InlineData(-1f)]
        [InlineData(float.NaN)]
        public void ZeroNegativeOrNaNRadiusIsRejected(float radius) => Assert.StartsWith("Radius must be above 0", NavigationRules.Radius(radius));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0f)]
        [InlineData(8f)]
        public void ZeroOrMoreIsValid(float value) => Assert.Null(NavigationRules.NonNegative("MaxSpeed", value));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(-0.5f)]
        [InlineData(float.NaN)]
        [InlineData(float.NegativeInfinity)]
        public void NegativeOrNonFiniteIsRejectedByName(float value) =>
            Assert.StartsWith("TravelCost must be 0 or more", NavigationRules.NonNegative("TravelCost", value));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0f, true)]
        [InlineData(1f, true)]
        [InlineData(0.5f, true)]
        [InlineData(-0.1f, false)]
        [InlineData(1.5f, false)]
        [InlineData(float.NaN, false)]
        public void PriorityIsZeroToOne(float value, bool valid) => Assert.Equal(valid, NavigationRules.Priority(value) == null);

        [Fact]
        public void OutlinesNeedThreePoints()
        {
            Assert.Null(NavigationRules.Outline(3));
            Assert.Equal("an outline needs at least 3 points (got 2)", NavigationRules.Outline(2));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BakeNeedsTheResourceAndNoRunningBake()
        {
            Assert.Null(NavigationRules.CanBake("NavigationRegion3D 'R'", "NavigationMesh", hasResource: true, baking: false));
            Assert.Equal("NavigationRegion3D 'R' has no NavigationMesh to bake into: set NavigationMesh = {\"$type\": \"NavigationMesh\"} first",
                NavigationRules.CanBake("NavigationRegion3D 'R'", "NavigationMesh", hasResource: false, baking: false));
            Assert.Equal("NavigationRegion2D 'R' is already baking",
                NavigationRules.CanBake("NavigationRegion2D 'R'", "NavigationPolygon", hasResource: true, baking: true));
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Particles/AGENTS.md`:

```md
# AGENTS.md — Godot-AI-Particles

A **Godot-MCP extension** for Godot's built-in `GPUParticles3D` / `GPUParticles2D` nodes, shipped as an **RQL
module**: it adds no MCP tools, only what the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools need to work
with emitters (validated members, `Restart()`, an agent guide rendered into the core `godot-rql` skill). A
**source-only NuGet package** (`com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Particles`) compiled inside the consumer's Godot project
against the consumer's own GodotSharp; the packaging recipe is in `docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md`.

## Layout

- `src/Godot-AI-Particles/Editor/Rql/` — the module:
  - `ParticlesModule.cs` — the `IRqlModule` (Order 100, `#if TOOLS`): the two adapters and the guide.
  - `Godot_GpuParticles3D_Adapter.cs`, `Godot_GpuParticles2D_Adapter.cs` — one adapter per type (`#if TOOLS`);
    their shared members live in `ParticlesMembers.cs`.
  - `ParticlesRules.cs` (validation) and `ParticlesGuide.cs` (the guide) — pure-managed, NOT behind `#if TOOLS`.
- `src/Godot-AI-Particles/build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Particles.props` — source-injection props, auto-imported
  by NuGet in the consumer; MUST stay named `<PackageId>.props`.
- `tests/Godot-AI-Particles.Tests/` — xUnit (no Godot binary): rules, guide examples parse, the module's member
  tables (GodotSharp metadata, `TOOLS` defined), and the e2e manifest runs every guide example.
- `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` — the live calls (`rql-*`), driven by `scripts/extension_e2e.py` from the monorepo suite.
- `testbed/Particles-Testbed.csproj` — consumer project restoring the local-packed package (injection proof).
- `commands/` — `bump-version`, `update-core`, `init` (`.ps1` + `.py`), `get-version.ps1`.
- CI and publishing are centralized in the monorepo; see `../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md`.

## Critical invariants

- **RQL surface.** Everything is registered by `ParticlesModule` and documented in `ParticlesGuide` (topic
  "Particles"). Every guide example runs, in order, in `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` (xUnit-asserted).
- **Validated members replace the C# properties** of the same name (`Amount`, `Lifetime`, `Explosiveness`,
  `Randomness`) and read / write the Godot property by name, so one implementation serves both emitter types
  (they share no emitter base class). A rejected value fails the whole mutation; never clamp silently.
- The module uses only Godot, `com.IvanMurzak.Rql` and the BCL, never core-addon types (the authoring build has
  no core). Undo, dirty marking and saving come from the core's mutation hooks.

## Build / test (no Godot binary)

```bash
dotnet build src/Godot-AI-Particles/Godot-AI-Particles.csproj -c Debug   # the module (#if TOOLS included)
dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-Particles.Tests/Godot-AI-Particles.Tests.csproj
```

The live suite (one headless editor for every module) is `python scripts/test_extensions.py` from the monorepo
root. `dotnet pack` reuses the **global NuGet cache** for an already-cached version: when re-packing the same
`Version`, clear `~/.nuget/packages/com.ivanmurzak.godot.mcp.particles/<ver>` (or pack a unique version).

## Conventions

- Root namespace `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Particles`. Every `.cs` starts with the Apache-2.0 header and
  `#nullable enable`.
- The package declares only the `com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin` / `ReflectorNet` / `Rql` pins (equal to the core's); **GodotSharp must
  never become a package dependency** (CI asserts the nuspec). Bump them with `commands/update-core.ps1`.

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Particles/README.md`:

```md
# Particles Tools

RQL module for Godot GPU particles (2D & 3D): validated emitter settings and Restart() for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

Optional Godot-MCP extension, independently versioned as NuGet package `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Particles` (1.0.1).
Requires a Godot C# project (4.3.0+) with a core `godot_mcp` addon that has the RQL tools
(`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, the release after 0.28.0).

## Install

```sh
godot-cli install-plugin /path/to/project
godot-cli install-extension com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Particles /path/to/project
godot-cli build /path/to/project
```

The installer resolves the latest stable version from NuGet; use `--version 1.0.1` to request an exact version.
Packages contain C# source and build props, compiled against the project's own GodotSharp.
Previous NuGet versions remain installable after the repository migration.

## RQL

Since 1.0.0 the extension is an **RQL module**: it adds no MCP tools. Agents create, tune and read emitters
with the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools, and the module's guide is part of the core
`godot-rql` skill. The module adds:

- **Validated emitter members** on `GPUParticles3D` and `GPUParticles2D`: `Amount` (at least 1), `Lifetime`
  (seconds, above 0), `Explosiveness` and `Randomness` (0 to 1). An out-of-range value fails the whole mutation
  and changes nothing (0.x clamped it).
- **`Restart()`** as an RQL call.

```
root | call AddChild("GPUParticles3D", "FX")
nodes | where name == "FX" | set Amount = 32, Lifetime = 2, Explosiveness = 0.5, Randomness = 0.25, OneShot = false
nodes | where name == "FX" | set ProcessMaterial = {"$type": "ParticleProcessMaterial"}
nodes | where name == "FX" | set ProcessMaterial.props["initial_velocity_min"] = 2, ProcessMaterial.props["initial_velocity_max"] = 4
nodes | where name == "FX" | call Restart()
nodes | where name == "FX" | set Emitting = false
nodes | where $ is GPUParticles3D | select name Amount Lifetime Emitting Explosiveness ProcessMaterial
```

Every write is one undoable action and marks the scene unsaved (`editor | call SaveScene()` writes it).

### Migrating from 0.x

| 0.x tool | RQL |
| --- | --- |
| `particles-defaults` | removed: a new emitter starts with Godot's defaults; the guide lists typical values |
| `particles-create` | `rql-mutate` `root \| call AddChild("GPUParticles3D", "FX")` (or `GPUParticles2D`), then `set …` |
| `particles-configure` | `rql-mutate` `nodes \| where name == "FX" \| set Amount = 32, Lifetime = 2, …` |
| `particles-set-emitting` | `rql-mutate` `… \| set Emitting = false`; `… \| call Restart()` |
| `particles-get` | `rql-query` `nodes \| where $ is GPUParticles3D \| select name Amount Lifetime Emitting …` |

## Development and releases

See the [monorepo test and release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md).
This module retains its own package, version, tests and Apache-2.0 [license](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/extensions/Godot-AI-Particles/LICENSE).
Releasing another module does not rebuild or republish this package.

## Asset Library installation

The independent Asset Library entry is named **Godot MCP - Particles** and becomes public after moderator approval.
It downloads only this extension from its versioned GitHub release. Install Godot MCP core
and configure its NuGet dependencies first, then install the archive into the project and build C#.
The archive includes its own license, README and installation instructions. Third-party addon
prerequisites listed above still apply. Use either this source installation or this extension
NuGet package in a project; installing both creates duplicate C# types.

See the [Asset Library release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md#godot-asset-library).

`extensions/Godot-AI-Particles/commands/bump-version.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Set the extension package version (the single source of truth: the package csproj <Version>).

.DESCRIPTION
    Updates <Version> in the source-only package csproj under src/. The release workflow is version-gated
    on this value (it publishes only when <Version> increases AND the tag does not yet exist).

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/bump-version.ps1 -NewVersion "1.0.1"
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/bump-version.ps1 -NewVersion "1.0.1" -WhatIf
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$NewVersion,
    [switch]$WhatIf
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "../extension.json")) {
    $pythonCommand = Get-Command py, python3, python -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $pythonCommand) { throw "Python 3 is required for the central version helper." }
    $pythonArguments = @()
    if ($pythonCommand.Name -match '^py(\.exe)?$') { $pythonArguments += '-3' }
    $pythonArguments += @((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "bump-version.py"), $NewVersion)
    if ($WhatIf) { $pythonArguments += '--what-if' }
    & $pythonCommand.Source @pythonArguments
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

if ($NewVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z\.\-]+)?$') {
    throw "Invalid semantic version: '$NewVersion' (expected major.minor.patch[-prerelease])."
}

$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$csproj = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot "src") -Recurse -Filter *.csproj |
    Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -match '<PackageId>' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $csproj) { throw "Could not find the package csproj (with <PackageId>) under src/." }

$content = Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw
if ($content -notmatch '<Version>([^<]+)</Version>') { throw "No <Version> element in $($csproj.Name)." }
$current = $Matches[1]
$new = $content -replace '<Version>[^<]+</Version>', "<Version>$NewVersion</Version>"

Write-Host "Package: $($csproj.Name)"
Write-Host "Version: $current -> $NewVersion"
if ($WhatIf) { Write-Host "(WhatIf — no changes written)" -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 }
Set-Content -Path $csproj.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline
Write-Host "Updated." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Remember to commit, then push to main to trigger the version-gated release."

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Particles/commands/bump-version.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Set the extension package version (the package csproj <Version>). POSIX/Python mirror of bump-version.ps1.

Usage:
  python commands/bump-version.py 1.0.1
  python commands/bump-version.py 1.0.1 --what-if
  python commands/bump-version.py --get        # print current version
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SEMVER = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.\-]+)?$")


def find_package_csproj(root: Path) -> Path:
    for p in (root / "src").rglob("*.csproj"):
        if "<PackageId>" in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
            return p
    raise SystemExit("error: could not find the package csproj (with <PackageId>) under src/")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("version", nargs="?", help="new semantic version, e.g. 1.0.1")
    ap.add_argument("--what-if", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--get", action="store_true", help="print current version and exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    if (root / "extension.json").is_file():
        # Keep the monorepo inventory and package README versions in sync.
        sys.path.insert(0, str(root.parents[1] / "scripts"))
        from extension_release import bump
        from extensions import modules, SEMVER as stable_version
        module = modules(only=[root.name])[0]
        if args.get:
            print(module["version"])
            return 0
        if not args.version or not stable_version.fullmatch(args.version):
            ap.error("pass a stable major.minor.patch version")
        if args.what_if:
            print(f"{module['name']}: {module['version']} -> {args.version} (what-if)")
            return 0
        bump(module, args.version)
        return 0
    csproj = find_package_csproj(root)
    content = csproj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r"<Version>([^<]+)</Version>", content)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(f"error: no <Version> element in {csproj.name}")
    current = m.group(1)

    if args.get:
        print(current)
        return 0

    if not args.version or not SEMVER.match(args.version):
        print("error: pass a semantic version major.minor.patch[-prerelease]", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    print(f"Package: {csproj.name}")
    print(f"Version: {current} -> {args.version}")
    if args.what_if:
        print("(what-if — no changes written)")
        return 0
    csproj.write_text(re.sub(r"<Version>[^<]+</Version>", f"<Version>{args.version}</Version>", content),
                       encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    print("Updated.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
# Print the extension package version (the package csproj <Version>). Used by CI's version gate.
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$csproj = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot "src") -Recurse -Filter *.csproj |
    Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -match '<PackageId>' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $csproj) { Write-Error "Could not find the package csproj under src/."; exit 1 }
if ((Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw) -match '<Version>([^<]+)</Version>') { Write-Output $Matches[1]; exit 0 }
Write-Error "No <Version> in $($csproj.Name)."; exit 1
