`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/commands/init.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Initialize a new Godot-MCP extension from this template: replace placeholders, rename files/folders,
    and activate the CI workflows.

.DESCRIPTION
    From a single -Feature name (PascalCase, e.g. "Particles") this derives and substitutes every
    placeholder, then renames any file/folder whose name contains YOUR_FEATURE, then activates CI by
    renaming `.github/workflows/*.yml-sample` -> `*.yml`.

    Derived values (override any with the matching parameter):
      Package id  : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>     (the NuGet <PackageId>)
      Repo        : IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-<Feature>          (-GitHubRepository)
      Display name: "<Feature> Tools"                       (-DisplayName)
      Description : "RQL module for Godot <Feature>."      (-Description)
      RQL source  : <feature-lowercased>                     (-SourceName; the module's RQL source name)

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/init.ps1 -Feature "Particles"

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/init.ps1 -Feature "Particles" -GitHubRepository "myuser/Godot-AI-Particles" -DisplayName "Particle Tools"
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string]$Feature,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$DisplayName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$Description,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$GitHubRepository,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$SourceName
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if ($Feature -notmatch '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$') {
    throw "Feature must be alphanumeric PascalCase (letters/digits, starts with a letter). Got: '$Feature'"
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DisplayName))      { $DisplayName = "$Feature Tools" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Description))       { $Description = "RQL module for Godot $Feature." }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($GitHubRepository))  { $GitHubRepository = "IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-$Feature" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SourceName))        { $SourceName = $Feature.ToLower() }

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$RepoRoot  = Split-Path -Parent $ScriptDir

# Longest tokens first so no token is a prefix of another mid-replacement.
$Replacements = [ordered]@{
    "YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY" = $GitHubRepository
    "YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME"               = $DisplayName
    "YOUR_DESCRIPTION"                = $Description
    "YOUR_SOURCE"                     = $SourceName
    "YOUR_FEATURE"                    = $Feature
}

Write-Host "Initializing Godot-MCP extension:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Feature      : $Feature"
Write-Host "  Package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.$Feature"
Write-Host "  Repository   : $GitHubRepository"
Write-Host "  Display name : $DisplayName"
Write-Host "  RQL source   : $SourceName"
Write-Host ""

$ExcludeDirs = @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', '.godot', 'local-nuget', '.vs')

function Test-Excluded([string]$path) {
    foreach ($d in $ExcludeDirs) {
        if ($path -match "[\\/]$([regex]::Escape($d))([\\/]|$)") { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

# 1) Replace placeholder content in all text files.
Write-Host "Replacing placeholders in file content..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$textExt = @('.cs','.csproj','.props','.targets','.md','.json','.yml','.yaml','.yml-sample','.godot','.config','.sh','.ps1','.py','.editorconfig','.gitignore','.txt')
Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoRoot -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object {
    $file = $_
    if (Test-Excluded $file.FullName) { return }
    if ($file.Name -eq 'init.ps1' -or $file.Name -eq 'init.py') { return }  # don't rewrite the running script
    $ext = $file.Extension.ToLower()
    $isText = ($textExt -contains $ext) -or ($file.Name -like '*.yml-sample') -or ($file.Name -eq 'LICENSE')
    if (-not $isText) { return }
    $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $content) { return }
    $new = $content
    foreach ($k in $Replacements.Keys) { $new = $new.Replace($k, $Replacements[$k]) }
    if ($new -ne $content) {
        Set-Content -Path $file.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline
        Write-Host "  updated $($file.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length+1))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

# 2) Rename files/folders whose NAME contains YOUR_FEATURE (deepest-first so children rename before parents).
Write-Host "Renaming files and folders..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoRoot -Recurse | Where-Object { -not (Test-Excluded $_.FullName) } |
    Sort-Object { $_.FullName.Length } -Descending | ForEach-Object {
        if ($_.Name -like '*YOUR_FEATURE*') {
            $newName = $_.Name.Replace('YOUR_FEATURE', $Feature)
            Rename-Item -Path $_.FullName -NewName $newName
            Write-Host "  renamed $($_.Name) -> $newName" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        }
    }

# 3) Activate CI: *.yml-sample -> *.yml
Write-Host "Activating CI workflows (*.yml-sample -> *.yml)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$wf = Join-Path $RepoRoot ".github/workflows"
if (Test-Path $wf) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $wf -Filter "*.yml-sample" | ForEach-Object {
        $target = $_.FullName -replace '\.yml-sample$', '.yml'
        Move-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $target -Force
        Write-Host "  activated $($_.Name) -> $([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($target))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Done. Next:" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  1. Review the changes, then build + test:"
Write-Host "       dotnet build src/Godot-AI-$Feature/Godot-AI-$Feature.csproj"
Write-Host "       dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-$Feature.Tests/Godot-AI-$Feature.Tests.csproj"
Write-Host "  2. Write the RQL module under src/Godot-AI-$Feature/Editor/Rql (adapters, sources, guide; see AGENTS.md)."
Write-Host "  3. Configure the NUGET_API_KEY secret, then push to main with a bumped <Version> to release."

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/commands/init.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Initialize a new Godot-MCP extension from this template (POSIX/Python path; mirrors init.ps1).

From a single --feature name (PascalCase, e.g. "Particles") this substitutes every placeholder, renames
files/folders whose name contains YOUR_FEATURE, then activates CI (*.yml-sample -> *.yml).

Derived (override with the matching flag):
  package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>
  repo         : IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-<Feature>      (--github-repository)
  display name : "<Feature> Tools"                   (--display-name)
  description  : "RQL module for Godot <Feature>."  (--description)
  RQL source   : <feature lowercased>                 (--source-name; the module's source, e.g. "particles | select …")

Usage:
  python commands/init.py --feature Particles
  python commands/init.py --feature Particles --github-repository myuser/Godot-AI-Particles
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {".git", "bin", "obj", ".godot", "local-nuget", ".vs"}
TEXT_EXT = {".cs", ".csproj", ".props", ".targets", ".md", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml",
            ".yml-sample", ".godot", ".config", ".sh", ".ps1", ".py", ".editorconfig",
            ".gitignore", ".txt"}
SELF = {"init.py", "init.ps1"}


def is_excluded(path: Path, root: Path) -> bool:
    rel_parts = path.relative_to(root).parts
    return any(part in EXCLUDE_DIRS for part in rel_parts)


def is_text(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name
    if name == "LICENSE":
        return True
    if name.endswith(".yml-sample"):
        return True
    return path.suffix.lower() in TEXT_EXT


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Initialize a Godot-MCP extension from the template.")
    ap.add_argument("--feature", required=True, help="PascalCase feature name, e.g. Particles")
    ap.add_argument("--display-name")
    ap.add_argument("--description")
    ap.add_argument("--github-repository")
    ap.add_argument("--source-name")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    feature = args.feature
    if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$", feature):
        print(f"error: --feature must be alphanumeric PascalCase. Got: {feature!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    display = args.display_name or f"{feature} Tools"
    description = args.description or f"RQL module for Godot {feature}."
    repo = args.github_repository or f"IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-{feature}"
    source = args.source_name or feature.lower()

    # Longest tokens first so no token is a prefix of another mid-replacement.
    replacements = [
        ("YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY", repo),
        ("YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME", display),
        ("YOUR_DESCRIPTION", description),
        ("YOUR_SOURCE", source),
        ("YOUR_FEATURE", feature),
    ]

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

    print("Initializing Godot-MCP extension:")
    print(f"  Feature      : {feature}")
    print(f"  Package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.{feature}")
    print(f"  Repository   : {repo}")
    print(f"  Display name : {display}")
    print(f"  RQL source   : {source}\n")

    # 1) Replace placeholder content.
    print("Replacing placeholders in file content...")
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file() or is_excluded(path, root) or path.name in SELF or not is_text(path):
            continue
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
            continue
        new = text
        for token, value in replacements:
            new = new.replace(token, value)
        if new != text:
            path.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
            print(f"  updated {path.relative_to(root)}")

    # 2) Rename files/folders containing YOUR_FEATURE, deepest-first.
    print("Renaming files and folders...")
    entries = [p for p in root.rglob("*") if not is_excluded(p, root)]
    for path in sorted(entries, key=lambda p: len(str(p)), reverse=True):
        if "YOUR_FEATURE" in path.name:
            new_name = path.name.replace("YOUR_FEATURE", feature)
            path.rename(path.with_name(new_name))
            print(f"  renamed {path.name} -> {new_name}")

    # 3) Activate CI.
    print("Activating CI workflows (*.yml-sample -> *.yml)...")
    wf = root / ".github" / "workflows"
    if wf.is_dir():
        for sample in wf.glob("*.yml-sample"):
            target = sample.with_name(sample.name[: -len("-sample")])
            sample.replace(target)
            print(f"  activated {sample.name} -> {target.name}")

    print("\nDone. Next:")
    print(f"  dotnet build src/Godot-AI-{feature}/Godot-AI-{feature}.csproj")
    print(f"  dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-{feature}.Tests/Godot-AI-{feature}.Tests.csproj")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Update the core MCP / reflection / query pins (com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin / com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet /
    com.IvanMurzak.Rql) in lockstep across the package, tests, and testbed csproj files.

.DESCRIPTION
    These pins MUST equal the core Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP/Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py
    core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise); com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL module API. When the core advances its pins,
    run this in the same change. Pass any of the three.

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -McpPlugin "6.11.0"
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -McpPlugin "6.11.0" -ReflectorNet "5.4.0" -WhatIf
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -Rql "0.2.0"
#>
param(
    [string]$McpPlugin,
    [string]$ReflectorNet,
    [string]$Rql,
    [switch]$WhatIf
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if (-not $McpPlugin -and -not $ReflectorNet -and -not $Rql) { throw "Pass -McpPlugin, -ReflectorNet and/or -Rql." }

$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$targets = @('src', 'tests', 'testbed') | ForEach-Object {
    $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $_
    if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Recurse -Filter *.csproj }
}

$pins = @{}
if ($McpPlugin)    { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin']  = $McpPlugin }
if ($ReflectorNet) { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet'] = $ReflectorNet }
if ($Rql)          { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.Rql']          = $Rql }

foreach ($csproj in $targets) {
    $content = Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw
    $new = $content
    foreach ($id in $pins.Keys) {
        $pattern = '(<PackageReference\s+Include="' + [regex]::Escape($id) + '"\s+Version=")[^"]+(")'
        $new = [regex]::Replace($new, $pattern, "`${1}$($pins[$id])`${2}")
    }
    if ($new -ne $content) {
        Write-Host "Updating $($csproj.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length+1))"
        foreach ($id in $pins.Keys) { Write-Host "  $id -> $($pins[$id])" }
        if (-not $WhatIf) { Set-Content -Path $csproj.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline }
    }
}
if ($WhatIf) { Write-Host "(WhatIf — no changes written)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
else { Write-Host "Done. Rebuild + test to confirm compatibility." -ForegroundColor Green }

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/commands/update-core.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Update the core MCP / reflection / query pins in lockstep across package/tests/testbed. Mirror of update-core.ps1.

The pins (com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin, com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet, com.IvanMurzak.Rql = the RQL module API) must
EQUAL the core Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP/Godot-MCP.csproj); scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise.

Usage:
  python commands/update-core.py --mcp-plugin 6.11.0
  python commands/update-core.py --mcp-plugin 6.11.0 --reflector-net 5.4.0 --what-if
  python commands/update-core.py --rql 0.2.0
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--mcp-plugin")
    ap.add_argument("--reflector-net")
    ap.add_argument("--rql")
    ap.add_argument("--what-if", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not args.mcp_plugin and not args.reflector_net and not args.rql:
        raise SystemExit("error: pass --mcp-plugin, --reflector-net and/or --rql")

    pins = {}
    if args.mcp_plugin:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin"] = args.mcp_plugin
    if args.reflector_net:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet"] = args.reflector_net
    if args.rql:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.Rql"] = args.rql

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    csprojs = []
    for sub in ("src", "tests", "testbed"):
        d = root / sub
        if d.is_dir():
            csprojs += list(d.rglob("*.csproj"))

    for csproj in csprojs:
        content = csproj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        new = content
        for pid, ver in pins.items():
            new = re.sub(
                r'(<PackageReference\s+Include="' + re.escape(pid) + r'"\s+Version=")[^"]+(")',
                r"\g<1>" + ver + r"\g<2>", new)
        if new != content:
            print(f"Updating {csproj.relative_to(root)}")
            for pid, ver in pins.items():
                print(f"  {pid} -> {ver}")
            if not args.what_if:
                csproj.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")

    print("(what-if — no changes written)" if args.what_if else "Done. Rebuild + test to confirm.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md`:

```md
# The source-only NuGet recipe (the centerpiece)

A Godot-MCP extension is distributed as a **source-only** NuGet package: it ships C# **source**, not a
compiled DLL. The source compiles **inside the consumer's Godot project**, against the **consumer's own
GodotSharp**. This is what lets one package work across Godot versions with no bundled engine and no
version lock.

This recipe is **verified** end-to-end with `dotnet` alone (no Godot binary): build the package → unit
test → `dotnet pack` → restore+build a consumer `Godot.NET.Sdk` project that references it → the injected
source compiles clean against the consumer's GodotSharp.

## Why not a normal (DLL) package?

The RQL module calls Godot's C# API (`Node`, `Resource`, `EditorInterface`, …) which lives in
**GodotSharp**. A pre-compiled DLL is built against **one** GodotSharp version and is therefore locked to
it — a consumer on a different Godot version gets binary-incompatibility. Shipping **source** sidesteps
this: the consumer is itself a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, so its build supplies GodotSharp at compile time
and our source compiles against *that* exact version.

## The three levers (in the package csproj)

```xml
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">   <!-- min-version floor; consumer uses its own -->
  <PropertyGroup>
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>            <!-- (1) ship no DLL -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>  <!-- (3) -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is a package dependency (the consumer already has it); pins = the core's. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin"   Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql"         Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- (3) GodotSharp is needed to COMPILE locally but must NOT be a package dependency. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp"            Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor"      Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- (2) Pack the .cs as plain files under src/ + the injection props under build/. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Editor/**/*.cs"  Pack="true" PackagePath="src/Editor/" />
    <None Include="build/<PackageId>.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

**Lever 1 — no DLL.** `IncludeBuildOutput=false` keeps the compiled assembly out of the package; the
package's payload is the `.cs` files + the injection props.

**Lever 2 — inject source as `<Compile>` in the consumer.** The `.cs` are packed as plain files under
`src/`. The package ships `build/<PackageId>.props`, which **NuGet auto-imports** into any consuming
project (this is why the file MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props`). The props adds the packed `.cs`
as `<Compile>` items:

```xml
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="<PackageId>\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

`$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)` resolves into the NuGet cache (`…/<package>/<version>/build/`), so
`..\src\**\*.cs` is the packed source. The consumer's own default glob never reaches the cache, so
`Exclude="@(Compile)"` is just belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion.

**Lever 3 — declare NO GodotSharp dependency.** The authoring project uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` so the
`Godot` namespace resolves and `#if TOOLS` compiles locally — but GodotSharp must NOT leak into the
package's dependency list (the consumer provides its own). Two steps are required because a plain
`<PackageReference Update="GodotSharp" PrivateAssets="all">` in the project body **does not work** (the
SDK adds GodotSharp *after* the body is evaluated, so there is nothing to update yet):

1. `DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences=true` drops the SDK's implicit `GodotSharp` + `GodotSharpEditor`.
2. Re-add `GodotSharp`/`GodotSharpEditor` explicitly with `PrivateAssets="all"` (kept for the local
   compile, excluded from the package deps). `Godot.SourceGenerators` has **no** SDK opt-out, so it is
   re-stated as an explicit `Include … PrivateAssets="all"` (this duplicates the implicit add → the
   harmless `NU1504`, suppressed via `NoWarn`).

Verify it worked by inspecting the generated `.nuspec` — its `<dependencies>` must list **only**
`com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin`, `com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet` and `com.IvanMurzak.Rql`, with **no** `GodotSharp` /
`Godot.SourceGenerators`. CI asserts exactly this (`scripts/extensions.py` `verify_package`).

## Why `build/*.props` injection, not `contentFiles`?

NuGet's `contentFiles` with `buildAction="Compile"` is the other documented way to inject source. We use
the **`build/*.props`** mechanism instead because:

- **SDK-agnostic and deterministic.** It is plain MSBuild `<Compile Include>` — it does not depend on
  NuGet's `contentFiles`-Compile auto-injection behaving identically under `Godot.NET.Sdk` (which
  customizes globbing); the props is auto-imported the same way for every SDK.
- **One obvious file to read and override.** The whole injection is one short, visible props file rather
  than `contentFiles` metadata split between the nuspec and NuGet's restore-generated targets.
- **No double-compile risk.** `EnableDefaultNoneItems=false` + the explicit `<None Pack>` list controls
  exactly what ships; the consumer's project-dir glob never overlaps the cache.

`contentFiles` remains a valid alternative; if you switch, drop the props and pack the `.cs` under
`contentFiles/cs/any/…` with `buildAction="Compile"`, and re-verify the consumer build + the `.nuspec`
dependency list.

## Editor-only API: `#if TOOLS`

The RQL module, its adapters and sources sit behind `#if TOOLS`: RQL is the editor's data layer, so they
compile in the editor and are excluded from shipped games — exactly as in the core addon (Godot defines
`TOOLS` for the editor/Debug build and **not** for an exported game build). The agent guide and other
pure-managed helpers (validation rules, label maps) stay outside the guard so they are CI-unit-testable.
The core runs every RQL query on the editor main thread, so module code may touch `Node` / `Resource` /
`EditorInterface` directly.

## The consumer story

1. The consumer is a Godot **C#** project with the core `godot_mcp` addon enabled (which already
   references `com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin`, `com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet` and `com.IvanMurzak.Rql`).
2. Installing the extension adds one line to the consumer's `.csproj`:
   `<PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>" Version="x.y.z" />`
   (done by the **Extensions dock**, `godot-cli install-extension`, or by hand).
3. Rebuild. NuGet imports `build/<PackageId>.props` → the extension's `.cs` compile into the consumer's
   single project assembly against the consumer's GodotSharp.
4. The core's RQL engine discovers the module (`IRqlModule`) in the project assembly — **no registry edit**.
   Its adapters, sources and guide appear in `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` and the `godot-rql`
   skill, inside the user's real Godot editor.

## Publishing & the shared catalog

`release.yml` publishes the source-only package to NuGet (version-gated) and cuts an atomic GitHub
Release. To make the extension appear in the in-editor **Extensions** dock and `godot-cli
install-extension`, append one entry to the shared catalog `addons/godot_mcp/extensions.catalog.json` in
**Godot-MCP** (schema in `extensions.catalog.md`): `name`, `description`, `packageId`
(`com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>`), optional `version`, `gitUrl`, and `tools` (empty for an RQL module). That
single source of truth is consumed by the dock, the CLI, and the app.

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/src/Godot-AI-Tilemap/Editor/Rql/Godot_TileMapLayer_Adapter.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap
{
    /// <summary>
    /// TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+): read-only <c>usedCells</c> rows and <c>usedCellCount</c>; calls
    /// <c>SetCell(x, y, sourceId, atlasX, atlasY, alternative)</c>, <c>EraseCell(x, y)</c>, <c>Clear()</c>. Undoable: the cells
    /// are the layer's own stored data.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class Godot_TileMapLayer_Adapter : RqlTypeAdapter<TileMapLayer>
    {
        public override string Description =>
            "TileMapLayer (Tilemap extension): TileSet, usedCells (x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative), usedCellCount; " +
            "call SetCell(x, y, sourceId, atlasX, atlasY, alternative), EraseCell(x, y), Clear()";

        protected override void Members(MemberTable<TileMapLayer> m)
        {
            m.Add<List<TilemapCellRow>>("usedCells", UsedCells, description: "the painted cells (read-only rows: x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative)")
             .Add<int>("usedCellCount", l => l.GetUsedCells().Count, description: "number of painted cells");

            m.Untyped
                .AddMethod("SetCell", new[]
                    {
                        new CallableParameter("x", typeof(int)), new CallableParameter("y", typeof(int)), new CallableParameter("sourceId", typeof(int)),
                        new CallableParameter("atlasX", typeof(int)), new CallableParameter("atlasY", typeof(int)),
                        new CallableParameter("alternative", typeof(int), hasDefault: true, defaultValue: 0),
                    }, typeof(void),
                    (o, a) => { SetCell((TileMapLayer)o, (int)a[0]!, (int)a[1]!, (int)a[2]!, (int)a[3]!, (int)a[4]!, (int)a[5]!); return null; },
                    "paint cell (x, y) with the tile at atlas (atlasX, atlasY) of TileSet source sourceId (alternative tile, default 0)");
            m.Method<int, int>("EraseCell", (l, x, y) => l.EraseCell(new Vector2I(x, y)), "x", "y", "empty the cell (x, y)");
            m.Expose("Clear", "erase every cell (the TileSet stays)");
        }

        private static void SetCell(TileMapLayer layer, int x, int y, int sourceId, int atlasX, int atlasY, int alternative)
        {
            Require(TilemapRules.SourceId(sourceId));
            Require(TilemapRules.AtlasCoords(atlasX, atlasY));
            Require(TilemapRules.Alternative(alternative));
            layer.SetCell(new Vector2I(x, y), sourceId, new Vector2I(atlasX, atlasY), alternative);
        }

        private static List<TilemapCellRow> UsedCells(TileMapLayer layer) =>
            layer.GetUsedCells()
                .Select(c =>
                {
                    var atlas = layer.GetCellAtlasCoords(c);
                    return new TilemapCellRow(c.X, c.Y, layer.GetCellSourceId(c), atlas.X, atlas.Y, layer.GetCellAlternativeTile(c));
                })
                .ToList();

        private static void Require(string? reason)
        {
            if (reason != null) throw new ArgumentException(reason);
        }
    }
}
#endif

```

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/src/Godot-AI-Tilemap/Editor/Rql/TilemapCellRow.cs`:

/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap
{
    /// <summary>
    /// One painted cell of a TileMapLayer, as a read-only row of <c>TileMapLayer.usedCells</c>: a snapshot with no Godot type,
    /// built by the adapter. Change cells with the layer's calls (<c>SetCell</c>, <c>EraseCell</c>, <c>Clear</c>).
    /// </summary>
    [RqlDescription("TileMapLayer cell (read-only): x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative")]
    public sealed class TilemapCellRow
    {
        public TilemapCellRow(int x, int y, int sourceId, int atlasX, int atlasY, int alternative)
        {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.sourceId = sourceId;
            this.atlasX = atlasX;
            this.atlasY = atlasY;
            this.alternative = alternative;
        }

        [RqlDescription("cell X (map coordinates)")]
        public int x { get; }

        [RqlDescription("cell Y (map coordinates)")]
        public int y { get; }

        [RqlDescription("TileSet source id")]
        public int sourceId { get; }

        [RqlDescription("atlas X of the tile in its source")]
        public int atlasX { get; }

        [RqlDescription("atlas Y of the tile in its source")]
        public int atlasY { get; }

        [RqlDescription("alternative tile id (0 = the base tile)")]
        public int alternative { get; }
    }
}

/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The agent guide of the Tilemap RQL module, rendered into the <c>godot-rql</c> skill (<see cref="TilemapModule"/>).
    /// Pure strings (no Godot API, not behind <c>#if TOOLS</c>) so the xUnit suite parses every example; the live e2e
    /// manifest (<c>tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json</c>) runs each one, in this order, against a scene whose root is a Node2D.
    /// </summary>
    public static class TilemapGuide
    {
        public const string Topic = "Tilemap";

        /// <summary>One example per line: the query, three or more spaces, a note.</summary>
        public const string Examples =
            "root | call AddChild(\"TileMapLayer\", \"Layer\")   a tile layer (one per layer; replaces the deprecated TileMap)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Layer\" | set TileSet = \"res://e2e-tileset.tres\"   its TileSet (sources and their atlas tiles)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Layer\" | call SetCell(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)   cell (0, 0) = source 0, atlas tile (0, 0)\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Layer\" | call SetCell(1, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1)   cell (1, 0) = atlas tile (2, 1), alternative 1\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Layer\" | get usedCells | select x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative   read the painted cells\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Layer\" | call EraseCell(0, 0)   empty one cell\n" +
            "nodes | where $ is TileMapLayer | select name usedCellCount TileSet   read the layers\n" +
            "nodes | where name == \"Layer\" | call Clear()   erase every cell (the TileSet stays)";

        public const string Markdown =
            "A TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) paints the tiles of a TileSet on a 2D grid. Add one with `AddChild`, assign the " +
            "TileSet and paint cells (undoable; the scene is marked unsaved):\n\n```\n" + Examples + "\n```\n\n" +
            "A tile is addressed by its TileSet source id and its atlas coordinates in that source (plus an alternative tile " +
            "id, 0 = the base tile); `TileSet.props[\"…\"]` reads the TileSet's sources. Source ids, atlas coordinates and " +
            "alternatives are validated (0 or more; erase with `EraseCell`): a rejected value changes nothing. Other settings " +
            "are C# members (`Enabled`, `YSortEnabled`, `CollisionEnabled`, `NavigationEnabled` …) or `props[\"…\"]`; " +
            "`rql-schema \"TileMapLayer\"` lists them.";
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/src/Godot-AI-Tilemap/Editor/Rql/TilemapRules.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The value rules the module enforces before a TileMapLayer cell is painted (the 0.x tools' rules): a TileSet source id
    /// of at least 0 (-1 means "no tile": erase with EraseCell) and atlas / alternative coordinates of at least 0. Each
    /// returns the rejection reason, or null when the value is valid. Pure-managed (no Godot API), so it is unit-tested.
    /// </summary>
    public static class TilemapRules
    {
        public static string? SourceId(int sourceId) =>
            sourceId >= 0
                ? null
                : $"sourceId must be a TileSet source id of at least 0 (got {sourceId}); erase a cell with EraseCell(x, y)";

        public static string? AtlasCoords(int atlasX, int atlasY) =>
            atlasX >= 0 && atlasY >= 0 ? null : $"atlas coordinates must be at least 0 (got ({atlasX}, {atlasY}))";

        public static string? Alternative(int alternative) =>
            alternative >= 0 ? null : $"alternative must be an alternative tile id of at least 0 (got {alternative})";
    }
}

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/src/Godot-AI-Tilemap/Godot-AI-Tilemap.csproj`:

```csproj
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE-ONLY NuGet package recipe — the load-bearing detail of a Godot-MCP extension.          │
  │  Full rationale + the consumer story: docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md.                        │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Why source-only? An extension's RQL module (adapters, sources, methods) calls Godot's C# API (Node,
  Resource, EditorInterface, …). Shipping a
  pre-compiled DLL would LOCK the package to one GodotSharp version. Instead we ship the .cs SOURCE and
  let it compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project, against the CONSUMER's own GodotSharp (supplied by
  their `Godot.NET.Sdk`). No bundled Godot, no version lock.

  How (3 levers):
    1. <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>  — do NOT put this project's compiled DLL in the package.
    2. The .cs are packed under `src/` (plain files) and injected as <Compile> items in the consumer by
       `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet). See that props file.
    3. NO GodotSharp dependency is declared (DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences + PrivateAssets=all below)
       — the consumer provides it. Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is declared as a (min-version) dependency,
       which the consumer already has via the core Godot-MCP addon.

  This project ALSO uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` for AUTHORING only: so the editor-only module (#if TOOLS) compiles
  + the `Godot` namespace resolves when you build/test locally.
  No Godot binary is needed — `Godot.NET.Sdk` pulls `GodotSharp` from NuGet at compile time.
-->
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <RootNamespace>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap</AssemblyName>

    <!-- ===== Package identity (bump-version.ps1 / get-version.ps1 own the Version element) ===== -->
    <IsPackable>true</IsPackable>
    <PackageId>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap</PackageId>
    <Version>1.0.1</Version>
    <Title>Tilemap Tools</Title>
    <Authors>Ivan Murzak</Authors>
    <Description>RQL module for Godot Tilemap.</Description>
    <PackageTags>godot;mcp;ai;tools;godot-mcp;ai-game-developer</PackageTags>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>Apache-2.0</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP</RepositoryUrl>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP</PackageProjectUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>

    <!-- ===== Source-only levers ===== -->
    <!-- 1) Do not ship the compiled DLL; the consumer compiles our source against their GodotSharp. -->
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>
    <!-- NU5128: source-only package (dependencies but no lib/ref) — expected, silence it.
         NU1504: Godot.SourceGenerators is re-stated PrivateAssets=all to keep it out of deps (see below). -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <NoPackageAnalysis>true</NoPackageAnalysis>
    <!-- We hand-pick exactly which files ship (below); turn off default None globbing to avoid duplicates. -->
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
    <!-- Drop the SDK's implicit GodotSharp/GodotSharpEditor so we can re-add them PrivateAssets=all (a body
         <PackageReference Update> does NOT work — the SDK adds them after the project body is evaluated). -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!--
    Package DEPENDENCIES: only the engine-agnostic MCP / reflection / query stack (com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL
    module API: IRqlModule, type adapters). A NuGet Version="x" is a ">= x" floor; the pins EQUAL the core
    Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise): a lower
    ReflectorNet than the McpPlugin requires is a NU1605 downgrade, a higher pin cannot restore in a consumer
    pinned to the core. `update-core.ps1` / `update-core.py` keep package, tests and testbed in lockstep.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    GodotSharp is needed for AUTHORING compile only, NOT as a package dependency (the consumer supplies its
    own, version-matched). PrivateAssets=all stops these flowing into the package's dependency list — this
    is the "no GodotSharp dependency" guarantee, verified by inspecting the generated .nuspec.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <!-- Godot.SourceGenerators has no SDK opt-out property, so re-state it (Include) PrivateAssets=all to
         keep it out of the package deps too. This duplicates the SDK's implicit add -> NU1504 (suppressed
         above). The analyzer still runs locally (PrivateAssets governs only what flows to CONSUMERS). -->
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    What ships in the .nupkg:
      • the .cs SOURCE under `src/` (plain files — NOT contentFiles; injected by the props below),
      • `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet in the consumer; does the <Compile> injection),
      • README.md (package page).
    The .cs are <Compile> items in THIS authoring build (Godot.NET.Sdk default glob) so they compile +
    unit-test locally; adding them to <None Pack="true"> just also bundles them into the package.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Editor/**/*.cs" Pack="true" PackagePath="src/Editor/" />
    <None Include="build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/src/Godot-AI-Tilemap/README.md`:

```md
# Tilemap Tools

RQL module for Godot TileMapLayer (4.3+): used-cell rows and SetCell / EraseCell / Clear for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

Optional Godot-MCP extension, independently versioned as NuGet package `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap` (1.0.1).
Requires a Godot C# project (4.3.0+) with a core `godot_mcp` addon that has the RQL tools
(`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, the release after 0.28.0).

## Install

```sh
godot-cli install-plugin /path/to/project
godot-cli install-extension com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap /path/to/project
godot-cli build /path/to/project
```

The installer resolves the latest stable version from NuGet; use `--version 1.0.1` to request an exact version.
Packages contain C# source and build props, compiled against the project's own GodotSharp.
Previous NuGet versions remain installable after the repository migration.

## RQL

Since 1.0.0 the extension is an **RQL module**: it adds no MCP tools. Agents create TileMapLayers, assign their
TileSet and paint cells with the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools, and the module's guide is
part of the core `godot-rql` skill. The module adds, on `TileMapLayer`:

- **Cells**: read-only `usedCells` rows (`x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative`) and `usedCellCount`.
- **Calls**: `SetCell(x, y, sourceId, atlasX, atlasY, alternative = 0)` (source id, atlas coordinates and
  alternative validated: 0 or more), `EraseCell(x, y)` and `Clear()`. A rejected value changes nothing.

```
root | call AddChild("TileMapLayer", "Layer")
nodes | where name == "Layer" | set TileSet = "res://e2e-tileset.tres"
nodes | where name == "Layer" | call SetCell(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
nodes | where name == "Layer" | call SetCell(1, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1)
nodes | where name == "Layer" | get usedCells | select x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative
nodes | where name == "Layer" | call EraseCell(0, 0)
nodes | where $ is TileMapLayer | select name usedCellCount TileSet
nodes | where name == "Layer" | call Clear()
```

Every write is one undoable action and marks the scene unsaved (`editor | call SaveScene()` writes it).

### Migrating from 0.x

| 0.x tool | RQL |
| --- | --- |
| `tilemap-create` | `rql-mutate` `root \| call AddChild("TileMapLayer", "Layer")` |
| `tilemap-set-tileset` | `rql-mutate` `nodes \| where name == "Layer" \| set TileSet = "res://tiles.tres"` |
| `tilemap-set-cell` | `rql-mutate` `… \| call SetCell(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)` (x, y, sourceId, atlasX, atlasY[, alternative]) |
| `tilemap-erase-cell` | `rql-mutate` `… \| call EraseCell(0, 0)` |
| `tilemap-get-used-cells` | `rql-query` `… \| get usedCells \| select x y sourceId atlasX atlasY`; `… \| select usedCellCount TileSet` |
| `tilemap-clear` | `rql-mutate` `… \| call Clear()` |

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/src/Godot-AI-Tilemap/build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap.props`:

```props
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE INJECTION — the consumer half of the source-only package recipe.                       │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  NuGet auto-imports `build/<PackageId>.props` into any project that references this package. This file
  MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props` (com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap.props) or NuGet will
  not import it. `bump-version` / `init` keep the name in lockstep with <PackageId>.

  It adds this package's packed `.cs` (which sit in the NuGet cache under `<package>/<version>/src/`) as
  <Compile> items in the CONSUMER's project, so they compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project against
  the consumer's own GodotSharp. Because the consumer is a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, `Godot` types resolve
  and `#if TOOLS` is defined for the editor build — exactly as if the source lived in the consumer's repo.

  • $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory) resolves to `<package>/<version>/build/` in the NuGet cache, so
    `../src/**/*.cs` is the packed source.
  • Exclude="@(Compile)" is belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion (the consumer's own default
    glob never reaches the NuGet cache, so it normally excludes nothing).
  • Link groups the injected files under the package id in IDEs (cosmetic).
-->
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>

`extensions/Godot-AI-Tilemap/tests/Godot-AI-Tilemap.Tests/TilemapModuleTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Linq;
using Godot;
using Rql.Execution;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The module configures cleanly and shapes TileMapLayer: an RQL engine discovers it, registers its guide, and the member
    /// table of TileMapLayer carries the cell rows and the cell calls. Metadata only: no Godot object is created.
    /// </summary>
    public class TilemapModuleTests
    {
        private static RqlEngine Engine()
        {
            var engine = new RqlEngine();
            var reports = engine.AddModulesFrom(new[] { typeof(TilemapModule).Assembly });
            Assert.All(reports, r => Assert.True(r.Ok, r.ToString()));
            Assert.Contains(reports, r => r.Module == typeof(TilemapModule).FullName);
            return engine;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ModuleRegistersItsGuide()
        {
            var guide = Assert.Single(Engine().Guides, g => g.Key == TilemapGuide.Topic);
            Assert.Equal(TilemapGuide.Markdown, guide.Value);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LayerHasCellRowsAndCalls()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(TileMapLayer));
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "usedCells" && !m.CanWrite && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(m.Description));
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "usedCellCount" && m.Type == typeof(int) && !m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "TileSet" && m.CanWrite);
            var set = Assert.Single(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "SetCell");
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "x", "y", "sourceId", "atlasX", "atlasY", "alternative" }, set.Parameters.Select(p => p.Name));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { false, false, false, false, false, true }, set.Parameters.Select(p => p.HasDefault));
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "EraseCell" && c.Parameters.Count == 2);
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "Clear" && c.Parameters.Count == 0);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CellRowsAreReadOnlyColumns()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(TilemapCellRow));
            Assert.Equal(new[] { "x", "y", "sourceId", "atlasX", "atlasY", "alternative" }, info.Members.Select(m => m.Name));
            Assert.All(info.Members, m => Assert.False(m.CanWrite));
        }
    }
}

/*

using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Tilemap.Tests
{
    public class TilemapRulesTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0)]
        [InlineData(3)]
        public void SourceIdsOfZeroOrMoreAreValid(int sourceId) => Assert.Null(TilemapRules.SourceId(sourceId));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(-1)] // TileSet.INVALID_SOURCE
        [InlineData(-5)]
        public void NegativeSourceIdsAreRejectedPointingToEraseCell(int sourceId)
        {
            var reason = TilemapRules.SourceId(sourceId);
            Assert.NotNull(reason);
            Assert.Contains("EraseCell", reason);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(0, 0)]
        [InlineData(2, 7)]
        public void NonNegativeAtlasCoordsAreValid(int x, int y) => Assert.Null(TilemapRules.AtlasCoords(x, y));

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(-1, 0)]
        [InlineData(0, -1)]
        public void NegativeAtlasCoordsAreRejected(int x, int y) => Assert.Contains("at least 0", TilemapRules.AtlasCoords(x, y));

        [Fact]
        public void AlternativeMustBeZeroOrMore()
        {
            Assert.Null(TilemapRules.Alternative(0));
            Assert.Null(TilemapRules.Alternative(2));
            Assert.Contains("at least 0", TilemapRules.Alternative(-1));
        }
    }
}

`extensions/Shared/Tests/GuideExampleTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Rql;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Extensions.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The checks every extension's agent guide must pass, shared by the extension test projects (each links this file;
    /// the test assemblies are separate, so the type exists once per assembly). A derived class names its guide: every
    /// example parses, the guide markdown carries them, and the live e2e manifest (<c>tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json</c>, copied
    /// next to the test assembly) runs exactly the guide examples, in order, each with the tool its last stage needs
    /// (rql-mutate for set / call, rql-query otherwise).
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class GuideExampleTests
    {
        /// <summary>The guide's examples: one per line, the query, three or more spaces, a note.</summary>
        protected abstract string Examples { get; }

        /// <summary>The guide markdown the module registers.</summary>
        protected abstract string Markdown { get; }

        /// <summary>The queries of a guide's examples, in order (the note after three or more spaces is dropped).</summary>
        public static string[] Queries(string examples) =>
            examples.Split('\n').Select(l => Regex.Split(l.Trim(), @"\s{3,}")[0]).Where(l => l.Length > 0).ToArray();

        [Fact]
        public void EveryExampleParses()
        {
            var failures = Queries(Examples)
                .Select(q => RqlParser.TryParse(q, out _, out var error) ? null : $"'{q}': {error?.Message}")
                .Where(f => f != null).ToList();
            Assert.Empty(failures);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GuideCarriesItsExamples()
        {
            Assert.NotEmpty(Queries(Examples));
            Assert.Contains(Examples, Markdown);
            Assert.All(Queries(Examples), q => Assert.DoesNotContain("   ", q));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheLiveE2eRunsEveryGuideExampleInOrder()
        {
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "e2e-tools.json")));
            var calls = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("tools").EnumerateArray()
                .Where(c => c.TryGetProperty("input", out var input) && input.TryGetProperty("query", out _))
                .Select(c => (tool: c.GetProperty("tool").GetString()!, query: c.GetProperty("input").GetProperty("query").GetString()!))
                .ToList();
            var next = 0;
            foreach (var example in Queries(Examples))
            {
                while (next < calls.Count && calls[next].query != example) next++;
                Assert.True(next < calls.Count, $"tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json does not run the guide example (in order): {example}");
                var last = example.Split('|').Last().TrimStart();
                var mutates = last.StartsWith("set ", StringComparison.Ordinal) || last.StartsWith("call ", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                Assert.Equal(mutates ? "rql-mutate" : "rql-query", calls[next].tool);
                next++;
            }
        }
    }
}

`scripts/assert_runtime_harness.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
# │  Repository: GitHub (https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP)    │
# │  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
# │  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
# │  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
"""
Assert the structured result file produced by the issue-#186 runtime-integration harness
(Godot-Tests/Harness/RuntimeHarness.cs). The harness ALREADY decides pass/fail and encodes
it in its process exit code + the result's `ok` field; this asserter re-checks every
per-version expectation INDEPENDENTLY so CI fails with a readable, field-by-field diagnosis
(not just a bare non-zero exit) and so a future harness regression that flips `ok` true
without actually capturing what it claims is still caught here.

Usage:
    python scripts/assert_runtime_harness.py --result <path> --engine-logger-expected {0|1} \
        [--require-connect {0|1}] [--require-roundtrip {0|1}]

Per-version contract (the issue's acceptance criteria):
  * ALWAYS: capture installed + available; the C# unobserved-Task exception captured WITH a
    stack trace; (when --require-connect=1) the live SignalR transport connected; and the
    Godot.Variant converter round-trip (issue #292) — every documented wire shape materializes,
    an unreadable payload raises instead of degrading to a silent Nil, and the issue's own
    ProjectSettings.SetSetting repro reads its value back. (The Node-ref converter's resolve path
    is NOT covered here: its resolver is installed under #if TOOLS and this is a game process.)
  * --engine-logger-expected 1 (Godot 4.5+): the engine GDScript runtime error captured WITH
    a multi-frame backtrace (>= 2 frames, issue #163) + push_error + push_warning.
  * --engine-logger-expected 0 (Godot 4.3 / 4.4): the engine channel is ABSENT (graceful stub
    degradation) — no engine rows, no engine frames — while the C# channel still captures.

Pure stdlib — runs anywhere Python 3.8+ does. Exit 0 = every assertion held; 1 = a failure
(each failed assertion is printed); 2 = the result file is missing/unparseable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


#: Minimum number of Godot.Variant wire shapes the harness must exercise (issue #292).
#:
#: DELIBERATELY an independent literal, not read from RuntimeHarness.VariantRoundTripMinimumChecks.
#: This asserter's whole charter (see the module docstring) is to re-check the harness's claims
#: INDEPENDENTLY, so that a harness edit which flips `ok` true without actually doing the work is
#: still caught. Deriving this number from the harness source would make one edit defeat both
#: gates — the opposite of defence in depth. It is a FLOOR, so it does not need to track the C#
#: constant upward; it only needs to stop the assertion going vacuous.
VARIANT_MIN_CHECKS = 11


def _b(value) -> bool:
    return value is True


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Assert the Godot-MCP runtime-harness result.")
    ap.add_argument("--result", required=True, help="Path to the harness result JSON.")
    ap.add_argument("--engine-logger-expected", required=True, choices=["0", "1"],
                    help="1 when the Godot 4.5+ engine logger channel must be present, 0 for 4.3/4.4.")
    ap.add_argument("--require-connect", default="1", choices=["0", "1"],
                    help="1 (default) to require the live SignalR connection.")
    ap.add_argument("--require-roundtrip", default="0", choices=["0", "1"],
                    help="1 to require the result to record a successful tool roundtrip (default 0: the "
                         "roundtrip is asserted by the workflow's own server POST, not by the harness).")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    result_path = Path(args.result)
    if not result_path.is_file():
        print(f"::error::harness result file not found: {result_path}")
        return 2

    try:
        data = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"::error::could not parse harness result {result_path}: {ex}")
        return 2

    engine_expected = args.engine_logger_expected == "1"
    require_connect = args.require_connect == "1"

    failures: list[str] = []

    def check(cond: bool, msg: str) -> None:
        if not cond:
            failures.append(msg)

    # --- Always-required (version-independent) -----------------------------------------------
    check(data.get("fatalError") in (None, ""), f"harness reported a fatal error: {data.get('fatalError')!r}")
    check(_b(data.get("captureInstalled")), "runtime error capture did not install")
    check(_b(data.get("captureAvailable")), "RuntimeErrorCollector.Current was not available")
    check(_b(data.get("hasCSharpException")), "the C# (unobserved-Task) exception was not captured")
    check(_b(data.get("cSharpExceptionHasStackTrace")), "the captured C# exception had no stack trace")

    # --- Godot.Variant converter (issue #292) ------------------------------------------------
    # This runs against a REAL Godot, which is the only place it CAN run: materializing a non-Nil
    # Variant calls godotsharp_* P/Invoke and faults the plain xUnit host, so the unit suite covers
    # only the pure parser and the failure paths.
    variant_failures = data.get("variantRoundTripFailures") or []
    check(not variant_failures,
          f"Godot.Variant round-trip failures: {variant_failures}")
    checked = data.get("variantRoundTripChecked", 0)
    check(isinstance(checked, int) and checked >= VARIANT_MIN_CHECKS,
          f"Godot.Variant round-trip exercised only {checked} shape(s), expected >= {VARIANT_MIN_CHECKS} "
          "— the assertion must not go vacuous")
    check(_b(data.get("variantRoundTripRejectsGarbage")),
          "an unreadable Godot.Variant payload did NOT raise — that is the issue-#292 silent-Nil regression")
    check(_b(data.get("variantProjectSettingRoundTrip")),
          "ProjectSettings.SetSetting through a wire Godot.Variant did not read back the value "
          "(the verbatim issue-#292 repro)")

    # --- In-game script-execute -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Roslyn compiled and ran C# inside the running game (arithmetic + a read of the game's scene tree).
    exec_failures = data.get("scriptExecuteFailures") or []
    check(not exec_failures, f"in-game script-execute failures: {exec_failures}")
    check(data.get("scriptExecuteSum") == "2",
          f"in-game script-execute '1 + 1' returned {data.get('scriptExecuteSum')!r}, expected '2'")
    check(data.get("scriptExecuteRootName") == '"root"',
          f"in-game script-execute read the root window name as {data.get('scriptExecuteRootName')!r}, expected '\"root\"'")

    if require_connect:
        check(_b(data.get("connected")), "the live SignalR transport did not reach Connected")
        check(_b(data.get("initialConnectReturned")), "Connect() did not return true (initial connect failed)")

    # --- Per-version engine-channel expectations ---------------------------------------------
    check(_b(data.get("engineLoggerExpected")) == engine_expected,
          f"engineLoggerExpected in result ({data.get('engineLoggerExpected')}) != "
          f"--engine-logger-expected ({engine_expected}) — the leg's SDK build / version are mismatched")

    if engine_expected:
        # Godot 4.5+: engine GDScript runtime error WITH the #163 multi-frame backtrace + push diagnostics.
        check(_b(data.get("hasEngineRuntimeError")),
              "engine GDScript runtime error was NOT captured (4.5+ engine logger expected)")
        frame_count = data.get("engineRuntimeErrorFrameCount", 0)
        check(isinstance(frame_count, int) and frame_count >= 2,
              f"engine GDScript runtime error backtrace was not deep enough "
              f"(frames={frame_count}, expected >= 2 — issue #163)")
        check(_b(data.get("engineRuntimeErrorHasStackTrace")),
              "engine GDScript runtime error carried no formatted stack trace")
        check(_b(data.get("hasPushError")), "push_error was NOT captured (4.5+ engine logger expected)")
        check(_b(data.get("hasPushWarning")), "push_warning was NOT captured (4.5+ engine logger expected)")
    else:
        # Godot 4.3 / 4.4: the engine channel must degrade gracefully to ABSENT.
        check(not _b(data.get("hasEngineRuntimeError")),
              "engine GDScript runtime error was captured on a < 4.5 leg (engine logger should be absent)")
        check(data.get("engineRuntimeErrorFrameCount", 0) == 0,
              "engine backtrace frames present on a < 4.5 leg (engine logger should be absent)")
        check(not _b(data.get("hasPushError")),
              "push_error was captured on a < 4.5 leg (engine logger should be absent)")
        check(not _b(data.get("hasPushWarning")),
              "push_warning was captured on a < 4.5 leg (engine logger should be absent)")

    # --- The harness's own verdict must agree ------------------------------------------------
    check(_b(data.get("ok")), "the harness's own 'ok' verdict was false")

    print(f"Godot version: {data.get('godotVersion')!r}; engineLoggerExpected={engine_expected}; "
          f"requireConnect={require_connect}")
    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))

    if failures:
        print(f"::error::runtime harness assertion FAILED ({len(failures)} issue(s)):")
        for f in failures:
            print(f"::error::  - {f}")
        return 1

    print("Runtime harness assertions PASSED.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

`scripts/assetlib_extensions.py`:

```py
"""Independent source ZIPs and idempotent Godot Asset Library submissions.

Uses the documented Asset Library API (including Custom GitHub Release URLs).
Initial submissions and updates both require moderator approval; an accepted
submission is deliberately reported as submitted, not as a public asset.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import zipfile

from extension_release import REPO, selection, tag, verify_registry
from extensions import ROOT, SEMVER, read_json, run, verify_package

API = 'https://godotengine.org/asset-library/api'
RECEIPT = 'assetlib-submission.json'


def archive_name(module):
    return 'godot-mcp-' + tag(module) + '-assetlib.zip'


def archive_url(module):
    return f'https://github.com/{REPO}/releases/download/{tag(module)}/{archive_name(module)}'


def archive_files(module, package, *, root=ROOT, package_version=None):
    verify_package(package, module, root, version=package_version)
    prefix = module['name'] + '-' + module['version'] + '/addons/godot_mcp_extensions/'
    prefix += module['name'].removeprefix('Godot-AI-') + '/'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(package) as bundle:
        files = {prefix + name.removeprefix('src/'): bundle.read(name)
                 for name in bundle.namelist() if name.startswith('src/') and name.endswith('.cs')}
        files[prefix + 'README.md'] = bundle.read('README.md')
    files[prefix + 'LICENSE'] = (root / 'LICENSE').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').encode('utf-8')
    files[prefix + 'extension.json'] = json.dumps({key: module[key] for key in
        ('name', 'packageId', 'version', 'minGodotVersion')}, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode()
    files[prefix + 'INSTALL.md'] = (
        f"# {module['name']} {module['version']}\n\n"
        f"Requires Godot .NET {module['minGodotVersion']} or later and an installed Godot MCP core.\n"
        "Set up the core's NuGet dependencies first, as described in its README.\n"
        "Install this archive's addons/ folder into the existing Godot project, then build the C# project.\n"
        "The core discovers the extension's tools from the compiled assembly.\n"
        "Consult README.md for any third-party addon prerequisites.\n\n"
        "Choose either this source archive or the extension's NuGet package for a project.\n"
        "If switching from NuGet, remove that extension's PackageReference before building to avoid duplicate C# types.\n"
        "The Godot MCP core and its NuGet dependencies must remain installed.\n\n"
        f"Source and documentation: https://github.com/{REPO}/blob/main/extensions/{module['name']}/README.md\n"
    ).encode()
    return files


def pack_archive(module, package, output, *, root=ROOT, package_version=None):
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archive = output / archive_name(module)
    files = archive_files(module, package, root=root, package_version=package_version)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w') as bundle:
        for name, data in sorted(files.items()):
            entry = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            entry.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            entry.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
            bundle.writestr(entry, data)
    verify_archive(module, package, archive, root=root, package_version=package_version)
    return archive


def verify_archive(module, package, archive, *, root=ROOT, package_version=None):
    expected = archive_files(module, package, root=root, package_version=package_version)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
        names = bundle.namelist()
        if len(names) != len(set(names)) or set(names) != set(expected):
            raise ValueError('Asset Library archive contains missing, duplicate or unexpected files')
        for name, data in expected.items():
            if bundle.read(name) != data:
                raise ValueError('Asset Library archive bytes differ: ' + name)
    return True


def extract_archive(archive, project):
    # Archives are verified before extraction. Keep the path guard here as a
    # separate boundary: the leading release folder is stripped by AssetLib.
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
        for name in bundle.namelist():
            parts = name.split('/')
            if any(part in ('', '.', '..') for part in parts) or len(parts) < 5:
                raise ValueError('Invalid Asset Library archive path')
            path = project.joinpath(*parts[1:]).resolve()
            if not path.is_relative_to(project.resolve()):
                raise ValueError('Asset Library archive escapes project')
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(bundle.read(name))


def payload(module):
    feature = module['name'].removeprefix('Godot-AI-')
    return {
        'title': 'Godot MCP - ' + feature,
        'description': f'{feature} tools for Godot MCP. Requires the .NET edition of Godot and '
            'an installed Godot MCP core with its NuGet dependencies configured. '
            'Install the addons/ folder and build the C# project. This download contains only '
            'this extension; consult its README for third-party addon prerequisites. '
            'Use either this source archive or the equivalent NuGet package in a project to '
            'avoid duplicate C# types.\n\nDocumentation: '
            f'https://github.com/{REPO}/blob/main/extensions/{module["name"]}/README.md',
        'category_id': '5', 'godot_version': '.'.join(module['minGodotVersion'].split('.')[:2]),
        'version_string': module['version'], 'cost': 'Apache-2.0',
        'download_provider': 'Custom', 'download_commit': archive_url(module),
        'browse_url': f'https://github.com/{REPO}/tree/main/extensions/{module["name"]}',
        'issues_url': f'https://github.com/{REPO}/issues',
        'icon_url': f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{REPO}/main/addons/godot_mcp/icon.png',
        'previews': [],
    }


class Api:
    def request(self, path, body=None):
        request = urllib.request.Request(API + path,
            data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,
            headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json',
                     'User-Agent': 'Godot-MCP-AssetLibrary-Publisher'})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
                result = json.load(response)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            # Login errors and transport failures must never echo credentials,
            # tokens, response bodies or POST data into logs.
            raise RuntimeError(f'Asset Library HTTP {error.code} on {path.split("?")[0]}') from None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            raise RuntimeError('Asset Library request failed on ' + path.split('?')[0]) from None
        if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get('error'):
            raise RuntimeError('Asset Library rejected request on ' + path.split('?')[0])
        return result

    def listing(self, path, **query):
        rows = []
        page = 0
        while True:
            result = self.request(path + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({**query, 'page': page, 'max_results': 500}))
            if not isinstance(result.get('result'), list):
                raise ValueError('Malformed Asset Library listing')
            rows.extend(result['result'])
            page += 1
            if page >= int(result.get('pages', 0)):
                return rows
            if page > 100:
                raise ValueError('Asset Library listing exceeds safety bound')


def submit(module, api, username, token):
    desired = payload(module)
    owned = api.listing('/asset', user=username, type='addon', godot_version='any', filter=desired['title'])
    pending = api.listing('/asset/edit', user=username, filter=desired['title'])
    def matches(rows):
        found = [row for row in rows if row.get('title') == desired['title']
                 and row.get('author', '').casefold() == username.casefold()]
        if len(found) > 1:
            raise ValueError('Ambiguous Asset Library entries: ' + module['name'])
        return found[0] if found else None
    asset, edit = matches(owned), matches(pending)
    for row in (asset, edit):
        if row:
            current = row.get('version_string')
            if current and SEMVER.fullmatch(current):
                if tuple(map(int, current.split('.'))) > tuple(map(int, module['version'].split('.'))):
                    raise ValueError('Newer Asset Library version already exists: ' + module['name'])
    if asset and asset.get('version_string') == module['version']:
        actual = api.request('/asset/' + str(int(asset['asset_id'])))
        if actual.get('download_commit') != archive_url(module):
            raise ValueError('Existing Asset Library version points to a different archive')
        return {'status': 'published', 'assetId': int(asset['asset_id'])}
    if edit:
        detail = api.request('/asset/edit/' + str(int(edit['edit_id'])))
        effective = {**(detail.get('original') or {}), **{key: value for key, value in detail.items() if value is not None}}
        current = effective.get('version_string') or ''
        if SEMVER.fullmatch(current) and tuple(map(int, current.split('.'))) > tuple(map(int, module['version'].split('.'))):
            raise ValueError('Newer Asset Library edit already exists: ' + module['name'])
        if detail.get('status') not in ('new', 'in_review'):
            raise ValueError('Asset Library edit changed status; reconcile before retry: ' + module['name'])
        if (effective.get('version_string') == module['version']
                and effective.get('download_commit') == archive_url(module)):
            return {'status': 'submitted', 'editId': int(edit['edit_id'])}
        # Never duplicate an initial submission or overwrite an in-review edit.
        if detail.get('status') != 'new':
            raise ValueError('Asset Library edit is in review; await moderation: ' + module['name'])
        path = '/asset/edit/' + str(int(edit['edit_id']))
    else:
        path = '/asset/' + str(int(asset['asset_id'])) if asset else '/asset'
    result = api.request(path, {**desired, 'token': token})
    edit_id = int(result['id'])
    if edit_id <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid Asset Library submission ID')
    return {'status': 'submitted', 'editId': edit_id}


def gh(*args):
    return json.loads(run(['gh', *args]))


def attach(release, path):
    found = [asset for asset in release['assets'] if asset['name'] == path.name]
    digest = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if found:
        if len(found) != 1 or found[0].get('digest') != digest:
            raise ValueError('Existing immutable Asset Library attachment differs: ' + path.name)
        return
    run(['gh', 'release', 'upload', release['tag_name'], path, '--repo', REPO])


def sync(selected, output):
    if os.environ.get('GITHUB_ACTIONS') != 'true' or os.environ.get('GITHUB_REF') != 'refs/heads/main':
        raise ValueError('Submit Asset Library entries only through the main-branch GitHub workflow')
    api, token = Api(), None
    username = os.environ.get('GODOT_ASSETLIB_USERNAME', '')
    results = []
    for module in selected:
        folder = output / module['name']
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        release = gh('api', f'repos/{REPO}/releases/tags/{tag(module)}')
        if release['draft'] or release['prerelease']:
            raise ValueError('Publish the stable component before its Asset Library submission')
        package = verify_registry(module, folder)
        archive = folder / archive_name(module)
        if any(asset['name'] == archive.name for asset in release['assets']):
            run(['gh', 'release', 'download', tag(module), '--repo', REPO, '--dir', folder,
                 '--pattern', archive.name, '--clobber'])
            verify_archive(module, package, archive)
        else:
            archive = pack_archive(module, package, folder)
        checksum = folder / (archive.name + '.sha256')
        checksum.write_text(hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest() + '  ' + archive.name + '\n')
        attach(release, archive)
        attach(release, checksum)
        receipt = folder / RECEIPT
        if any(asset['name'] == RECEIPT for asset in release['assets']):
            run(['gh', 'release', 'download', tag(module), '--repo', REPO, '--dir', folder,
                 '--pattern', RECEIPT, '--clobber'])
            saved = read_json(receipt)
            if any(saved.get(k) != v for k, v in {'schema': 1, 'packageId': module['packageId'],
                    'version': module['version'], 'archiveUrl': archive_url(module),
                    'archiveSha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}.items()):
                raise ValueError('Existing Asset Library receipt targets different package coordinates')
            if saved.get('status') not in ('submitted', 'published') or not any(
                    type(saved.get(key)) is int and saved[key] > 0 for key in ('editId', 'assetId')):
                raise ValueError('Invalid Asset Library receipt')
        else:
            if token is None:
                password = os.environ.get('GODOT_ASSETLIB_PASSWORD', '')
                if not username or not password:
                    raise ValueError('Missing Asset Library repository credentials')
                login = api.request('/login', {'username': username, 'password': password})
                if login.get('authenticated') is not True or not login.get('token'):
                    raise ValueError('Asset Library login failed')
                token = login['token']
                print('::add-mask::' + token, flush=True)
            saved = {'schema': 1, 'packageId': module['packageId'], 'version': module['version'],
                     'archiveUrl': archive_url(module),
                     'archiveSha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                     **submit(module, api, username, token)}
            receipt.write_text(json.dumps(saved, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
            attach(release, receipt)
        results.append(saved)
        print(f"Asset Library {module['name']} {module['version']}: {saved['status']}", flush=True)
    (output / 'submissions.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('command', choices=['plan', 'sync'])
    parser.add_argument('--only', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=ROOT / '.artifacts/assetlib-extensions')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    selected = selection(args.only)
    if args.command == 'plan':
        print(json.dumps([payload(module) for module in selected], indent=2))
    else:
        sync(selected, args.output.resolve())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        print('Asset Library submission failed: ' + str(error), flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)
