`scripts/smoke_rql_values.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Live cases of values an agent writes the way it reads them, run by scripts/smoke_rql.py against a running editor:
CallMethod arguments converted to the types the Godot method declares (a vector as text, a res:// path, an enum by
name; a wrong one refused before any call), enum-hinted int properties by name, new embedded resources from object
literals ("$type" or class, Godot or script classes), resource files of a script class_name, a multi-target Connect
that is all-or-nothing, and the suggestions of godot.find.

Every change is checked where it cannot lie: the .tscn / .tres text Godot wrote, plus a read-back query.
Pure stdlib, Python 3.8+.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib
import re

from smoke_rql_lib import check, file_has, file_text, must, mutate, q, query, tool
from smoke_rql_models import fails, has, lacks, new_scene, node, result_is


def run(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    call_arguments(host, project, d)
    enum_props(host, project, d)
    literals(host, project, d)
    script_class_resources(host, project, d)
    connect_validator(host, d)
    find_suggestions(host, d)


def call_arguments(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """CallMethod converts each argument to the declared type; a value that does not convert is refused, nothing runs."""
    tex = f"{d}/v_tex.tres"
    sc = f"{d}/v_calls.tscn"
    new_scene(host, sc, "Node2D", "CallRoot", [("Sprite2D", "Spr"), ("Sprite2D", "Spr2"), ("Control", "Ui")])
    must("V1 texture file", mutate(host, f'editor | call CreateResource({q(tex)}, "GradientTexture2D")'))
    must("V1 vector as text", mutate(host, f'{node("Spr")} | call CallMethod("set_position", ["(3, 4)"])'))
    has("V1 position set", must("V1 read", query(host, f'{node("Spr")} | select Position')), "(3, 4)")
    must("V1 vector as list", mutate(host, f'{node("Spr2")} | call CallMethod("set_position", [[5, 6]])'))
    has("V1 list position set", must("V1 read list", query(host, f'{node("Spr2")} | select Position')), "(5, 6)")
    must("V1 resource by path", mutate(host, f'{node("Spr")} | call CallMethod("set_texture", [{q(tex)}])'))
    has("V1 texture set", must("V1 read texture", query(host, f'{node("Spr")} | select Texture')), tex)
    must("V1 enum by name", mutate(host, f'{node("Ui")} | call CallMethod("set_anchors_preset", ["FullRect"])'))
    has("V1 anchors full rect", must("V1 read anchors", query(host, f'{node("Ui")} | select AnchorRight AnchorBottom')), "1|1")
    fails("V1 a value that does not convert", mutate(host, f'{node("Spr")} | call CallMethod("set_position", ["nope"])'),
          "set_position argument 1", "Vector2")
    fails("V1 a resource of the wrong class", mutate(host, f'{node("Spr")} | call CallMethod("set_material", [{q(tex)}])'),
          "set_material argument 1")
    fails("V1 an unknown enum name", mutate(host, f'{node("Ui")} | call CallMethod("set_anchors_preset", ["Sideways"])'),
          "not one of", "PRESET_FULL_RECT")
    # Spr (first) has set_flip_h, the Control does not: the validator refuses before Spr flips.
    fails("V1 multi-target is all-or-nothing",
          mutate(host, 'nodes | where name == "Spr" or name == "Ui" | call CallMethod("set_flip_h", [true])'), "has no method")
    has("V1 Spr not flipped", must("V1 read flip", query(host, f'{node("Spr")} | select FlipH')), "false")
    must("V1 save", mutate(host, "editor | call SaveScene()"))
    check("V1 saved", file_has(project, sc, r"^position = Vector2\(3, 4\)$") and file_has(project, sc, r"^texture = ExtResource\("),
          file_text(project, sc))


def enum_props(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """An enum-hinted int property takes the inspector's name or the constant."""
    sc = f"{d}/v_enums.tscn"
    new_scene(host, sc, "Control", "EnumRoot", [("Button", "B")])
    must("V2 by inspector name", mutate(host, f'{node("B")} | set props["grow_horizontal"] = "Both"'))
    version = re.search(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)", must("V2 version", query(host, "editor | select godotVersion")))
    # The setter's enum constants (GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN, not the label "Top") need ClassDB.class_get_property_setter: 4.4+.
    constant = "GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN" if version and (int(version.group(1)), int(version.group(2))) >= (4, 4) else "Top"
    must("V2 by constant (4.4+) or label", mutate(host, f'{node("B")} | set props["grow_vertical"] = {q(constant)}'))
    must("V2 by number", mutate(host, f'{node("B")} | set props["focus_mode"] = 0'))
    has("V2 read", must("V2 read", query(host, f'{node("B")} | select props["grow_horizontal"] props["grow_vertical"] props["focus_mode"]')), "2|0|0")
    fails("V2 an unknown name", mutate(host, f'{node("B")} | set props["grow_horizontal"] = "Sideways"'), "not one of", "Both")
    must("V2 save", mutate(host, "editor | call SaveScene()"))
    check("V2 saved", file_has(project, sc, r"^grow_horizontal = 2$") and file_has(project, sc, r"^grow_vertical = 0$"), file_text(project, sc))


def literals(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """Object literals naming a class build embedded sub-resources; an abstract class is refused."""
    sc = f"{d}/v_literals.tscn"
    new_scene(host, sc, "Node3D", "LitRoot", [("CollisionShape3D", "Col"), ("MeshInstance3D", "Mesh"), ("WorldEnvironment", "Env"),
                                              ("MeshInstance3D", "Over")])
    # A nested value of the target's own type (Material in a Material) and a literal as a CallMethod argument.
    must("V3 same-type nesting", mutate(host, f'{node("Over")} | set MaterialOverride = {{class: "StandardMaterial3D", '
                                              'NextPass: {class: "StandardMaterial3D", AlbedoColor: "#00ff00"}}'))
    must("V3 literal argument", mutate(host, f'{node("Over")} | call CallMethod("set_mesh", [{{"$type": "SphereMesh", Radius: 2}}])'))
    fails("V3 abstract class refused", mutate(host, f'{node("Col")} | set Shape = {{"$type": "Shape3D"}}'), "cannot be instantiated")
    must("V3 $type", mutate(host, f'{node("Col")} | set Shape = {{"$type": "BoxShape3D", Size: "(1, 2, 1)"}}'))
    must("V3 class + nested", mutate(host, f'{node("Mesh")} | set Mesh = {{class: "BoxMesh", Material: {{class: "StandardMaterial3D", AlbedoColor: "#ff0000"}}}}'))
    must("V3 concrete property type", mutate(host, f'{node("Env")} | set Environment = {{BackgroundMode: "Sky", Sky: {{SkyMaterial: {{"$type": "ProceduralSkyMaterial"}}}}}}'))
    fails("V3 unrelated class refused", mutate(host, f'{node("Col")} | set Shape = {{class: "BoxMesh"}}'), "BoxMesh")
    must("V3 save", mutate(host, "editor | call SaveScene()"))
    text = file_text(project, sc)
    check("V3 box shape saved", re.search(r'^\[sub_resource type="BoxShape3D" id="[^"]+"\]\nsize = Vector3\(1, 2, 1\)$', text, re.M) is not None, text)
    check("V3 nested material saved", re.search(r'^\[sub_resource type="StandardMaterial3D" id="[^"]+"\]\nalbedo_color = Color\(1, 0, 0, 1\)$', text, re.M) is not None
          and "material = SubResource(" in text, text)
    check("V3 environment saved", "background_mode = 2" in text and 'type="ProceduralSkyMaterial"' in text, text)
    check("V3 nested same-type material saved", "next_pass = SubResource(" in text and "albedo_color = Color(0, 1, 0, 1)" in text, text)
    check("V3 literal argument saved", re.search(r'^\[sub_resource type="SphereMesh" id="[^"]+"\]\nradius = 2\.0$', text, re.M) is not None, text)


def script_class_resources(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """A script class_name works for CreateResource, godot.resources and object literals."""
    cls = "HzItem" + re.sub(r"\D", "", d)[-9:]  # class_name is global: one per run
    gd, item, sc = f"{d}/v_item.gd", f"{d}/v_item.tres", f"{d}/v_holder.tscn"
    holder_gd = f"{d}/v_holder.gd"
    # The run folder must be known to the editor filesystem before the class_name script lands in it, or Godot never
    # registers the class; a scan before script-create (never after it: that hung Godot 4.4, see smoke_rql_models).
    must("V4 scan the run folder", mutate(host, "editor | call Reimport()"))
    must("V4 class script", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": gd, "content":
         f"@tool\nclass_name {cls}\nextends Resource\n@export var price: int = 10\n@export var label: String = \"\"\n@export var icon: Resource\n"}))
    tex = f"{d}/v_icon.tres"
    must("V4 icon file", mutate(host, f'editor | call CreateResource({q(tex)}, "GradientTexture2D")'))
    must("V4 holder script", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": holder_gd, "content": "@tool\nextends Node\n@export var item: Resource\n"}))
    must("V4 CreateResource of a class_name", mutate(host, f"editor | call CreateResource({q(item)}, {q(cls)})"))
    must("V4 edit it", mutate(host, f'godot.resource({q(item)}) | set props["price"] = 25, props["label"] = "Sword"'))
    check("V4 saved with its script", file_has(project, item, r'^script = ExtResource\(') and file_has(project, item, r"^price = 25$"),
          file_text(project, item))
    has("V4 godot.resources by class_name", must("V4 find", query(host, f"godot.resources({q(cls)}) | select path props[\"price\"]")), f"{item}|25")
    new_scene(host, sc, "Node", "HolderRoot", [("Node", "Holder")])
    must("V4 attach", tool(host, "script-attach-to-node", {"nodeRef": "Holder", "scriptPath": holder_gd}))
    # icon is a Resource like item itself: the res:// path must still load (no re-entry skip of the adapter).
    must("V4 literal of a class_name", mutate(host, f'{node("Holder")} | set props["item"] = {{class: {q(cls)}, price: 9, Label: "Dagger", icon: {q(tex)}}}'))
    must("V4 save", mutate(host, "editor | call SaveScene()"))
    text = file_text(project, sc)
    check("V4 embedded script resource saved", "price = 9" in text and 'label = "Dagger"' in text and "item = SubResource(" in text
          and re.search(r"^icon = ExtResource\(", text, re.M) is not None, text)
    fails("V4 unknown property of the class", mutate(host, f'{node("Holder")} | set props["item"] = {{class: {q(cls)}, nope: 1}}'), "no property")


def connect_validator(host: str, d: str) -> None:
    """A multi-target Connect is checked for every target before the first connection."""
    gd = f"{d}/v_target.gd"
    new_scene(host, f"{d}/v_connect.tscn", "Node", "ConnRoot", [("Button", "A"), ("Node", "B"), ("Node", "Target")])
    must("V5 script", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": gd, "content": "extends Node\nfunc _on_pressed():\n\tpass\n"}))
    must("V5 attach", tool(host, "script-attach-to-node", {"nodeRef": "Target", "scriptPath": gd}))
    # A (a Button) has "pressed", B (a Node) does not: nothing may connect.
    fails("V5 multi-target Connect is all-or-nothing",
          mutate(host, 'nodes | where name == "A" or name == "B" | call Connect("pressed", godot.find("Target"), "_on_pressed")'),
          "invalid-value", "no signal 'pressed'")
    result_is("V5 A not connected", must("V5 read", query(host, 'godot.find("A") | select name n=(connections.count())')), "0")
    fails("V5 dry run reports a missing method", mutate(host, 'godot.find("A") | call Connect("pressed", godot.find("Target"), "_nope")', dry_run=True),
          "invalid-value", "no method")


def find_suggestions(host: str, d: str) -> None:
    """A godot.find miss suggests the paths of similar names."""
    new_scene(host, f"{d}/v_find.tscn", "Node3D", "FindRoot", [("Node3D", "Geometry")])
    must("V6 child", mutate(host, 'godot.find("Geometry") | call AddChild("Node3D", "Floor")'))
    fails("V6 typo", query(host, 'godot.find("Flor") | select name'), "no node at 'Flor'", "similar: Geometry/Floor")
    fails("V6 wrong parent", query(host, 'godot.find("World/Floor") | select name'), "similar: Geometry/Floor")
    lacks("V6 no suggestion for a far name", fails("V6 far", query(host, 'godot.find("Zebra") | select name'), "no node"), "similar")

```

`scripts/smoke_rql_wave4.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Live cases of what wave-4 agent runs (a seeded, messy project to audit and repair) could not do, run by scripts/smoke_rql.py
against a running editor: the elements of a Godot array property (props["events"]) as the values they hold, the undo / redo
history an agent can read before stepping it, which file loads which (files: deps, missingDeps, usedBy), how a scene instance
differs from its scene file (overrides), import options (files: importSettings), and script-update of a GDScript that declares its own class_name.

Every change is checked where it cannot lie: the .tres / .tscn / .gd text Godot wrote, plus a read-back query.
Pure stdlib, Python 3.8+.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import pathlib
import re
import struct

from smoke_rql_lib import check, disk, file_has, file_text, must, mutate, q, query, tool
from smoke_rql_models import fails, has, lacks, new_scene, node


def run(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    array_elements(host, project, d)
    undo_history(host, d)
    file_references(host, project, d)
    instance_overrides(host, project, d)
    class_name_update(host, project, d)
    import_settings(host, project, d)


def write(project: pathlib.Path, res_path: str, text: str) -> None:
    path = disk(project, res_path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def array_elements(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """A Godot array property streams the values it holds (not Variant structs), and writes through them reach the file."""
    sc = f"{d}/w4_shortcut.tres"
    write(project, sc, '[gd_resource type="Shortcut" load_steps=3 format=3]\n\n'
                       '[sub_resource type="InputEventKey" id="k1"]\nkeycode = 65\n\n'
                       '[sub_resource type="InputEventKey" id="k2"]\nkeycode = 66\n\n'
                       '[resource]\nevents = [SubResource("k1"), SubResource("k2")]\n')
    must("W4A reimport", mutate(host, f"editor | call Reimport([{q(sc)}])"))
    text = must("W4A read elements", query(host, f'godot.resource({q(sc)}) | get props["events"] | select k=(props["keycode"])'))
    lacks("W4A no Variant warning", text, "on Variant")
    has("W4A element members", text, "65", "66")
    text = must("W4A where", query(host, f'godot.resource({q(sc)}) | get props["events"] | where props["keycode"] == 66 | count'))
    check("W4A filter on an element member", re.search(r"^1$", text, re.M) is not None, text)
    fails("W4A an index write is refused (it would skip undo and saving)",
          mutate(host, f'godot.resource({q(sc)}) | set props["events"][0] = null'), "")
    must("W4A copy the whole list into another property", mutate(host, f'godot.resource({q(sc)}) | set props["events"] = props["events"]'))
    must("W4A write through an element",
         mutate(host, f'godot.resource({q(sc)}) | get props["events"] | where props["keycode"] == 66 | set props["keycode"] = 67'))
    check("W4A saved", file_has(project, sc, r"^keycode = 67$") and file_has(project, sc, r"^keycode = 65$"), file_text(project, sc))


def undo_history(host: str, d: str) -> None:
    """editor | select undoHistory / redoHistory list what Undo() / Redo() would step, newest first."""
    must("W4U new scene", mutate(host, f'editor | call NewScene({q(d + "/w4_undo.tscn")}, "Node3D", "U")'))
    must("W4U add", mutate(host, 'root | call AddChild("Node3D", "W4UAlpha")'))
    must("W4U rename", mutate(host, 'godot.find("W4UAlpha") | set name = "W4UBeta"'))
    text = must("W4U read history", query(host, "editor | select undoHistory"))
    check("W4U newest first", 0 <= text.find("W4UBeta") < text.find("AddChild"), text)
    must("W4U undo", mutate(host, "editor | call Undo()"))
    has("W4U redo lists the undone rename", must("W4U read redo", query(host, "editor | select redoHistory")), "W4UBeta")
    lacks("W4U undo no longer lists it", must("W4U read undo", query(host, "editor | select undoHistory")), "W4UBeta")


def file_references(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """files: deps (what a file loads), missingDeps (broken references), usedBy (what loads it; empty = unused)."""
    used, unused, gone, mat = f"{d}/w4_used.png", f"{d}/w4_unused.png", f"{d}/w4_gone.png", f"{d}/w4_mat.tres"
    png = bytes.fromhex("89504e470d0a1a0a0000000d4948445200000001000000010802000000907753de0000000c4944415408d763f8cfc000000301"
                        "0100c9fe92ef0000000049454e44ae426082")
    for p in (used, unused):
        path = disk(project, p)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(png)
    write(project, mat, '[gd_resource type="StandardMaterial3D" load_steps=3 format=3]\n\n'
                        f'[ext_resource type="Texture2D" path="{used}" id="1_a"]\n'
                        f'[ext_resource type="Texture2D" path="{gone}" id="2_b"]\n\n'
                        '[resource]\nalbedo_texture = ExtResource("1_a")\nnormal_texture = ExtResource("2_b")\n')
    must("W4F reimport", mutate(host, f"editor | call Reimport([{q(used)}, {q(unused)}, {q(mat)}])"))
    has("W4F deps", must("W4F read deps", query(host, f"files | where path == {q(mat)} | select deps")), used, gone)
    text = must("W4F read missing", query(host, f"files | where path == {q(mat)} | select missingDeps"))
    has("W4F missing dep", text, gone)
    lacks("W4F an existing dep is not missing", text, used)
    has("W4F usedBy", must("W4F read usedBy", query(host, f"files | where path == {q(used)} | select usedBy")), mat)
    has("W4F unused texture", must("W4F unused", query(host, f'files | where dir == {q(d + "/")} and ext == "png" and usedBy.count() == 0 | select path')),
        unused)
    lacks("W4F deps on request only", must("W4F default row", query(host, f"files | where path == {q(mat)} | select $")), "deps")


def instance_overrides(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """overrides: how a scene instance differs from its scene file (a transform as position / scale; a child's material)."""
    house, level = f"{d}/w4_house.tscn", f"{d}/w4_level.tscn"
    mat_a, mat_b = f"{d}/w4_a.tres", f"{d}/w4_b.tres"
    must("W4O material a", mutate(host, f'editor | call CreateResource({q(mat_a)}, "StandardMaterial3D")'))
    must("W4O material b", mutate(host, f'editor | call CreateResource({q(mat_b)}, "StandardMaterial3D")'))
    new_scene(host, house, "Node3D", "House", [("MeshInstance3D", "Body")])
    must("W4O body", mutate(host, f'{node("Body")} | set Mesh = {{$type: "BoxMesh"}}, MaterialOverride = {q(mat_a)}, Position = "(0, 1.5, 0)"'))
    must("W4O save house", mutate(host, "editor | call SaveScene()"))
    new_scene(host, level, "Node3D", "Level", [])
    for name in ("H1", "H2", "H3"):
        must(f"W4O instance {name}", mutate(host, f'root | call InstantiateScene({q(house)}, {q(name)})'))
    must("W4O scale H2", mutate(host, f'{node("H2")} | set Scale = "(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)"'))
    must("W4O material H3", mutate(host, f'nodes | where path == "H3/Body" | set MaterialOverride = {q(mat_b)}'))
    text = must("W4O read", query(host, 'nodes | where SceneFilePath != "" | get overrides | select node property value template'))
    has("W4O scale override", text, ".|scale|(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)|(1, 1, 1)")
    lacks("W4O the root's placement is not an override", text, ".|position|")
    has("W4O child material override", text, f"Body|material_override|")
    has("W4O template value", text, mat_a)
    text = must("W4O H1", query(host, f'{node("H1")} | get overrides | select node property'))
    check("W4O an untouched instance has none (its placement aside)", all(l == ".|position" for l in text.splitlines()[2:] if l.strip()), text)
    must("W4O revert to the template", mutate(host, f'nodes | where path == "H3/Body" | set MaterialOverride = {q(mat_a)}'))
    lacks("W4O reverted", must("W4O H3", query(host, f'{node("H3")} | get overrides | select property')), "material_override")
    must("W4O save level", mutate(host, "editor | call SaveScene()"))
    lacks("W4O no override saved for the reverted material", file_text(project, level), mat_b)


def class_name_update(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """script-update rewrites a GDScript that declares the class_name it registers; a real error names its line."""
    path = f"{d}/w4_item.gd"
    name = "W4Item" + re.sub(r"\D", "", d)[-9:]
    must("W4S create", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": path, "content": f"class_name {name}\nextends Resource\n\n@export var price: float = 0.0\n"}))
    must("W4S update keeps the class_name",
         tool(host, "script-update", {"scriptPath": path, "content": f"class_name {name}\nextends Resource\n\n@export var price: float = 1.0\n"}))
    check("W4S written", file_has(project, path, r"price: float = 1\.0"), file_text(project, path))
    # Godot 4.5+ reports the engine's script errors (line and message); older versions only the error code.
    version = re.search(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)", must("W4S version", query(host, "editor | select godotVersion")))
    precise = version is not None and (int(version.group(1)), int(version.group(2))) >= (4, 5)
    fails("W4S a real error is refused" + (" with its line" if precise else ""),
          tool(host, "script-update", {"scriptPath": path, "content": f"class_name {name}\nextends Resource\n\nfunc broken(:\n"}),
          *(("line 4",) if precise else ("parse",)))
    check("W4S file untouched by the refused update", file_has(project, path, r"price: float = 1\.0"), file_text(project, path))


def import_settings(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    """files: importSettings["option"] reads an imported file's .import [params]; a write changes it and re-imports the file."""
    wav = f"{d}/w4_loop.wav"
    rate, n = 8000, 800
    samples = b"".join(struct.pack("<h", int(3000 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 220 * i / rate))) for i in range(n))
    path = disk(project, wav)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(b"RIFF" + struct.pack("<I", 36 + len(samples)) + b"WAVEfmt " + struct.pack("<IHHIIHH", 16, 1, 1, rate, rate * 2, 2, 16) +
                     b"data" + struct.pack("<I", len(samples)) + samples)
    must("W4I import", mutate(host, f"editor | call Reimport([{q(wav)}])"))
    text = must("W4I read", query(host, f'files | where path == {q(wav)} | select importSettings["edit/loop_mode"]'))
    check("W4I read an option", re.search(r"^0$", text, re.M) is not None, text)
    must("W4I set loop mode", mutate(host, f'files | where path == {q(wav)} | set importSettings["edit/loop_mode"] = 2'))
    check("W4I .import written", file_has(project, wav + ".import", r"^edit/loop_mode=2$"), file_text(project, wav + ".import"))
    has("W4I re-imported", must("W4I loop", query(host, f"godot.resource({q(wav)}) | select LoopMode")), "Forward")
    fails("W4I an unknown option names the options", mutate(host, f'files | where path == {q(wav)} | set importSettings["edit/nope"] = 1'),
          "edit/loop_mode")
    fails("W4I a native file has none", mutate(host, f'files | where path == {q(d + "/w4_mat.tres")} | set importSettings["x"] = 1'), "not an imported file")
```

`scripts/smoke_rql_wave5.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Live cases of what wave-5 agent runs (building a small game end to end) could not do, run by scripts/smoke_rql.py against a
running editor: script-validate reporting GDScript warnings (an unused variable), an autoload added with rql-mutate being
known to the editor's GDScript compiler at once (and gone again after Undo), and a clear error for a call without its query.
The C# compiler warnings of script-build are checked by scripts/smoke_reload.py. Pure stdlib, Python 3.8+.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib

from smoke_rql_lib import check, must, mutate, q, query, tool
from smoke_rql_models import has, lacks, value_is

TAB = "\t"


def run(host: str, project: pathlib.Path, d: str) -> None:
    missing_query(host)
    gdscript_warnings(host, d)
    autoload_registry(host, d)


def missing_query(host: str) -> None:
    """A call without its query names the argument instead of an internal ArgumentNullException. A GameDev-MCP-Server that
    checks arguments against the input schema refuses it first ([invalid_params]), which is as good."""
    for name in ("rql-query", "rql-mutate"):
        ok, text = tool(host, name, {})
        check(f"W5Q {name} without a query", not ok and "query" in text and ("missing-argument" in text or "[invalid_params]" in text), text)


def gdscript_warnings(host: str, d: str) -> None:
    """script-validate lists the GDScript warnings (shown only in the script editor before) without failing ok."""
    path = f"{d}/w5_warn.gd"
    src = f"extends Node\n\nfunc _ready() -> void:\n{TAB}var unused_counter := 0\n{TAB}var unused_total := 1\n{TAB}print(1)\n"
    must("W5W script-create", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": path, "content": src}))
    text = must("W5W validate", tool(host, "script-validate", {"scriptPath": path}))
    if "Coarse" in text:
        print("[SKIP] W5W GDScript warnings need the Godot 4.5+ error hook", flush=True)
        return
    has("W5W both unused variables are warnings", text, "unused_counter", "unused_total", "Warning")
    flat = text.replace(" ", "").replace('"', "").lower()
    check("W5W ok stays true and both warnings are counted", "ok:true" in flat and "warningcount:2" in flat, text)
    lacks("W5W the probe's error marker is not shown", text, "Warning treated as error")
    level = must("W5W the warning level is restored", query(host, 'settings | where name == "debug/gdscript/warnings/unused_variable" | select value'))
    value_is("W5W unused_variable stays at Warn (1)", level, "1")


def autoload_registry(host: str, d: str) -> None:
    """An autoload added through rql-mutate is a GDScript singleton for the editor right away; Undo removes it again."""
    name = "W5SmokeAutoload"
    singleton, user = f"{d}/w5_singleton.gd", f"{d}/w5_user.gd"
    must("W5A singleton script", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": singleton, "content": f"extends Node\n\nfunc ping() -> int:\n{TAB}return 1\n"}))
    must("W5A add the autoload", mutate(host, f"project | call AddAutoload({q(name)}, {q(singleton)})"))
    must("W5A a script using it", tool(host, "script-create", {"scriptPath": user, "content": f"extends Node\n\nfunc _ready() -> void:\n{TAB}print({name}.ping())\n"}))
    text = must("W5A validate", tool(host, "script-validate", {"scriptPath": user}))
    check("W5A the singleton resolves", "ErrorCount:0" in text, text)
    must("W5A undo the autoload", mutate(host, "editor | call Undo()"))
    text = must("W5A validate after undo", tool(host, "script-validate", {"scriptPath": user}))
    # Godot < 4.5 has no error text (Coarse fidelity): the parse error itself is the evidence there.
    unknown = "not declared" in text or "not found" in text or ("Coarse" in text and "ParseError" in text)
    check("W5A undone: the singleton is unknown again", unknown, text)
    must("W5A redo", mutate(host, "editor | call Redo()"))
    text = must("W5A validate after redo", tool(host, "script-validate", {"scriptPath": user}))
    check("W5A redone: the singleton resolves again", "ErrorCount:0" in text, text)
    must("W5A remove the autoload", mutate(host, f"project | call RemoveAutoload({q(name)})"))

```

`scripts/smoke_script_execute.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Live smoke of `script-execute` (Code-Exec) against a running Godot editor with this addon (default toolFormat Rql).

Checks: an expression, a game type from the project's own C# assembly (with auto-import of its namespace), Godot
API, GD.Print / GD.PushWarning (Godot 4.5+ only: the engine logger) and Console captured into the result, the
plugin's live statics with one copy of the game assembly and GodotSharp, `await`, full-source mode, a compile error at
the snippet's own line, a runtime error, `include` of a helper, the output caps (a huge value or print flood comes back cut),
Godot structs / lazy sequences / a freed object as results, and that snippet assemblies unload (0 live contexts
after GC).

It does NOT launch anything (or use `godot-cli exec`, which does):

    GODOT_MCP_CONNECTION_MODE=Custom GODOT_MCP_HOST=http://localhost:8080 GODOT_MCP_START_SERVER=true \\
        godot --headless --path <project> --editor &
    python scripts/smoke_script_execute.py --host http://localhost:8080 --project <project>

`--project` gets a fixture game type (`res://SmokeExec/SmokeExecScore.cs`, namespace SmokeExec) and a snippet helper
(`.ai-game-dev/snippets/smoke/SmokeHelper.cs`) written before the run: build the project after the first run (or run
it once, build, start the editor, run again). `--prepare` only writes them (CI runs it before its C# build). Use a
disposable project. Exit code 0 = every case passed. Stdlib only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

GAME_TYPE = "namespace SmokeExec\n{\n    public static class SmokeExecScore\n    {\n        public static int Value => 77;\n    }\n}\n"
HELPER = "public static class SmokeHelper\n{\n    public static int Twice(int v) => v * 2;\n}\n"
FAILURES: list[str] = []


def execute(host: str, args: dict, timeout: float = 180) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """(succeeded, the tool's text or error)."""
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{host}/api/tools/script-execute", data=json.dumps(args).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            body = json.loads(resp.read().decode() or "{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode()
        try:
            body = json.loads(raw or "{}")
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            body = {"error": raw or str(e)}
    if "error" in body:
        return False, str(body["error"])
    if "structured" in body:
        return True, json.dumps(body["structured"])
    return True, "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in body.get("content") or [])


def wait_ready(host: str, timeout: float) -> bool:
    """Poll a trivial snippet until the editor answers (each probe bounded by the time left, at most 30 s)."""
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while (left := deadline - time.monotonic()) > 0:
        try:
            if execute(host, {"csharpCode": "0"}, timeout=min(30, left))[0]:
                return True
        except (OSError, ValueError):  # server not reachable yet, the probe timed out, or a non-JSON reply
            pass
        time.sleep(1)
    return False


def case(host: str, name: str, args: dict, ok: bool, *expected: str) -> str:
    succeeded, text = execute(host, args)
    missing = [e for e in expected if e not in text]
    status = "PASS" if succeeded == ok and not missing else "FAIL"
    print(f"{status} {name}: {text.splitlines()[0] if text else ''}")
    if status == "FAIL":
        FAILURES.append(f"{name}: succeeded={succeeded} (want {ok}), missing {missing}; got:\n{text}")
    return text


def check_size(name: str, text: str, limit: int) -> None:
    if len(text) > limit:
        print(f"FAIL {name}: {len(text)} chars returned (limit {limit})")
        FAILURES.append(f"{name}: {len(text)} chars returned, more than {limit}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    parser.add_argument("--host", help="MCP server base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (required unless --prepare)")
    parser.add_argument("--project", required=True, type=pathlib.Path, help="the Godot project the editor has open")
    parser.add_argument("--prepare", action="store_true", help="only write the fixtures into --project, then exit")
    parser.add_argument("--wait", type=float, default=0, help="seconds to wait for the editor to answer script-execute")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    game = args.project / "SmokeExec" / "SmokeExecScore.cs"
    helper = args.project / ".ai-game-dev" / "snippets" / "smoke" / "SmokeHelper.cs"
    for path, text in ((game, GAME_TYPE), (helper, HELPER)):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if not path.exists():
            path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    if args.prepare:
        return 0
    if not args.host:
        parser.error("--host is required unless --prepare")
    host = args.host.rstrip("/")

    if args.wait > 0 and not wait_ready(host, args.wait):
        print(f"script-execute never answered on {host} within {args.wait:.0f}s", flush=True)
        return 1

    case(host, "expression", {"csharpCode": "1 + 2"}, True, "System.Int32: 3")
    case(host, "game type + auto-import", {"csharpCode": "SmokeExecScore.Value"}, True, "System.Int32: 77")
    version = case(host, "godot api", {"csharpCode": 'Engine.GetVersionInfo()["string"].AsString()'}, True,
                   "System.String: ", "4.")
    # GD.Print / GD.PushWarning reach `logs` only through the engine logger (OS.AddLogger, Godot 4.5+); older engines
    # capture Console output only (GodotPrintLogCapture), so there the snippet must just succeed.
    match = re.search(r"System\.String: (\d+)\.(\d+)", version)
    engine_logger = not match or (int(match[1]), int(match[2])) >= (4, 5)
    case(host, "GD.Print captured" if engine_logger else "GD.Print (not captured before Godot 4.5)",
         {"csharpCode": 'GD.Print("smoke-print"); GD.PushWarning("smoke-warn"); 5'}, True,
         "System.Int32: 5", *(("logs:", "smoke-print") if engine_logger else ()))
    case(host, "Console captured", {"csharpCode": 'Console.WriteLine("smoke-console"); 6'}, True,
         "System.Int32: 6", "logs:", "smoke-console")
    # The addon compiles into the game assembly: a live static set by the plugin, and one copy of it and of GodotSharp
    # (assemblies of contexts still unloading after a hot reload are not counted).
    case(host, "live statics, no duplicate assemblies", {"csharpCode":
         "using System.Runtime.Loader;\n"
         "var names = new[] { typeof(SmokeExecScore).Assembly.GetName().Name, \"GodotSharp\" };\n"
         "var live = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().Where(a => AssemblyLoadContext.All.Contains(AssemblyLoadContext.GetLoadContext(a)));\n"
         "var copies = names.Select(n => live.Count(a => a.GetName().Name == n));\n"
         "$\"{com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.MainThreadDispatch.MainThreadDispatcher.Instance != null}/{string.Join(\",\", copies)}\""},
         True, "True/1,1")
    case(host, "await", {"csharpCode": "await Task.Delay(20);\nEngine.GetProcessFrames() > 0"}, True, "System.Boolean: true")
    case(host, "full-source mode", {"csharpCode": "public class Script { public static int Main() { return 7; } }"}, True, "System.Int32: 7")
    case(host, "compile error line", {"csharpCode": "var a = 1;\nvar b = a +;\nb"}, False, "Compilation failed", "snippet.cs(2,")
    case(host, "runtime error", {"csharpCode": 'throw new InvalidOperationException("smoke-boom");'}, False,
         "Execution failed (Runtime)", "smoke-boom", "snippet.cs:line 1")
    case(host, "include", {"csharpCode": "SmokeHelper.Twice(21)", "include": ["smoke"]}, True, "System.Int32: 42")
    # Code-Exec 0.3: includes stay inside the snippets folder; a bad `using` is reported as itself.
    case(host, "include outside the snippets folder is refused", {"csharpCode": "1", "include": ["../../project.godot"]},
         False, "InvalidRequest", "outside the include root")
    case(host, "bad using is named", {"csharpCode": "1", "usings": ["No.Such.Smoke"]}, False, "using 'No.Such.Smoke'")
    # Output caps: a huge value or flood of prints reaches the agent cut (20000 chars each), with a note.
    text = case(host, "huge value is cut", {"csharpCode": "new string('y', 2_000_000)"}, True, "[truncated:")
    check_size("huge value is cut", text, 25_000)
    text = case(host, "flood of prints is cut", {"csharpCode": "for (int i = 0; i < 20000; i++) Console.WriteLine(\"line \" + i + \" \" + new string('x', 50));\n1"},
                True, "System.Int32: 1", "log line(s) left out")
    check_size("flood of prints is cut", text, 25_000)
    # Values the reflector cannot show field by field: Godot structs as text, lazy sequences enumerated, a freed object.
    case(host, "Basis as text", {"csharpCode": "Basis.Identity"}, True, "(1, 0, 0)")
    case(host, "StringName as text", {"csharpCode": "new StringName(\"smoke-name\")"}, True, "smoke-name")
    case(host, "lazy sequence enumerated", {"csharpCode": "Enumerable.Range(0, 5).Select(i => i * i)"}, True, "16")
    case(host, "freed object", {"csharpCode": "var n = new Node(); n.Free(); n"}, True, "freed")
    # The RQL format's compact text: entries, items and members instead of the reflector's internals and tables.
    case(host, "dictionary entries", {"csharpCode": 'new Dictionary<string, int> { ["a"] = 1, ["b"] = 2 }'}, True,
         "Dictionary<string, int>: {a: 1, b: 2}")
    case(host, "list of Godot structs", {"csharpCode": "new List<Vector3> { new Vector3(1, 2, 3) }"}, True, "List<Vector3>: [(1, 2, 3)]")
    case(host, "anonymous object", {"csharpCode": 'new { name = "x", count = 3 }'}, True, 'anonymous: {name: "x", count: 3}')
    text = case(host, "nodes like rql-query", {"csharpCode":
                "var root = new Node3D { Name = \"SmokeRoot\" }; var kid = new Node3D { Name = \"Kid\" }; root.AddChild(kid); kid.Owner = root;\n"
                "new { root, kid, list = new Godot.Collections.Array<Node> { kid } }"},
                True, "(SmokeRoot)", "(Kid)", "Node3D#")
    if "/root/" in text or "instanceId" in text:
        FAILURES.append(f"nodes like rql-query: an editor path or reflector field leaked: {text}")
    case(host, "Godot dictionary keys bare", {"csharpCode": 'Json.ParseString("{\\"a\\": 1}").AsGodotDictionary()'}, True, "{a: 1}")
    case(host, "lazy sequence names its element type", {"csharpCode": "Enumerable.Range(0, 2).Select(i => new Vector3(i, 0, 0))"},
         True, "IEnumerable<Vector3>: [(0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0)]")
    # A Godot collection that holds itself crashed the editor (stack overflow in the Variant converter).
    case(host, "self-containing Godot array", {"csharpCode": "var a = new Godot.Collections.Array(); a.Add(a); a"}, True, "Array")
    for i in range(20):
        execute(host, {"csharpCode": f"var v{i} = {i};\nv{i} + 1"})
    case(host, "unload (0 live snippet contexts besides this one)", {"csharpCode":
         "GC.Collect(); GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers(); GC.Collect();\n"
         "System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext.All.Count(c => c.Name != null && c.Name.StartsWith(\"CodeExec:\")) - 1"},
         True, "System.Int32: 0")

    if FAILURES:
        print(f"\n{len(FAILURES)} failed:\n" + "\n\n".join(FAILURES))
        return 1
    print("\nall script-execute cases passed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`scripts/test_extensions.py`:

```py
"""Isolated NuGet consumers followed by one live Godot editor for all modules."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from extensions import ROOT, chain_active, core_pins, modules, read_json, run, verify_package


def compatible(module, sdk):
    return tuple(map(int, sdk.split('.'))) >= tuple(map(int, module['minGodotVersion'].split('.')))


def unit_tests(output):
    run(['dotnet', 'build', 'Godot-MCP.sln', '-c', 'Debug'], log=output / 'core-build.log')
    # Preserve the legacy authoring gate too: Release packing excludes #if TOOLS,
    # while xUnit links only pure-managed files. Build every complete module in
    # Debug against its declared dependency floors before testing consumers.
    for module in modules():
        run(['dotnet', 'build', module['project'], '-c', 'Debug'],
            log=output / (module['name'] + '-authoring-build.log'))
    projects = ['Godot-MCP.Tests/Godot-MCP.Tests.csproj'] + [m['tests'] for m in modules()]
    for index, project in enumerate(projects):
        text = run(['dotnet', 'test', project, '-c', 'Debug', '--logger', 'trx',
                    '--results-directory', str(output / f'unit-{index}')], log=output / f'unit-{index}.log')
        summary = [line for line in text.splitlines() if 'Passed!' in line or 'Total tests:' in line]
        print(project, '\n'.join(summary), flush=True)


def consumer(folder, sdk, selected, version, feed, cache):
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'addons/godot_mcp', folder / 'addons/godot_mcp',
                    ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('bin', 'obj', '.godot', '*.uid'))
    assembly = 'GodotExtensionTests'
    project = ET.Element('Project', Sdk='Godot.NET.Sdk/' + sdk)
    properties = ET.SubElement(project, 'PropertyGroup')
    for key, value in {'TargetFramework': 'net8.0', 'EnableDynamicLoading': 'true',
                       'Nullable': 'enable', 'AssemblyName': assembly}.items():
        ET.SubElement(properties, key).text = value
    group = ET.SubElement(project, 'ItemGroup')
    for package, pin in core_pins().items():
        ET.SubElement(group, 'PackageReference', Include=package, Version='[' + pin + ']')
    for module in selected:
        ET.SubElement(group, 'PackageReference', Include=module['packageId'], Version='[' + version + ']')
    ET.SubElement(group, 'EmbeddedResource', Include='addons/godot_mcp/extensions.catalog.json',
                  LogicalName='Godot-MCP.extensions.catalog.json')
    csproj = folder / 'GodotExtensionTests.csproj'
    ET.ElementTree(project).write(csproj, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
    config = ET.Element('configuration')
    sources = ET.SubElement(config, 'packageSources')
    ET.SubElement(sources, 'clear')
    ET.SubElement(sources, 'add', key='candidate', value=str(feed))
    ET.SubElement(sources, 'add', key='nuget.org', value='https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json')
    # Train supplies private candidate packages through its generated root
    # config. Keep that feed visible after adding the extension's local feed.
    chain_config = ROOT / 'nuget.config'
    if chain_active() and chain_config.is_file():
        for entry in ET.parse(chain_config).findall('.//packageSources/add'):
            if entry.attrib.get('value') not in {node.attrib.get('value') for node in sources}:
                ET.SubElement(sources, 'add', **entry.attrib)
    ET.ElementTree(config).write(folder / 'nuget.config', encoding='utf-8')
    (folder / 'project.godot').write_text(
        'config_version=5\n\n[application]\nconfig/name="GodotExtensionTests"\n'
        f'config/features=PackedStringArray("{sdk}", "C#")\n\n'
        f'[dotnet]\nproject/assembly_name="{assembly}"\n\n'
        '[editor_plugins]\nenabled=PackedStringArray("res://addons/godot_mcp/plugin.cfg")\n', encoding='utf-8')
    for module in selected:
        testbed = ROOT / 'extensions' / module['name'] / 'testbed'
        for fixture in testbed.glob('*.tres'):
            target = folder / fixture.name
            if target.exists():
                raise ValueError('Conflicting E2E fixture name: ' + fixture.name)
            shutil.copy2(fixture, target)
        for relative in module.get('testDirectories', []):
            directory = (folder / relative).resolve()
            if not directory.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()):
                raise ValueError('Test directory escapes project: ' + relative)
            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    autoloads = {}
    for module in selected:
        for name, path in module.get('testAutoloads', {}).items():
            if (name in autoloads or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', name)
                    or not re.fullmatch(r'res://addons/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', path)
                    or '..' in Path(path.removeprefix('res://')).parts):
                raise ValueError('Invalid or conflicting test autoload: ' + name)
            autoloads[name] = path
    if autoloads:
        with (folder / 'project.godot').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as config:
            config.write('\n[autoload]\n')
            for name, path in autoloads.items():
                config.write(f'{name}="*{path}"\n')
    return csproj


def compile_consumer(project, selected, version, cache, log):
    env = {**os.environ, 'NUGET_PACKAGES': str(cache)}
    run(['dotnet', 'build', project, '-c', 'Debug'], env=env, log=log)
    # Evaluate the actual NuGet-imported Compile items after restore. A cache may
    # contain every package; only declared packages may inject source into this assembly.
    evaluated = json.loads(run(['dotnet', 'msbuild', project, '-getItem:Compile', '-verbosity:quiet'], env=env))
    paths = {Path(item['FullPath']).resolve() for item in evaluated['Items']['Compile']}
    expected_pins = core_pins()
    assets = read_json(project.parent / '.godot/mono/temp/obj/project.assets.json')['libraries']
    for package, pin in expected_pins.items():
        if package + '/' + pin not in assets:
            raise ValueError('Consumer resolved the wrong core library: ' + package + '/' + pin)
    selected_ids = {module['packageId'].lower() for module in selected}
    for module in modules():
        package_root = cache / module['packageId'].lower() / version
        actual = {path for path in paths if path.is_relative_to(package_root)}
        if module['packageId'].lower() in selected_ids:
            expected = {path.resolve() for path in (package_root / 'src').rglob('*.cs')}
            if not expected or actual != expected:
                raise ValueError('Consumer did not compile exact package sources: ' + module['name'])
        elif actual:
            raise ValueError('Undeclared extension sources leaked into consumer: ' + module['name'])


def isolation_canary(isolated, combined, cache, output):
    text = ('public static class IsolationCanary { public static System.Type Sibling => '
            'typeof(com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Beehave.BeehaveModule); }\n')
    paths = [project.parent / 'IsolationCanary.cs' for project in (isolated, combined)]
    for path in paths:
        if path.exists():
            raise ValueError('Canary must not overwrite existing work: ' + str(path))
    env = {**os.environ, 'NUGET_PACKAGES': str(cache)}
    try:
        for path in paths:
            path.write_text(text)
        run(['dotnet', 'build', combined, '-c', 'Debug', '--no-restore'], env=env,
            log=output / 'canary-combined.log')
        result = subprocess.run(['dotnet', 'build', str(isolated), '-c', 'Debug', '--no-restore'],
                                env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        (output / 'canary-isolated.log').write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr, encoding='utf-8')
        if result.returncode == 0 or 'CS0234' not in result.stdout or 'Beehave' not in result.stdout:
            raise ValueError('Isolation canary did not fail on the undeclared sibling type')
        print('Isolation canary: combined succeeds; Animation-only consumer rejects Beehave (CS0234)', flush=True)
    finally:
        for path in paths:
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    # Restore the combined binary after removing the canary.
    run(['dotnet', 'build', combined, '-c', 'Debug', '--no-restore'], env=env,
        log=output / 'canary-clean-build.log')


def prepare(sdk, output, *, prove_isolation=False):
    selected = [module for module in modules() if compatible(module, sdk)]
    feed, cache = output / 'feed', output / 'packages'
    feed.mkdir(parents=True)
    version = '0.0.0-ci.' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    for module in selected:
        run(['dotnet', 'pack', module['project'], '-c', 'Release', '-p:Version=' + version,
             '-o', feed], log=output / (module['name'] + '-pack.log'))
        archive = feed / f"{module['packageId']}.{version}.nupkg"
        verify_package(archive, module, version=version)
    projects = {}
    for name, subset in [('core', [])] + [(m['name'], [m]) for m in selected] + [('combined', selected)]:
        project = consumer(output / name, sdk, subset, version, feed, cache)
        compile_consumer(project, subset, version, cache, output / (name + '-build.log'))
        projects[name] = project
        print(f'Compiled {name}: {len(subset)} extension(s), exact packed-source inclusion verified', flush=True)
    if prove_isolation:
        isolation_canary(projects['Godot-AI-Animation'], projects['combined'], cache, output)
    # AssetLib installs sources directly into addons/, with no extension NuGet
    # references. Compile that distribution separately while keeping the live
    # editor on the existing combined NuGet consumer. No extra editor launch.
    from assetlib_extensions import pack_archive, extract_archive
    asset_project = consumer(output / 'assetlib', sdk, [], version, feed, cache)
    for module in selected:
        package = feed / f"{module['packageId']}.{version}.nupkg"
        archive = pack_archive(module, package, output / 'assetlib-archives', package_version=version)
        extract_archive(archive, asset_project.parent)
    compile_consumer(asset_project, [], version, cache, output / 'assetlib-build.log')
    env = {**os.environ, 'NUGET_PACKAGES': str(cache)}
    evaluated = json.loads(run(['dotnet', 'msbuild', asset_project, '-getItem:Compile', '-verbosity:quiet'], env=env))
    compiled = {Path(item['FullPath']).resolve() for item in evaluated['Items']['Compile']}
    source_folder = asset_project.parent / 'addons/godot_mcp_extensions'
    expected = {path.resolve() for path in source_folder.rglob('*.cs')}
    actual = {path for path in compiled if path.is_relative_to(source_folder.resolve())}
    if not expected or expected != actual:
        raise ValueError('Asset Library consumer did not compile the exact installed archive sources')
    plan = {'sdk': sdk, 'ciVersion': version, 'modules': [m['name'] for m in selected],
            'project': str(projects['combined']), 'nugetCache': str(cache)}
    (output / 'suite.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
    return plan


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--sdk', default='4.5.1')
    parser.add_argument('--godot', help='Godot mono executable matching --sdk')
    parser.add_argument('--server', help='Released gamedev-mcp-server executable')
    parser.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true', help='Compile/package verification only; no live editor')
    parser.add_argument('--unit-only', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--skip-unit', action='store_true', help='CI: unit tests already ran in the required parent job')
    parser.add_argument('--prove-isolation', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.unit_only and not args.prepare_only and not args.godot:
        parser.error('Full suite requires --godot; --prepare-only explicitly omits live tests')
    output = ROOT / '.artifacts/extensions' / args.sdk / uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    print('Suite output:', output, flush=True)
    if not args.skip_unit:
        unit_tests(output)
    if not args.unit_only:
        plan = prepare(args.sdk, output, prove_isolation=args.prove_isolation)
        if not args.prepare_only:
            from extension_live import live, released_server
            server = args.server or os.environ.get('GODOT_MCP_SERVER_PATH') or released_server(output / 'server')
            live(plan, args.godot, server, output)
    print('PASS:', 'unit tests' if args.unit_only else
          'compile/package verification (live tests explicitly omitted)' if args.prepare_only else
          'unit, isolated consumers and combined live-editor suite', flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except (ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        print('FAIL:', error, file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
```

```py
class ArchiveDistribution(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.package_fixture = fixtures.PackageVerification()
        self.package_fixture.setUp()
        self.addCleanup(self.package_fixture.doCleanups)
        self.root = self.package_fixture.root
        self.module = self.package_fixture.module

    def fixture(self):
        self.package_fixture.verify()
        (self.root / 'LICENSE').write_text('Apache-2.0 fixture\n')
        module = {**self.module, 'name': 'Godot-AI-Example', 'minGodotVersion': '4.3.0'}
        package = self.root / 'example.nupkg'
        archive = assetlib.pack_archive(module, package, self.root / 'output', root=self.root)
        return module, package, archive

    def test_archive_contains_only_selected_sources_and_installs_under_addons(self):
        module, package, archive = self.fixture()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
            self.assertEqual(5, len(bundle.namelist()))
            self.assertTrue(all('/addons/godot_mcp_extensions/Example/' in name for name in bundle.namelist()))
        target = self.root / 'consumer'
        assetlib.extract_archive(archive, target)
        self.assertEqual(b'class Example {}', (target / 'addons/godot_mcp_extensions/Example/Editor/Test.cs').read_bytes())
        self.assertFalse(list(target.rglob('*.props')))
        self.assertFalse(list(target.rglob('*.csproj')))
        assetlib.verify_archive(module, package, archive, root=self.root)

    def test_archive_is_deterministic_and_foreign_sources_are_rejected(self):
        module, package, archive = self.fixture()
        before = archive.read_bytes()
        assetlib.pack_archive(module, package, archive.parent, root=self.root)
        self.assertEqual(before, archive.read_bytes())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'a') as bundle:
            bundle.writestr('other/addons/Sibling/Tool.cs', 'class Sibling {}')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'unexpected files'):
            assetlib.verify_archive(module, package, archive, root=self.root)

    def test_archive_modified_source_is_rejected(self):
        module, package, archive = self.fixture()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
            files = {name: bundle.read(name) for name in bundle.namelist()}
        name = next(name for name in files if name.endswith('.cs'))
        files[name] += b'// changed'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w') as bundle:
            for name, data in files.items():
                bundle.writestr(name, data)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'bytes differ'):
            assetlib.verify_archive(module, package, archive, root=self.root)

    def test_extraction_rejects_traversal(self):
        archive = self.root / 'traversal.zip'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w') as bundle:
            bundle.writestr('release/../../outside/file.cs', b'bad')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Invalid'):
            assetlib.extract_archive(archive, self.root / 'project')


class FakeApi:
    def __init__(self, owned=(), pending=(), details=None):
        self.owned, self.pending, self.details = list(owned), list(pending), details or {}
        self.posts = []

    def listing(self, path, **query):
        return self.owned if path == '/asset' else self.pending

    def request(self, path, body=None):
        if body is None:
            return self.details[path]
        self.posts.append((path, body))
        return {'id': 42}


class Reconciliation(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.module = {'name': 'Godot-AI-Example', 'packageId': 'com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.Example',
                       'version': '1.2.3', 'minGodotVersion': '4.4.0'}
        self.title = assetlib.payload(self.module)['title']

    def test_initial_submission_is_reported_as_pending_not_public(self):
        api = FakeApi()
        result = assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token')
        self.assertEqual({'status': 'submitted', 'editId': 42}, result)
        self.assertEqual('/asset', api.posts[0][0])
        self.assertEqual('Custom', api.posts[0][1]['download_provider'])
        self.assertEqual(assetlib.archive_url(self.module), api.posts[0][1]['download_commit'])
        self.assertEqual('4.4', api.posts[0][1]['godot_version'])

    def test_retry_reuses_matching_pending_edit_without_post(self):
        api = FakeApi(pending=[{'title': self.title, 'author': 'owner', 'edit_id': 7}],
                      details={'/asset/edit/7': {'version_string': '1.2.3',
                               'download_commit': assetlib.archive_url(self.module), 'status': 'in_review'}})
        self.assertEqual({'status': 'submitted', 'editId': 7}, assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token'))
        self.assertEqual([], api.posts)

    def test_approved_asset_is_reused_and_wrong_archive_fails(self):
        asset = {'title': self.title, 'author': 'owner', 'asset_id': 9, 'version_string': '1.2.3'}
        api = FakeApi(owned=[asset], details={'/asset/9': {'download_commit': assetlib.archive_url(self.module)}})
        self.assertEqual({'status': 'published', 'assetId': 9}, assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token'))
        self.assertEqual([], api.posts)
        api.details['/asset/9']['download_commit'] = 'https://example.invalid/wrong.zip'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'different archive'):
            assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token')

    def test_in_review_old_submission_is_not_duplicated(self):
        api = FakeApi(pending=[{'title': self.title, 'author': 'owner', 'edit_id': 7}],
                      details={'/asset/edit/7': {'version_string': '1.0.0', 'status': 'in_review'}})
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'in review'):
            assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token')
        self.assertEqual([], api.posts)

    def test_editable_pending_submission_updates_same_id(self):
        api = FakeApi(pending=[{'title': self.title, 'author': 'owner', 'edit_id': 7}],
                      details={'/asset/edit/7': {'version_string': '1.0.0', 'status': 'new'}})
        assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token')
        self.assertEqual('/asset/edit/7', api.posts[0][0])

    def test_ambiguous_entries_fail_without_mutating(self):
        item = {'title': self.title, 'author': 'owner', 'edit_id': 7}
        api = FakeApi(pending=[item, {**item, 'edit_id': 8}])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Ambiguous'):
            assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token')
        self.assertEqual([], api.posts)

    def test_newer_public_version_is_never_downgraded(self):
        api = FakeApi(owned=[{'title': self.title, 'author': 'owner', 'asset_id': 9, 'version_string': '2.0.0'}])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Newer'):
            assetlib.submit(self.module, api, 'owner', 'fixture-token')
        self.assertEqual([], api.posts)

    def test_http_failure_does_not_expose_response_body_or_credentials(self):
        error = urllib.error.HTTPError(assetlib.API + '/login', 403, 'Forbidden', {}, io.BytesIO(b'fixture-secret'))
        with patch.object(assetlib.urllib.request, 'urlopen', side_effect=error):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'HTTP 403') as caught:
                assetlib.Api().request('/login', {'password': 'fixture-password'})
        self.assertNotIn('fixture-secret', str(caught.exception))
        self.assertNotIn('fixture-password', str(caught.exception))
```

```py
"""Cases for scripts/check-runtime-boundary.py: which `#if` guards keep editor APIs and editor-only packages out of games."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest

_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "check-runtime-boundary.py"
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("check_runtime_boundary", _SCRIPT)
boundary = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(boundary)


def scan(source: str):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "Sample.cs"
        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
        return boundary.scan_file(path)


class Gates(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tools_gate(self):
        self.assertTrue(boundary.is_tools_gate("TOOLS"))
        self.assertTrue(boundary.is_tools_gate("TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS"))
        self.assertFalse(boundary.is_tools_gate("TOOLS || DEBUG"))
        self.assertFalse(boundary.is_tools_gate("!TOOLS"))
        # An opted-in game defines the code-exec symbol, so its guard is no TOOLS gate.
        self.assertFalse(boundary.is_tools_gate("TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME"))

    def test_code_exec_gate(self):
        self.assertTrue(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("TOOLS"))
        self.assertTrue(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME"))
        self.assertTrue(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME || GODOT_MCP_UNIT_TESTS"))
        self.assertTrue(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME"))
        self.assertFalse(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME || DEBUG"))
        self.assertFalse(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("!GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME"))
        self.assertFalse(boundary.is_code_exec_gate("DEBUG"))


class PackageGuards(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_code_exec_under_the_opt_in_guard_is_allowed(self):
        _, packages, _ = scan("#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME\nusing com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec;\n"
                              "using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\n#endif\n")
        self.assertEqual([], packages)

    def test_code_exec_outside_any_guard_fails(self):
        _, packages, _ = scan("using com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec;\n")
        self.assertEqual([(1, "com.IvanMurzak.CodeExec")], [(p[0], p[1]) for p in packages])

    def test_code_exec_in_the_else_of_the_opt_in_guard_fails(self):
        _, packages, _ = scan("#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME\n#else\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\n#endif\n")
        self.assertEqual([3], [p[0] for p in packages])

    def test_rql_stays_tools_only(self):
        _, packages, _ = scan("#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME\nusing Rql;\n#endif\n")
        self.assertEqual([(2, "Rql", "#if TOOLS")], [p[:3] for p in packages])
        _, packages, _ = scan("#if TOOLS\nusing Rql;\n#endif\n")
        self.assertEqual([], packages)

    def test_editor_api_under_the_opt_in_guard_fails(self):
        violations, _, _ = scan("#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME\nvar e = EditorInterface.Singleton;\n#endif\n")
        self.assertEqual([(2, "EditorInterface")], [v[:2] for v in violations])

    def test_nested_tools_inside_opt_in_guard(self):
        violations, packages, _ = scan("#if TOOLS || GODOT_MCP_CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME\n#if TOOLS\nusing Rql;\n"
                                       "var e = EditorInterface.Singleton;\n#endif\n#endif\n")
        self.assertEqual(([], []), (violations, packages))


class CharLiterals(unittest.TestCase):

        self.assertEqual([2], [p[0] for p in packages])
```
