```py
"""Regression guards for source-only releases and isolated test execution."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import zipfile

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
import extension_live
import extension_release
import extensions
import new_extension


class PublicationWait(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_whole_batch_is_submitted_before_slow_indexing_and_existing_version_is_not_pushed(self):
        selected = [{'name': name, 'packageId': name, 'version': '1.2.3'}
                    for name in ('first', 'second', 'existing')]
        clock, submitted = [0], []
        def sleep(seconds):
            self.assertEqual(['first.1.2.3.nupkg', 'second.1.2.3.nupkg'], submitted)
            clock[0] += seconds
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            (root / 'pending.json').write_text(json.dumps([m['packageId'] for m in selected]))
            with patch.object(extension_release, 'published', side_effect=lambda m: m['name'] == 'existing' or clock[0] >= 600), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_package'), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_registry') as verify, \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'run', side_effect=lambda args: submitted.append(args[3].name)), \
                    patch.object(extension_release.time, 'monotonic', side_effect=lambda: clock[0]), \
                    patch.object(extension_release.time, 'sleep', side_effect=sleep), \
                    patch.dict(os.environ, {'NUGET_API_KEY': 'fixture-token'}):
                extension_release.push(selected, root)
            self.assertEqual(600, clock[0])
            self.assertCountEqual([m['packageId'] for m in selected],
                                  [call.args[0]['packageId'] for call in verify.call_args_list])

    def test_wait_is_bounded_and_reports_only_unpublished_packages(self):
        selected = [{'name': name, 'packageId': name, 'version': '1.2.3'} for name in ('ready', 'missing')]
        clock = [0]
        def sleep(seconds):
            clock[0] += seconds
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            (root / 'pending.json').write_text(json.dumps([m['packageId'] for m in selected]))
            with patch.object(extension_release, 'published', side_effect=lambda m: m['name'] == 'ready'), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_package'), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_registry') as verify, \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'run'), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'PUBLICATION_WAIT_SECONDS', 120), \
                    patch.object(extension_release.time, 'monotonic', side_effect=lambda: clock[0]), \
                    patch.object(extension_release.time, 'sleep', side_effect=sleep), \
                    patch.dict(os.environ, {'NUGET_API_KEY': 'fixture-token'}):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'missing@1.2.3') as error:
                    extension_release.push(selected, root)
            self.assertNotIn('ready@', str(error.exception))
            self.assertEqual(120, clock[0])
            self.assertEqual(['ready'], [call.args[0]['name'] for call in verify.call_args_list])

    def test_invalid_public_payload_fails_without_waiting_or_pushing(self):
        module = {'name': 'existing', 'packageId': 'existing', 'version': '1.2.3'}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            (root / 'pending.json').write_text('["existing"]')
            with patch.object(extension_release, 'published', return_value=True), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_registry', side_effect=ValueError('modified source')), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'run') as submit, \
                    patch.object(extension_release.time, 'sleep') as sleep:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'modified source'):
                    extension_release.push([module], root)
            submit.assert_not_called()
            sleep.assert_not_called()


class DraftPublication(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_draft_lookup_uses_numeric_release_id(self):
        response = SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stdout=json.dumps({
            'apiUrl': 'https://api.github.com/repos/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/releases/42'}), stderr='')
        with patch.object(extension_release.subprocess, 'run', return_value=response), \
                patch.object(extension_release, 'run', return_value='{"id":42,"draft":true}') as api:
            self.assertEqual({'id': 42, 'draft': True}, extension_release.find_release('animation-v0.1.2'))
        api.assert_called_once_with(['gh', 'api', 'repos/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/releases/42'])

    def test_lookup_distinguishes_missing_release_from_transport_failure(self):
        response = SimpleNamespace(returncode=1, stdout='', stderr='release not found\n')
        with patch.object(extension_release.subprocess, 'run', return_value=response):
            self.assertIsNone(extension_release.find_release('missing-v0.1.2'))
            response.stderr = 'network unavailable'
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'Cannot inspect'):
                extension_release.find_release('missing-v0.1.2')

    def test_draft_assets_are_proven_before_publish_and_corruption_blocks_publication(self):
        module = {'name': 'Godot-AI-Example', 'packageId': 'example', 'version': '1.2.3'}
        for corrupt in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(corrupt=corrupt), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
                output = Path(temporary)
                package = output / 'example.1.2.3.nupkg'
                package.write_bytes(b'candidate package')
                calls, downloads = [], []
                draft = {'id': 42, 'draft': True, 'assets': [
                    {'name': package.name, 'id': 11}, {'name': 'SHA256SUMS', 'id': 12}]}
                def command(args):
                    calls.append(args)
                    if args[:2] == ['git', 'rev-parse']:
                        return 'a' * 40
                    if args[:3] == ['gh', 'release', 'edit']:
                        self.assertEqual([11, 12], downloads)
                    return ''
                def download(args, **kwargs):
                    asset = int(args[2].rsplit('/', 1)[-1])
                    downloads.append(asset)
                    content = package.read_bytes() if asset == 11 else (output / module['name'] / 'SHA256SUMS').read_bytes()
                    return SimpleNamespace(stdout=b'corrupt' if corrupt else content)
                with patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_registry'), \
                        patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_package'), \
                        patch.object(extension_release, 'find_release', side_effect=[None, draft]), \
                        patch.object(extension_release, 'run', side_effect=command), \
                        patch.object(extension_release.subprocess, 'run', side_effect=download):
                    if corrupt:
                        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Uploaded component asset differs'):
                            extension_release.publish_github(module, output)
                    else:
                        extension_release.publish_github(module, output)
                edits = [args for args in calls if args[:3] == ['gh', 'release', 'edit']]
                self.assertEqual(0 if corrupt else 1, len(edits))


class PackageVerification(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.source = self.root / 'module'
        self.source.mkdir()
        self.module = {'project': 'module/package.csproj', 'packageId': 'example', 'version': '1.2.3'}
        (self.source / 'package.csproj').write_text('''<Project><ItemGroup>
<PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" Version="8.8.1"/>
<PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.4.3"/>
<PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" Version="0.1.1"/>
</ItemGroup></Project>''')
        self.files = {'src/Editor/Test.cs': b'class Example {}', 'build/example.props': b'<Project/>',
                      'README.md': b'Package readme'}
        for name, value in self.files.items():
            path = self.source / name.removeprefix('src/')
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(value)
        self.files['example.nuspec'] = b'''<package><metadata><id>example</id><version>1.2.3</version>
<dependencies><dependency id="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" version="8.8.1"/>
<dependency id="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" version="5.4.3"/>
<dependency id="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" version="0.1.1"/></dependencies></metadata></package>'''

    def verify(self):
        archive = self.root / 'example.nupkg'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w') as bundle:
            for name, value in self.files.items():
                bundle.writestr(name, value)
        return extensions.verify_package(archive, self.module, self.root)

    def test_repository_signature_is_allowed(self):
        self.files['.signature.p7s'] = b'registry signature'
        self.assertTrue(self.verify())

    def test_modified_source_is_rejected(self):
        self.files['src/Editor/Test.cs'] += b'// modified'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'bytes differ'):
            self.verify()

    def test_sibling_source_is_rejected(self):
        self.files['src/Editor/Sibling.cs'] = b'class Sibling {}'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'unexpected sources'):
            self.verify()

    def test_compiled_godot_dll_is_rejected(self):
        self.files['lib/net8.0/GodotSharp.dll'] = b'dll'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'DLL'):
            self.verify()

    def test_wrong_package_identity_is_rejected(self):
        self.files['example.nuspec'] = self.files['example.nuspec'].replace(b'<id>example', b'<id>sibling')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'identity/version'):
            self.verify()

    def test_changed_dependency_floor_is_rejected(self):
        self.files['example.nuspec'] = self.files['example.nuspec'].replace(b'8.8.1', b'9.0.0')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'dependency floor'):
            self.verify()

    def test_missing_rql_dependency_is_rejected(self):
        self.files['example.nuspec'] = self.files['example.nuspec'].replace(
            b'\n<dependency id="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" version="0.1.1"/>', b'')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected package dependencies'):
            self.verify()

    def test_train_package_requires_exact_candidate_dependency(self):
        (self.root / 'Directory.Build.targets').write_text('''<Project><ItemGroup>
<PackageReference Update="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" Version="[8.7.1-ws.ga1b2c3d4]"/>
</ItemGroup></Project>''')
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {'CHAIN_ACTIVE': '1'}):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'dependency floor'):
                self.verify()
            self.files['example.nuspec'] = self.files['example.nuspec'].replace(b'8.8.1', b'[8.7.1-ws.ga1b2c3d4]')
            self.assertTrue(self.verify())
        # No applied override (CHAIN_LOCK alone is the raw dispatch input): the source floors rule.
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {'CHAIN_LOCK': 'candidate lock', 'CHAIN_ACTIVE': ''}):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'dependency floor'):
                self.verify()
            self.files['example.nuspec'] = self.files['example.nuspec'].replace(b'[8.7.1-ws.ga1b2c3d4]', b'8.8.1')
            self.assertTrue(self.verify())


class SuiteGuards(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_script_failure_is_fatal(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Script/assembly'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log('ERROR: Parameter "instance" is null.\nSCRIPT ERROR: Missing autoload')

    def test_unrelated_native_error_is_fatal(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected engine error'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log('ERROR: Parameter "instance" is null.\nAnotherTool')

    def test_former_gridmap_gizmo_error_is_fatal(self):
        # The old gridmap-create tool's EditNode produced it; the RQL module never selects nodes.
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected engine error'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log('ERROR: Parameter "instance" is null.\ninstance_geometry_set_transparency')

    def test_expected_tool_error_is_allowed_only_in_its_own_call_window(self):
        rejected = ('ERROR: [McpPlugin] McpToolManager: Error Response to AI:\n'
                    'error coercion-failed: Amount must be at least 1 (got 0)\n')
        log = 'boot\n' + rejected + 'later call\n'
        self.assertFalse(any(extension_live.check_editor_log(log, failure_windows=[(1, 3)]).values()))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected tool error'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log(log, failure_windows=[(3, 4)])  # outside its window
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected tool error'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log('boot\n' + rejected * 2, failure_windows=[(1, 5)])  # two in one window
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'left no error response'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log('boot\n', failure_windows=[(0, 1)])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected tool error'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log(log)

    def test_godot44_native_cold_import_is_reported_only_during_startup(self):
        error = ('ERROR: Do not use progress dialog (task) while flushing the message queue or using call_deferred()!\n'
                 '   at: add_task (editor/progress_dialog.cpp:183)\n')
        boot = '[Godot-MCP] plugin loaded\n'
        self.assertEqual(1, extension_live.check_editor_log(error + boot, '4.4.0', startup_lines=3)['godot44ColdImportProgress'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log(error + boot, '4.5.1', startup_lines=3)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unexpected'):
            extension_live.check_editor_log(boot + 'running tools\n' * 20 + error, '4.4.0', startup_lines=1)

    def test_archive_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(root / 'bad.zip', 'w') as bundle:
                bundle.writestr('../escaped.txt', b'bad')
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'escapes'):
                extension_live.extract(root / 'bad.zip', root / 'target')
            self.assertFalse((root / 'escaped.txt').exists())

    def test_release_reuses_published_package_without_building(self):
        module = {'name': 'Example', 'packageId': 'example', 'version': '1.2.3'}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            existing = root / 'registry.nupkg'
            existing.write_bytes(b'existing immutable bytes')
            with patch.object(extension_release, 'published', return_value=True), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'verify_registry', return_value=existing), \
                    patch.object(extension_release, 'pack') as build, \
                    patch.dict(os.environ, {'GITHUB_OUTPUT': str(root / 'outputs')}):
                extension_release.stage([module], root)
            build.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual([], json.loads((root / 'pending.json').read_text()))
            self.assertEqual(b'existing immutable bytes', (root / 'example.1.2.3.nupkg').read_bytes())

    def test_scaffold_registers_module_without_legacy_workflows(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            for folder in ('extensions', 'templates/extension', 'addons/godot_mcp', 'cli/src/utils'):
                shutil.copytree(extensions.ROOT / folder, root / folder,
                                ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('bin', 'obj', '.godot', '__pycache__'))
            folder = new_extension.create('ExampleFeature', root)
            self.assertFalse((folder / '.github').exists())
            self.assertEqual('Godot-AI-ExampleFeature', extensions.modules(root)[-1]['name'])
            self.assertNotIn('YOUR_FEATURE', (folder / 'extension.json').read_text())
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'already exists'):
                new_extension.create('ExampleFeature', root)
            shutil.copytree(extensions.ROOT / 'scripts', root / 'scripts',
                            ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('tests', '__pycache__'))
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(folder / 'commands/bump-version.py'), '0.1.1'],
                           check=True, capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual('0.1.1', extensions.modules(root)[-1]['version'])

                extensions.core_pin_drift(root)

"""Cases for scripts/release_dependency_guard.py: which pins a release may ship (hermetic: a fake nuget.org)."""
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import textwrap
import unittest

_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "release_dependency_guard.py"
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("release_dependency_guard", _SCRIPT)
guard = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
sys.modules[_spec.name] = guard  # dataclasses resolve annotations through sys.modules
_spec.loader.exec_module(guard)

PUBLISHED = {
    "com.ivanmurzak.reflectornet": ["5.4.0", "5.5.0"],
    "com.ivanmurzak.mcpplugin": ["8.13.1"],
    "com.ivanmurzak.rql": ["0.1.0", "0.2.0"],
    "com.ivanmurzak.codeexec": ["0.3.1"],
    "godotsharp": ["4.3.0"],
}


def fake_registry(published=PUBLISHED, fail=False):
    def fetch(url):
        if fail:
            raise guard.RegistryError("offline")
        package = url.split("/")[-2]
        versions = published.get(package)
        return None if versions is None else json.dumps({"versions": versions}).encode()
    return guard.NuGetRegistry(fetch)


def csproj(*references):
    lines = "\n".join(f'    <PackageReference Include="{i}" Version="{v}" />' for i, v in references)
    return f'<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">\n  <ItemGroup>\n{lines}\n  </ItemGroup>\n</Project>\n'


ADDON_DEPS = """export const ADDON_PACKAGE_REFERENCES = [
  { id: 'com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet', version: '5.5.0' },
  { id: 'com.IvanMurzak.Rql', version: '%s', editorOnly: true },
];
"""


class Fixture:
    """A minimal Godot-MCP tree: the core csproj, one extension, the CLI pins."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path, rql="0.2.0", feed=False):
        self.root = root
        self.write("Godot-MCP.csproj", csproj(("com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet", "5.5.0"), ("com.IvanMurzak.Rql", rql)))
        self.write("extensions/Godot-AI-CSG/src/Godot-AI-CSG/Godot-AI-CSG.csproj",
                   csproj(("com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin", "8.13.1"), ("com.IvanMurzak.Rql", rql), ("GodotSharp", "4.3.0")))
        # Test projects and testbeds ship nothing: their CI-only pins must not trip the guard.
        self.write("extensions/Godot-AI-CSG/testbed/CSG-Testbed.csproj",
                   csproj(("com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.CSG", "0.0.0-ci")))
        self.write("extensions/Godot-AI-CSG/testbed/nuget.config",
                   '<configuration><packageSources><add key="local" value="../local-nuget" /></packageSources></configuration>')
        self.write("cli/src/utils/addon-deps.ts", ADDON_DEPS % rql)
        self.write("cli/package.json", json.dumps({"dependencies": {"@baizor/gamedev-cli-core": "^0.7.2"},
                                                   "devDependencies": {"vitest": "4.0.0-beta.1"}}, indent=2))
        if feed:
            self.write("Directory.Build.props", textwrap.dedent("""\
                <Project>
                  <PropertyGroup>
                    <RestoreAdditionalProjectSources>$(RestoreAdditionalProjectSources);$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)prerelease-packages</RestoreAdditionalProjectSources>
                  </PropertyGroup>
                </Project>
                """))

    def write(self, relative, text):
        path = self.root / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        return path


class GuardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)

    def problems(self, registry=None):
        _, problems = guard.run(self.root, registry or fake_registry())
        return [(guard.rel(p.file, self.root), p.message) for p in problems]

    def test_published_pins_pass(self):
        Fixture(self.root)
        pins, problems = guard.run(self.root, fake_registry())
        self.assertEqual([], problems)
        self.assertIn(("nuget", "GodotSharp", "4.3.0"), {(p.ecosystem, p.package, p.version) for p in pins})

    def test_prerelease_pins_and_feed_fail_everywhere_they_ship(self):
        Fixture(self.root, rql="0.3.0-dev.602ce7c", feed=True)
        problems = self.problems()
        files = {f for f, m in problems if "com.IvanMurzak.Rql 0.3.0-dev.602ce7c is a pre-release" in m}
        self.assertEqual({"Godot-MCP.csproj", "extensions/Godot-AI-CSG/src/Godot-AI-CSG/Godot-AI-CSG.csproj",
                          "cli/src/utils/addon-deps.ts"}, files)
        self.assertTrue(any(f == "Directory.Build.props" and "prerelease-packages" in m for f, m in problems))
        self.assertFalse(any("testbed" in f for f, _ in problems))

    def test_unpublished_stable_version_and_unknown_package_fail(self):
        Fixture(self.root, rql="0.9.0")
        problems = self.problems()
        self.assertIn(("Godot-MCP.csproj", "com.IvanMurzak.Rql 0.9.0 is not published on nuget.org"), problems)
        unknown = self.problems(fake_registry({**PUBLISHED, "com.ivanmurzak.rql": None}))
        self.assertIn(("Godot-MCP.csproj", "com.IvanMurzak.Rql is not a package on nuget.org"), unknown)

    def test_registry_outage_fails_closed(self):

        problems = self.problems(fake_registry(fail=True))

        self.assertTrue(all("cannot verify on nuget.org" in m for _, m in problems))

    def test_msbuild_property_versions_are_resolved(self):
        Fixture(self.root)
        self.root.joinpath("Godot-MCP.csproj").write_text(textwrap.dedent("""\
            <Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">
              <PropertyGroup><RqlVersion>$(RqlBase)-dev.1</RqlVersion><RqlBase>0.3.0</RqlBase></PropertyGroup>
              <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'"><RqlVersion>0.2.0</RqlVersion></PropertyGroup>
              <ItemGroup>
                <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" Version="$(RqlVersion)" />
                <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet"><Version>$(Missing)</Version></PackageReference>
              </ItemGroup>
            </Project>
            """), encoding="utf-8")
        problems = self.problems()
        # A property set under different Conditions: every value it may take is checked.
        self.assertIn(("Godot-MCP.csproj", "com.IvanMurzak.Rql 0.3.0-dev.1 is a pre-release version"), problems)
        self.assertIn(("Godot-MCP.csproj", "com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet: cannot resolve version '$(Missing)'"), problems)
        # write-nuget-deps.mjs copies the csproj text: a `$(Prop)` version would ship literally.
        self.assertIn(("Godot-MCP.csproj", "com.IvanMurzak.Rql: nuget-deps.json would ship the literal version "
                                           "'$(RqlVersion)' (write-nuget-deps.mjs does not evaluate MSBuild)"), problems)

class VersionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prerelease(self):
        self.assertTrue(guard.is_prerelease("0.3.0-dev.602ce7c"))
        self.assertTrue(guard.is_prerelease("1.0.0-rc.1+build"))
        self.assertFalse(guard.is_prerelease("1.0.0+build-7"))
        self.assertFalse(guard.is_prerelease("8.13.1"))

    def test_normalize(self):
        self.assertEqual("1.0.0", guard.normalize_nuget_version("1.0"))
        self.assertEqual("1.0.0", guard.normalize_nuget_version("1.0.0.0"))
        self.assertEqual("1.2.3.4", guard.normalize_nuget_version("01.2.3.4"))
        self.assertEqual("1.0.0-rc.1", guard.normalize_nuget_version("1.0.0-RC.1+meta"))

    def test_ranges(self):
        self.assertEqual((["1.0.0"], None), guard.nuget_versions_in("[1.0.0]"))
        self.assertEqual((["1.0"], None), guard.nuget_versions_in("[1.0,2.0)"))  # exclusive upper bound need not exist
        self.assertEqual((["1.0", "2.0"], None), guard.nuget_versions_in("[1.0,2.0]"))
        self.assertEqual((["1.0"], None), guard.nuget_versions_in("[1.0, )"))
        self.assertEqual(([], "floating version '1.*' is not a pin"), guard.nuget_versions_in("1.*"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

```

`scripts/write-nuget-deps.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generate `addons/godot_mcp/nuget-deps.json` from Godot-MCP.csproj at release time.
//
// The addon ships as source, so a consumer's .csproj must declare the same NuGet
// PackageReferences the addon was built against. `godot-cli install-plugin` reads this
// file from the addon it installs (instead of the pins baked into its own build), so the
// consumer is pinned to what THAT addon release needs. The file is GENERATED (and
// gitignored) — Godot-MCP.csproj stays the single source of truth; never hand-edit it.
//
// Usage: node scripts/write-nuget-deps.mjs [outputPath]
//   outputPath defaults to addons/godot_mcp/nuget-deps.json (relative to the repo root).

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const repoRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const csprojPath = path.join(repoRoot, 'Godot-MCP.csproj');
const outputPath = path.resolve(repoRoot, process.argv[2] ?? 'addons/godot_mcp/nuget-deps.json');

// Same strings as EDITOR_ONLY_CONDITION / CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME_CONDITION in cli/src/utils/addon-deps.ts (the generator
// test reads the manifest back).
const EDITOR_ONLY_CONDITION = "'$(Configuration)' != 'ExportDebug' and '$(Configuration)' != 'ExportRelease'";
const CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME_CONDITION = `'$(GodotMcpCodeExecInGame)' == 'true' or (${EDITOR_ONLY_CONDITION})`;

const csproj = fs.readFileSync(csprojPath, 'utf-8');
const packageReferences = [];
for (const element of csproj.match(/<PackageReference\b[^>]*>/gi) ?? []) {
  const id = /\bInclude\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/i.exec(element)?.[1];
  const version = /\bVersion\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/i.exec(element)?.[1];
  // The editor-only Condition marks a package exports leave out, the in-game one a package exports keep when the game
  // opts in to in-game script-execute (`inGameOptIn`, which an older godot-cli ignores: it writes plain editor-only);
  // godot-cli writes the same condition. Any other Condition is refused: the manifest could not carry it.
  const condition = /\bCondition\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/i.exec(element)?.[1];
  if (condition !== undefined && condition !== EDITOR_ONLY_CONDITION && condition !== CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME_CONDITION) {
    console.error(
      `Unsupported Condition in ${csprojPath} (only "${EDITOR_ONLY_CONDITION}" or "${CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME_CONDITION}"): ${element}`,
    );
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const editorOnly = condition !== undefined;
  const inGameOptIn = condition === CODE_EXEC_IN_GAME_CONDITION;
  if (id !== undefined && version !== undefined) {
    packageReferences.push({ id, version, ...(editorOnly && { editorOnly }), ...(inGameOptIn && { inGameOptIn }) });
  }
}

if (packageReferences.length === 0) {
  console.error(`No <PackageReference Include=".." Version=".."> found in ${csprojPath}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const manifest = { schemaVersion: 1, packageReferences };
fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`);
console.log(`Wrote ${path.relative(repoRoot, outputPath)}:`);
for (const ref of packageReferences) {
  const scope = ref.inGameOptIn ? ' (editor-only; in game with GodotMcpCodeExecInGame)' : ref.editorOnly ? ' (editor-only)' : '';
  console.log(`  ${ref.id} ${ref.version}${scope}`);
}

`templates/extension/AGENTS.md`:

```md
# AGENTS.md — Godot-AI-Tools-Template

**Template** for Godot-MCP extension packages (the Godot analog of `Unity-AI-Tools-Template`). An extension
is an **RQL module**: it teaches the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools about a Godot feature
(adapters, sources, methods, a guide) instead of adding MCP tools. `scripts/new_extension.py` (monorepo) or
`commands/init.ps1` / `init.py` turn the placeholder boilerplate into a real extension, so every change here
propagates to future extensions — keep placeholder tokens consistent.

## Placeholders (replaced by `init`)

| Token | Example value | Used in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `YOUR_FEATURE` | `Particles` | namespaces, `<Feature>Module` / `Guide` / `Api`, folder/file names, the package id suffix |
| `YOUR_SOURCE` | `particles` | the RQL source name of the sample module (`--source-name` / `-SourceName`) |
| `YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME` | `Particles Tools` | package `Title`, the guide topic, docs |
| `YOUR_DESCRIPTION` | `RQL module for Godot Particles.` | package `Description` |
| `YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY` | `IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-Particles` | repo URLs |

The package id is always `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>`, written literally as
`com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE`. `init` also renames `build/<id>.props` and activates CI
(`*.yml-sample` → `*.yml`).

## Layout

- `src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/` — the source-only package (`Godot.NET.Sdk`).
  - `Editor/Rql/YOUR_FEATUREModule.cs` — the `IRqlModule` (behind `#if TOOLS`): adapters, sources, guide.
  - `Editor/Rql/YOUR_FEATUREApi.cs` — the sample `YOUR_SOURCE` source (a view object, `#if TOOLS`).
  - `Editor/Rql/YOUR_FEATUREGuide.cs` — the agent guide; pure strings, NOT behind `#if TOOLS` (unit-tested).
  - `build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE.props` — source-injection props (must stay `<PackageId>.props`).
- `tests/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.Tests/` — xUnit over the module sources (`TOOLS` defined, GodotSharp metadata only); the
  guide checks come from `extensions/Shared/Tests/GuideExampleTests.cs`, linked by the test csproj.
- `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` — the live calls that run every guide example (driver: `scripts/extension_e2e.py`).
- `testbed/` — consumer `Godot.NET.Sdk` project restoring the local-packed package (injection proof).
- `commands/` — `init`, `bump-version`, `update-core` (`.ps1` + `.py`), `get-version.ps1`.
- `.github/workflows/*.yml-sample` — CI, inert until `init`. Never commit live `.github/workflows/*.yml` here.
- `docs/` — `source-only-nuget-recipe.md` (the packaging recipe + consumer story); `ci.md`.

## Build / test (no Godot binary)

```bash
dotnet build src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.csproj   # the module compiles (Debug: #if TOOLS too)
dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.Tests/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.Tests.csproj
dotnet pack  src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.csproj -p:Version=0.0.0-ci -o local-nuget
dotnet build testbed/YOUR_FEATURE-Testbed.csproj                      # consumes the local package (injection proof)
```

## Conventions

- Root namespace `com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>`. One adapter per file, named `Godot_<Type>_Adapter`.
- The module uses only Godot, `com.IvanMurzak.Rql` and the BCL — never core-addon types: the authoring build
  compiles without the core, and the core discovers the module by `IRqlModule` in the consumer assembly.
- Undo and saving come from the core: a `set` or a call on a node / resource records its stored Godot
  properties, so put a method on the object it changes. Validate values in adapters (`validate:`) instead of
  clamping them: a rejected value fails the whole mutation.
- Every guide example runs in `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` (xUnit-asserted, in order); keep them runnable.
- Core pins (`McpPlugin`, `ReflectorNet`, `Rql`) equal the core addon's (`core_pin_drift` fails CI otherwise); bump with
  `commands/update-core.ps1`. GodotSharp must never become a package dep (see the recipe; CI asserts it).

```

`templates/extension/README.md`:

```md
# Godot extension scaffold

From the Godot-MCP repository root, run:

```sh
python scripts/new_extension.py MyFeature
```

This creates `extensions/Godot-AI-MyFeature/` and registers the module and both catalog
mirrors. The scaffold is an **RQL module** (`Editor/Rql/`): an `IRqlModule` that the core addon
discovers in the consumer assembly, a sample `myfeature` source, and the agent guide that the core
renders into its `godot-rql` skill. Agents use the extension through the core `rql-query` /
`rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` tools; an extension adds no MCP tools. Replace the sample with adapters
for the Godot types the feature covers (validated members, methods), sources and runnable guide
examples, and keep `tests/e2e/e2e-tools.json` running every guide example (the xUnit suite checks it).
Use the shared test suite and independent release workflow described in
[the monorepo guide](../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md) and the RQL design in [docs/rql.md](../../docs/rql.md).

The package remains source-only: consumer projects supply their own Godot SDK.
Keep `IncludeBuildOutput=false`, the package-named MSBuild props, and private GodotSharp
authoring references. Read [the packaging recipe](docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md).
Legacy standalone initialization scripts and workflow samples are retained as historical
scaffold material; the monorepo generator excludes them from active module workflows.

## Asset Library installation

The independent Asset Library entry is named **Godot MCP - YOUR_FEATURE** and becomes public after moderator approval.
It downloads only this extension from its versioned GitHub release. Install Godot MCP core
and configure its NuGet dependencies first, then install the archive into the project and build C#.
The archive includes its own license, README and installation instructions. Third-party addon
prerequisites listed above still apply. Use either this source installation or this extension
NuGet package in a project; installing both creates duplicate C# types.

See the [Asset Library release guide](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/blob/main/docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md#godot-asset-library).

```

`templates/extension/commands/bump-version.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Set the extension package version (the single source of truth: the package csproj <Version>).

.DESCRIPTION
    Updates <Version> in the source-only package csproj under src/. The release workflow is version-gated
    on this value (it publishes only when <Version> increases AND the tag does not yet exist).

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/bump-version.ps1 -NewVersion "1.0.1"
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/bump-version.ps1 -NewVersion "1.0.1" -WhatIf
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$NewVersion,
    [switch]$WhatIf
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "../extension.json")) {
    $pythonCommand = Get-Command py, python3, python -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $pythonCommand) { throw "Python 3 is required for the central version helper." }
    $pythonArguments = @()
    if ($pythonCommand.Name -match '^py(\.exe)?$') { $pythonArguments += '-3' }
    $pythonArguments += @((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "bump-version.py"), $NewVersion)
    if ($WhatIf) { $pythonArguments += '--what-if' }
    & $pythonCommand.Source @pythonArguments
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

if ($NewVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z\.\-]+)?$') {
    throw "Invalid semantic version: '$NewVersion' (expected major.minor.patch[-prerelease])."
}

$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$csproj = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot "src") -Recurse -Filter *.csproj |
    Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -match '<PackageId>' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $csproj) { throw "Could not find the package csproj (with <PackageId>) under src/." }

$content = Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw
if ($content -notmatch '<Version>([^<]+)</Version>') { throw "No <Version> element in $($csproj.Name)." }
$current = $Matches[1]
$new = $content -replace '<Version>[^<]+</Version>', "<Version>$NewVersion</Version>"

Write-Host "Package: $($csproj.Name)"
Write-Host "Version: $current -> $NewVersion"
if ($WhatIf) { Write-Host "(WhatIf — no changes written)" -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 }
Set-Content -Path $csproj.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline
Write-Host "Updated." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Remember to commit, then push to main to trigger the version-gated release."

```

`templates/extension/commands/bump-version.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Set the extension package version (the package csproj <Version>). POSIX/Python mirror of bump-version.ps1.

Usage:
  python commands/bump-version.py 1.0.1
  python commands/bump-version.py 1.0.1 --what-if
  python commands/bump-version.py --get        # print current version
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SEMVER = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.\-]+)?$")


def find_package_csproj(root: Path) -> Path:
    for p in (root / "src").rglob("*.csproj"):
        if "<PackageId>" in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
            return p
    raise SystemExit("error: could not find the package csproj (with <PackageId>) under src/")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("version", nargs="?", help="new semantic version, e.g. 1.0.1")
    ap.add_argument("--what-if", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--get", action="store_true", help="print current version and exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    if (root / "extension.json").is_file():
        # Keep the monorepo inventory and package README versions in sync.
        sys.path.insert(0, str(root.parents[1] / "scripts"))
        from extension_release import bump
        from extensions import modules, SEMVER as stable_version
        module = modules(only=[root.name])[0]
        if args.get:
            print(module["version"])
            return 0
        if not args.version or not stable_version.fullmatch(args.version):
            ap.error("pass a stable major.minor.patch version")
        if args.what_if:
            print(f"{module['name']}: {module['version']} -> {args.version} (what-if)")
            return 0
        bump(module, args.version)
        return 0
    csproj = find_package_csproj(root)
    content = csproj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r"<Version>([^<]+)</Version>", content)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(f"error: no <Version> element in {csproj.name}")
    current = m.group(1)

    if args.get:
        print(current)
        return 0

    if not args.version or not SEMVER.match(args.version):
        print("error: pass a semantic version major.minor.patch[-prerelease]", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    print(f"Package: {csproj.name}")
    print(f"Version: {current} -> {args.version}")
    if args.what_if:
        print("(what-if — no changes written)")
        return 0
    csproj.write_text(re.sub(r"<Version>[^<]+</Version>", f"<Version>{args.version}</Version>", content),
                       encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    print("Updated.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`templates/extension/commands/get-version.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
# Print the extension package version (the package csproj <Version>). Used by CI's version gate.
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$csproj = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot "src") -Recurse -Filter *.csproj |
    Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -match '<PackageId>' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $csproj) { Write-Error "Could not find the package csproj under src/."; exit 1 }
if ((Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw) -match '<Version>([^<]+)</Version>') { Write-Output $Matches[1]; exit 0 }
Write-Error "No <Version> in $($csproj.Name)."; exit 1

```

`templates/extension/commands/init.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Initialize a new Godot-MCP extension from this template: replace placeholders, rename files/folders,
    and activate the CI workflows.

.DESCRIPTION
    From a single -Feature name (PascalCase, e.g. "Particles") this derives and substitutes every
    placeholder, then renames any file/folder whose name contains YOUR_FEATURE, then activates CI by
    renaming `.github/workflows/*.yml-sample` -> `*.yml`.

    Derived values (override any with the matching parameter):
      Package id  : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>     (the NuGet <PackageId>)
      Repo        : IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-<Feature>          (-GitHubRepository)
      Display name: "<Feature> Tools"                       (-DisplayName)
      Description : "RQL module for Godot <Feature>."      (-Description)
      RQL source  : <feature-lowercased>                     (-SourceName; the module's RQL source name)

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/init.ps1 -Feature "Particles"

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/init.ps1 -Feature "Particles" -GitHubRepository "myuser/Godot-AI-Particles" -DisplayName "Particle Tools"
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string]$Feature,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$DisplayName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$Description,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$GitHubRepository,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$SourceName
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if ($Feature -notmatch '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$') {
    throw "Feature must be alphanumeric PascalCase (letters/digits, starts with a letter). Got: '$Feature'"
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DisplayName))      { $DisplayName = "$Feature Tools" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Description))       { $Description = "RQL module for Godot $Feature." }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($GitHubRepository))  { $GitHubRepository = "IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-$Feature" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SourceName))        { $SourceName = $Feature.ToLower() }

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$RepoRoot  = Split-Path -Parent $ScriptDir

# Longest tokens first so no token is a prefix of another mid-replacement.
$Replacements = [ordered]@{
    "YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY" = $GitHubRepository
    "YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME"               = $DisplayName
    "YOUR_DESCRIPTION"                = $Description
    "YOUR_SOURCE"                     = $SourceName
    "YOUR_FEATURE"                    = $Feature
}

Write-Host "Initializing Godot-MCP extension:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Feature      : $Feature"
Write-Host "  Package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.$Feature"
Write-Host "  Repository   : $GitHubRepository"
Write-Host "  Display name : $DisplayName"
Write-Host "  RQL source   : $SourceName"
Write-Host ""

$ExcludeDirs = @('.git', 'bin', 'obj', '.godot', 'local-nuget', '.vs')

function Test-Excluded([string]$path) {
    foreach ($d in $ExcludeDirs) {
        if ($path -match "[\\/]$([regex]::Escape($d))([\\/]|$)") { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

# 1) Replace placeholder content in all text files.
Write-Host "Replacing placeholders in file content..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$textExt = @('.cs','.csproj','.props','.targets','.md','.json','.yml','.yaml','.yml-sample','.godot','.config','.sh','.ps1','.py','.editorconfig','.gitignore','.txt')
Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoRoot -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object {
    $file = $_
    if (Test-Excluded $file.FullName) { return }
    if ($file.Name -eq 'init.ps1' -or $file.Name -eq 'init.py') { return }  # don't rewrite the running script
    $ext = $file.Extension.ToLower()
    $isText = ($textExt -contains $ext) -or ($file.Name -like '*.yml-sample') -or ($file.Name -eq 'LICENSE')
    if (-not $isText) { return }
    $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $content) { return }
    $new = $content
    foreach ($k in $Replacements.Keys) { $new = $new.Replace($k, $Replacements[$k]) }
    if ($new -ne $content) {
        Set-Content -Path $file.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline
        Write-Host "  updated $($file.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length+1))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

# 2) Rename files/folders whose NAME contains YOUR_FEATURE (deepest-first so children rename before parents).
Write-Host "Renaming files and folders..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoRoot -Recurse | Where-Object { -not (Test-Excluded $_.FullName) } |
    Sort-Object { $_.FullName.Length } -Descending | ForEach-Object {
        if ($_.Name -like '*YOUR_FEATURE*') {
            $newName = $_.Name.Replace('YOUR_FEATURE', $Feature)
            Rename-Item -Path $_.FullName -NewName $newName
            Write-Host "  renamed $($_.Name) -> $newName" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        }
    }

# 3) Activate CI: *.yml-sample -> *.yml
Write-Host "Activating CI workflows (*.yml-sample -> *.yml)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$wf = Join-Path $RepoRoot ".github/workflows"
if (Test-Path $wf) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $wf -Filter "*.yml-sample" | ForEach-Object {
        $target = $_.FullName -replace '\.yml-sample$', '.yml'
        Move-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $target -Force
        Write-Host "  activated $($_.Name) -> $([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($target))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Done. Next:" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  1. Review the changes, then build + test:"
Write-Host "       dotnet build src/Godot-AI-$Feature/Godot-AI-$Feature.csproj"
Write-Host "       dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-$Feature.Tests/Godot-AI-$Feature.Tests.csproj"
Write-Host "  2. Write the RQL module under src/Godot-AI-$Feature/Editor/Rql (adapters, sources, guide; see AGENTS.md)."
Write-Host "  3. Configure the NUGET_API_KEY secret, then push to main with a bumped <Version> to release."

```

`templates/extension/commands/init.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Initialize a new Godot-MCP extension from this template (POSIX/Python path; mirrors init.ps1).

From a single --feature name (PascalCase, e.g. "Particles") this substitutes every placeholder, renames
files/folders whose name contains YOUR_FEATURE, then activates CI (*.yml-sample -> *.yml).

Derived (override with the matching flag):
  package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>
  repo         : IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-<Feature>      (--github-repository)
  display name : "<Feature> Tools"                   (--display-name)
  description  : "RQL module for Godot <Feature>."  (--description)
  RQL source   : <feature lowercased>                 (--source-name; the module's source, e.g. "particles | select …")

Usage:
  python commands/init.py --feature Particles
  python commands/init.py --feature Particles --github-repository myuser/Godot-AI-Particles
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {".git", "bin", "obj", ".godot", "local-nuget", ".vs"}
TEXT_EXT = {".cs", ".csproj", ".props", ".targets", ".md", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml",
            ".yml-sample", ".godot", ".config", ".sh", ".ps1", ".py", ".editorconfig",
            ".gitignore", ".txt"}
SELF = {"init.py", "init.ps1"}


def is_excluded(path: Path, root: Path) -> bool:
    rel_parts = path.relative_to(root).parts
    return any(part in EXCLUDE_DIRS for part in rel_parts)


def is_text(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name
    if name == "LICENSE":
        return True
    if name.endswith(".yml-sample"):
        return True
    return path.suffix.lower() in TEXT_EXT


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Initialize a Godot-MCP extension from the template.")
    ap.add_argument("--feature", required=True, help="PascalCase feature name, e.g. Particles")
    ap.add_argument("--display-name")
    ap.add_argument("--description")
    ap.add_argument("--github-repository")
    ap.add_argument("--source-name")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    feature = args.feature
    if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$", feature):
        print(f"error: --feature must be alphanumeric PascalCase. Got: {feature!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    display = args.display_name or f"{feature} Tools"
    description = args.description or f"RQL module for Godot {feature}."
    repo = args.github_repository or f"IvanMurzak/Godot-AI-{feature}"
    source = args.source_name or feature.lower()

    # Longest tokens first so no token is a prefix of another mid-replacement.
    replacements = [
        ("YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY", repo),
        ("YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME", display),
        ("YOUR_DESCRIPTION", description),
        ("YOUR_SOURCE", source),
        ("YOUR_FEATURE", feature),
    ]

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

    print("Initializing Godot-MCP extension:")
    print(f"  Feature      : {feature}")
    print(f"  Package id   : com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.{feature}")
    print(f"  Repository   : {repo}")
    print(f"  Display name : {display}")
    print(f"  RQL source   : {source}\n")

    # 1) Replace placeholder content.
    print("Replacing placeholders in file content...")
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file() or is_excluded(path, root) or path.name in SELF or not is_text(path):
            continue
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
            continue
        new = text
        for token, value in replacements:
            new = new.replace(token, value)
        if new != text:
            path.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
            print(f"  updated {path.relative_to(root)}")

    # 2) Rename files/folders containing YOUR_FEATURE, deepest-first.
    print("Renaming files and folders...")
    entries = [p for p in root.rglob("*") if not is_excluded(p, root)]
    for path in sorted(entries, key=lambda p: len(str(p)), reverse=True):
        if "YOUR_FEATURE" in path.name:
            new_name = path.name.replace("YOUR_FEATURE", feature)
            path.rename(path.with_name(new_name))
            print(f"  renamed {path.name} -> {new_name}")

    # 3) Activate CI.
    print("Activating CI workflows (*.yml-sample -> *.yml)...")
    wf = root / ".github" / "workflows"
    if wf.is_dir():
        for sample in wf.glob("*.yml-sample"):
            target = sample.with_name(sample.name[: -len("-sample")])
            sample.replace(target)
            print(f"  activated {sample.name} -> {target.name}")

    print("\nDone. Next:")
    print(f"  dotnet build src/Godot-AI-{feature}/Godot-AI-{feature}.csproj")
    print(f"  dotnet test  tests/Godot-AI-{feature}.Tests/Godot-AI-{feature}.Tests.csproj")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`templates/extension/commands/update-core.ps1`:

```ps1
#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Update the core MCP / reflection / query pins (com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin / com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet /
    com.IvanMurzak.Rql) in lockstep across the package, tests, and testbed csproj files.

.DESCRIPTION
    These pins MUST equal the core Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP/Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py
    core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise); com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL module API. When the core advances its pins,
    run this in the same change. Pass any of the three.

.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -McpPlugin "6.11.0"
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -McpPlugin "6.11.0" -ReflectorNet "5.4.0" -WhatIf
.EXAMPLE
    ./commands/update-core.ps1 -Rql "0.2.0"
#>
param(
    [string]$McpPlugin,
    [string]$ReflectorNet,
    [string]$Rql,
    [switch]$WhatIf
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
if (-not $McpPlugin -and -not $ReflectorNet -and -not $Rql) { throw "Pass -McpPlugin, -ReflectorNet and/or -Rql." }

$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)
$targets = @('src', 'tests', 'testbed') | ForEach-Object {
    $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $_
    if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Recurse -Filter *.csproj }
}

$pins = @{}
if ($McpPlugin)    { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin']  = $McpPlugin }
if ($ReflectorNet) { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet'] = $ReflectorNet }
if ($Rql)          { $pins['com.IvanMurzak.Rql']          = $Rql }

foreach ($csproj in $targets) {
    $content = Get-Content $csproj.FullName -Raw
    $new = $content
    foreach ($id in $pins.Keys) {
        $pattern = '(<PackageReference\s+Include="' + [regex]::Escape($id) + '"\s+Version=")[^"]+(")'
        $new = [regex]::Replace($new, $pattern, "`${1}$($pins[$id])`${2}")
    }
    if ($new -ne $content) {
        Write-Host "Updating $($csproj.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length+1))"
        foreach ($id in $pins.Keys) { Write-Host "  $id -> $($pins[$id])" }
        if (-not $WhatIf) { Set-Content -Path $csproj.FullName -Value $new -NoNewline }
    }
}
if ($WhatIf) { Write-Host "(WhatIf — no changes written)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
else { Write-Host "Done. Rebuild + test to confirm compatibility." -ForegroundColor Green }

`templates/extension/commands/update-core.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Update the core MCP / reflection / query pins in lockstep across package/tests/testbed. Mirror of update-core.ps1.

The pins (com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin, com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet, com.IvanMurzak.Rql = the RQL module API) must
EQUAL the core Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP/Godot-MCP.csproj); scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise.

Usage:
  python commands/update-core.py --mcp-plugin 6.11.0
  python commands/update-core.py --mcp-plugin 6.11.0 --reflector-net 5.4.0 --what-if
  python commands/update-core.py --rql 0.2.0
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--mcp-plugin")
    ap.add_argument("--reflector-net")
    ap.add_argument("--rql")
    ap.add_argument("--what-if", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not args.mcp_plugin and not args.reflector_net and not args.rql:
        raise SystemExit("error: pass --mcp-plugin, --reflector-net and/or --rql")

    pins = {}
    if args.mcp_plugin:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin"] = args.mcp_plugin
    if args.reflector_net:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet"] = args.reflector_net
    if args.rql:
        pins["com.IvanMurzak.Rql"] = args.rql

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    csprojs = []
    for sub in ("src", "tests", "testbed"):
        d = root / sub
        if d.is_dir():
            csprojs += list(d.rglob("*.csproj"))

    for csproj in csprojs:
        content = csproj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        new = content
        for pid, ver in pins.items():
            new = re.sub(
                r'(<PackageReference\s+Include="' + re.escape(pid) + r'"\s+Version=")[^"]+(")',
                r"\g<1>" + ver + r"\g<2>", new)
        if new != content:
            print(f"Updating {csproj.relative_to(root)}")
            for pid, ver in pins.items():
                print(f"  {pid} -> {ver}")
            if not args.what_if:
                csproj.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")

    print("(what-if — no changes written)" if args.what_if else "Done. Rebuild + test to confirm.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

`templates/extension/docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md`:

```md
# The source-only NuGet recipe (the centerpiece)

A Godot-MCP extension is distributed as a **source-only** NuGet package: it ships C# **source**, not a
compiled DLL. The source compiles **inside the consumer's Godot project**, against the **consumer's own
GodotSharp**. This is what lets one package work across Godot versions with no bundled engine and no
version lock.

This recipe is **verified** end-to-end with `dotnet` alone (no Godot binary): build the package → unit
test → `dotnet pack` → restore+build a consumer `Godot.NET.Sdk` project that references it → the injected
source compiles clean against the consumer's GodotSharp.

## Why not a normal (DLL) package?

The RQL module calls Godot's C# API (`Node`, `Resource`, `EditorInterface`, …) which lives in
**GodotSharp**. A pre-compiled DLL is built against **one** GodotSharp version and is therefore locked to
it — a consumer on a different Godot version gets binary-incompatibility. Shipping **source** sidesteps
this: the consumer is itself a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, so its build supplies GodotSharp at compile time
and our source compiles against *that* exact version.

## The three levers (in the package csproj)

```xml
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">   <!-- min-version floor; consumer uses its own -->
  <PropertyGroup>
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>            <!-- (1) ship no DLL -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>  <!-- (3) -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is a package dependency (the consumer already has it); pins = the core's. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin"   Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql"         Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- (3) GodotSharp is needed to COMPILE locally but must NOT be a package dependency. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp"            Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor"      Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- (2) Pack the .cs as plain files under src/ + the injection props under build/. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Editor/**/*.cs"  Pack="true" PackagePath="src/Editor/" />
    <None Include="build/<PackageId>.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

**Lever 1 — no DLL.** `IncludeBuildOutput=false` keeps the compiled assembly out of the package; the
package's payload is the `.cs` files + the injection props.

**Lever 2 — inject source as `<Compile>` in the consumer.** The `.cs` are packed as plain files under
`src/`. The package ships `build/<PackageId>.props`, which **NuGet auto-imports** into any consuming
project (this is why the file MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props`). The props adds the packed `.cs`
as `<Compile>` items:

```xml
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="<PackageId>\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

`$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)` resolves into the NuGet cache (`…/<package>/<version>/build/`), so
`..\src\**\*.cs` is the packed source. The consumer's own default glob never reaches the cache, so
`Exclude="@(Compile)"` is just belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion.

**Lever 3 — declare NO GodotSharp dependency.** The authoring project uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` so the
`Godot` namespace resolves and `#if TOOLS` compiles locally — but GodotSharp must NOT leak into the
package's dependency list (the consumer provides its own). Two steps are required because a plain
`<PackageReference Update="GodotSharp" PrivateAssets="all">` in the project body **does not work** (the
SDK adds GodotSharp *after* the body is evaluated, so there is nothing to update yet):

1. `DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences=true` drops the SDK's implicit `GodotSharp` + `GodotSharpEditor`.
2. Re-add `GodotSharp`/`GodotSharpEditor` explicitly with `PrivateAssets="all"` (kept for the local
   compile, excluded from the package deps). `Godot.SourceGenerators` has **no** SDK opt-out, so it is
   re-stated as an explicit `Include … PrivateAssets="all"` (this duplicates the implicit add → the
   harmless `NU1504`, suppressed via `NoWarn`).

Verify it worked by inspecting the generated `.nuspec` — its `<dependencies>` must list **only**
`com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin`, `com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet` and `com.IvanMurzak.Rql`, with **no** `GodotSharp` /
`Godot.SourceGenerators`. CI asserts exactly this (`scripts/extensions.py` `verify_package`).

## Why `build/*.props` injection, not `contentFiles`?

NuGet's `contentFiles` with `buildAction="Compile"` is the other documented way to inject source. We use
the **`build/*.props`** mechanism instead because:

- **SDK-agnostic and deterministic.** It is plain MSBuild `<Compile Include>` — it does not depend on
  NuGet's `contentFiles`-Compile auto-injection behaving identically under `Godot.NET.Sdk` (which
  customizes globbing); the props is auto-imported the same way for every SDK.
- **One obvious file to read and override.** The whole injection is one short, visible props file rather
  than `contentFiles` metadata split between the nuspec and NuGet's restore-generated targets.
- **No double-compile risk.** `EnableDefaultNoneItems=false` + the explicit `<None Pack>` list controls
  exactly what ships; the consumer's project-dir glob never overlaps the cache.

`contentFiles` remains a valid alternative; if you switch, drop the props and pack the `.cs` under
`contentFiles/cs/any/…` with `buildAction="Compile"`, and re-verify the consumer build + the `.nuspec`
dependency list.

## Editor-only API: `#if TOOLS`

The RQL module, its adapters and sources sit behind `#if TOOLS`: RQL is the editor's data layer, so they
compile in the editor and are excluded from shipped games — exactly as in the core addon (Godot defines
`TOOLS` for the editor/Debug build and **not** for an exported game build). The agent guide and other
pure-managed helpers (validation rules, label maps) stay outside the guard so they are CI-unit-testable.
The core runs every RQL query on the editor main thread, so module code may touch `Node` / `Resource` /
`EditorInterface` directly.

## The consumer story

1. The consumer is a Godot **C#** project with the core `godot_mcp` addon enabled (which already
   references `com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin`, `com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet` and `com.IvanMurzak.Rql`).
2. Installing the extension adds one line to the consumer's `.csproj`:
   `<PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>" Version="x.y.z" />`
   (done by the **Extensions dock**, `godot-cli install-extension`, or by hand).
3. Rebuild. NuGet imports `build/<PackageId>.props` → the extension's `.cs` compile into the consumer's
   single project assembly against the consumer's GodotSharp.
4. The core's RQL engine discovers the module (`IRqlModule`) in the project assembly — **no registry edit**.
   Its adapters, sources and guide appear in `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema` and the `godot-rql`
   skill, inside the user's real Godot editor.

## Publishing & the shared catalog

`release.yml` publishes the source-only package to NuGet (version-gated) and cuts an atomic GitHub
Release. To make the extension appear in the in-editor **Extensions** dock and `godot-cli
install-extension`, append one entry to the shared catalog `addons/godot_mcp/extensions.catalog.json` in
**Godot-MCP** (schema in `extensions.catalog.md`): `name`, `description`, `packageId`
(`com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.<Feature>`), optional `version`, `gitUrl`, and `tools` (empty for an RQL module). That
single source of truth is consumed by the dock, the CLI, and the app.

```

`templates/extension/src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/Editor/Rql/YOUR_FEATUREApi.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using Godot;
using Rql;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The <c>YOUR_SOURCE</c> source: a view object whose public members RQL reads and whose <c>[RqlCallable]</c>
    /// methods <c>rql-mutate</c> calls. Every RQL call runs on the editor main thread, so the Godot editor API is safe here.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class YOUR_FEATUREApi
    {
        public static readonly YOUR_FEATUREApi Instance = new YOUR_FEATUREApi();

        [RqlDescription("the running Godot version, e.g. \"4.5.1-stable (official)\"")]
        public string godotVersion => (string)Engine.GetVersionInfo()["string"];

        [RqlDescription("the editor UI scale")]
        public float editorScale => EditorInterface.Singleton.GetEditorScale();

        [RqlCallable("return the message, or \"YOUR_SOURCE-ready\" when it is empty")]
        public string Echo(string? message = null) => EchoText(message);

        /// <summary>Pure-managed logic of <see cref="Echo"/> (unit-tested).</summary>
        public static string EchoText(string? message) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(message) ? "YOUR_SOURCE-ready" : message!;
    }
}
#endif

`templates/extension/src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/Editor/Rql/YOUR_FEATUREModule.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#if TOOLS
#nullable enable
using Rql.Execution;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The extension's RQL module. The core addon discovers every public <see cref="IRqlModule"/> in the loaded assemblies,
    /// so this one is active as soon as the package's sources compile into the consumer's Godot project — no registry edit.
    /// What it contributes appears in the core <c>rql-query</c> / <c>rql-mutate</c> / <c>rql-schema</c> tools and its guide
    /// in the <c>godot-rql</c> skill; the extension needs no MCP tools of its own.
    /// <para>
    /// Typical contributions (see the Godot-AI-* extensions): <c>ctx.AddAdapter(new Godot_&lt;Type&gt;_Adapter())</c> for a
    /// Godot type (validated members that replace C# properties, virtual members, <c>Method</c> / <c>Function</c> calls,
    /// <c>Expose("Name")</c> for an existing C# method), <c>ctx.AddSource</c> for state no node owns, and
    /// <c>ctx.AddGuide</c>. Writes are undoable when their target is the Godot object that changes (the core snapshots the
    /// stored properties of every changed node / resource), so put a method on the object it modifies.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class YOUR_FEATUREModule : IRqlModule
    {
        /// <summary>Configuration order: the core uses 0 and 10, extensions 100.</summary>
        public int Order => 100;

        public void Configure(RqlModuleContext ctx) =>
            ctx.AddSource("YOUR_SOURCE", () => YOUR_FEATUREApi.Instance,
                    "YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME: godotVersion, editorScale; call Echo(message)")
               .AddGuide(YOUR_FEATUREGuide.Topic, YOUR_FEATUREGuide.Markdown);
    }
}
#endif

`templates/extension/src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.csproj`:

```csproj
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE-ONLY NuGet package recipe — the load-bearing detail of a Godot-MCP extension.          │
  │  Full rationale + the consumer story: docs/source-only-nuget-recipe.md.                        │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Why source-only? An extension's RQL module (adapters, sources, methods) calls Godot's C# API (Node,
  Resource, EditorInterface, …). Shipping a
  pre-compiled DLL would LOCK the package to one GodotSharp version. Instead we ship the .cs SOURCE and
  let it compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project, against the CONSUMER's own GodotSharp (supplied by
  their `Godot.NET.Sdk`). No bundled Godot, no version lock.

  How (3 levers):
    1. <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>  — do NOT put this project's compiled DLL in the package.
    2. The .cs are packed under `src/` (plain files) and injected as <Compile> items in the consumer by
       `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet). See that props file.
    3. NO GodotSharp dependency is declared (DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences + PrivateAssets=all below)
       — the consumer provides it. Only the MCP / reflection / query stack is declared as a (min-version) dependency,
       which the consumer already has via the core Godot-MCP addon.

  This project ALSO uses `Godot.NET.Sdk` for AUTHORING only: so the editor-only module (#if TOOLS) compiles
  + the `Godot` namespace resolves when you build/test locally.
  No Godot binary is needed — `Godot.NET.Sdk` pulls `GodotSharp` from NuGet at compile time.
-->
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.3.0">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <RootNamespace>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE</AssemblyName>

    <!-- ===== Package identity (bump-version.ps1 / get-version.ps1 own the Version element) ===== -->
    <IsPackable>true</IsPackable>
    <PackageId>com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE</PackageId>
    <Version>0.1.0</Version>
    <Title>YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME</Title>
    <Authors>Ivan Murzak</Authors>
    <Description>YOUR_DESCRIPTION</Description>
    <PackageTags>godot;mcp;ai;tools;godot-mcp;ai-game-developer</PackageTags>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>Apache-2.0</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY</RepositoryUrl>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME_REPOSITORY</PackageProjectUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>

    <!-- ===== Source-only levers ===== -->
    <!-- 1) Do not ship the compiled DLL; the consumer compiles our source against their GodotSharp. -->
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>
    <!-- NU5128: source-only package (dependencies but no lib/ref) — expected, silence it.
         NU1504: Godot.SourceGenerators is re-stated PrivateAssets=all to keep it out of deps (see below). -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5128;NU1504</NoWarn>
    <NoPackageAnalysis>true</NoPackageAnalysis>
    <!-- We hand-pick exactly which files ship (below); turn off default None globbing to avoid duplicates. -->
    <EnableDefaultNoneItems>false</EnableDefaultNoneItems>
    <!-- Drop the SDK's implicit GodotSharp/GodotSharpEditor so we can re-add them PrivateAssets=all (a body
         <PackageReference Update> does NOT work — the SDK adds them after the project body is evaluated). -->
    <DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>true</DisableImplicitGodotSharpReferences>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!--
    Package DEPENDENCIES: only the engine-agnostic MCP / reflection / query stack (com.IvanMurzak.Rql is the RQL
    module API: IRqlModule, type adapters). A NuGet Version="x" is a ">= x" floor; the pins EQUAL the core
    Godot-MCP addon's (Godot-MCP.csproj; scripts/extensions.py core_pin_drift fails CI otherwise): a lower
    ReflectorNet than the McpPlugin requires is a NU1605 downgrade, a higher pin cannot restore in a consumer
    pinned to the core. `update-core.ps1` / `update-core.py` keep package, tests and testbed in lockstep.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.ReflectorNet" Version="5.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.McpPlugin" Version="8.14.0-dev.e8985d5" />
    <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Rql" Version="0.3.0-dev.0f1bf94" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    GodotSharp is needed for AUTHORING compile only, NOT as a package dependency (the consumer supplies its
    own, version-matched). PrivateAssets=all stops these flowing into the package's dependency list — this
    is the "no GodotSharp dependency" guarantee, verified by inspecting the generated .nuspec.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharp" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <PackageReference Include="GodotSharpEditor" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug'" />
    <!-- Godot.SourceGenerators has no SDK opt-out property, so re-state it (Include) PrivateAssets=all to
         keep it out of the package deps too. This duplicates the SDK's implicit add -> NU1504 (suppressed
         above). The analyzer still runs locally (PrivateAssets governs only what flows to CONSUMERS). -->
    <PackageReference Include="Godot.SourceGenerators" Version="4.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    What ships in the .nupkg:
      • the .cs SOURCE under `src/` (plain files — NOT contentFiles; injected by the props below),
      • `build/<PackageId>.props` (auto-imported by NuGet in the consumer; does the <Compile> injection),
      • README.md (package page).
    The .cs are <Compile> items in THIS authoring build (Godot.NET.Sdk default glob) so they compile +
    unit-test locally; adding them to <None Pack="true"> just also bundles them into the package.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Editor/**/*.cs" Pack="true" PackagePath="src/Editor/" />
    <None Include="build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE.props" Pack="true" PackagePath="build/" />
    <None Include="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

```

`templates/extension/src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/README.md`:

```md
# YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME

YOUR_DESCRIPTION

A **source-only** RQL-module extension for [Godot-MCP / AI Game Developer](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP).
The package ships C# source (no compiled DLL, no bundled Godot) that compiles inside your Godot project
against your own GodotSharp, so it never locks you to a Godot version.

## Install

Requires the core [`godot_mcp`](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP) addon in your Godot C# project.

```bash
# via the godot-cli (resolves from the shared catalog, edits your .csproj, rebuilds)
godot-cli install-extension com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE

# …or add the reference manually and rebuild:
#   <PackageReference Include="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE" Version="0.1.0" />
```

…or pick it from the **Extensions** dock inside the Godot editor.

After a rebuild, the core discovers the extension's RQL module (`IRqlModule`) in the project assembly — no
registry edit. The extension adds no MCP tools: agents use it through the core `rql-query` / `rql-mutate` /
`rql-schema` tools, and its guide is part of the core `godot-rql` skill.

## RQL

```
YOUR_SOURCE | select godotVersion editorScale
YOUR_SOURCE | call Echo("ci-roundtrip")
```

License: Apache-2.0.

```

`templates/extension/src/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE/build/com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE.props`:

```props
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  SOURCE INJECTION — the consumer half of the source-only package recipe.                       │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  NuGet auto-imports `build/<PackageId>.props` into any project that references this package. This file
  MUST be named exactly `<PackageId>.props` (com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE.props) or NuGet will
  not import it. `bump-version` / `init` keep the name in lockstep with <PackageId>.

  It adds this package's packed `.cs` (which sit in the NuGet cache under `<package>/<version>/src/`) as
  <Compile> items in the CONSUMER's project, so they compile INSIDE the consumer's Godot project against
  the consumer's own GodotSharp. Because the consumer is a `Godot.NET.Sdk` project, `Godot` types resolve
  and `#if TOOLS` is defined for the editor build — exactly as if the source lived in the consumer's repo.

  • $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory) resolves to `<package>/<version>/build/` in the NuGet cache, so
    `../src/**/*.cs` is the packed source.
  • Exclude="@(Compile)" is belt-and-suspenders against double-inclusion (the consumer's own default
    glob never reaches the NuGet cache, so it normally excludes nothing).
  • Link groups the injected files under the package id in IDEs (cosmetic).
-->
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\src\**\*.cs"
             Exclude="@(Compile)"
             Link="com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE\%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>

```

`templates/extension/tests/Godot-AI-YOUR_FEATURE.Tests/YOUR_FEATUREModuleTests.cs`:

```cs
/*
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Author: Ivan Murzak (https://github.com/IvanMurzak)             │
│  Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak                                  │
│  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.                 │
│  See the LICENSE file in the project root for more information.  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
*/
#nullable enable
using System.Linq;
using Rql.Execution;
using Xunit;

namespace com.IvanMurzak.Godot.MCP.YOUR_FEATURE.Tests
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The module configures cleanly in a plain RQL engine: it is discovered, registers its source and guide, and the source's
    /// view type exposes its members and callable methods. Metadata only: no member that touches the Godot editor is read.
    /// </summary>
    public class YOUR_FEATUREModuleTests
    {
        private static RqlEngine Engine()
        {
            var engine = new RqlEngine();
            var reports = engine.AddModulesFrom(new[] { typeof(YOUR_FEATUREModule).Assembly });
            Assert.All(reports, r => Assert.True(r.Ok, r.ToString()));
            Assert.Contains(reports, r => r.Module == typeof(YOUR_FEATUREModule).FullName);
            return engine;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ModuleRegistersItsSourceAndGuide()
        {
            var engine = Engine();
            Assert.True(engine.Sources.ContainsKey("YOUR_SOURCE"));
            var guide = Assert.Single(engine.Guides, g => g.Key == YOUR_FEATUREGuide.Topic);
            Assert.Equal(YOUR_FEATUREGuide.Markdown, guide.Value);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SourceTypeHasItsMembersAndEcho()
        {
            var info = Engine().Types.Info(typeof(YOUR_FEATUREApi));
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "godotVersion" && !m.CanWrite);
            Assert.Contains(info.Members, m => m.Name == "editorScale");
            Assert.Contains(info.Callable, c => c.Name == "Echo");
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(null, "YOUR_SOURCE-ready")]
        [InlineData("", "YOUR_SOURCE-ready")]
        [InlineData("ci-roundtrip", "ci-roundtrip")]
        public void EchoReturnsTheMessageOrTheReadyText(string? message, string expected) =>
            Assert.Equal(expected, YOUR_FEATUREApi.EchoText(message));
    }
}
